motions.title: West Leederville Kerbside Parking Review – Workshop
motions.description: That: (i) further reports be prepared with a view to introducing: (a) increased 'No Stopping' distance at intersections; (b) timed kerbside parking restrictions adjacent to commercial properties; (c) review of Town Planning Scheme for on site parking; (d) 'No Parking Road or Verge Residential Parking Permit Exempt' restrictions adjacent to residential properties; (e) yellow kerbside line marking to reinforce 'No Stopping' signs; (f) paid parking meters adjacent to commercial properties or zones; (ii) yellow line markings be installed in Salvado Road adjacent to Matthews Netball Centre and St John of God Hospital with funds up to $1,500 from budget account M924; (iii) administration recommendations from TS04.90 and TS05.03 be used as guide.

motions.title: Oceanic Drive/Howtree Place/Brookdale Street/Floreat Avenue Intersection – Traffic Design
motions.description: That: (i) the development of a design for a roundabout at the Oceanic Drive/Howtree Place/Brookdale Street/Floreat Avenue intersection not proceed; (ii) any future proposal to develop a design for a roundabout should recognise the requirement to: (a) consider rezoning of adjacent residential land on the eastern side of Floreat Avenue to commercial; (b) consider the current traffic volumes, change of traffic volumes and degree of accuracy of estimation of future traffic volumes; (c) review most recent accident statistics; (d) conduct a SIDRA Analysis on the intersection.

motions.title: Railway Parade/Southport Street Intersection – Traffic Management
motions.description: That: (i) the proposal to proceed with the design of a roundabout at the Railway Parade/Southport Street intersection be endorsed; (ii) the preliminary and detailed road design for a roundabout be progressed and statutory approvals be sought from Main Roads WA. Negotiations be commenced for acquisition of land from the PTA; (iii) funding for design and approvals be considered within the Draft Budget for 2007/2008; (iv) a report be submitted to Council when issues associated with the proposal have progressed.

motions.title: Holyrood Park Draft Improvement Plan
motions.description: That: (i) the Draft Holyrood Park Improvement Plan (Plan No. P658-06-01) be approved for public comment subject to amendments: (a) the croquet clubhouse to remain as a building for potential community use and an assessment of upgrades required be carried out; (b) the playground to be relocated to the area depicted as 'seating area 2.2' and to be a similar size as the existing playground; (c) deletion of the concrete path between the croquet clubhouse and the Town Hall; (d) deletion of the hard-stand parking bay in the grassed car park; (e) add a new annotation 'Investigate opportunities for disabled parking'; (f) add a new annotation 'Investigate suitable relocation of the sculptures but keeping them within the park'; (ii) public comments be assessed and the Draft Plan be finalised and submitted to Council for further consideration and endorsement.

motions.title: Rutter Park – Install Playground Shade Shelter Petition
motions.description: That: (i) an audit be conducted of the playgrounds in the Town and a plan be developed on the cost and maintenance of the provision of shade shelters as per the recommendations of the Playground Management Plan as adopted by Council in February 2000 (Item TS00.01); (ii) an amount of $12,000 be included for consideration in the 2007/2008 draft budget for the design, supply and installation of a shade shelter at Rutter Park.

A report with costings be provided for consideration to upgrade this existing toilet facility.

motions.title: Lake Monger – Interpretive Information Signage
motions.description: That: (i) Conservation and Land Management be appointed to develop final designs, artwork and signage at a total cost of $18,200; (ii) the Lake Monger logo (Number 4) as generally recommended by the Lake Monger Working Group with the addition of the Town's logo be approved, options with and without the sun required; (iii) the increase of the Nature Trail budget by an additional $19,000 to $119,000 be approved; (iv) costs in (i) above be charged to Budget Item 'Lake Monger Nature Trail'; (v) the additional $19,000 required be funded from the Public Open Space Reserve fund and authorised by an ABSOLUTE MAJORITY as unbudgeted expenditure in accordance with Section 6.8 of the Local Government Act 1995; (vi) the design workshop to finalise designs, artwork and signs be scheduled for inclusion at the next Lake Monger Working Group Meeting on Thursday 26 August 1999.

motions.title: Lake Monger – Nature Trail (Boardwalk, Lookout Bridges and Information Booth)
motions.description: That: (i) the appointment of Conservation and Land Management be approved to supply all materials, labour and supervision to construct a boardwalk, three bridges and a lookout, at a cost of $95,830, together with an information booth at the Dodd Street end of Lake Monger at a cost of $18,000; (ii) costs in (i) above be charged to Budget Items 'Lake Monger Nature Trail' and 'Lake Monger Information Centre' respectively.

motions.title: Federal Road Safety Black Spot Program 2000/2001
motions.description: That the following projects be endorsed for submission within the 2000/2001 Federal Black Spot Program: (i) The Boulevard/Howtree Place Intersection; (ii) The Boulevard/Grantham Street Intersection; (iii) The Boulevard/Empire Avenue Intersection; (iv) Grantham Street/Brookdale Street Intersection; (v) The Boulevard/Brookdale Street Intersection.

motions.title: A Class Reserve Status for Land North of Oceanic Drive
motions.description: That as the owner of the land located between Oceanic Drive and The Boulevard and in recognition of the System 6 and other environmental recommendations, the Town of Cambridge shall apply for A Class Reserve status for the area, as surveyed to the Town's satisfaction, vested in the Town, and that all remaining bushland in that area shall be maintained as natural and indigenous bushland in perpetuity, compatible with the environmental management of the Bold Regional Park and associated bushland.

motions.title: Environmental Management Programme for Degraded Areas
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge:- (i) affirms its obligation to prepare an Environmental Management Programme for the degraded areas as outlined in the Land Use Strategy for Bold Park and Environs (635) Statement issued by the Minister for the Environment in February 1995; (ii) will rehabilitate those degraded areas to their natural and indigenous bushland setting to be maintained in perpetuity, compatible with the environmental management of the Bold Regional Park and associated bushland.

motions.title: Incorporation of Area H into Bold Regional Park
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge is of the view that the area of land designated as Area H as described on Plan 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement, be incorporated into the Bold Regional Park area.

motions.title: Incorporation of Area F into Bold Regional Park
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge is of the view that the area of land between the Cottesloe Golf Course and Fortview Street in Mount Claremont, described as Area F on Plan 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement, be incorporated into the Bold Regional Park area.

motions.title: Area F to Remain as Bushland Buffer Zone
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge is of the view that the area of land between the Cottesloe Golf Course and Fortview Street in Mount Claremont, described as Area F on Plan 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement, remain as bushland to act as a buffer zone between the Cottesloe Golf Course, the Christ Church Grammar School playing fields and the Bold Regional Park.

motions.title: Support for Creation of Bold Regional Park with Amended Boundaries
motions.description: That the Council supports the initiative to create the Bold Regional Park as proposed by the Government of Western Australia, with the following amendments to the prescribed boundaries:- (i) to exclude the area of land designated as Alderbury Reserve and Perry Lakes Reserve as described on Plan No. 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement; (ii) to include the area of land designated as Area H and described as the land located between the Christ Church Grammar School playing fields and Rochdale Road as described on Plan No. 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement.

motions.description: That Council immediately seeks a meeting with Main Roads WA in order to request them to reallocate funds, as a priority, in order to resolve the dangerous situation regarding vehicle access from the West Coast Highway to Floreat Beach.

motions.title: TravelSmart Individualised Marketing

motions.description: That the directional sign on the southwest corner of Kilpa Court and Brompton Road be moved three metres back from the kerb to give motorists adequate sight distance to safely enter Brompton Road from Kilpa Court.

motions.title: Construction Works – Four capital works projects

motions.title: Leave of Absence – Cr Corinne MacRae
motions.description: That in accordance with Clause 2.9 of the Standing Orders, Cr Corinne MacRae be granted Leave of Absence from 8 to 21 July 1998 inclusive.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes – Ordinary Meeting 26 May 1998

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes – Special Meeting 9 June 1998
motions.description: That the Minutes of the Special Meeting of the Council held on 9 June 1998 be confirmed.

motions.title: Northwood Street – Local Area Traffic Management Petition
motions.description: That: (i) the petition relating to Local Area Traffic Management in Northwood Street be received; (ii) prior to reconsidering further work in the local area traffic management precinct bounded by Lake Monger Drive, Harborne Street, Cambridge Street and Southport Street within the 1998/99 Budget, consideration be given to assessing the impact of the most recent works in Kimberley and Ruislip Streets; (iii) in assessing further works priorities within the region, the current Main Roads WA policies be acknowledged and people in Northwood Street and other significant locations within the precinct be consulted.

motions.title: Local Area Traffic Management – Entry Statements
motions.description: That: (i) it is Council's intention that the flush red hotmix entry statements, as approved in TS97.78 July 1997 and TS97.140 November 1997, proceed; (ii) the Minister for Transport be requested to direct Main Roads WA to approve the erection of appropriate signage for local residential precincts and be advised that this area is representative of traffic problems within the metropolitan area; (iii) a meeting be arranged with His Worship the Mayor and/or his representative, the Chief Executive Officer and the Minister for Transport to discuss this issue; (iv) a progress report be submitted to the next meeting of the Technical Services Committee.

motions.title: West Leederville Traffic Calming – Kimberley, Woolwich Intersection
motions.description: That: (i) parking embayments or appropriate treatments at the Kimberley Street/Woolwich Street intersection be considered within the 1998/99 Budget; (ii) the development of the Local Area Traffic Management in Kimberley Street be considered within the 1998/99 Budget; (iii) the need for, and detailed design of, the parking embayments be clarified and discussed with local residents.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Drive – Traffic Management
motions.description: That: (i) appropriate signs namely, 40kph plus an information sign designating 'Perry Lakes Picnic Area', accompanied by a change of road texture, possibly red hotmix entry statements, speed reduction devices and other measures be progressively considered for Perry Lakes Drive; (ii) a report with detailed costings be submitted to the August 1998 meeting of the Technical Services Committee.

motions.title: Cromarty Road – Traffic Management
motions.description: That in relation to traffic management in Cromarty Road: (i) the Council's preferred option is: (a) right turn pockets in Empire Avenue and Pearson Street medians be extended at the two existing University entrances; (b) the Edith Cowan University be asked to redevelop their carpark to accommodate the closure of their access from Cromarty Road; (c) the existing entrance/exit to the Edith Cowan University from Cromarty Road be closed; (ii) discussions be continued at a Senior Executive level with Edith Cowan University to implement the preferred option.

motions.title: Loftus Street – Road Upgrading
motions.description: That the information relating to the proposed upgrading of Loftus Street, Cambridge Street and Railway Parade, in accordance with Main Roads WA Plans Numbers 9731-4232, 9731-4275-1, 9731-4235-1 be noted.

motions.title: Woolwich Street, West Leederville – Proposed 'Two Hour' Parking Restriction
motions.description: That: (i)-(v) 2 hour parking restrictions be imposed on various sections of Woolwich Street, West Leederville operative from 8.00am to 6.00pm Monday to Friday and 8.00am to 11.00am Saturday; (vi)-(vii) Football parking restrictions be imposed on sections of Woolwich Street operative from 6.00pm to 11.00pm Monday to Friday and 11.00am to 11.00pm Saturdays, Sundays and Public Holidays; as shown on Plan Numbers E283-03-02 and E283-85-02.

motions.title: Connaught Street, West Leederville – Proposed 'No Stopping' Restriction
motions.description: That a 'No Stopping' restriction be imposed on the southern and western sides of Connaught Street, West Leederville, commencing 18 metres west of Carlton Street and extending 60 metres westwards and then northwards to the northern boundary of 21 Connaught Street, operative at all times, in lieu of unrestricted parking, as shown on Plan Number E276-98-01.

motions.title: Clune Avenue, West Leederville – Proposed 'Two Hour' Parking Restriction

motions.title: McCourt Street, West Leederville – Proposed 'No Stopping' Restriction
motions.description: That a 'No Stopping' restriction be imposed on the eastern side of McCourt Street, West Leederville, commencing at Woolwich Street and extending 47.4 metres northwards, operative at all times in lieu of unrestricted parking as shown on Plan Number E258-98-01.

motions.title: Lake Monger Drive, West Leederville – Proposed 'No Parking' Road or Verge Restriction
motions.description: That a 'No Parking, Road or Verge' restriction be imposed on the southern side of Lake Monger Drive, West Leederville, commencing 6 metres east of Northwood Street and extending 51 metres eastwards, operative at all times, in lieu of unrestricted parking as shown on Plan Number E309-98-01.

motions.description: That further consideration of the item relating to the refurbishment of the Wembley Piazza Shopping Centre be deferred to the next Ordinary Meeting of the Council.

motions.title: Review of Coastal Facilities (Original Motion)
motions.description: That: (i) as a matter of priority, the commercial viability and performance of the existing kiosks on the beachfront be evaluated, opportunities for enhancement be identified and the feasibility and desirability of a cafe/restaurant facility be examined; (ii) expressions of interest be called from suitably qualified consultants to undertake the analysis outlined in (i) above; (iii) the Council's administration proceed with the background assessment of existing facilities and activities on the beachfront with a view to commencing a public consultation exercise as the first step in developing a strategy for the future control of the use of the beachfront; (iv) a suitable brief for consultants be prepared, based on the matters raised in the report in (iii) above, for the purpose of undertaking a public consultation exercise.

motions.title: Review of Coastal Facilities - Amendment
motions.description: That Clause (i) of the motion be amended by deleting the words 'a cafe/restaurant facility' and inserting the words 'other facilities'.

motions.title: Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places (Original Motion)
motions.description: That: (i) the report dated 6 July 1995, relating to the Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places, be received; (ii) the following actions required to progress the project be approved: (a) advise the community about the Municipal Inventory by advertising in the local newspaper, and advising ratepayer/resident associations, schools and community, business and special interest groups; (b) call for expressions of interest for membership of a Community Advisory Committee by advertising in the local newspaper and by inviting community and business groups, schools and individuals of known interest or expertise in heritage matters to nominate for membership; (c) call for registrations of interest from consultants to facilitate the process and advise the Council on the compilation of the Municipal Inventory.

motions.title: Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places - First Amendment
motions.description: That Clause (ii)(b) of the motion be amended by adding the words 'comprising at least one Councillor from each Ward' following the word 'Committee'.

motions.title: Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places - Second Amendment
motions.description: That Clause (ii)(b) of the motion be further amended by deleting the words 'at least'.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications

motions.title: Subiaco Special Events Station (Original Motion)
motions.description: That: (i) the Council expresses its continued support for increasing the use of public transport to access major events at Subiaco Oval and to this end, formally requests the Department of Transport to continue its investigation and promotion of the Subiaco Special Events Station, with a view to involving the West Australian Football Commission (WAFC) in progressing this matter; (ii) the City of Subiaco be advised of the Council decision in (i) above and invited to support the Town of Cambridge position on this matter in its approach to the Department of Transport.

motions.title: Subiaco Special Events Station - Amendment
motions.description: That Clause (i) of the motion be amended by deleting the words 'continue its investigation and promotion' and inserting the words 'commence an investigation into the feasibility'.

motions.description: Information item regarding public hearing sessions for MRS Bold Park Amendment. motions.title: State Road Funds to Local Government
motions.description: Information item regarding state road funding review outcome distributed May 1995. Town of Cambridge allocation for 1995/96 direct grant is $51,136. Councils expected to contribute one-third of cost for specific capital road works projects.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Redevelopment
motions.description: Approval of redevelopment of 'new' course at Wembley Golf Complex. Option Two recommended - limited improvements including increased course length, minimal upgrade of tees/greens/reticulation. Project cost $911,000 with additional $45,000 required in 1996/97 budget. GHD appointed as project manager at cost of $32,270.

motions.title: Electricity Usage Audit
motions.description: Approval for appointment of WA Energy Consultants to conduct electricity usage audit of Council buildings, parks and reserves. No cost for initial investigation with payment of 25 percent of achieved savings over twelve month period. Total 1994/95 electricity cost $290,000.

motions.title: Kiosk No. 3, Challenger Parade, City Beach

Alternative proposal to relocate impounded dogs to Dogs Refuge Home at Shenton Park at cost $150/week. Council may join Western Suburbs Combined Dog Control Committee.

motions.title: Building Licence Fees - Minimum Fee Increase

motions.title: Establishment of Particular Reserves

motions.title: Rolling Stones Concert Fee Transfer to Reserve
motions.description: Motion to transfer the $100,000 fee received for the hire of Perry Lakes Stadium for the Rolling Stones Concert to the Area Improvement Reserve.

motions.title: 1995/96 Draft Budget - Referral for Adoption
motions.description: Motion to refer the Draft 1995/96 Budget, as amended, to the next Council meeting for formal adoption. The budget includes a 5% rate increase representing approximately $300,000 in additional revenue.

motions.title: Confidential Session - Fairway Tavern Rent Submission
motions.description: Confidential motion regarding Fairway Tavern rent arrears. A total of 26 submissions were received during the consultation period, with feedback focused primarily on operational improvements rather than fundamental change. The policy is no longer necessary as compliance with Australian Accounting Standards is mandated through the Local Government Act 1995 and Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, and the policy creates risk of conflict with current standards and annual financial statements.

motions.title: Revocation of Council Policy 070 – Public Liability Insurance
motions.description: Council Policy 070 seeks to ensure that all hirers using the Town's sports grounds, reserves and community facilities have adequate Public Liability Insurance. The requirement for public liability has been incorporated into the conditions of hire for both community facilities and open spaces, making the standalone policy redundant.

motions.title: Review of Vehicle Crossover Policy - Administration Recommendation
motions.description: The Vehicle Crossover Policy has been amended to improve clarity and consistency in relation to the design, construction, and approval of vehicle crossovers within the Town. Key amendments include clarification of permitted crossover widths, specification of approved materials and colours, inclusion of provisions for commercial and temporary crossovers, introduction of approval validity periods, streamlined guidance on verge tree clearance requirements, and updated references to related standards and documents.

motions.title: Amendment to Vehicle Crossover Policy - Town-Initiated Works
motions.description: Amendment to add a new Section 21 addressing Town-Initiated Works Affecting Existing Vehicle Crossovers. The amendment specifies that where the Town undertakes renewal or upgrade works to Town-owned rights-of-way affecting existing bitumen vehicle crossovers, the Town will ordinarily replace the affected crossover with a concrete vehicle crossover constructed in accordance with the specifications, subject to circumstances where replacement would be inappropriate or impractical.

motions.title: Vehicle Crossover Policy - Substantive Motion (as amended)

Evaluation panel assessed submissions against qualitative criteria including understanding of tasks, capacity to supply, record of delivering similar projects, and social/economic effects. Respondent 4 recommended as preferred supplier based on sound knowledge, experience, and cost within budget.

motions.title: Mid Year Budget Review 2025/2026
motions.description: Mid-year budget review for the period 1 July 2025 to 31 December 2025. Comprehensive review of financial performance against budget, with reforecasting to 30 June 2026. Result is a balanced budget with revised variances across operating, investing and financing activities. Key changes include opening balance lower than expected, increased depreciation based on fair valuations, and decreased capital expenditure after reviewing project costing and delivery capacity.

Total request is $28,000, within the $36,000 budget allocation. The E-Flower is a permanent solar-powered public parklet with seating, landscaping, lighting, bicycle parking and e-bike/mobile charging infrastructure, complemented by a $25,000 RAC grant.

motions.description: Application for carport with skillion roof, set back 0.33 metre from front boundary. Assessment required against setback of garages and carports design principles of Residential Design Codes.

motions.title: Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace - 31 Multiple Dwellings (Revised)
motions.description: Reconsideration of council's previous decision to refuse application for 31 multiple dwellings at Lot 501 (No. 15) Omaroo Terrace, City Beach. Application previously refused on 27 September 2016. Amended plans received 27 January and 24 February 2017 addressing building footprint, parking, and tree preservation concerns.

motions.title: Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace - Refusal Motion
motions.description: Following the lost motion to approve, a motion was moved to refuse the application for 31 multiple dwellings citing inconsistency with Ocean Mia Design Guidelines, traffic concerns, building footprint non-compliance, bulk and scale issues, and inadequate tree preservation demonstration.

motions.title: Consider Item Behind Closed Doors
motions.description: Motion to move consideration of Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace item to closed session at end of meeting

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders - Clause 8.13
motions.description: Suspension of limitation of addresses clause to allow open discussion on Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace item

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders - Clause 8.13
motions.description: Resumption of limitation of addresses clause following open discussion

motions.title: Lot 504 Vincent Street West - Two Storey Dwelling Approval
motions.description: SAT reconsideration of application for two storey dwelling at Lot 504 (No. 429) Vincent Street West, West Leederville. Council previously refused application on 20 December 2016. Amended plans submitted 3 February 2017 with larger front setback and pitched roof addressing previous refusal reasons.

motions.title: Draft Policy 6.4 Precinct P4 Wembley for advertising
motions.description: Amendment to Policy 6.4: Precinct P4: Wembley to reflect strategic direction for Wembley Precinct, including Wembley Sports Park and Wembley Activity Centre. Amendments to align with current Scheme provisions for corner lots coded R20.

motions.title: Closure of Pedestrian Access Way Lot 8008 - Deferral (Committee)
motions.description: Request to defer consideration of pedestrian access way closure between Lot 232 Finishline View and Lot 233 Stadium Drive, Floreat to allow further consideration of submissions received during advertising period.

motions.title: Closure of Pedestrian Access Way Lot 8008 - Not to Proceed (Foreshadowed)
motions.description: Foreshadowed motion by Cr Timmermanis to proceed with original administration recommendation not to proceed with pedestrian access way closure, following loss of deferral motion.

motions.title: Design Review Panel Amendment to Selection Process
motions.description: Amendment to simplify the Design Review Panel selection process by appointing the Chairman and top 5 ranked members directly from confidential recommendation without establishing a separate selection committee.

motions.title: Design Review Panel Member Appointments - Final Decision
motions.description: Council decision on Design Review Panel member appointments following closed session consideration. Second-ranked member removal amendment was lost, and original motion was carried.

motions.title: Metro West JDAP Member Nominations
motions.description: Nomination of councillors to represent Town of Cambridge on the Metropolitan West Joint Development Assessment Panel for the next three-year term expiring 26 April 2020.

motions.title: Building Permit Fees Reduction - Paganin House Reinstatement
motions.description: Request for building permit fees reduction for owners T Bult and L Church of Lot 8 (No. 165) The Boulevard, Floreat in recognition of their commitment to reinstatement of heritage-significant Paganin House, a 1960s dwelling designed by architect Iwan Iwanoff.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications Report - December 2016 and January 2017
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for December 2016 and January 2017, including building permit approvals, WAPC referrals, and State Administrative Tribunal appeals.

motions.title: Building Permits Report - December 2016 and January 2017
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data of building permits approved under delegated authority, including permit numbers, demolition permits, occupancy permits, and value of construction.

motions.title: Tender RFT 43-16 Irrigation Maintenance Services Award
motions.description: Award of tender for irrigation maintenance services, a schedule of rates contract for construction, development, testing, maintenance of bores, reticulation and related equipment.

motions.title: Beecroft Park improvement concept plan
motions.description: Draft Beecroft Park improvement concept plan to be received and circulated for public comment, with assessment of public comments and presentation to Council for consideration and endorsement.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Estate Parking Review - Plan E 188 16 01 Rev B
motions.description: Review of Perry Lakes Estate parking plan with proposed amendments to increase marked on-road parking bays from 26 to 69.

motions.title: 10 Year Program for Car Parks
motions.description: Updated 10-year program for car park resurfacing with Year 1 projects for 2017/18 budget consideration.

motions.title: Road Improvement - Capital Works Five Year Program 2017-22
motions.description: Five year road improvement capital works program from 2017/18 to 2021/22 for endorsement and budget preparation.

motions.title: City Beach High Mast Lighting
motions.description: Review of City Beach high mast lighting poles with recommendation to remove damaged poles and undertake lighting requirements review.

motions.title: Gateway Entry Signage for Town of Cambridge
motions.description: Following consideration by the Public Art Committee on 24 January 2017, a proposal for the installation of gateway signage at three locations has been referred to the Council for a decision based on two concept designs.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Club Endorsement
motions.description: The Wembley Golf Course has been examining the introduction of golf membership that would allow golfers to acquire and maintain a golf handicap with Golf Australia. The necessary processes have now been completed to facilitate the formalisation of Wembley Golf Club.

motions.title: West Australian Ballet - 10 Year Memorandum of Understanding
motions.description: The West Australian Ballet (WAB) has been a long-term hirer of the Quarry Amphitheatre (24 years) and has written to the Town proposing a Memorandum of Understanding to secure the WAB's use of the Quarry Amphitheatre for their annual 'Ballet at the Quarry' production for the next 10 years.

motions.title: Underground Power Program Update
motions.description: Three of the four proposals submitted for funding under Round 6 of the State Underground Power Program have been successful. The report presents a proposal to complete underground power for remaining areas of the Town and the framework for developing a charging model for property owners.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - February 2017
motions.description: To advise Council of documents that have been affixed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge.

motions.title: Annual General Meeting of Electors 2015/2016 - Decisions
motions.description: This report recommends that the Council receive the minutes of the Annual General Meeting of Electors, held on Monday 12 December 2016.

motions.title: Delegated Authority 2016/2017 - Christmas/New Year Recess
motions.description: During the 2016/2017 Christmas/New Year recess, one matter required the delegated authority to be acted upon by the Chief Executive Officer.

motions.title: Cambridge Coastcare and Floreat Surf Club Shed Update
motions.description: Cambridge Coastcare and the Floreat Surf Life Saving Club have finished construction of a 171m2 shed. Due to the storage of chemicals used by Cambridge Coastcare, both organisations have agreed that Cambridge Coastcare move into an existing 28.5m2 concrete shed within the Floreat Surf Lifesaving Club leased area.

motions.title: Wastewater Emergency Storage Facility - Helston Park
motions.description: The Water Corporation proposes to construct overflow storage capacity to provide emergency storage for the Helston Avenue Sewerage Wastewater Pump Station at Helston Park, City Beach. The facility will involve below-ground storage pipes with inspection hatches at ground level, and removal and replacement of trees.

motions.title: Part Closure of Road Reserve - Finishline View, Floreat
motions.description: Edge Visionary Living has requested closure of a portion of road reserve at Finishline View, Floreat to enable amalgamation of Crown land (currently holding a Western Power Transformer) into Lot 232 as part of a multi-unit development. The Department of Lands owns the Crown land and will negotiate directly with the developer.

motions.title: Tamala Park Regional Council Meeting - December 2016
motions.description: Report on items considered at the Tamala Park Regional Council (TPRC) Ordinary Meeting held on 8 December 2016. The Town of Cambridge holds 1/12 equity ownership in the TPRC. The report covers project cash flow, sales strategies, civil construction status, and development planning for the Catalina Beach precinct with projections for 2,700 dwellings.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - December 2016 and January 2017
motions.description: Monthly report of accounts paid by the Town in accordance with Local Government Act (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Includes cheque payments and electronic fund transfers for the periods December 2016 and January 2017.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - January 2017
motions.description: Report on the Town's investment portfolio performance for January 2017, detailing the distribution of funds invested with various financial institutions and interest earned against year-to-date budget. The total investment portfolio at end of January 2017 was $46.4 million.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements - January 2017
motions.description: Monthly financial report for the period ended 31 January 2017, reviewing the financial position and commenting on permanent and timing variances. Includes approval of unbudgeted expenditure of $16,500 for Cambridge Croquet Court Lighting Upgrade by absolute majority.

motions.title: Community Engagement and Integrated Planning and Reporting Funding
motions.description: Report on outcomes of Phase 1 community engagement for Integrated Planning and Reporting (IPR) project. A total of 979 participants registered and 576 responded to survey. Recommends reallocation of $100,000 in funding from Furniture and Equipment Capital Budget to support Phase 2 community engagement and IPR completion by June 2017.

motions.title: Ocean Village Shopping Centre Deed of Agreement for Parking
motions.description: Confidential matter relating to negotiation and execution of a Deed of Agreement for access and parking over Lot 241 to Pindan Capital Pty Ltd.

motions.title: Confidential Discussion - Director Community Development
motions.description: Motion to regard discussion of the Director Community Development appointment as confidential in accordance with Section 5.23 of the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Appointment - Director Community Development
motions.description: Council decision to offer employment as Director Community Development to candidate A under a Common Law contract for services, with employment contract to be negotiated by the Chief Executive Officer.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 17 September 1996.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Support and Consideration
motions.description: Motion to reaffirm support for the City to Sea Greenway project and consider a route through the Town. Multiple amendments proposed but not carried.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Lees Option Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to motion regarding City to Sea Greenway to support the Lees option as preferred route.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Resident Consultation Amendment
motions.description: Amendment requiring consultation with residents of The Boulevard should the Greenway be routed along the verge.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - No Further Action
motions.description: Motion proposing no further action be taken on the City to Sea Greenway proposals due to lack of consensus.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Referral to Committee
motions.description: Motion by Mayor to refer the City to Sea Greenway item back to Technical Services Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Local Area Traffic Management Works 1996/97
motions.description: Budget approval for West Leederville traffic precinct improvements including entry statements, roundabout works, and public consultation for traffic management in Gregory Street, Daglish Street, and Salvado Road. Matters referred to Committee for further discussion following initial Committee consideration and subsequent Council meetings.

motions.title: Verge Parking Gregory/Barrett Streets
motions.description: Consideration of removal of verge parking restrictions on eastern side of Gregory Street, Wembley, following new information from owner of 43 Barrett Street regarding bollards and brick paving.

motions.title: Council Car Park West Leederville Pay to Park Trial
motions.description: Approval for trial of pay parking system at West Leederville Bowling Club car park using Parking Systems Australia Pty Ltd for three-month period.

motions.title: Street Parking West Leederville/Wembley
motions.description: Imposition of revised parking restrictions in West Leederville and Wembley areas related to football events at Subiaco Oval, including additional signage, publicity plan, and investigation of enforcement outsourcing options.

motions.title: Vincent Street West Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Modification of parking restrictions on Vincent Street West, West Leederville, following property developments, including changes to No Parking, Two Hour Parking, Bus Zones, and No Standing restrictions, with consultation completed.

motions.title: Waste Management Composting Investigation
motions.description: Approval to conduct investigation into composting options for green waste disposal, following Council consideration of pilot project at Murdoch University and community presentation.

motions.title: Extended Recycling Service Progress Report
motions.description: Report on implementation progress of extended recycling program including container distribution, participation rates, support systems, and customer service matters.

motions.title: Depot Sewerage Work Tender Acceptance
motions.description: Acceptance of tender from DJ & MB MacCormick for sewerage work at Town's Lemnos Street Depot facility, including linkage to main trunk sewer.

motions.title: Birkdale/The Boulevard Tree Removal
motions.description: Approval for removal of Eucalyptus botryoides (Mahogany Gum) tree located adjacent to Floreat Tennis Courts due to safety concerns, debris issues, termite and fungal attack, and weak crown growth following previous lopping.

motions.title: Postal Voting Method for May 1997 Election
motions.description: Support for conducting the ordinary election in May 1997 using the postal voting method, subject to written agreement from the Electoral Commissioner. Includes amendment to negotiations clause regarding WAMA involvement.

motions.title: Petitions at Council Facilities Policy
motions.description: Adoption of a policy to restrict the placement of petitions at Council facilities. Original motion with amendments addressing placement rules and Council-supported petitions.

motions.title: Review of Operation and Functions of Committees
motions.description: Approval of revised meeting schedule and operational arrangements for Standing Committees, including meeting dates, deputation procedures, agenda formats, and recording of meetings. Includes amendment for quarterly election of Presiding Members.

motions.title: WAMA Member Municipal WorkCare Scheme Board of Management
motions.description: Receipt of request for nomination of a member to the Municipal WorkCare Scheme Board of Management.

motions.title: WAMA Telecommunications Forum Opposition and Support
motions.description: Correspondence to Federal Minister and Members of Parliament opposing telecommunications carrier exemptions and overhead cabling; support for WAMA efforts on Telecommunications National Code modifications.

motions.title: Coastal Planning Policy Submission to WAPC
motions.description: Submission of comments on the Western Australian Planning Commission discussion paper 'Coastal Planning and Development in Western Australia - Towards a Policy Framework'.

motions.title: Financial Support for City of Subiaco Legal Challenge
motions.description: Contribution of $500 to the City of Subiaco's legal challenge against the Minister for Planning's appeal decision concerning a vacant strata subdivision proposal.

motions.title: Home occupation - accounting systems consultancy
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] on behalf of [private individual — name withheld] to operate a home occupation (office for accounting systems consultancy) from a dwelling in West Leederville. The applicant proposes to use one room as an office with equipment including telephone and personal computer, operating 9am-6pm with no client visits.

motions.title: Application refused - Day Centre for the Aged
motions.description: Application by Parry and Rosenthal Architects on behalf of Sisters of Mercy for a Day Centre for the Aged at 124 Salvado Road, Wembley. The proposal seeks to demolish existing house and construct single storey building to provide day centre services for seniors. Two objections were received during advertising.

motions.title: Day Centre application referred back to committee
motions.description: Motion to refer the Day Centre for the Aged application back to the Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration, at the request of Cr Anderton.

motions.title: Extensions and alterations to shopping centre - approved
motions.description: Application for extensions and alterations to Ocean Village Shopping Centre at Hale Road, City Beach. Proposal includes two new shops with total net floor area of 178 square metres. Plot ratio will increase from 0.50:1 to 0.54:1, exceeding scheme requirement. Absolute majority decision required.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications - received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for month ending 30 September 1996, including vacant strata subdivision, subdivision, home occupation renewals, and temporary advertising balloon. Also notifications of appeals received and determined.

motions.title: Residential design guidelines - consultant engagement
motions.description: Motion to seek registrations of interest from consultants for preparation of residential design guidelines for the Town, based on study outline. Budget approved to maximum $25,000. Guidelines to address design issues in four main suburban areas: West Leederville, Wembley, Floreat, and City Beach.

motions.title: Pedestrian accessway closure - processing approval
motions.description: Application by Sullivan Commercial Pty Ltd for closure of pedestrian accessway on Part Lot 241 Hale Road, City Beach. The disused accessway separates Ocean Village Shopping Centre developments on adjoining lots. Council to undertake public consultation subject to applicant meeting administrative fee ($200) and closure costs.

motions.title: Change of use residence to office - application refused
motions.description: Application by Shean Pty Ltd for change of use from residence to office on Strata Lot 3, Cambridge Street, Floreat. Existing development comprises squash courts, shops, and caretaker residence. Application refused due to parking shortfall; however, Council indicated willingness to consider residential conversion of squash courts under Clause 26(2) and authorized CEO to initiate advertising.

motions.title: Additional dwelling and modifications - application refused
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] for preliminary building licence to construct additional two storey dwelling at rear of existing residence, and modifications to existing dwelling at West Leederville. Application refused due to insufficient parking bay dimensions, inadequate manoeuvre space, and inappropriate provision of parking within front setback area.

motions.title: Additions to cottage and rear dwelling - approved
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions to existing cottage and construction of rear two storey dwelling at 118 Cambridge Street, West Leederville. Proposal involves upgrading existing cottage and building new residence with subdivision of lot into two parcels. Absolute majority approval required due to variations to R-Codes setback requirements.

motions.title: 6 Carlton Street - Two Storey Residence Approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licence for a two storey residence at 6 Carlton Street, West Leederville, with revised proposal dated 23 September 1996. Site has a plot ratio of 0.53:1.0 exceeding policy limit of 0.5:1.0, but represents improvement on earlier proposal.

motions.title: Lot 300 Ruislip Street - Two Storey Residence Approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licence for a two storey residence at Lot 300 Ruislip Street, West Leederville, with revised proposal dated 26 September 1996. Plot ratio of 0.47:1.0 exceeds policy limit of 0.4:1.0. Earlier application refused February 1996; deferred last month for applicant review and overshadowing assessment.

motions.title: 47 Keane Street Wembley - Two Single Dwellings Approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licences to construct two single storey residences on subdivided lot. Plot ratio of 0.44:1 exceeds R20 zone policy of 0.4:1. Minor non-compliance with R-Codes for north side setback and minimum open space (48% vs 50% required).

motions.title: 42 Yaltara Road City Beach - Reconsideration of Floor Level Condition
motions.description: Application to reconsider ground floor level condition for previously approved two storey residence. Applicant seeks to increase floor level by 500mm from FL 13.91 to FL 14.41 to accommodate undercraft garage. Earlier approval was for plot ratio variation of 0.43:1, partly on basis of reduced floor level.

motions.title: Lot 62 Clune Avenue West Leederville - Two Storey Residence Approval
motions.description: Application for revised preliminary building licence to construct two storey residence. Plot ratio of 0.45:1.0 exceeds R30 zone policy of 0.4:1.0. Original approval 16 July 1996 for plot ratio 0.43:1; revised proposal increases plot ratio by 0.02 for additional bedroom space.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority - September 1996
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved during September 1996 under delegated authority. Total of 36 building licences with combined value of $2,664,752; three preliminary building licences (including new multi-level Medical Clinic for St John of God Hospital) and two demolition licences also approved.

motions.title: Environmental Health - Asbestos/Poisons Collection Day
motions.description: Participation in free asbestos and poisons collection day on 20 October 1996 at Brockway Transfer Station. Service for disposal of hazardous materials, asbestos-cement sheeting (max 3 sheets per household), and waste vehicle tyres. Cost sharing arrangement with western suburbs local authorities.

motions.title: Financial Statements - Period Ended 31 August 1996
motions.description: Financial statements for the period ended 31 August 1996 have been produced and circulated with notice paper.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment - Investment and Advance Accounts
motions.description: Schedule of accounts including investments and advance account transfers totalling $4,173,100.00 in Municipal Account and $780,000.00 in Endowment Account, to be confirmed in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at 30 September 1996
motions.description: Report advising Council of surplus funds invested, distribution of funds, and financial performance of each investment. Investment portfolio complies with Council policy limiting funds to any one institution at maximum 25%. Interest accrued to date shows 14.2% actual performance against 1996/97 budget.

motions.title: On Site Security Truck - City Beach Foreshore
motions.description: Licence agreement with Kevin and Warren Todd for operation of two on-site security trucks on City Beach foreshore for storage of beach patrons' valuables. Seasonal operation from 1 November to 31 March; licence term of three years (amended from five years at committee meeting); licence fee $1,000 per season; public liability insurance required.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council - Formal Membership
motions.description: Authorisation for Mayor and Chief Executive Officer to sign Deed of Variation of Constitution admitting Town of Cambridge to Mindarie Regional Council. Town has been disposing waste at Mindarie since 1 July 1994; formal membership sought to participate in important decisions regarding landfill site and forward planning.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Social Club - Seeding Fund Donation
motions.description: One-off donation of $750 to Town of Cambridge Social Club for establishment seeding fund. Social Club formed early 1996 with approximately 60 current members and potential for over 100 employees to participate. Benefits include improved staff morale, team building, and inter-departmental communication.

motions.title: City Beach Civic Centre - Lease to West Coast Bridge Club Referred to Committee
motions.description: Motion to refer lease arrangement for City Beach Civic Centre to West Coast Bridge Club back to Corporate and Customer Services Committee for further consideration. Sub-Committee had recommended 10-year lease with 10-year option; members expressed concern and requested deferral for further discussion with Bridge Club representatives.

motions.title: Commonwealth-Local Government Memorandum of Understanding
motions.description: Receipt of Australian Local Government Association Discussion Draft of proposed Memorandum of Understanding between Commonwealth and Local Governments. Comment on draft due by 11 October 1996 to Western Australian Municipal Association.

motions.title: WA Alive Projects Rankings and Ratings
motions.description: Council to advise Ministry of Sport and Recreation of rankings and ratings for five WA Alive projects including Bold Park Aquatic Centre, Floreat Oval wicket upgrade, Floreat Tennis Club shade structures, Floreat-City Beach Croquet Club reticulation, and Western Australian Rugby Union changeroom extensions.

motions.title: Lake Monger Management Plan - Rehabilitation and Water Quality
motions.description: Council to endorse Lake Monger Management Plan, release Rehabilitation Plan for public comment regarding work in Sections 5 and 6, engage specialists from Centre for Water Research and/or CSIRO for advice and preparation of brief, endorse proposal for consultant engagement for water quality concept designs, and approach Main Roads WA for potential contribution.

motions.title: Response to Local Government Structural Reform Committee Report
motions.description: Council to note recommendations in Local Government Structural Reform Committee report and forward responses to Minister for Local Government, with exception of Recommendation 18 regarding potential restructuring of Cities of Stirling and Wanneroo.

motions.title: Request for Co-operative Process by Local Government Advisory Board
motions.description: Motion requesting that Local Government Advisory Board adopt a more co-operative and public process in its work.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Promotion
motions.description: Council to participate as partner in advertising campaign for Wembley Golf Complex, with contribution subject to surplus funds being available from operational budget and absolute majority authorisation.

motions.title: Meeting Behind Closed Doors
motions.description: Motion to regard the following matter as confidential in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(a) of the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Chief Executive Officer's Performance Confidential
motions.description: Confidential report relating to a matter affecting an employee. The motion to adopt the confidential motion as outlined in the report received a split decision.

motions.title: Reopening Meeting to Public
motions.description: Procedural motion to reopen the meeting to the public after confidential session concluded.

motions.title: Draft 2011/2012 Budget - Endorsement for Public Comment
motions.description: Consider the draft Town of Cambridge Budget for the year ending 30 June 2012 incorporating a general rate increase of 6.3%, capital works of $21 million, and allocation of $70,000 surplus funds.

motions.title: Draft 2011/2012 Budget - Amendment with Rate Adjustment
motions.description: Amendment to the draft budget to reflect a general rate increase of 5.9% instead of 6.3%, and to allocate the $70,000 capital surplus plus $15,000 carry forward funds for the Floreat Groyne path to the Lake Monger Path Stage 3.1.

motions.title: Confidentiality - Item 8.1 Report and Attachments
motions.description: Procedural motion to declare the report and attachments for Item 8.1 (Waste Collection and/or Processing Services - Tender T02-11) as confidential in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(c) of the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Waste Collection and/or Processing Services - Tender T02-11
motions.description: Tender award for waste management services including general waste, recyclable collection and processing, green/organic collection and processing (Perthwaste), and bulk verge collection (Alvito) for the period 1 October 2011 to 30 June 2016.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting held on 19 December 2006 and the Special Meeting held on 15 February 2007

motions.title: Ruislip Street Kerbside Parking
motions.description: Review of kerbside parking restrictions in Ruislip Street from Harborne Street to Kimberley Street, West Leederville, in accordance with Council policy and community consultation survey conducted in July 2006

motions.title: Cambridge Street kerbside parking restrictions McCourt to Southport
motions.description: Review of kerbside parking restrictions in Cambridge Street from McCourt Street to Southport Street, following parking workshop on 4 December 2006.

motions.title: Northwood Street kerbside parking restrictions Railway Parade to Cambridge Street
motions.description: Amendment to kerbside parking restrictions on the western side of Northwood Street at the intersection of Cambridge Street, following parking workshop on 4 December 2006.

motions.title: Oceanic Drive/Cambridge Street road works Brookdale to Lissadell
motions.description: Proposed road works including median islands and parking embayments in Oceanic Drive and Cambridge Street from Brookdale Street to Lissadell Street, with community consultation responses incorporated.

motions.title: Policy No. 4.2.26 Parking Restrictions review and amendment
motions.description: Review of the Town's Parking Restrictions Policy following the completion of the West Leederville Parking Review and parking workshop on 4 December 2006.

motions.title: Northwood Street/Woolwich Street Parking – Review
motions.description: Review of parking restrictions and school volunteer parking permits affecting West Leederville Primary School

motions.title: Kimberley Street Parking – Aged Care Centre
motions.description: Kerbside parking restrictions in Kimberley Street adjacent to Kimberley Residential Aged Care Centre

motions.title: Kimberley Street/Railway Parade Roundabout
motions.description: Proposed roundabout design at Kimberley Street/Railway Parade intersection

motions.title: McCourt Street, Northwood Street, Kimberley Street and Cambridge Street Road Works
motions.description: Detail design options for development of intersections with Cambridge Street, including traffic calming and turning restrictions

motions.title: Pandora Drive proposed road works
motions.description: Community consultation report regarding proposed traffic island and road works in Pandora Drive. Survey showed lack of support for blister island but community preference for alternative options including extension of Gifford Gardens Park.

motions.title: Kirkdale Avenue road works approval
motions.description: Proposed road works for Kirkdale Avenue between Lothian Street and Kinross Crescent/Kintyre Street including nibs, parking embayments and edge lines. Community survey showed mixed support with 2 supporting and 2 opposed.

motions.title: Salvado Road traffic management works
motions.description: Proposed road works in Salvado Road from Selby Street to Birkdale Street including kerbside nibs, parking embayments, traffic island extension and parking restrictions. Community survey showed strong support with 15 supporting the traffic entrance nibs and parking embayment.

motions.title: Parks and landscape works programs
motions.description: Report on various parks and landscape works programs and projects identified for implementation in the 2007/2008 Draft Budget.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Standing Orders Local Law 2007 referral
motions.description: Adoption of the final version of the Town of Cambridge Standing Orders Local Law 2007, repealing the previous version and introducing revised meeting procedures. Members were advised the Department of Local Government wished to request minor amendments prior to formal adoption.

motions.title: Delegated authority decisions Christmas/New Year recess 2006/2007
motions.description: Confirmation of delegated authority decisions made during the 2006/2007 Christmas/New Year recess, including an application for a shade sail at Lot 6 (No.3) Marimba Crescent, City Beach approved under delegation by the Chief Executive Officer.

motions.title: Tender for Audit Services – 2007–2009 Triennium
motions.description: Appointment of external auditors for the Town for a three to five year period as required under the Local Government Act 1995. Two tenders received from Barrett and Partners – DFK and Stamfords. After discussion about Stamfords submission, external audit services were approved and internal audit services deferred pending further information.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts
motions.description: Confirmation of accounts for payment from the Municipal Account and Trust Account, with cheque payments totalling $2,513,257.52 and EFT payments totalling $1,520,383.16, for a total of $4,033,640.68.

motions.title: Investment Schedule
motions.description: Monthly investment report showing the distribution of surplus funds and financial performance for January 2007. Total investments of $15.54 million with weighted average interest rate of 7.62% compared to Bank Bill Index of 6.65%.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements
motions.description: Financial statements for the period ended 31 January 2007 showing operating results and key financial indicators comparing current and prior year performance.

motions.title: Financial Statements - Monthly Review November/December 2006
motions.description: Review of financial performance and budget variations for the period ended 31 December 2006. Report identifies significant variances, budget reallocations totalling $79,000 (executive recruitment $27,000 and parking sign replacement $52,000), and assesses capital works expenditure and aged debtors.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Record of documents sealed with the Common Seal of the Town, including withdrawal of caveat on Niola Hospital properties, HACC Program deed of variation, traffic code authorisation instrument, and lease with Cambridge Bowling and Recreation Club.

motions.title: Cambridge Library Community Consultation report received
motions.description: Report on Cambridge Library biennial community survey and focus groups conducted in 2006, assessing user satisfaction and identifying areas for improvement to library services and collections.

motions.title: Community Grants Program – Financial Assistance for Community Facilities
motions.description: Applications from Perth Netball Association for electrical rewiring of Matthews Netball Centre ($15,000) and Floreat Park Tennis Club for clubhouse refurbishment ($75,000). Both organizations meet program criteria and have demonstrated financial commitment.

motions.title: Community Arts Development Program – 2006/2007 Disbursement

motions.title: Dwelling addition at Lot 118, Salvado Road, Floreat

motions.title: Additions and alterations at Lot 37, Blencowe Street

motions.title: Carport at Lot 260, Cambridge Street, Floreat

motions.title: Two storey dwelling at Lot 3, Joseph Street, West Leederville

motions.title: Two storey dwelling amended plan at Lot 187, Talgarth Way, City Beach

motions.title: Two storey grouped dwelling at Lot 3, Ruislip Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two storey grouped dwelling with undercroft garage with variations to side setbacks, building height, and roof pitch. Three neighbour submissions objecting to reduced setbacks, excessive height, and overshadowing impacts. Application recommended for refusal.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling at Lot 14, St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling with multiple variations to design standards. Original application lodged February 2006 with objections; amended plans lodged September 2006 and December 2006. Adjoining neighbour to south submitted objection.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling - St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville

Subsequently, amendment to delete clause (v) was moved by Cr Bradley, seconded by Cr Gow and carried 5/3.

motions.title: Three storey dwelling and swimming pool - Peasholm Street, City Beach
motions.description: Application for a three storey dwelling with swimming pool at Lot 138 (No. 11) Peasholm Street, City Beach. motions.title: Platform extension and new platform - West Leederville Train Station

motions.title: Retrospective patio approval - Yanagin Crescent, City Beach

motions.description: Application to approve variations to Local Law 43 – Buildings on Endowment Lands & Limekilns Estate for five residential properties in City Beach and Floreat. motions.description: Motion to install 'No Stopping' kerbside parking restrictions at two locations in Pearson Place to improve safety at the Herdsman Markets access.

motions.description: Motion to seek community comment on implementing one-way traffic in the narrow laneway between Ruislip Street and Clune Avenue in West Leederville.

motions.title: Beaches and Dunes Solar Powered Lights Replacement
motions.description: Motion to approve replacement of solar powered lights in carparks north of Floreat Beach at estimated cost of $4,600 to be included in 2002/2003 Budget.

motions.title: Floreat Forum Palm Relocation
motions.description: A seven metre high palm (Phoenix canariensis) at the corner of The Boulevard and Howtree Place requires removal due to Floreat Forum Shopping Centre redevelopment. The Administration recommended relocation to a landscape professional outside the Town at nil cost. The Committee considered that the palm should be retained on-site with a revised landscaping plan.

motions.title: Review of Local Laws: Amendments
motions.description: The Town's recently adopted local laws were reviewed by the Parliamentary Joint Standing Committee on Delegated Legislation. The Committee suggested minor amendments to various local laws including the Parking, Local Government and Public Property, Trading in Public Places, Private Property, Animals, and Health local laws.

motions.title: Former Nursery Site: Salvado Road, Jolimont
motions.description: The Town owns the former Nursery site in Salvado Road, Jolimont, comprising 4.64 hectares subject to a Municipal Trust condition. The site has been used for municipal purposes since 1908. The Town seeks to remove the Trust to allow unrestricted use of the land, but the State Government seeks revenue-sharing arrangements. The Council authorised the CEO to continue negotiations with the Department of Land Administration and the relevant Minister.

motions.title: Underground Power – City Beach
motions.description: The Town proposes to submit an application to the State Underground Power Program Round 3 for installation of underground power to approximately 1,620 lots in City Beach area. The project would involve an estimated cost of approximately $6.5 million. The Council approved submission to Round 3 funding applications.

motions.title: National General Assembly of Local Government 2002
motions.description: The Council approved attendance at the 2002 National General Assembly of Local Government to be held in Alice Springs from 3 to 6 November 2002. The Mayor, two Councillors and the CEO were authorised to attend at an approximate cost of $2,700 per person.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for expenses incurred by the Town in accordance with Regulation 13 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule

The investment portfolio complies with Council Policy limiting not more than 25% of available funds to be placed with any one institution.

motions.title: Documents Sealed

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre – Inlet Channel Repair
motions.description: The central inlet channel of the outdoor 50m pool at Bold Park Aquatic Centre requires major repair or replacement due to structural impact from redevelopment works and year-round usage. Fremantle Diving Centre identified extensive damage requiring expert consultation.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre orchestra pit enclosure

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre orchestra pit enclosure - council decision
motions.description: Council decision following amendment to approve the enclosure of the orchestra pit at the Quarry Amphitheatre prior to the 2002/2003 performance season, up to a cost of $10,000, with structural certification required.

motions.title: Senior Needs Advisory Committee minutes and seniors initiatives
motions.description: Motion to receive the minutes of the Senior Needs Advisory Committee meeting held on 4 July 2002 and approve the appointment of a consultant to produce the 2002/2003 Seniors Information Directory up to $15,000.

motions.description: Amendment to add clause requiring Town of Cambridge residents be advised of Council's decision with full explanation of the Town's financial model and how it differs from the City of Subiaco's model.

motions.title: Underground Power - Daglish/Jolimont council decision
motions.description: Council decision approving the extension of the City of Subiaco underground power project to include 24 lots (30 assessments) in Daglish/Jolimont, subject to consultation with affected property owners and adoption of specified charging model.

motions.description: Council decision approving the sublease of up to 14,000m2 from the Speech and Hearing Centre to Bold Park Community School, subject to ministerial consent, memorandum of understanding amendments, and acknowledgment of Town's support.

motions.title: Lot 423 Marlow Street Wembley - six bay car wash approval

motions.title: Amendment to car wash application conditions
motions.description: Amendment to clause (i) of the car wash development conditions at Lot 423 Marlow Street, Wembley, requiring DEP satisfaction with contamination remediation.

motions.title: Approval of car wash with contamination conditions
motions.description: Committee recommendation to approve six-bay do-it-yourself car wash at Lot 423 Marlow Street, Wembley, subject to contamination remediation conditions.

motions.title: Refusal of car wash application due to contamination
motions.description: Motion to refuse the car wash application and advise applicant that council will not consider development until contamination is remediated, with additional clause for council to impress upon DEP the urgent need for remediation.

motions.description: Application for change of use from offices to shop (Broadway Surf and Sail retail) at Lot 6 Railway Parade, West Leederville, with parking shortfall variation.

motions.description: Motion to refer back the planning application for Lot 126 (No. 8) Weelara Road, City Beach to the Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration due to neighbours' concerns about amended plans.

motions.description: Council position on proposed redevelopment of Edith Cowan University Churchlands Campus for residential purposes with conditions regarding traffic management and through-traffic limitations. motions.title: Refuse additions to cottage and grouped dwelling, 118 Cambridge Street, West Leederville

motions.description: Proposed amendment to parking designation for the Truck Delivery Bay (Loading Zone) along Ruislip Street fronting the Koh-I-Noor redevelopment site from 15 minutes at all times to Half-hour parking 7am-7pm Monday to Saturday.

motions.title: RFQ Traffic Study Work Scope Approval

motions.title: Tender RFT 05-18 Cleaning Services Award

motions.title: Beecroft Park Final Concept Plan Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of final concept plan for Beecroft Park improvements following community engagement and amended design reflecting 70% support threshold and less than 25% opposition. Includes universal toilets, BBQ/picnic facilities, paths for wheelchair access, and additional features approved at committee meeting.

motions.title: Oban Road Parking and Landscaping Improvements Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of draft concept plan for parking, traffic calming and landscaping of Oban Road between The Boulevard and Gayton Road car park entry and Lot 100 area. Includes off-street parking reconfiguration, median and verge tree planting, landscaping in Lot 100, pedestrian connectivity improvements, and mural design for Water Corporation compliance.

motions.title: 2018-2019 Review of Fees and Charges - Works and Parks
motions.description: Adoption of fees and charges for road reserves and park reserves for 2018/19 financial year including crossover administration fee, crossover subsidy, and park access fees and bonds.

motions.title: 2018-2019 Review of Fees and Charges - Waste Services
motions.description: Adoption of waste management fees and charges for 2018/19 budget period, accommodating contractor collection contract price variations and increased disposal costs at Mindarie Regional Council due to lower member tonnages and State Government Landfill levy increase from $65 to $70 per tonne effective 1 July 2018.

motions.title: St John Ambulance WA Safe Town Partnership
motions.description: St John Ambulance WA has approached the Town seeking support in establishing the Town of Cambridge as a 'St John WA Safe Town' with a two-year Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). The partnership includes initiatives for training, safe assessments, defibrillators, event health services, and community transport services. An indicative budget of $35,000 for 2018/2019 is proposed with $18,000 in additional funds required.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre Fees and Charges 2018/2019
motions.description: Review of current fees and charges for entry, programs and services at Bold Park Aquatic Centre. The report recommends minor increases to entry and program fees of approximately 1.5% to reflect current market prices and increases in utilities and other costs. No increases proposed for Swim School enrolments or Centre Memberships due to competition from Scarborough Beach Pool.

motions.title: Age Friendly Community Plan and Seniors Services Strategy
motions.description: Creating Communities completed an Age-Friendly Community Plan (AFCP) with recommendations confirming that senior residents want to age-in-place. A Cambridge Seniors Services Strategy for 2018/19-2021/22 is proposed to establish a small Senior Services team to support older people (55+). Total funding of $255,000 operational and $12,000 capital requested for 2018/19.

motions.title: Challenger Parade Pedestrian Improvements and Traffic Calming Measures
motions.description: The Town received 175 responses to a community survey seeking views on proposed options to improve pedestrian crossings and traffic calming measures on Challenger Parade near the Surf Club Building and Commercial Development at City Beach. Community feedback shows general support for the initiatives. Preferred options are recommended for endorsement along with proposed priority of undertaking works for each option.

The budget incorporates a 5.5% general rate increase based on estimated general increase in net cost of services and increased rate funding for asset renewal. General rates levied at 6.8103 cents per dollar on GRV properties and 0.2024 cents per dollar on UV properties with minimum rate of $836. motions.title: Interim Position on Community Leases

motions.title: 63 Alexander Street, Wembley - Dental Surgery Use - Refusal

Advertising procedure completed with 11 submissions and one petition (31 signatures) received, all objecting. Concerns raised regarding traffic, parking, security, property values and amenity impact.

motions.title: 95-99 Cambridge Street, Leederville - J.B O'Reilly's Tavern - Internal Alterations - Lost

Existing parking shortfall of 30 bays, would increase to 42 with mezzanine. History of complaints regarding noise and parking. Motion to approve relocation of entertainment to snug area only (excluding mezzanine floor) subject to acoustic engineer report.

motions.title: 24 Caddy Avenue, Leederville - Two Storey Residence - Approved

motions.description: Committee recommendation for modest skate facility design similar to Subi Centro facility to be developed at Lake Monger Reserve with further report to committee.

motions.description: Motion to refer skate facility item back to committee for Lake Monger Working Group consideration.

motions.description: Motion to refer Scout facility matter back to Corporate and Customer Services Committee for further investigation of funding and accommodation options.

motions.description: Approval to advertise for expressions of interest in providing a contracted beach inspection and patrol service for five year period commencing 1 October 2000.
