motions.description: Proposed subdivision of Salvado Road/Jersey Street land into residential lots and sale of land to fund Wembley Town Centre works, carpark servicing, and other area improvements.

motions.title: Temporary kiosk licence at City Beach
motions.description: Vendors licence for temporary kiosk service at central City Beach during construction of new Café/Restaurant/Kiosk facility.

motions.title: Lot 236 Empire Avenue retaining wall application refused
motions.description: Application by B Allan for proposed retaining wall within front and secondary street setback areas at Lot 236 (No.35) Empire Avenue, corner of Chipping Road, City Beach. Proposal substantially exceeds Residential Design Guidelines height limits.

motions.title: Repeal of Local Law 43 deferred pending Scheme amendment
motions.description: Motion to initiate Town Planning Scheme amendment and defer repeal of Local Law 43 (Buildings on Endowment Lands and Limekilns Estate) until amendment is gazetted.

motions.title: Johnson Street Wembley section rename
motions.description: Application to rename the section of Johnson Street east of Daglish Street intersection to resolve street numbering issues for corner lot developments.

motions.title: Lot 209 Pandora Drive two-storey dwelling conditions
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling at Lot 209 (No.42) Pandora Drive, City Beach. Minister upheld appeal; council applies conditions for screening and landscaping.

motions.title: Speech and Hearing Centre Early Intervention Centre
motions.description: Application for an Early Intervention Centre at the Speech and Hearing Centre at Reserve R34689 (No. 36) Dodd Street, Wembley. The proposal includes a new building with associated car parking (28 bays proposed, total 60 bays with existing 32 bays). Committee expressed concern about incremental expansion and lack of long term planning. Administration was requested to speak to the Centre regarding parking access options.

motions.title: Lots 1,2,3 and 4 Oxford Close West Leederville office and warehouse
motions.description: Application for a new commercial development (office and warehouse) at Lots 1, 2, 3 and 4 (Nos 39-41) Oxford Close, West Leederville. Applicant Zeus Technology Pty Ltd seeks variation to parking standards - 22 bays proposed instead of 24 required (2 bay shortfall). Office/service/production area 183 sqm, warehouse 860 sqm, archive rooms 234 sqm on mezzanine. Building height 6.4-7 metres. An Absolute Majority required due to parking variation.

motions.title: Lot 73 Tilton Terrace City Beach aged and dependent persons dwellings
motions.description: Application for two aged and dependent persons' dwellings (single storey) at Lot 73 (No.1) Tilton Terrace (cnr Norbury Crescent), City Beach. Proposal requires variations to standards including primary street setback (6.5m instead of 7.5m), rear setback, and side setbacks. Previous similar proposal in March 1999 was refused; WAPC refused subdivision in April 1999; Minister for Planning granted subdivision on appeal in 2000. Site is 1204 sqm with 59% open space proposed. Each dwelling approximately 192-189.5 sqm excluding garages. Dwellings designed as aged persons residences with occupancy restrictions.

motions.title: Lot 1154 Katrine Street Floreat home occupation piano rental services
motions.description: Application for retrospective Planning Approval for a home occupation (Piano Rental Services) at Lot 1154 (No. 16) Katrine Street, Floreat. Business has been operating for 20 years. Garage 34.2 sqm and study 8.37 sqm used for business (total 42.4 sqm, exceeding 30 sqm policy limit). Site inspection found 12 pianos stored on site. Business operates hire service involving regular delivery/collection of pianos by trailer. Anonymous complaint received about business activities. No objections from immediate neighbours. Applicant claims Council officer inspected premises years ago and approved. No records found. Proposal violates definition of home occupation which explicitly excludes sale or hire of goods.

motions.title: Lot 502 Tilton Terrace City Beach two storey residence
motions.description: Application for a single two storey residence at Lot 502 (No. 5A) Tilton Terrace, City Beach. Lot area 772 sqm with 66% open space. Proposed residence has 3 bedrooms, kitchen, dining, family, laundry, bathroom and double garage on lower level (FFL 12.6) and 4th bedroom, ensuite and verandah on upper floor (FFL 15.4/15.5). Lot slopes away to rear and front. Applicant seeks variations to primary street setbacks (7.2m vs 7.5m required), side setbacks ground and upper floor, and retaining wall height. Adjoining neighbours signed plans with no objection. Councillor Smith expressed concern about development altering street character and requested recording against the motion.

motions.title: Lot 60 Clune Avenue West Leederville single dwelling
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for a single dwelling at Lot 60 (No. 2A) Clune Avenue, corner of Northwood Street, West Leederville. Lot created as part of 3-lot subdivision approved by WAPC in February 1996. Lot area 365 sqm with 45% open space (below 50% required). Dwelling has below-ground garage for 3 vehicles, main floor with 4 bedrooms, dining, lounge/family room, kitchen/breakfast bar, laundry. Distinctive architecture with two towers and turret as features. Subject to 2.7m Western Power easement along Northwood Street. Applicant seeks variations to primary street setback (4.57m vs 6m required), rear setback (2.674m minimum vs 6m average required), side setbacks, and open space (45% vs 50% required). Neighbours consulted; western neighbours no objection after plans modified; rear neighbour no objection. An Absolute Majority required for open space variation.

motions.title: Lot 165 Hesperia Avenue City Beach ground floor and upper storey additions
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions to existing residence at Lot 165 (No. 38) Hesperia Avenue, City Beach. Lot area 986 sqm with 69% open space. Proposed modifications include ground floor lounge, kitchen, laundry and outdoor deck; upper storey addition with master bedroom, ensuite, balcony and study. Existing two storey wall to be extended and height increased. Building setback 20-23 metres from street. Applicant seeks variations to rear setback (6.9m vs 7.5m average required) and side setback south (1.4m ground floor and 1.0-1.7m upper floor vs 1.5m and 1.7m required) and building height (7.45m vs 6.5m specified). Neighbours consulted: northern neighbour no objection; northern west neighbour no objection; southern neighbour (40 Hesperia Avenue) raised objections to building bulk and overshadowing. Plans modified to reduce height and increase setback from southern boundary in response to concerns. Neighbours at 40 Hesperia Avenue yet to comment on latest modified plans.

motions.title: Upper storey addition and ground floor extensions at 38 Hesperia Avenue
motions.description: Application for additions to existing residence at Lot 165 (No.38) Hesperia Avenue, City Beach. Further comments from neighbours at 40 Hesperia Avenue received, objecting to intrusion of south west wall for stairwell but accepting rear extension.

motions.title: Additions and alterations to dwelling at 10 Dartmouth Avenue
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions and alterations to existing two-storey dwelling at Lot 181 (No.10) Dartmouth Avenue, City Beach. Applicant seeks approval to vary wall and roof height standards under Residential Design Guidelines. Wall height proposed 9.2 metres (non-compliant with 6.5 metre requirement) and roof height 10.2 metres (non-compliant with 10 metre requirement). Extension would create third level to residence.

motions.title: Shed/workshop construction at 55 Marlow Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for building approval for shed/workshop constructed of steel sheeting at rear of existing house at Lot 421 (No.55) Marlow Street, Wembley. Shed is 48 square metres, 3.3 metres high, 3 metres from rear boundary, 1 metre from side boundary (north). Exceeds standard by 12 square metres. Applicant seeks approval to vary maximum floor area for outbuilding.

motions.title: Fill and retaining walls on boundary at Perina Way and Yaltara Road
motions.description: Application for building approval for relocation of existing limestone retaining wall and associated fill at subdivision creating new lot 503 (No.3) Perina Way between lots 81 and 82, City Beach. Proposed retaining walls on western and southern boundaries to achieve level of RL 100.50. Western boundary wall 1.19-1.28 metres high, 8.43 metres long. Southern boundary wall maximum 1.55 metres high. Adjoining property owner at lot 70 objected regarding privacy and additional elevation.

motions.title: Fence and carport door at 2A Dumfries Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for construction of fence and installation of garage door to existing carport at corner lot. Proposed fence on front and side boundaries. Applicant seeks to vary 80% primary and 40% secondary street visual permeability clauses. Enclosure of carport would create garage requiring 9m setback from primary street boundary.

motions.title: Front fence at 208 Harborne Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for building approval for front fence at Lot 1073 (No.208) Harborne Street, Wembley on west boundary. Applicant seeks approval to vary 80% primary street visual permeability clause. Proposed fence 85% solid, permitted is 20% solid. Council notes Harborne Street is District Distributor A Road with significant traffic volumes.

motions.title: Pylon signs and flag poles at 350 Cambridge Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for planning and building approval for four pylon signs at No.350 Cambridge Street, Wembley. Pylons 4.63 metres high and 1.98m wide. Proposed signs display hotel information. Non-compliant: 4 signs proposed (2 permitted), 2.7m headway clearance (2.75m required), 14.65m² area (10m² permitted). Signs previously erected and removed approximately 2.5 years ago.

motions.title: Outcome of legal action against Butcher Tom's
motions.description: Report on legal proceedings initiated against Proprietor of Butcher Tom's, Shop 30, 13 Howtree Place, Floreat Forum, Floreat for contraventions of Health Act 1911. Two charges brought for preparation and sale of 95% Lean Topside Mince containing more fat than prescribed standard. Case heard 21 March 2000. Defendant convicted on both charges.

motions.title: Street closure of Regent Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Proposed closure of Regent Street road reserve and amalgamation with adjacent Tower Park. Council consulted 94 residents in October 1999 by letter regarding closure and park establishment. 12 submissions received: 10 supported park establishment, 2 opposed (applicant and one resident). Main concerns: parking, anti-social behaviour, landscaping design, costs. Estimated landscaping works cost $35,000. Committee endorsed initiation of closure procedures on 18 April 2000.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme No.1 Proposed Amendments No.3 and No.4
motions.description: Proposed amendments to rectify errors and make administrative changes to Town Planning Scheme No.1. Amendment No.3: rectify zoning error - Lot 1 (No.182) and 1084 (No.186) Harborne Street incorrectly zoned Residential R20, should be Local Centre; lots 1104, 1105, 1106 incorrectly zoned Local Centre, should be Residential R20. Amendment No.4: modify scheme text including clause references, delete Subiaco Redevelopment Authority reference, add new Use Classes (Conference Centre, Hospital Special Purposes, Dwelling Multiple).

motions.title: Permission for Cr Anderton to participate in DES00.70 discussions
motions.description: Cr Anderton declared interest in item DES00.70 (Street Name Changes) as part owner of property in Boscombe Avenue and left the meeting at 7.14pm. Project involves removal of surface soil, fence installation, and drainage works estimated at $12,000 to be funded as unbudgeted expenditure from the Endowment Lands Account.

motions.title: Beach Front Park name change to City Beach Park
motions.description: Review of the name of Beach Front Park and installation of park identification signs. The park's current name is considered merely a location descriptor rather than a proper name. Four alternative names were proposed, with the Administration recommending "City Beach Park".

motions.title: Street tree pruning practices amendment and streetscape strategy
motions.description: Review of street tree management and pruning operations to address resident concerns and improve customer satisfaction. Proposes amendment of current pruning practices according to new specification to be included in the 2001/2002 tender, and development of a vegetated streetscape strategy to minimize impact on residents.

motions.title: New Skid Steer Loader tender acceptance
motions.description: Acceptance of tender for provision of new Skid Steer Loader and disposal of existing Council Skid Steer Mustang 960. Comparative analysis of nine tenderers offering twelve different loaders, with selection based on whole-of-life cost assessment.

motions.title: Special meeting of Council on 7 May 2001
motions.description: Approval to hold a Special Meeting of Council to perform post-election functions including swearing in of councillors, election of Deputy Mayor, appointment of standing committees, and appointment of council delegates and representatives.

motions.title: Adoption of Trading in Public Places Local Law
motions.description: Adoption of final version of Town of Cambridge Trading in Public Places Local Law incorporating updated provisions from multiple former by-laws, reflecting current practices and ensuring compliance with National Competition Policy requirements. Health Department recommendations regarding itinerant food vendors have been incorporated.

motions.title: Adoption of Local Government and Public Property Local Law
motions.description: Adoption of final version of Town of Cambridge Local Government and Public Property Local Law incorporating updated provisions from nine former by-laws, including controls for streets, parks, golf courses, beach areas, swimming pool and halls.

motions.title: Adoption of Health Local Law 2001
motions.description: Adoption of final version of Town of Cambridge Health Local Law 2001 to replace inherited City of Perth local law. Includes revisions recommended by Health Department of WA regarding deletion of food premises provisions and transfer of itinerant food vendor provisions.

motions.title: Adoption of Health (Food Premises) Local Law 2001
motions.description: Adoption of draft Health (Food Premises) Local Law 2001 to provide separate regulation of food premises following Health Department of WA recommendations to separate food premises provisions from the general Health Local Law.

motions.title: Adoption of Animals Local Law
motions.description: Adoption of final version of Town of Cambridge Animals Local Law incorporating updated provisions from former by-laws for control of dogs, cats, large animals, domestic fowl, pigeons, and bees on public and private property.

motions.title: Accounts for payment confirmation
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for expenses incurred by the Town to fund its operation in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment schedule received
motions.description: Receipt of investment schedule for period ended 28 February 2001 detailing amount of surplus funds invested, distribution across institutions, and financial performance of each investment.

motions.title: Documents sealed noted
motions.description: Notation of documents sealed with the Common Seal of the Town including Withdrawal of Caveat and Deed of Surrender of Lease.

motions.title: Monthly financial statements received
motions.description: Receipt of Financial Statements for the period ended 31 March 2001.

motions.title: Seniors Needs Study Report to May 2001 Council
motions.description: Workshop conducted by Elizabeth Vlok from Community Perspectives on the Seniors Needs Study. Motion to present draft report to May 2001 Council meeting.

motions.title: Chaplaincy Service at City Beach High School
motions.description: Request from City Beach Christian Resource Council Chaplaincy Committee for increase to Town's financial contribution. Original commitment was $2,000 per annum for three years from 1995/96. Recommendation to continue support for another three-year term.

motions.title: Security Patrols at Council Beach Car Parking
motions.description: Examination of need for Council-funded security guard at City Beach and Floreat Beach carparks to reduce theft from vehicles. Police statistics show average of just under one offence per day over six-month period. Recommendation against dedicated security guard; instead support educational campaign.

motions.title: Aquatic and Recreation Institute Conference Attendance
motions.description: Approval for Bold Park Aquatic Centre Manager to attend 37th Aquatic and Recreation Institute Conference in Sydney, 9-11 May 2001. Topics include pool filtration, water recycling, marketing, risk management, and future aquatic facilities. Cost approximately $2,500 to be reallocated from Program Account 500/87.

motions.title: Cambridge Linx Pilot Bus Project Discontinuation
motions.description: Evaluation of Cambridge Linx Pilot Bus Project which commenced 30 January 2001. Grant of $10,200 from Department of Local Government for pilot community bus service. Poor patronage: only 12 people used service in first five weeks of operation. PATH Transit recommended non-continuation.

motions.title: Joan Watters Children's Centre Service Delivery Review
motions.description: Review of Joan Watters Out of School Care program following operational changes at commencement of 2000/2001 financial year. Discussion of service provider issues, Council involvement, childcare benefit irregularities. Recommendation to call for Expressions of Interest for management responsibility with transition period until December 2001.

motions.title: Crime Prevention Advisory Committee Minutes Received
motions.description: Minutes of Crime Prevention Advisory Committee meeting held Thursday 22 March 2001 presented to Council for public record. Committee is constituted as Council Committee with Elected Member as Chairperson.

motions.title: Library Development – Major Land Transactions
motions.description: Approval for land transactions to facilitate development of new Town Library. Involves disposal of existing Floreat Library site (Lot 39 Howtree Place) to General Property Trust and acquisition of new Library site fronting The Boulevard. Compliance with Local Government Act sections 3.58 and 3.59. No submissions received during advertising periods. Business Plan prepared and approved.

motions.title: Floreat Library User Needs Study – Main Motion
motions.description: Results of Floreat Library User Needs Study conducted 19 February to 10 March 2001 involving questionnaires, school letters, community advertisement, and discussion groups. 242 questionnaires received from 17,000 visitors (1.3% return rate). Users predominately female, 60+ years, retired. Main criticisms: availability of new material, collection quality, access to technology.

motions.title: Floreat Library User Needs Study – Amendment 1
motions.description: Amendment to clause (iv) of main motion regarding frequency of user needs studies. Cr Smith expressed disappointment with low survey response rate and moved amendment to require Council be informed of steps to increase response rate before conducting future studies.

motions.title: Floreat Library User Needs Study – Amendment 2 (Lapsed)
motions.description: Amendment moved by Cr Smith to modify clause (v) regarding phone survey of non-users. Amendment lapsed for want of a seconder.

motions.title: Speech and Hearing Centre Lease – Revocation of Review Condition
motions.description: Recommendation to rescind part of Council's 27 June 2000 decision regarding lease extension for Speech and Hearing Centre for Deaf Children. Town's solicitors advised that condition allowing Council to review and amend lease terms at expiry of first 21-year term creates potential dispute and uncertainty unsuitable for binding agreement.

motions.title: Post Polio Network lease agreement
motions.description: Lease agreement with the Post Polio Network of WA Inc for premises, with rent increase by CPI (2.4%)

motions.title: Floreat Forum Shopping Centre redevelopment approval
motions.description: Application for planning approval for the redevelopment and upgrading of the Floreat Forum shopping centre at Lot 43 (No. 5) Howtree Place, Floreat. Overall floor area increasing from 11,654m² to 18,403m², including expansion of supermarkets, fresh food hall, decked carpark, relocated petrol station, restaurant precinct, tavern, and free standing retail outlet.

motions.description: Reception of quarterly financial review for period ended 30 September 1997 detailing statement of financial position, rate setting statement, operating statement, and budget variances with officer explanations.

motions.description: Making of Parking Facilities Local Law amendment increasing penalty for breach of Local Law provisions to maximum of $1,500, following advertising and no objections received.

motions.description: Approval of staffing and celebratory arrangements for the Christmas/New Year period, including office closure times, staff function, and elected members Christmas function arrangements.

motions.description: Response to Local Government Advisory Board proposal for boundary adjustment between Town of Cambridge and City of Subiaco, including forwarding submission, inviting board discussion, and advising residents of the proposal.

motions.description: Application for conversion of existing church building into three residential units and a two storey residence on adjoining vacant lot at 79 Woolwich Street, West Leederville, submitted by [private individual — name withheld]. motions.description: Application for a two storey residence on Lots 19 and 20 (No.79) Woolwich Street, West Leederville, submitted by L and J Pike. The proposal did not reflect heritage values and was incompatible with the existing character of the area.

motions.description: Application for a single residential dwelling (two-storey with undercroft garage and cellar) at Lot 251, No. 6 Adori Place, City Beach, submitted by Paul Meschiati and Associates on behalf of K K Smith. The proposal includes variations to plot ratio and setbacks.

motions.description: Application from Floreat Surf Life Saving Club for Council's approval to extend their premises at Floreat Beach. The proposed extension would be located on the south west corner of the building and would occupy an area of 90 square metres. Consideration was deferred pending completion of Coastal Planning Study.

motions.description: Application for alterations and additions to existing medical consulting centre at No.28 McCourt Street, West Leederville, submitted by White Dundas Architects Pty Ltd on behalf of Reira Pty Ltd. The addition comprises surgery rooms and related medical facilities. Includes conditions requiring design modifications to rear façade.

motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to the existing single storey residence at Lot 340, No.4 Tumut Road, City Beach, submitted by L and T Whinnen. The proposal includes a proposed upper storey to accommodate three bedrooms and study area.

motions.title: Financial Assistance - Community Organisations 2010/2011
motions.description: Endorsement of disbursement of funds for 2010/2011 Financial Assistance to Community Organisations program with total approved amount of $13,587 (excl GST) from budgeted $12,000, requiring approval of additional $1,587 by absolute majority.

motions.title: Leederville Sporting Club - Financial Assistance for Coolroom Facilities
motions.description: Emergency funding request from Leederville Sporting Club for removal and replacement of coolroom refrigeration plant and electrical equipment at 78 Cambridge Street, West Leederville. Project cost $9,335 with Town contribution of $4,668 (dollar for dollar basis).

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements - September 2010
motions.description: Review of financial position for the period ended 30 September 2010 with commentary on permanent and timing variances.

motions.title: Annual Financial Report for year ended 30 June 2010
motions.description: Consideration of the Annual Financial Report for the year ended 30 June 2010, including audit testing and compliance with accounting standards.

motions.title: Representation on statutory authorities - amendment
motions.description: Amendment to the motion regarding nomination of Council representatives to various statutory authorities and public bodies.

motions.title: Representation on statutory authorities - final decision
motions.description: Council decision on nominations for representation on various statutory authorities and public bodies, with Mayor Withers nominated to the Superannuation Plan Board.

motions.title: Purchase of 38 Cambridge Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Approval to purchase property at 38 Cambridge Street, West Leederville for $3 million following public advertising of Business Plan under Local Government Act 1995 s3.59.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Minutes of the Development Committee Meeting held on 7 August 2023

motions.title: DV23.42 - Tavern and Betting Agency Use
motions.description: Proposed change of use from 'Health Studio' to 'Tavern' and 'Betting Agency (Use Not Listed)' at Suite 24, Lot 8 (No. 350) Cambridge Street, Wembley. The proposal is for a sports bar with three self-service wagering terminals operating under an extension of the Wembley Hotel's tavern liquor licence, with maximum 80 patrons at any one time. Six objections and 36 submissions in support were received during public consultation.

motions.title: Procedural Motion - Item Referred to Council
motions.description: Motion to submit DV23.42 to Council for determination following discussion at Committee level

motions.title: DV23.43 - Carport Addition at Orrel Avenue, Floreat
motions.description: Application for alterations and additions to existing single house at Lot 78 (No. 21) Orrel Avenue, Floreat, including a carport within the 9m primary street setback area, landscaping, front fence additions, and new crossover. The carport provides covered parking for two vehicles. Development value $18,500.

motions.title: DV23.44 Lot 1712 No. 60 Oceanic Drive Floreat - Refuse Front Fence and Retaining Wall
motions.description: Non-complying application for proposed front fence and retaining wall within the primary street setback area. The proposal includes retaining walls with a maximum height of 1.2m set back 0.6m from the primary street boundary (in lieu of 9m), fill with a maximum height of 1.2m, and front fencing with maximum overall height of 2.56m (in lieu of 1.8m).

motions.title: DV23.45 Lot 1107 No. 2 Yolande Place City Beach - Refuse Alterations and Additions
motions.description: Non-complying application for alterations and additions to existing single house including garage extension built up to western boundary with reduced primary street setback of 5.4m (in lieu of 7.5m), reduced side boundary setbacks, reduced rear boundary setback, and timber look cladding materials.

motions.title: DV23.46 Lot 476 Ferndale Street Floreat - Refuse carport and verandah extension
motions.description: Application for carport addition and extension to existing verandah to existing single house at Lot 476 (No. 12) Ferndale Street, Floreat. Proposal includes new double carport in front of existing garage with minimum street setback of 3.57m in lieu of 9m, and 1.6m2 minor extension to existing verandah with setback of 7.4m from front boundary in lieu of 9m.

motions.title: DV23.47 Lot 214 Dodonia Gardens City Beach - Refuse alterations and additions (Administration recommendation)
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing two-storey single house at Lot 214 (No. 11) Dodonia Gardens, City Beach. Initially proposed carport, patio, and fireplace with reduced setbacks. Following August deferral, amended plans received 23 August 2023 with increased setbacks and fireplace moved behind street setback. Development value $500,000.

motions.title: DV23.47 Lot 214 Dodonia Gardens City Beach - Approve alterations and additions (Committee recommendation)
motions.description: Following rejection of Administration recommendation, Committee moved alternative motion to approve the application. The Committee determined that the amended application meets the streetscape policy and in terms of visual bulk it satisfies the Committee's requirements.

motions.title: DV23.48 Local Law 43 variations - Approve five material applications
motions.description: Applications under Local Law 43 for approval of building materials variations for five properties in City Beach and Floreat. Properties: 1 Yolande Place (timber-look covet battens), 86 Branksome Gardens (timber cladding), 35 Pindari Road (feature timber cladding), 247 Selby Street (selected axon cladding), 28 Tilton Terrace (James Hardie Scyon Linea weatherboard cladding).

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 27 August 2013
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting held on 27 August 2013.

motions.title: Lot 31 (No. 23) Hovea Crescent - Retrospective Driveway Application
motions.description: Retrospective application for a driveway at No. 23 Hovea Crescent, City Beach. The proposal was initially assessed as non-compliant but the applicant provided an alternative proposal during the Development Committee meeting. The alternative proposal increases landscaping by extending a landscaping strip separating double and single driveways. The amended proposal from 17 September 2013 was submitted to Council for determination.

motions.title: Lot 1 and 2 (No. 47) Pangbourne Street - Two Storey Grouped Dwellings
motions.description: Application for two, two storey grouped dwellings in mirror image at No. 47 Pangbourne Street, Wembley. The site is a redevelopment of an existing single storey duplex. Assessment required against landscaping in primary street setback area design principles. During committee discussion, members questioned whether garage impact could be further reduced by lowering floor levels and increasing balcony protrusion. The applicant requested consideration of the proposal as presented. An amendment was made at Council to increase balcony depth to 1 metre over the garage.

motions.title: Lot 407 (No. 21) Larundel Road - Two Storey Dwelling
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling at No. 21 Larundel Road, City Beach. Assessment required against rear setback design principles and objection received from adjoining property. Amended plans submitted to address concerns regarding upper storey windows. At committee meeting, members agreed the building should be moved north by 1 metre to alleviate neighbour overshadowing concerns. Amendment added conditions for increased rear setback and transparent fencing requirements.

motions.title: Lot 11 (No. 9) Caddy Avenue - Two Storey Dwelling
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling at No. 9 Caddy Avenue, West Leederville. Assessment required against street setback, open space, wall height, street surveillance and landscaping design principles. Original administration recommendation required ensuite wall to be set back 4.0 metres. Applicant submitted amended plans moving the entire dwelling back to achieve the deemed-to-comply front setback requirement of 4.0 metres for the upper floor, which increased landscaping provision from 49% to 57%.

motions.title: Lot 365 (No. 3) Ocean Court - Two Storey Dwelling
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling at No. 3 Ocean Court, City Beach with reduced street setbacks and nil setbacks to side and rear boundaries. Assessment required against street setback, building height and landscaping design principles. Original administration recommendation required deletion of front fencing. At committee meeting, members noted that the proposed fence meets deemed-to-comply provisions and could remain. Amendment passed to delete the fencing deletion condition.

motions.title: Second storey addition at Lot 1 Kavanagh Street
motions.description: Application for second storey addition submitted by Nexus Home Improvements at Lot 1 (No. 13a) Kavanagh Street, Wembley. The applicant sought variations to deemed-to-comply provisions relating to visual privacy and solar access. Neighbour submissions were received from adjoining properties objecting to privacy variations and bulk of the two storey.

motions.title: Referral of Lot 1 Kavanagh Street back to Development Committee
motions.description: Following the committee recommendation that the application be approved, during discussion a question was asked as to whether Council approval had been given for the enclosed garage. It was suggested that the item be referred back to Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Solid front fence at Lot 1158 Katrine Street - Committee recommendation
motions.description: Council's decision to refuse a retrospective application for solid front fencing at No. 8 Katrine Street had been appealed to the State Administrative Tribunal. Following a directions hearing and on-site mediation, the applicant submitted amended plans. The Development Committee recommended that Council not approve the plans dated 3 September 2013 but be prepared to approve a revised design incorporating tubes or wrought iron instead of panels.

motions.title: Solid front fence at Lot 1158 Katrine Street - Council decision
motions.description: Following the amendment to the committee recommendation and further consideration of amended plans dated 24 September 2013 showing revised infill design with 3:1 open-to-solid ratio similar to gatehouse infill, Council approved the plans with conditions for modification within 60 days.

motions.title: Housing Options Study - Council decision on proceeding
motions.description: Following extensive community consultation on the Housing Options Study with 92 submissions received, Council considered recommendations from the Development Committee regarding the administration of the outcomes and progression of the Housing Options Study through the Town Planning Scheme Review Steering Committee.

motions.title: Cat Act 2011 - Implementation and Authorisations
motions.description: Council considered matters relating to the implementation and administration of the Cat Act 2011, including delegation of powers to the CEO, authorisation to negotiate a contract with Cat Haven Inc for provision of a Cat Management Facility and cat trapping service, and adoption of cat registration fees.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications for August 2013
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for August 2013, including planning approvals, referrals to WAPC, and notifications of applications for review.

motions.title: Building Permits Approved under Delegated Authority - August 2013
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data of building permits approved under delegated authority in August 2013.

motions.title: Traffic chicanes and Ruislip Street intersections
motions.description: Council considered a petition for a roundabout at Holland/Ruislip Streets and alternative traffic calming treatments for several intersections with Ruislip Street.

motions.title: Keane Street/Ruislip Street roundabout construction - decline grant
motions.description: Council considered declining the Black Spot Grant for a roundabout at Keane/Ruislip Streets and pursuing alternative stop sign treatment instead.

motions.title: Parking restriction - Southport Street
motions.description: Council approved implementation of 'No Stopping - Road or Verge' parking restrictions in Southport Street between Cambridge Street and the Mitchell Freeway pedestrian overpass.

motions.title: Dodd Street - New Shared Path and Replacement Footpath
motions.description: Council deferred consideration of proposed shared path and footpath works in Dodd Street to the Council Forum for further consideration of additional construction options.

motions.title: Lake Monger Reserve - Security Lights Replacement/Provision Program
motions.description: Council received a report on the unsuccessful grant application and the status of stages 1 and 2 of the security lights replacement program.

motions.title: Waste Policy - Fee Rebate (Concession) for Hardship
motions.description: Council adopted a new waste fee concession policy for large families and compassionate circumstances.

motions.title: Community Sporting Recreation Facilities Fund - Bold Park Aquatic Centre
motions.description: Council submitted a forward planning grant application for $3 million to support redevelopment of Bold Park Aquatic Centre.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Skate Park Expansion - Community Consultation
motions.description: Proposed staged expansion of Perry Lakes Skate Park incorporating Options 3 Stage 1 and Stage 2 design concepts with cost estimates of $445,000 and $595,000 respectively. Recommendation to undertake community consultation on the staged expansion approach.

motions.title: Events - City Beach Foreshore and Ovals - March 2014
motions.description: Approval sought for two separate events over the weekend of 22-23 March 2014: a sandcastle building competition at City Beach and an inaugural Harmony Week Multicultural Australian Football League event at City Beach Ovals. Total estimated cost $25,000 with $10,000 from Council budget and remainder from event partners.

motions.title: Surf Club Building - WAPC Approval and Community Consultation
motions.description: Report on submissions received regarding the Town's submission to WAPC for Development Approval for the Surf Club Building and Commercial Development at City Beach. Twenty-three submissions received with majority of concerns relating to traffic in Challenger Parade. Amendment moved to prepare options for parking, speed reduction and traffic treatments.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Course Hospitality Concept Design - Community Consultation Outcome
motions.description: Report on community consultation feedback for the proposed concept design for new facilities at Wembley Golf Course. 373 questionnaires received with 76% in favour of expanded facilities and 72% in favour of development as proposed. Main concerns from social golf clubs regarding meeting spaces and memorabilia display areas.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre - Concept Design
motions.description: Proposed redevelopment of Bold Park Aquatic Centre including new 10 lane 50 metre main pool, learn to swim/leisure pool, new main building and associated works. Revised conceptual layout presented with community consultation recommended. Estimated construction cost $8.6 million.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - August 2013
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for August 2013 in accordance with Local Government Act (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Total payments of $8,015,827.25 comprising cheque payments of $911,782.93 and electronic fund transfers of $7,104,044.32.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - August 2013
motions.description: Report on the amount of surplus funds invested, distribution of those funds and financial performance. Total investment at end of August 2013 is $23.7 million with weighted average interest rate of 3.68% compared to cash rate of 2.50%.

motions.title: Financial Statements August 2013 received
motions.description: Monthly financial report for the period ended 31 August 2013, showing operating revenue of $25 million in line with budget, operating expenses of $5.9 million against budget of $6.6 million with favourable variance of $671k, and net operating surplus of $19.2 million.

motions.title: Budget Amendment 2013/2014 carried forward works
motions.description: Amendment to the 2013/2014 budget following finalisation of year end 2012/2013 revenues and expenditures. Closing funds carried forward reduced from $4,602,400 to $4,554,400 due to cash deficit of $48,000. Carried forward works schedule amended including Treescape Plan reduction of $59,500, West Leederville Centre Street Enhancement increase to $729,000, and deletion of Central City Beach Toilets project. Major projects schedule amended including reallocation of $530k from Wembley Golf Course Trail to West Leederville Streetscape Project.

motions.title: West Leederville Streetscape parking restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of parking restrictions during construction of West Leederville Centre streetscape project awarded in August 2013. Works will require single lane movements in Cambridge Street in each direction. No kerbside stopping for vehicles (except bus stops) will be provided during works.

motions.title: Petition regarding soft plastics recycling
motions.description: Petition with 35 signatures from Cassie Clarkson requesting Council provide further information on soft plastics recycling and initiate 'purple lid' bin collection from verge.

motions.title: Allow Vic Richards deputation on Item 11.3
motions.description: Motion to allow Vic Richards to make a deputation regarding Item 11.3 – Proposed 'Freeplay Zone' Trial in Empire Park, City Beach.

motions.title: Allow Julian Atkinson deputation on Item CR21.113
motions.description: Motion to allow Julian Atkinson to make a deputation regarding Item CR21.113 – Draft Perry Lakes Management Plan – Results of Community Consultation.

motions.title: Allow Jordeana Cain deputation on Item 11.3
motions.description: Motion to allow Jordeana Cain to make a deputation regarding Item 11.3 – Proposed 'Freeplay Zone' Trial in Empire Park, City Beach.

motions.title: Procedural motion to reject minutes amendment
motions.description: Procedural motion to reject Mayor's recommendation to amend the Minutes of 12 October 2021 regarding Harms Lane consultation.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes 12 October 2021 with amendment
motions.description: Confirmation of Minutes of 12 October 2021 with amendment regarding Harms Lane consultation.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes 19 October 2021
motions.description: Confirmation of Minutes of Special Council Meeting held on 19 October 2021.

motions.title: Proposed Variations to Local Law 43
motions.description: Council determination of applications for variations to Local Law 43 - Buildings on Endowment Lands & Limekilns Estate for two properties: Lot 3 (No. 1A) Hovea Crescent, City Beach regarding brown cladding, and Lot 1215 (No. 25) Cromarty Road, Floreat regarding tinted acrylic sheeting.

motions.title: Scheme Amendment No. 40 approval
motions.description: Council approval of Scheme Amendment No. 40 for Lot 547 (No. 69) McCourt Street, West Leederville to permit Liquor Store and Take Away Food Outlet as discretionary 'A' uses.

motions.title: West Leederville Activity Centre Plan - Deferral to Elected Member Forum
motions.description: Consideration of the draft West Leederville Activity Centre Plan following consultation, with recommendations for approval subject to modifications. Mayor suggested deferral to Elected Member Forum for newly elected members to consider.

motions.title: Cambridge Street Medical Precinct Urban Design Study and Local Planning Policy 2.5.2
motions.description: Council considered the Cambridge Street Medical Precinct Urban Design Study and draft Local Planning Policy 2.5.2: Medical Precinct following community consultation. The report recommended adoption of the draft LPP2.5.2 with modifications to address submissions received regarding setbacks, building height, plot ratio, and density coding.

motions.title: Planning Delegated Decisions and Notifications – October 2021
motions.description: Council received the register of Planning Delegated decisions for October 2021. The planning applications listed had been dealt with under delegated authority as they complied with the Town Planning Scheme and Council Policy.

motions.title: Building Permits Approved Under Delegated Authority – October 2021
motions.description: Council received the register of Building Permits issued under delegated authority for October 2021. The report detailed building approvals issued during the month, including 35 certified building permits, 10 uncertified building permits, 4 demolition permits, and other building approval certificates with a total construction value of $3,171,481.40.

motions.title: Light Vehicle Replacement Program
motions.description: Council approved the acquisition and disposal of 18 light fleet vehicles identified for replacement in the 2021/2022 financial year, including seven Sport Utility Vehicles (SUVs) and 11 utility vehicles. The proposal includes fleet standardisation to the Toyota RAV4 GX Hybrid for SUVs and standardisation of utility vehicles to one make where possible, with estimated acquisition costs of $608,100, trade-in value of $446,500, and net changeover cost of $161,600.

motions.title: Energy Sustainability and Renewables Project
motions.description: Council approved participation in the WA Local Government Sustainable Energy Future Tender for the development of a Local Government Power Purchase Agreement allowing for the adoption of 100% renewable energy at contestable sites for a three year contract term commencing April 2022. The Town will purchase renewable energy from three accredited windfarms (Emu Downs, Collar and Albany) with an additional annual cost of $81,244 for 100% renewable uptake.

motions.title: Jubilee Park – Basketball Half-Court
motions.description: Council approved the concept design for a basketball half-court facility and ancillary items at Jubilee Park, City Beach. The project responds to a petition received in February 2019 with 16 signatures requesting installation of a half-court basketball facility. The facility will be 12 metres long by 16 metres wide with a Plexipave surface, limestone block wall behind the hoop for seating and ball barrier, new pathway and pram ramp from Challenger Parade, and limestone block edging to replace existing log edge.

motions.title: Marlow Street, Cambridge to Ruislip Street, Wembley Road Modifications – Final Consultation Outcomes
motions.description: Council considered the outcomes of community consultation relating to the removal of five centre island Angophora costata street trees on Marlow Street, Wembley and the planting of 11 verge Lophostemon confertus trees. The consultation showed 70% of respondents supported the removal of the centre island trees (74% when considering household responses). The removal addresses damage to the road caused by tree root systems. Additional funding of $60,000 from the Durston Road resurfacing project variance is required, with total removal and remedial works cost of $159,116.

motions.title: Marlow Street tree removal and road widening
motions.description: Community engagement results from Marlow Street residents relating to removal of five centre island trees; transfer of funds from road resurfacing program to Marlow Street road widening project; removal of trees and planting of replacement trees.

motions.title: Churchlands Green traffic trials update
motions.description: Traffic counts recorded on Town's road network during City of Stirling's Churchlands Green traffic management trial from May to September 2021; discussion of increased traffic on streets within the Town.

motions.title: Ocean Mia Estate on-street parking consultation
motions.description: Community consultation results relating to on-street parking within Ocean Mia Estate; approval for maintaining status quo and removal of footpath sections along Omaroo Terrace.

motions.title: CR21.111 recommittal procedural motion
motions.description: Procedural motion to recommit item CR21.111 to permit Cr Bradley to speak on the item.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Reserve conservation covenant
motions.description: Approval to establish conservation covenant over part of Perry Lakes Reserve to increase eligibility for grant funding for revegetation and land management activities.

motions.title: Draft Perry Lakes Management Plan adoption
motions.description: Adoption of final Perry Lakes Management Plan 2021-2031 and Perry Lakes Masterplan 2021-2031 following community consultation; feedback primarily related to minor grammar corrections and requests for cycling facilities.

motions.title: Wembley Oval electronic scoreboard approval
motions.description: Approval for Wembley Athletics Club to install electronic scoreboard at Wembley Oval subject to conditions regarding funding, supervision, and promotion of Town events.

motions.title: RFT 2021-17 Lake Monger Pump and Jump Track contract award
motions.description: Approval of additional budget allocation of $80,000 and award of contract for design and construction of Lake Monger Pump and Jump Track following tender evaluation.

motions.title: Summer Bus Service - Notes information
motions.description: Council to note information contained in the report related to the provision of future Summer Bus services, including accessibility requirements, communications, route changes, and three service options (Town community buses, external bus service, or co-funded Transperth service).

motions.title: World Transplant Games 2023 - Sponsorship Approval
motions.description: Council to approve in principle for consideration in the 2022/23 Budget a sponsorship amount of $20,000 (ex GST) to support the World Transplant Games as a Supporting Sponsor. The Games will be held April 15-21, 2023 at various venues in Perth including locations within the Town of Cambridge.

motions.title: Community Development Grant - City Beach Activation Association
motions.description: Council to approve the awarding of $2,000 grant funding through the Community Development Grant program to City Beach Activation Association for their family friendly New Year's Eve event to be held on Friday, 31 December 2021 at City Beach foreshore.

motions.title: Community Organisation Support Grant Round One - Awards
motions.description: Council to approve the awarding of grant funding through the Community Organisation Support Grant program for ten applications submitted by various community organisations for round one of the program, with a total allocation of $11,020.50.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - October 2021
motions.description: Council to confirm the schedule of account payments for the month of October 2021 in accordance with Regulation 13 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - October 2021
motions.description: Council to receive the Investment Schedule for October 31, 2021 providing information on the Town's investment portfolio performance during the month, including total investments of $57.8 million.

motions.title: City Beach Tennis Club - Tennis Court Resurfacing Budget Approval
motions.description: Council to approve a new capital budget item for the resurfacing of four synthetic grass tennis courts at City Beach Tennis Club, with estimated maximum cost of $125,000, funded through reserve funds of $93,500 with any shortfall to be contributed by the Club.

motions.title: Amend report name West Leederville Bowling Club
motions.description: Committee meeting discussion agreed correct name is Leederville Sporting Club. Amendment to delete incorrect name and insert correct name in the report.

motions.title: Leederville Sporting Club Licence Agreement and fence relocation
motions.description: Council decision on committee recommendation regarding Licence Agreement for temporary use of park land, reallocation of $3,000 from Capital Works Budget for fence relocation, and authorisation of CEO to finalise agreement and consult on future land use.

motions.title: Adopt Council and Committee Meeting Schedule 2022
motions.description: Adoption of annual Council, Committee Meeting and Elected Member Forum Schedule for 2022 in accordance with Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Local Planning Policy 3.19 Percent for Public Art amendment
motions.description: Amendment to LPP 3.19 to remove 3-year cash contribution refund requirement, endorsement of Public Art Expenditure Plan. Committee recommendation amended during discussion to delete clauses 2.2(i) and 4.1(i) and (ii), and add request for CEO to review policy for simplification.

motions.title: Cambridge Street Tram Track Removal - Tree removal option lost
motions.description: First motion on Cambridge Street timber sleeper removal works. Option 1 proposed removal of two Eucalyptus maculata trees to allow safe traffic passage during reconstruction. Motion lost 3/5.

motions.title: Cambridge Street Tram Track Removal - Traffic detour option
motions.description: Second motion on Cambridge Street timber sleeper removal works. Option 2 approved to detour eastbound traffic onto local roads for two consecutive two-week periods. Also approves contract variation by absolute majority.

motions.title: Community Development Grant to Westcity Church
motions.description: Approval to award $2,000 (GST Ex) to Westcity Church through Community Development Grant funding program for their annual Christmas community event on 5 December 2021.

motions.title: Award RFT 2021-07 Wide Area Network and Internet Services
motions.description: Approval of award of RFT 2021-07 for Provision of Wide Area Network (WAN) and Internet Services. WAN underpins Strategic ICT Plan 2021-2026 and is essential for multiple IT projects including ERP upgrade, remote working, Office 365, Microsoft Teams, system backup, malware controls, and network security.

motions.title: Award RFQ 2021-31 Network Storage and Server Virtualisation
motions.description: Approval of award of RFQ 2021-31 for Supply, installation, configuration and integration of full Network Storage and Server Host Virtualisation Platform Solution. Current network storage infrastructure nearing end of support and requires upgrade.

motions.title: Appointment of External Community Members to Audit and Risk Committee
motions.description: Appointment of external Community Members to the Town of Cambridge Audit and Risk Committee for a two-year term expiring at the 2023 local government elections. An amendment was proposed to appoint different applicants based on their suitability of skills.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements Review and Variances – October 2021
motions.description: Receipt of the Financial Statements for the period ended 31 October 2021, including analysis of year-to-date budget variances in revenue, expenditure, operating results, capital works, and cash position.

motions.title: Information Bulletin – November 2021
motions.description: Receipt of the Information Bulletin dated November 2021, providing information to the Community and Elected Members which does not require a Council decision.

motions.title: Amendment of Policy No. 033 - Developer Contact with Planning Staff
motions.description: Amendment to Policy No. 033 to clarify record keeping practices and regulate the type of pre-lodgement advice provided to developers, ensuring transparency, procedural fairness, and compliance with State Records Act obligations. motions.description: Application for a Preliminary Building Licence for a Single Dwelling submitted by Petal Enterprises at Lot 39, No 130 Tower Street, subject to conditions regarding setbacks and subdivision finalisation.

motions.description: Application for a Preliminary Building Licence for a single two-storey residential dwelling at Lot 9 (No. 46) Branksome Gardens, City Beach. Application involves variations to plot ratio, setbacks, and retaining walls. Amended plans received addressing neighbour concerns.

motions.title: Application for Three Additional Grouped Dwellings - Cambridge Street Wembley
motions.description: Application for three additional two-storey grouped dwellings at rear of existing dwelling at Lot 6, No.377 Cambridge Street, Wembley. Application involves non-compliance with density, setback, and open space requirements.

motions.title: Extension to Liquor Retail Outlet - Gayton Road City Beach
motions.description: Application for 70 square metres extension to existing Liquor Retail Outlet (Vintage Cellars) at Lot 13 (No.31) Gayton Road, City Beach. Proposal involves plot ratio variation and parking layout modification.

motions.title: Eating House Addition to Existing Shop - West Leederville
motions.description: Application for eating house (tearoom) addition to existing newsagent/snacks shop at Lot 1, No. 164 Cambridge Street corner Joseph Street, West Leederville. Involves conversion of verandah and portion of hall to tearoom with seating in courtyard.

motions.title: Subdivision Clearance - Northwood Street West Leederville
motions.description: Request for clearance of boundary clearance condition for subdivision application at Part Lot 14 and Lot 15 Northwood Street, West Leederville. Application proposes rear boundary clearance of 3.1 metres instead of required 6 metres.

motions.title: Western Australian Lacrosse Fixtures Night Games - Floreat Oval
motions.description: Request from Wembley Lacrosse Club to conduct three home and away night fixtures at Floreat Oval in April and May 1998. Original lighting approval was for training purposes only with lights off by 9:30pm. Proposed night games would involve crowds up to 300.

motions.title: Western Suburbs Accord - Code of Practice for Licensed Premises
motions.description: Proposed Code of Practice involving operators of local licensed premises and local authorities, aimed at reducing crime and violence from excessive alcohol consumption. Council consideration of partnership and representation on Steering Committee.

motions.title: Information - Outcome of Legal Action by Development and Environmental Services
motions.description: Report on outcomes of legal proceedings: Health Act prosecution against Narcissus Holdings Pty for contraventions of Health Act; Local Government Act prosecution for non-compliance with swimming pool safety fencing requirements.

motions.title: Investigate legal action for unauthorized demolition
motions.description: A building at 148 Northwood Street, Leederville was demolished without Council approval and without a Demolition Licence issued under the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1960.

motions.title: Serve notice on dangerous structure at 308 Salvado Road
motions.description: A brick garage wall at the boundary of 308 Salvado Road, Floreat is structurally unstable and potentially dangerous. The Council's consultant structural engineer advised the wall does not meet Building Code of Australia requirements and should be demolished. A collapse could occur during strong winds.

motions.title: Authorize temporary building surveyor
motions.description: [private individual — name withheld] will be employed as a Temporary Building Surveyor for approximately one month to fill a vacant position. He possesses the necessary qualifications including a Certificate as a Municipal Building Surveyor. Authorization is required for him to exercise the powers of a Building Surveyor and to approve or refuse building licence applications.

motions.title: Accept tender for passenger shelter management
motions.description: The Town of Cambridge manages 100 passenger shelters with ongoing maintenance costs of approximately $20,000 per annum. Four tenders were received. Rainbow Neon Signs is the preferred tenderer as a local company using local products at advantageous price. The five-year contract runs from 1 August 1997 to 31 July 2002 with an option to extend for another five years. The proposal includes supply and installation of 25 illuminated shelters and 25 seats, maintenance of all shelters, and a net income of $241,900 to the Town over five years.

motions.title: Serve notice to cease vehicle storage use
motions.description: Lot 57 (No. 323) Cambridge Street, Wembley, owned by the Water Corporation, is being used for vehicle storage in breach of the Town Planning Scheme which classifies such use as prohibited in a Residential R40 zone. The property is informally leased to an adjoining service station (Gull Service Station) for vehicle storage. The use has caused complaints regarding visual impact and noise disturbance. The Water Corporation has been advised to seek approval but was unable to secure commitment from the lessee.

motions.title: Approve private street closure with land apportionment
motions.description: The private street between Lots 1629, 1630 and Lot 1 (comprising approximately 108 square metres, 24 metres long, 5 metres wide) in Wembley is to be closed. The Body Corporate of Units 1-4 at No.3 Dodd Street requested closure for maintenance responsibility and security reasons. Three residential properties are affected. Land apportionment: majority to applicant for vehicular access to parking, with 1 metre to No.1 Dodd Street for pedestrian access, and a small portion to No.4 Herdsman Parade.

motions.title: Refuse rezoning request for Grantham Street
motions.description: The Grantham Action Group petitioned Council on 23 September 1997 to rezone properties fronting Grantham Street, Floreat (between The Boulevard and Selby Street) from Residential R12.5 to either Residential R40 or Commercial, ostensibly as compensation if Grantham Street remains an Important Regional Road. Approximately 90 properties would be affected. The rezoning proposal lacks planning merit and would conflict with the single residential character of Floreat as intended in the draft Town Planning Scheme.

motions.title: Receive coastal planning study progress report
motions.description: The Coastal Planning Study, conducted by CoastWise consultants appointed in June 1997, is progressing towards completion of a draft report. Community participation has been extensive, including two public meetings with over 100 attendees each and formation of a Community Liaison Group. The draft report is due at the end of October 1997 for November consideration. A meeting with the consultant is proposed for 6 November 1997 at 5.30pm. Public advertising is scheduled for December-January, with final report consideration in February 1998.

motions.title: Adopt draft Residential Design Guidelines
motions.description: The draft Residential Design Guidelines have been refined following comments from a Councillor workshop held 30 September 1997. Eighteen specific refinements have been made to clauses relating to setbacks, carports, garages, fencing, balconies, and other design matters across various residential precincts. The Guidelines are to be advertised for 28 days with public consultation including display material, resident brochures, and newspaper notices.

motions.title: Receive delegated decisions and notifications report
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for September 1997 including five items processed under delegation: home occupation renewal, amended plans for single dwelling, vacant strata subdivision, café extensions, and subdivision. Also includes notifications of planning appeals and ministerial determinations, including one appeal upheld for two grouped dwellings at 93 Northwood Street and one dismissed for advertising billboard at 138 Railway Parade.

motions.title: Receive building licences schedule
motions.description: Schedule of 41 building licences approved under delegated authority for September 1997 with a combined value of $3,983,682. Also approved were 6 preliminary building licences and 7 demolition licences. Comparative data shows increases in building licences and value of construction compared to September 1996. Year-to-date figures show 101 building licences compared to 132 in the same period last year, with construction value decreasing from $8,208,663 to $7,261,040.

motions.title: Refuse restaurant floor space application
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] and [private individual — name withheld] for refurbishment of existing theatre restaurant (Dirty Dick's Elizabethan Room) at 194 Cambridge Street, Wembley and conversion to Chinese restaurant. Proposes increasing eating area from 144 to 164 square metres, requiring 41 instead of 36 parking bays. Only 9 parking bays available on site, creating shortfall of 27 bays. Applicant intends to open lunch and evening hours serving local business district, with takeaway/delivery available. Application refused due to parking shortfall.

motions.description: Consideration of a petition from residents in Clanmel Road requesting Council address concerns regarding traffic calming measures. The petition contained 37 signatures representing 30 of 39 properties (77% response rate).

motions.description: Consideration of additional Road Rehabilitation Grants allocation of $318,304 from Main Roads WA requiring Council to match on a 2:1 basis ($159,152) for four road projects: The Boulevard, Selby Street, Underwood Avenue, and Oceanic Drive.

motions.title: Rights of Way – Five Year Program
motions.description: Consideration of a five year program for the Town's rights-of-way pavement upgrading program covering budget years 2005/2006 to 2009/2010, with funding of $210,000 per annum.

motions.title: Tender No. T17-04 – Dune Boardwalk – City Beach to Floreat Beach
motions.description: Consideration of tender for construction of a raised timber boardwalk linking City Beach and Floreat Beach carparks. CAMBUILD selected as preferred tenderer for $355,798 (ex GST). Motion includes approval for Aboriginal heritage consultations, naming of boardwalk as 'Mum-Boy-Yet Jinnung', and engagement of Aboriginal artist for mosaic design.

motions.title: Tender No. T21-04 – Supply of Front End Loader
motions.description: Consideration of tender submissions for the supply of a new wheel loader and trade-in/outright sale of the current backhoe/front end loader. CJD Equipment selected with Volvo L35B for $108,861.

motions.title: Landscape Enhancement Strategy Oceanic Drive
motions.description: Adoption of a landscape enhancement strategy for Oceanic Drive including replacement of She-oak trees with West Australian Peppermint trees in the median over six stages, management of residential and parkland verges, and discontinuation of irrigation at the Quarry Amphitheatre bushland.

motions.title: Selby Street Landscape Enhancement Works
motions.description: Endorsement of landscape works in Selby Street between The Boulevard and Salvado Road, including planting of Spotted Gum and Long Flowered Marlock Gum Trees, construction of a garden bed at the northwest corner of The Boulevard and Selby Street intersection, and reallocation of budget funds.

motions.title: Coastal Dunes Rabbit Control Trial
motions.description: Implementation of a rabbit control trial in the Floreat and City Beach dunes using Pindone impregnated oats in baiting stations, with potential for an ongoing permanent rabbit control program if successful.

motions.title: Advisory 50 km/h Speed Signage Installation
motions.description: Installation of twelve advisory 50 km/h speed signs at various locations throughout the Town for a period of twelve months to address traffic speed problems on roads with default 50 km/h speed limits.

motions.title: Bus Shelter Replacement
motions.description: Request to Perth Sign Company to select five additional locations for bus shelter installation within the Town to fulfill their contractual obligations for twenty shelters in total.

motions.description: Adoption of the Town's Strategic Plan for the five-year period 2005-2009, which includes updated Vision and Mission statements and five Key Outcome Areas to guide Council operations.

motions.description: Council response to a request from the Coast Ward Ratepayers Association regarding amendments to the Local Government Act 1995 to require declaration of interests by elected members employed by State or Federal Governments.

motions.title: Financial assistance Reabold Tennis Club playground
motions.description: Application from Reabold Tennis Club for financial assistance to replace existing children's playground (approximately 30 years old) at leased premises. Club has 476 members, mostly Cambridge residents. Project cost $5,272 (GST exclusive), Town contribution requested $2,636. Club has received funding within last five years but justification for assistance provided based on safety concerns and Club contribution.

motions.title: City Beach Pavilion petition and needs assessment
motions.description: Petition (100 signatures) from West Coast Junior Football Club regarding condition of City Beach pavilion clubrooms. Facility built over 30 years ago (changerooms) and approximately 1984 (clubrooms). Town has invested approximately $71,000 in improvements. Application recommends appointing Recreation Consultant to undertake Stage 1 needs assessment, with results to be reported by end of May 2005.

motions.title: Lemnos Street depot rates waiver request

Town contends depot used for public purpose and should be exempt. Recommendation to request City of Nedlands waive rates under Section 6.47 Local Government Act 1995, and if unsuccessful, seek exemption from Minister.

motions.title: Delegated authority Christmas/New Year recess 2004/2005
motions.description: Delegation of powers and duties to Chief Executive Officer to deal with urgent items of business during Christmas/New Year recess period from 22 December 2004 to 7 February 2005. Conditions: Ward matters require majority of Ward Members agreement; general matters require majority of all Elected Members; summary report to February 2005 meeting.

motions.title: Kenmore Crescent/East Lorne Street subdivision - no support

Applicant seeks variation to minimum lot size (665 m2 vs 700 m2 required). Council does not support based on detrimental impact to East Lorne streetscape from modified dwellings with parapet walls and failure to achieve minimum lot size. Council would support alternative proposal with full demolition and more equal lot sizes.

motions.title: Athlone Road retrospective fence approval deferred

Fence constructed contrary to approved building licence requiring open steel railings. Property is second instance of non-compliance on this site. Council officers recommend approval based on performance criteria (visual privacy for main living areas) but with concern about manner of development. Committee recommends approval with variation noted.

motions.title: Subdivision of Lot 5 Salvado Road Wembley

motions.title: Additions and alterations to Pivet Medical Centre
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing medical centre at Lot 1 (No. 166-168) Cambridge Street, West Leederville, including internal and external works, with variations to parking, plot ratio and street setbacks.

motions.title: Change of use to wool shop and café at Grantham Street Wembley
motions.description: Application to amalgamate two existing tenancies and establish 'Woolly Latte's', a knitting boutique and coffee house combination with artist studio showcase, including note of variation to parking requirements.

motions.title: Extensions to City Beach Shopping Centre
motions.description: Application for extensions to existing shopping centre at Lot 13 (No. 31) Gayton Road, City Beach, including new retail spaces, service yards, upgraded entrances and alfresco areas, with variations to plot ratio and car parking requirements.

motions.title: Outdoor dining facility along Essex Street frontage
motions.description: Application for alfresco/outdoor eating facility with 5 tables and 10 chairs along Essex Street frontage of restaurant at Lot 538 (No. 284) Cambridge Street, Wembley, with restricted hours of operation.

motions.title: Two double storey grouped dwellings at Warwick Street
motions.description: Application for two double storey grouped dwellings at Lot 42 (No. 2) Warwick Street, West Leederville, with variations to primary street setback, paving, roof pitch, retaining walls and wall height requirements.

motions.title: Three level dwelling, Lot 61 No. 26 Truro Place, City Beach
motions.description: Application for a three level dwelling with variations to secondary street setback, open space, retaining walls and filling of land, upper floor side setback, rear setback, building height, and materials of construction. Initial recommendation to refuse was deferred for one month. Amended plans dated 17 November 2004 were subsequently assessed.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling, Lot 508 No. 138 Jersey Street, Jolimont
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling with variations to boundary setbacks, open space, building height, and visual privacy. Adjoining landowner to the south expressed concerns over overlooking from Bedroom 4.

motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling at Lot 182 (No. 12) Dartmouth Avenue, City Beach, seeking variations to wall height, side setback, visual privacy, and retaining wall requirements.

motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling at Lot 398 (No. 12) Chipping Road, City Beach, seeking variation to primary street setback requirement.

motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling at Lot 1021 (No. 121) Gregory Street, Wembley, seeking variations to roof pitch, wall height, side setbacks, retaining, visual privacy and overshadowing requirements.

motions.title: Refuse alterations and additions at Lot 42 Yanagin Crescent

The proposal does not satisfy building height requirements and impacts adjoining landowners' amenity.

motions.title: Refer item DES04.249 back to Development and Environmental Services Committee
motions.description: Motion to refer the item relating to the application by Kenan Aydogan and Greg Rowe and Associates back to the Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration following receipt of additional information.

motions.title: Approve upper storey addition at Lot 723 Gunee Road
motions.description: Application by Brookes Construction for upper storey addition and ground floor alterations at Lot 723 (No.9) Gunee Road, City Beach. Variations to wall height, visual privacy and boundary setbacks are proposed.

motions.title: Approve amended plans for deck and staircase at Lot 400 Larundel Road
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld]. Stewart for amended plans proposing deck and staircase at Lot 400 (No. 7) Larundel Road, City Beach. Variations to visual privacy and retaining walls from side boundary are proposed.

motions.title: Approve additions and alterations with white colorbond roof at Lot 81 Branksome Gardens
motions.description: Application by Numans Group Pty Ltd for additions and alterations to existing two storey dwelling at Lot 81 (No. 51) Branksome Gardens, City Beach. Approval sought for white colorbond roof in Cambridge Endowment Lands and variation to side setback requirement.

motions.title: Approve second storey addition at Lot 556 Kondil Place
motions.description: Application by Dale Alcock Home Improvement for second storey addition to existing dwelling with undercroft at Lot 556 (No. 12) Kondil Place, City Beach. Variations to wall height and visual privacy are proposed.

motions.title: Approve additions to dwelling at Lot 62 Highbury Street by absolute majority
motions.description: Application by W and J Stopforth for additions to existing single storey dwelling at Lot 62 (No. 18) Highbury Street, Floreat. Variations to secondary street setback, east side setback, rear setback and visual privacy are proposed.

motions.title: Approve colorbond outbuilding at Lot 362 Windarra Drive by absolute majority
