motions.title: Great Gardens workshop report - received
motions.description: Report on the successful Great Gardens workshop hosted by the Town of Cambridge in partnership with The Boulevard Centre on 20 September 2004, focusing on sustainable gardening practices.

motions.title: Sustainable Procurement Policy adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the Town of Cambridge Sustainable Procurement Policy (Policy No. 3.4.2), deletion of redundant Policy No. 2.3.3 Purchase of Paper Products, and authorization of over budget expenditure for Eco-Buy and Eco-Specifier membership subscriptions.

motions.title: Metropolitan Region Scheme Amendment No. 1088/33A support
motions.description: Support for the proposed Metropolitan Region Scheme Amendment No. 1088/33A (Minor Amendment) North West Districts Omnibus (No. 6), which includes Proposal 7 affecting portions of Lots 3, 9 and 10 Southport Street and Tower Street, West Leederville.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications report - received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions dealt with under delegated authority for November 2004 and notifications of planning appeals and decisions.

motions.title: Building licences report - received
motions.description: Report on building licences approved under delegated authority for November 2004 showing 49 building licences, 0 sign licences, 2 provisional building licences, and 10 demolition licences with a total construction value of $29,352,639.

motions.title: Nominations for statutory authorities and public bodies
motions.description: Request for nominations for Council representation on Fluoridation of Public Water Supplies Advisory Committee, Western Australian Water Safety Council, Heritage Tourism Reference Group, and Local Government Self Insurance Schemes Board.

motions.title: Annual General Meeting of Electors 2004 - decisions
motions.description: Council consideration of decisions made at the Annual General Meeting of Electors held on 2 December 2004. AGM included garden awards ceremony and discussion of Perry Lakes Stadium redevelopment. Council rejects request for independent survey but invites ratepayer associations to meet with CEO on Perry Lakes project.

motions.title: Wembley Day Care Centre expansion – planning application approval
motions.description: Application by A. Halstead for change of use from residential to child day care centre at Lot 1872 (No.112) Herdsman Parade, Wembley, involving expansion of existing Wembley Day Care Centre to accommodate up to 50 children. Application was initially deferred in October 2004 pending policy review; amended plans subsequently submitted addressing parking and setback issues. Neighbours provided written support.

motions.title: Amendment to parking bay condition – landscaping requirement
motions.description: Amendment to condition (iii) of the main planning approval motion, proposed during discussion noting the need for landscaping for shade and amenity in residential area

motions.title: Adoption of Annual Report 1999/2000
motions.description: Annual Report for the 1999/2000 Financial Year outlining the activities of the Town over the past financial year had been circulated.

motions.title: Censure of Chief Executive Officer
motions.description: Motion regarding advice given by the Chief Executive Officer to the Mayor and Councillors regarding the position and rights of ratepayers living in North Wembley.

motions.title: Removal of Telecommunications Infrastructure at Kilpa Court
motions.description: Motion to order complete removal of telecommunications infrastructure situated on Kilpa Court, considered contrary to Town Planning Scheme Section 5.3 and regarded as an environmental blot in the locality.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 13 February 1996
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the previous ordinary meeting held on 13 February 1996, subject to an amendment to Item 10.1.6 regarding the final sentence of comment on acceptable usage levels for Council reserves under lights.

motions.title: 80 Newry Street, Floreat - Home Occupation Approval
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] for approval to use an outbuilding as an office for real estate bookwork. The outbuilding is approximately 20 square metres and will be operated by one person with no additional traffic expected as all clients are contacted at point of sale/rental.

motions.title: WAWA Reserve, Kalinda Drive, City Beach - Vodafone Telecommunications Facility
motions.description: Revised proposal for Vodafone telecommunications facility involving a 30 metre high monopole tower plus small equipment shelter on WAWA Reserve. The revised location is further from residential properties and uses newer directional cross polar antenna with less visual impact than originally proposed.

motions.title: Dodd Street, Wembley - Request for Closure of Private Street
motions.description: Request from Corporate Body of Strata Development at Lot 1, No 3 Dodd Street, Wembley, for approval to close the private street between Lots 1 and 1629 Dodd Street. The private street is approximately 23 metres in length and 5 metres wide, forming a remnant portion of a larger private street mostly closed in 1994.

motions.title: Draft WAPC Policy on Battleaxe Subdivisions and Pedestrian Access Ways
motions.description: Council's response to WA Planning Commission's revised draft policy on battleaxe subdivisions and pedestrian access ways. Council considered impacts of proposed changes on the Town of Cambridge, particularly regarding the 400 square metres minimum lot size for battleaxe lots and encouragement of rights of way and private streets for access.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Rugby Union Park, Floreat - Floodlights Approval
motions.description: Application by Western Australian Rugby Union for installation of four floodlights at Perry Lakes Rugby Union warm up track. Council deferred decision on 23 January 1996 for consultation with adjoining residents. Application proposes 30m high monopole with conditions on frequency of fixtures (maximum 10 per season), operating hours (until 10pm), and parking management.

motions.title: 123 Daglish Street, Wembley - Home Occupation Approval
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] for approval to use a bedroom of her residence as office for speech pathology administration and research. Approximately 12 square metres; part-time operation with infrequent client visits; primary work is administration and research at approximately 5 hours per week.

motions.title: 66 Tate Street, Leederville - Two Storey Attached Houses
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for 2 two storey attached residences. Proposal exceeds plot ratio policy (0.54:1 vs required 0.4:1). Revised proposal represents improved design addressing earlier concerns regarding streetscape presentation.

motions.title: 169 Harborne Street, Wembley - Garage and Rear Extensions
motions.description: Application for building licence for proposed garage extension and rear 'granny flat' extensions to existing residence. Front garage setback does not comply with Residential Planning Codes (3.2m proposed vs 6.0m average required). Side setback of rear addition accords with existing setback.

motions.title: 106 Nanson Street, Wembley - Carport and Residence Additions
motions.description: Application for building licence for internal alterations, rear addition (kitchen, dining, family room, bathrooms) and double carport in primary street setback. Original proposal submitted 14 December 1995 raised concerns from neighbour at 104 Nanson Street. Amended plans submitted showing wall setback and redesigned front fence.

motions.title: Fix Australia Fix the Roads Campaign - Donation
motions.description: WAMA seeking financial support for 18-month joint campaign between State Government and Local Governments to raise profile of roads in WA. Campaign has successfully raised public awareness through media. Request for further contribution to maximise television coverage.

motions.title: Hale Road/West Coast Highway Intersection - Parking Improvements
motions.description: Area on southern side of Hale Road at intersection with West Coast Highway has been used as parking area by recreational users (surfers, fishers). Creates traffic hazards and damage to verge. Technical Services recommends installation of pine bollards, prohibition of verge parking, and replanting/refurbishment at estimated cost of $5,000. Funding identified from Budget Item 'Drainage - Yule/Weldon' (completed with $15,000 saving).

motions.title: Empire Avenue - Boundary Road Work
motions.description: City of Stirling seeking 50% contribution ($380,400) from Town of Cambridge for upgrade of Empire Avenue (Weaponess to Cromarty) at total cost of $760,800. Section 317 of Local Government Act requires municipalities to contribute to shared facilities. Town investigated and determined project unlikely to benefit Town and outside boundary responsibility. Officer report recommends no contribution.

motions.title: Petition - Local Area Traffic Management - Daglish Street
motions.description: Petition dated 6 February 1996 from residents regarding Local Area Traffic Management issues in Daglish Street, Wembley. Signatories state section between Grantham and Dodd Streets is too busy with excessive through traffic including commercial trucks and tourist coaches. Support urgent action including steering committee and budget allocation.

motions.title: Railway Parade, West Leederville - Clearway Restriction
motions.description: Clearway restriction proposed on southern side of Railway Parade to facilitate better traffic flow in westerly direction and improve access to Southport Street. Restriction addresses parking preventing right turn manoeuvres and restricting westbound traffic movement.

motions.title: Sunset Coast Tourist Drive Signage - Relocation
motions.description: Council approved Sunset Coast Tourist Drive signage on 24 October 1995. Signs have been erected at Challenger Parade/West Coast Highway, City Beach. Several South City Beach residents have requested removal, citing concerns about additional through traffic and noting Cottesloe excluded this section. Amendment proposed to relocate signage to West Coast Highway at Oceanic Drive rather than conduct survey.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Redevelopment - Progress Report
motions.description: Progress report on redevelopment of 'new' course at Wembley Golf Complex (approved at $920,000 budget in 1995/96). GHD appointed as design consultant and project manager. Project plan completed; earthworks and irrigation tenders scheduled for closure 1 March 1996; bore work completed by Coastal Drilling at $17,000; grassing documentation in draft; Western Power to underground power section.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Tender Recommendation
motions.description: Tender evaluation for design and contract administration of City to Sea Greenway project. Council approved concept in principle 12 December 1995. Three bids received: Mike Maher & Associates ($11,000), Land Planning Consultants ($14,750), BSD Consultants ($3,810). Assessment panel: Poynton (Technical Services), Bignell (Planning), Cunningham (Better Cities). Mike Maher & Associates recommended based on organisational profile, team credentials, timeline, and value.

motions.title: Matthews Netball Centre - Redevelopment Approval
motions.description: Perth Netball Association seeking approval for staged redevelopment of Matthews Netball Centre. First stage estimated at $350,000 includes hard stand courts, resurfacing, and court surround improvements. Funding options provided (CSRFF grant $165,000 or loan, Town $80,000, Association $105,000). Fraser Worley Pty Limited to be engaged as project manager (cost borne by Association). CEO or representative to participate in steering group.

motions.title: Emergency Management - State Emergency Service Meeting
motions.description: State Emergency Service proposing to review structure of emergency management committees in light of creation of new Towns. Town invited to send two representatives (elected member and designated officer) to meeting 7 March 1996. Executive Manager Technical Services proposed as designated officer due to responsibility for emergency management.

motions.title: Delegated Authority - Exemption from Rates
motions.description: Report on delegated authority exercised by CEO/Town Clerk to approve exemption of properties from Council Rates in accordance with Section 532 of Local Government Act 1960. One exemption approved: Perth Inner City Youth Service, Unit 3 145-147 Cambridge Street, Leederville for charitable purposes, $315.00.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre - Safe Replacement
motions.description: Break-in occurred 8 February 1996 at Bold Park Aquatic Centre. Offenders forced entry to administration area and safe, stealing day's takings and cash floats. Replacement safe required urgently. Original safe replacement value $1,600; new safe from Guardall Security cost $3,250 (higher security rating). Over expenditure of approximately $1,400 requires Council approval.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Local Government Accounting Directions 1994. Five municipal transactions totalling $1,425,778.48.

motions.title: Financial Statements for Period Ended 31 January 1996
motions.description: Financial statements for period ended 31 January 1996 have been produced (circulated with notice paper). Annual Financial Statements not yet received from City of Perth; Minister for Local Government authorised extension of time for account preparation.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex - Fees Review
motions.description: Review of green fees charged at Wembley Golf Complex. Previous review 27 June 1995 increased fees 15% effective 17 July 1995 based on benchmarking ten other metropolitan public golf courses. Fees are now below average as other courses have increased theirs. Proposal to increase fees effective 1 April 1996 to align with market rates. Next review proposed 1 January 1997.

motions.title: Ministerial Requests - Priority Listing
motions.description: Notice of motion by Cr McConnell proposing to shortlist areas of need for presentation to Minister for Local Government. Minister Paul Omodei has given verbal commitment to consider requests for additional funding for regional facilities and improving existing services. During discussion, Members agreed to send letter to Minister acknowledging commitments and advising priority listing to follow.

motions.title: WAMA Nomination - Restaurant and Caterers Accreditation Board
motions.description: WAMA seeking nomination for vacant position on Restaurant and Caterers Association of WA - Caterers Gold Licence Accreditation Board. Newly established committee, meets four times per year. Role to consider applications from caterers for gold licence accreditation.

motions.title: WAMA Nomination - Coastal Zone Council
motions.description: WAMA seeking nominations for one metropolitan and one non-metropolitan representative for newly established Coastal Zone Council. Quarterly meetings at Ministry of Planning, Albert Facey House. Meeting fee $73 per half-day. Term to be determined, commencing April 1996.

motions.title: WAMA Nomination - Heritage Council of WA
motions.description: WAMA seeking nominations for position on Heritage Council of WA (panel of three names). One to three year term at Minister's discretion. Monthly meetings at Perth Mint. Sitting fees and travelling expenses paid; annual stipend $3,750 plus additional meeting fees.

motions.title: Development approval 93/2049 condition deletion request
motions.description: Request for deletion of condition 4 of Council's development approval 93/2049 relating to upgrading of the rear right-of-way, with requirement to complete site landscaping and car parking bay marking.

motions.title: Anti-social behaviour prevention measures
motions.description: Preventative measures to reduce anti-social behaviour in Council facilities including public toilet blocks at Floreat Beach, Alderbury Reserve, Dodd Street (Lake Monger), Selby/Grantham Reserve and South City Beach sand dunes. Measures developed in conjunction with Wembley Police Station.

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders Sub-Clause 3.3.4
motions.description: Suspension of Standing Orders to allow for free discussion on anti-social behaviour prevention measures.

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders Sub-Clause 3.3.4
motions.description: Resumption of Standing Orders Sub-Clause 3.3.4 following discussion.

motions.title: Leave of Absence – Cr Corinne MacRae
motions.description: Application for leave of absence from 17 September to 17 October 1999 inclusive

motions.description: Confirmation of minutes of Ordinary Meeting held on 22 June 1999

motions.title: Roadside Advertising – Report Received
motions.description: Report on issues relevant to roadside advertising applications and approvals process within the Town of Cambridge

motions.title: Roadside Advertising – Street Litter Bins
motions.description: Proposal for advertising on roadside litter bins; motion to defer consideration of calling expressions of interest

motions.title: Bus Shelters and Seats – Tenders
motions.description: Progress report on establishment of bus stop shelters and seats; motion to call tenders for supply, installation and maintenance

motions.title: Gregory Street Traffic Management – Blister Islands
motions.description: Update on traffic management for Gregory Street from Grantham Street to Dodd Street; community survey results and motion to install blister islands

motions.title: Selby Street/Grantham Street – Traffic Signals Investigation
motions.description: Investigation of traffic management at intersection of Grantham Street and Selby Street; motion to engage consultant for SIDRA analysis and recommendations

motions.title: Brompton Road/Drabble Road/Minibah Street – Deferred
motions.description: Joint project with City of Stirling for reconstruction of intersection; motion deferred pending further investigation of design and cost

motions.title: Western Suburbs Railway Crossing – Amended Motion
motions.description: Progress on railway crossing upgrading between Ashton Avenue and Nicholson Road/Nash Street; motion as amended regarding correspondence with Ministers

motions.title: Ruislip Street/The Grove/St Vincents Avenue – Road Vestiture
motions.description: Motion to seek vestiture of private roads (Ruislip Street, The Grove, St Vincents Avenue) to Town of Cambridge for care, control and management

motions.title: Dodd Street – Road Reserve Establishment
motions.description: Motion to establish road reserve along southern boundary of Lake Monger Primary School and Speech and Hearing Centre; dedication of land as public street

motions.title: Street Lighting Agreement with Western Power
motions.description: Proposal to enter into a fixed-term street lighting agreement with Western Power for a 12-month period at a revised contract price of $335,656 per annum, with options to extend for four additional one-year terms.

motions.title: Challenger Parade Beach Dog Exercise Area Extension
motions.description: Proposal to extend the gazetted dog exercise area at City Beach from the pathway opposite Falmouth Avenue northwards to Dartmouth Avenue, and to apply parking restrictions to the northern side of Falmouth Avenue and Bodmin Avenue to manage parking and encourage use of the Dartmouth Avenue carpark.

motions.title: Lesser Street Kerbside Parking Restriction
motions.description: Proposal to change the parking restriction on the eastern side of Lesser Street from a 2-hour limit to a half-hour restriction with resident parking permits exempt, to address parking concerns raised by eight residents.

motions.title: Road Verges Development and Maintenance Policy
motions.description: Adoption of a uniform policy for the development and maintenance of council road verges to establish guidelines for verge development, safety standards, and pedestrian accommodation.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts totalling $2,140,468.84 for payment in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule as at 30 June 1999 showing investment performance and distribution of surplus funds across approved investment bodies.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Notation that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to a Deed of Extension of Lease with City Beach Tennis Club dated 6 July 1999.

motions.title: Beach Inspection Service Contract
motions.description: Approval to advertise for expressions of interest in providing a contracted beach inspection service for a five-year period commencing 1 October 1999, and continuation of current contract with Surf Life Saving WA on a monthly basis until the new contract is awarded.

motions.title: General Purpose Infringement Notice Format
motions.description: Approval of a general purpose infringement notice form to enable a single form to be used for the issue of infringements for all Council local laws, replacing separate forms for different offence types.

motions.title: BJ Giles Clubhouse electrical power upgrade
motions.description: Funding for upgrade of electrical power supply to BJ Giles Clubhouse and ground lighting, with maintenance costs to be undertaken at the expense of Wembley Athletic Club (Inc), with provision for repayment programs if needed. Discussion noted that Wembley Amateur Football Club reference was substituted with Wembley Athletics Club (Inc) due to lease agreement.

motions.title: Significant Accounting Policies adoption
motions.description: Amendment and adoption of Significant Accounting Policies which comply with Local Government Act 1995, Local Government Financial Regulations 1996, and Australian Accounting Standards. Policies cover local government reporting entity, basis of accounting, property/plant/equipment valuation, rates/grants/contributions, employee entitlements, investments, inventories, and rounding.

motions.title: Plan of Principal Activities 1999-2004 adoption
motions.description: Adoption of Plan of Principal Activities for period 1999 to 2004 as required by Section 5.56 of Local Government Act 1995. Plan contains 19 principal activities: 12 ongoing programs and 7 specific projects including new items Wembley Town Centre Improvements, Coastal Improvements, and Bold Park Aquatic Centre Development. Plan was advertised for public comment with no submissions received. Amendments agreed during committee discussion including changes to introduction text and deletion of coastal environment and Bold Regional Park references.

motions.title: Wembley Underground Power Pilot Project surplus funds allocation
motions.description: Finalisation report on Wembley Underground Power Pilot Project completed March 1999. Project achieved cost savings of $1,076,000 with total project costs of $3,049,000 against $4 million budget. Council received $358,666 one-third refund plus $64,522 surplus held, totalling $423,188 project surplus. After deducting $96,277 additional costs not included in joint costs, unallocated surplus is $326,911. Report discusses options: refund property owners, undertake streetscape improvements, remove stay wires on transmission lines, or combination. Initial deferral requested investigation of stay wire removal costs. Further report notes Minister advised work beyond project scope and State unable to provide funding; Western Power estimate $13,400 investigation cost plus approximately $60,000 per location for freestanding poles. Committee motion to use surplus for works lapsed for want of seconder.

motions.title: Alfresco dining area planning approval - City Beach restaurant
motions.description: Application for planning approval for alfresco area attached to approved restaurant use at Lot 3 (No. 316) The Boulevard, City Beach. Restaurant use approved 23 December 1998 for Tenancy 8 with condition requiring further approval for outdoor seating. Proposed alfresco area approximately 40 square metres (28 chairs/7 tables) as extension to approved 74 square metre internal restaurant. Committee requested further information on screening; additional report provided details of modifications including 2.6 metre brick/glass block screen wall, 2.0 metre timber wall, planter boxes, and pivoting timber screen door.

motions.title: Single dwelling condition reconsideration - Chipping Road City Beach
motions.description: Reconsideration of condition of approval for single two-storey dwelling at Lot 257 (No. 40) Chipping Road, City Beach. Original approval 22 June 1999 imposed condition requiring front retaining walls set back 3 metres from boundary with minimum 1.5 metre separation and maximum 1.5 metres height per rise, not exceeding 29.80 AHD. Applicant requested modification citing unacceptable 3 metre unusable strip and minimal useable area. Amended retaining wall plan submitted as compromise, with total retaining set back 3 metres (compared to 2.4 metres original) at same level as original application.

motions.title: Three grouped dwellings planning approval - West Leederville
motions.description: Application for three two-storey grouped dwellings at Lot 69 (No. 104) Kimberley Street, West Leederville. Lot 1,108 square metres, R40 zoning (allows 4 units). Each unit has ground floor lounge, meals/family, kitchen, laundry, double garage; upper floor with bedrooms. Applicant seeks variations to R codes and discretions to Residential Design Guidelines. Neighbours comment sought on retaining and privacy; no objections received. Committee requested investigation of overshadowing on adjacent sunroom; applicant submitted modified plan reducing upper storey wall length from 6.5 to 4.3 metres. Motion required absolute majority. Amendment moved to include modified plan dated 23 July 1999.

motions.title: Two grouped dwellings planning approval - Gregory/Dodd Street Wembley
motions.description: Application for two grouped dwellings (two storey) at Lot 1066 (No. 211) Gregory Street, corner of Dodd Street, Wembley. Lot 707 square metres, R20 zoning. Corner lot policy allows development under R30 standards with one dwelling fronting each street. Unit 1 addresses Gregory Street (lounge, dining, living, kitchen, laundry, four bedrooms, library, two bathrooms); Unit 2 addresses Dodd Street (lounge, living, dining, kitchen, bedroom, laundry, ensuite, three bedrooms, bathroom). Existing one-storey dwelling to be demolished. Site faces Lake Monger with Primary School opposite. Applicant seeks discretions to Residential Design Guidelines for portico width and upper storey setback.

motions.title: Two grouped dwellings at Lot 10 Salvado Road, Wembley
motions.description: Application submitted by Advantage Homes on behalf of P and P Dufty for two grouped dwellings with variations to setback requirements under the Town Planning Scheme No. 1.

motions.title: Single dwelling at Lot 201 Lake Monger Drive, Wembley
motions.description: Application submitted by The Cheir Family Trust for a single dwelling (two storey and undercroft) with variations to setback and privacy requirements.

motions.title: Single dwelling at Lot 122 Branksome Gardens, City Beach
motions.description: Application submitted by Jones Coulter Young Architects for a single dwelling (two storey and undercroft) with variations to building height, paving, and retaining wall requirements.

motions.title: Single dwelling at Lot 303 Clune Avenue, Wembley
motions.description: Application submitted by C and M Torre for a single dwelling (two storey) with variations to rear setback and building height requirements, requiring absolute majority.

motions.title: Two storey residence at Lot 22 Tower Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application submitted by Australasian Property Group on behalf of DH Pett and JL Connell for a two storey residence with variations to side setback and privacy requirements, requiring absolute majority.

motions.title: Two single dwellings at Lot 55 Joseph Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application submitted by C Griffiths for two single dwellings (two storey) with variations to side setback and upper storey setback requirements, requiring absolute majority.

motions.title: Additions to existing medical centre at Lot 1369 Essex Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application submitted by M Kailis and L Levitt for additions and alterations to existing medical centre with extension of non-conforming use, requiring absolute majority.

motions.title: Additions to existing residence at Lot 501 Vincent Street West, West Leederville
motions.description: Application submitted by G M Extensions Pty Ltd for additions to existing residence with variations to rear setback and open space requirements, requiring absolute majority.

motions.title: Additions and alterations to existing residence at Lot 140 Oban Road, City Beach
motions.description: Application submitted by J Papavassiliou for additions and alterations (two storey addition) with variations to rear and side setback requirements, requiring absolute majority.

motions.title: Off-White Colorbond Roof Approval
motions.description: Application by N Fong for an off-white colorbond roof for a single dwelling at Lot 402, No. 11 Larundel Road, City Beach. Variation to Local Law 43 standards approved by majority of surrounding residents.

motions.title: Retaining Wall Approval - Lot 116 Clune Avenue
motions.description: Application by J Letizia to construct a retaining wall at Lot 116 (No.35) Clune Avenue, West Leederville. Proposed wall to be raised to maximum height of 3.2 metres with privacy screening condition.

motions.title: Leederville Town Hall Refurbishment - Appointment of Heritage Architect
motions.description: Report on Leederville Town Hall Refurbishment Project. Council received grant of $17,000 from Lotteries Commission for conservation heritage assessment. Appointment of Philip Griffiths to prepare conservation management plan.

motions.title: Floreat Beach Upgrade - Concept Plan Deferred
motions.description: Report on progress of Floreat Beach upgrade project. CoastWise Coastal Planning and Management has prepared a concept plan. Item deferred to enable amended design with consideration of frontal dunes concerns and revised children's playground location.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Regulatory Services
motions.description: Annual review of fees and charges for Planning Services, Building Services and Environmental Health Services, effective from 1 July 1999. Elimination of minimum fee of $25 for development under $1,000 in favour of $100 minimum fee.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications Received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for June 1999 and notifications of appeals and planning appeals bill. Items included home occupations, sign licence, subdivision and amalgamation approved under delegation.

motions.title: Building Licences Schedule Received
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data on building licences issued for June 1999. 47 building licences issued with value of construction at $3,377,769.

motions.title: Authorised Persons Appointed Under Various Acts
motions.description: Authorisation of recently appointed officers to act and enforce various Acts, Regulations and By-Laws. Liesl Janine Thayne and Pasquale Bracone authorised for various environmental health, planning and building enforcement duties.

motions.title: Endowment Lands Area Rating System Amendment
motions.description: Notice of Motion from Cr Berry regarding amendment of rating system in Endowment Lands Area from Unimproved Value to Gross Rental Value method. Amendment motion by Cr Smith substituted for Berry's original motion.

motions.title: Endowment Lands Area Rating Referral Motion
motions.description: Motion by Cr Anderton to refer Berry's Endowment Lands Area rating motion back to Committee for consideration. Motion lost.

motions.title: Mayor Nominated for WAMA Local Government Advisory Board
motions.description: Nomination of His Worship the Mayor as WAMA Metropolitan Member to Local Government Advisory Board. Term until June 2000, monthly meetings.

motions.title: WAMA Westplan Hazmat Coordinating Committee Received
motions.description: Request for nomination of WAMA Member to Westplan Hazmat Coordinating Committee received. Bi-monthly meetings, no meeting fee.

motions.title: WAMA Heritage Council of Western Australia Nomination Received
motions.description: Request for nomination of WAMA Member to Heritage Council of Western Australia received. Term 12 months until introduction of new Heritage Act.

motions.title: LGA Keep Australia Beautiful Council Nomination Received
motions.description: Request for nomination of LGA Member and Deputy Member to Keep Australia Beautiful Council (WA) received. Term November 1999 to October 2000, monthly meetings.

motions.title: 1999-2000 Budget Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of Budget for year ending 30 June 2000. Rate increase of 5.7% providing for additional capital works, youth services, human resources and other expenditures. Property revaluation and endowment lands rate redistribution.

motions.title: City Beach Café/Restaurant Expressions of Interest
motions.description: Confidential item. City Beach café/restaurant development and operation. Four parties invited to tender: Letus Enterprises, Frasers Restaurant Pty Ltd, Saruman Holdings, Beachfront Enterprises. Conditions include lease term maximum 20 years with 10-year option, maximum two floor levels.

motions.title: Executive Managers Employment Contracts Renewal
motions.description: Confidential item. Renewal of employment contracts for Jason Buckley, Executive Manager Corporate and Customer Services, and Ian Birch, Executive Manager Development and Environmental Services. Five-year contracts commencing 30 January 2000 and 23 January 2000 respectively.

motions.title: Closed Session - Meeting Behind Closed Doors
motions.description: Procedural motion to enter closed session for confidential matters relating to commercial confidentiality of expressions of interest and matters affecting employees.

motions.title: Confidential items to be considered in normal business
motions.description: Items 14.1 Lake Monger Development and 14.3 Additional Staff Resources to be considered as part of normal business without proceeding behind closed doors

motions.title: 11 Boscastle Avenue subdivision refusal
motions.description: Proposed subdivision of lot into two lots at corner of Branksome Gardens and Boscastle Avenue, City Beach. Applicant sought approval for two lots below the minimum 800 square metres required under R12.5 zoning.

motions.title: Home occupation approval - travel agent
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] to operate travel agent office from dwelling at 41 Newry Street, Floreat. Limited to 12 months with conditions.

motions.title: Medical consulting room continuation
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] for continuation of medical consulting room use at 44 McCourt Street, Leederville. Original motion carried absolute majority but amendment proposed to add review after two years was lost.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval development public transport report
motions.description: Report on public transport provision for major sporting events at Subiaco Oval following Department of Transport meeting on 13 March 1996

motions.title: Home occupation approval - importing sporting accessories
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] for home occupation office for administration of importing sporting accessories at 30 Roscommon Road, Floreat. Approved for 12 months with storage restrictions.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment No 1 adoption
motions.description: Amendment to introduce planning application requirements for single or two grouped dwellings where variation from R-Codes or Council policy is sought. Advertised 1-22 March 1996 with no submissions received.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Rugby Union floodlights approval
motions.description: Application by WA Rugby Union for installation of four floodlights at Perry Lakes Rugby Union warm up track, Floreat. Council approved subject to conditions including maximum 8 night fixtures per season and 9.30pm curfew, after community meeting held 18 March 1996.

motions.title: 35 Aruma Way City Beach building licence
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licence for additions to a single dwelling with front setback variation. Applicant seeks approval for house extension set back 7.1m (0.4m less than required 7.5m) and carport at 0m setback.

motions.title: 121 Drabble Road building licence report received
motions.description: Report on application for building licence for single dwelling at 121 Drabble Road, City Beach. Application was previously deferred on 12 March 1996. Modified plans now comply with setback requirements and approval granted under delegated authority.

motions.title: 7 Baramba Road amendments refused
motions.description: Application to amend building licence for two-storey residence to add enclosed balcony and increase boundary retaining wall height from 2.0m to 2.6m. Proposal does not comply with plot ratio policy and raises significant concerns regarding bulk, scale, overlooking and overshadowing impacts on neighbours.

motions.title: Influenza vaccinations for council employees approved
motions.description: Proposal to provide free influenza vaccinations to all Councillors and Council employees in mid-May at estimated cost of $700. Vaccine to be administered by Medical Practitioner and Nurse engaged for Council's Immunisation service.

motions.title: Skid steer loader tender accepted
motions.description: Tender evaluation for supply and delivery of 40-45KW skid steer loader for Engineering works crew. Eight tenders received and evaluated. Mustang 960 recommended as best performing machine with fuel economy, warranty and spare parts comparable to other machines.

motions.title: Challenger Parade parking restriction deferred
motions.description: Proposed No Standing Anytime on Road or Verge restriction on western side of Challenger Parade from West Coast Highway northwards to Jubilee Crescent to address parking on grass verge by motorists. Subject to Ministerial approval.

motions.title: Challenger Parade verge parking restriction deferred
motions.description: Proposed No Parking on Verge restriction on eastern side of Challenger Parade between house numbers 30 and 34 to address parking by beachgoers and associated anti-social behaviour and damage to verge. Subject to Ministerial approval.

motions.title: Road management consultancy tender accepted (amended)
motions.description: Tender for road management consultancy services for approved Local Road Improvement and Rehabilitation Grant Projects. Four projects approved by Main Roads WA: The Boulevard (improvement) and three rehabilitation projects (Selby, Grantham, Cambridge Streets). Motion amended to accept only rehabilitation projects and defer The Boulevard pending additional reports.

motions.title: Waste management contracts accepted and levy approved
motions.description: Tender negotiations for waste management services concluded with two preferred tenderers. Australian Paper selected for recycling services and Cleanaway for general and green waste services on five-year contracts. Waste management levy of estimated $70 per property approved, payable up front or over two years.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval parking by-law amendment adopted
motions.description: Amendment to Parking By-law to increase infringement penalties for parking violations to maximum allowable $80 to address football-related parking issues. Council also advised Minister that Town does not accept need for third party adjudication of parking proposals.

motions.title: Garden Week site master plan deferred
motions.description: Master plan for development of Garden Week site at Perry Lakes Reserve presented by consultant Peter Coyne and Associates. Plan includes pathways, amphitheatre, paved areas, lighting, garden beds and parking. Projected cost $985,000. Initial works (bollards and paving) totalling $9,000 proposed for 1995/96. Item deferred for Council site visit.

motions.title: Emergency management LEMAC established
motions.description: Establishment of Local Emergency Management Advisory Committee (LEMAC) comprising representatives from Subiaco, Nedlands, Vincent and Cambridge. Approval for Council to appoint Cr Moore with Cr Johnston as deputy and Executive Manager Technical Services. Endorsement of new State Emergency Service unit formation and agreement to consider funding support in 1996/97 budget.

motions.title: Underground power supplementary proposal approved
motions.description: Authorisation for Chief Executive Officer to appoint consultant to prepare supplementary proposal to support Town's bid for underground power Phase Two implementation. Consultant appointment limited to cost of $20,000 to be charged to Consultancies - Technical Services budget with over committal.

motions.title: Appointment of Insurance Broker
motions.description: Selection of insurance broker for professional insurance services on a three-year contract commencing 1 July 1996.

motions.title: Waste Minimisation Conference Attendance
motions.description: Authorization for Cr McConnell and an officer to attend the 1996 Waste Minimisation Conference and Workshop in Sydney, NSW from 29 April to 1 May 1996, with expenditure authorization.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Local Government Accounting Directions 1994.

motions.title: Financial Statements for Period Ended 29 February 1996
motions.description: Receipt of financial statements for the period ended 29 February 1996.

motions.title: Wembley Playgroup Boundary Fence Realignment - Deferral
motions.description: Deferral of consideration of Wembley Playgroup Inc request to realign boundary fence at Joan Watters Community Centre to enable site visit by elected members.

motions.title: Resident Discount Scheme - Deferral
motions.description: Deferral of consideration of proposed Resident Discount Scheme at Wembley Golf Complex and Bold Park Aquatic Centre to enable further information provision.

motions.title: Ward Names Selection - First Motion
motions.description: Proposal to rename Wembley Ward to East Ward and City Beach Ward to West Ward.

motions.title: Ward Names Selection - City Beach Ward Renamed
motions.description: Motion to rename City Beach Ward to Coast Ward.

motions.title: Ward Names Selection - Wembley Ward Deferral

motions.title: Perry Lakes Damage Report Reception
motions.description: Receipt of report relating to damage caused to Perry Lakes area by Scout Jamboree in January 1995 and Rolling Stones Concert in April 1995.

motions.title: Council Committee System Implementation
motions.description: Implementation of a four-member committee system to facilitate detailed discussion and analysis of agenda issues, with request for Mayor and Deputy Mayor cooperation to waive chairing rights.

motions.title: Wembley Hotel Bulkhead Legal Action Cessation
motions.description: Motion to cease legal action against owners of Wembley Hotel for failure to replace bulkhead in Cambridge Bar to allow further negotiations.

motions.title: WAMA Disability Service Plan Nomination Request
motions.description: Receipt of request for nomination of a member to Department of Transport's Disability Service Plan Consultative Group.

motions.title: WAMA Public Libraries Aboriginal Reference Group Nomination Request
motions.description: Receipt of request for nomination of a member to Public Libraries Aboriginal Reference Group.

motions.title: Confidential Item Consideration - Lake Monger and Additional Staff Resources
motions.description: Motion to consider confidential items 14.1 Lake Monger Development and 14.3 Additional Staff Resources as part of normal business without proceeding behind closed doors.

motions.title: Lake Monger Development - Consultation Approval
motions.description: Reaffirmation of commitment to Lake Monger Management Plan and approval of consultation process with Nyungah Circle of Elders with funding allocation.

motions.title: Council Logo Design Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of recommended logo design as official logo for Town of Cambridge and declaration of winners of Logo Design Competition, with official announcement at new Civic Centre opening.

motions.title: Additional Staff Resources - First Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to add clause requesting reimbursement from Minister for Local Government for backlog work expenses.

motions.title: Additional Staff Resources - Second Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to insert 'up to' prior to budget figures to allow for cost containment.

motions.title: Additional Staff Resources Authorization
motions.description: Authorization of additional human resources and special projects funding to address work backlogs and staffing requirements.

motions.title: Leave of Absence – Cr Barlow
motions.description: Councillor Barlow requested leave of absence from 3 August to 8 August 2020 for personal reasons.

motions.title: Lot 780 No.2 Goonang Road – Two Storey Addition
motions.description: Development application for a proposed two storey addition to an existing single storey dwelling which does not comply with Cl26 of Local Planning Scheme No.1 and Cl7 (B) of Local Law 43.

motions.title: Lot 300 No.3 Waite Place – Single Dwelling Variation
motions.description: Application for variation to Local Law 43 - Buildings on Endowment Lands & Limekilns Estate for single dwelling with linea weatherboard cladding.

motions.title: Lot 258 No.17 Launceston Avenue – Cladding Variation
motions.description: Application for variation to Local Law 43 for cladding to proposed addition/alterations with timber frame construction and mixed cladding materials.

motions.title: Lot 786 No.11 Peebles Road – Cladding Variation
motions.description: Application for variation to Local Law 43 for cladding to double storey dwelling with Accoya cladding and selected tiles.

motions.title: Lot 517 No.4 Dandaloo Road – Cladding Variation
motions.description: Application for variation to Local Law 43 for cladding to single storey dwelling with weatherboard cladding.

motions.title: Lot 197 No.37 Peasholm Street – Single House Variation
motions.description: Application for variation to Local Law 43 for single house with Tuffwall Lightweight Cladding and Cedar Timber Planks.

motions.title: Council Policy Review – Planning and Development
motions.description: Review of Council policies pertaining to the Planning and Development Directorate. Various policies to be retained unchanged, amended, or rescinded.

motions.title: Local Planning Policy 3.19 Percent for Public Art and Tree Canopy
motions.description: Draft amended Local Planning Policy 3.19 regarding public art and tree canopy contributions, including clarification of application scope to developments with construction value of $2 million or more in specified activity centres and zones.

motions.title: Economic Development Strategy 2018-2022 Progress Report and COVID Survey
motions.description: Second annual progress report on Economic Development Strategy 2018-2022 and results of COVID-19 Business Economic Impact Survey with 16 responses indicating significant revenue decline and staffing reductions.

motions.title: Building Permits Approved Under Delegated Authority June 2020
motions.description: Register of building permits, demolition permits, and other building approvals issued under delegated authority for June 2020, totalling 48 permits with construction value of $10,234,862.52.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications Report June 2020
motions.description: Schedule of planning applications dealt with under delegated authority in accordance with Council policy as they complied with Town Planning Scheme and Council Policy requirements.

motions.title: Western Metropolitan Regional Council Annual Contribution MoU
motions.description: Proposal for Town to contribute to operational costs of WMRC resource recovery facility in Shenton Park to enable Cambridge residents continued access to recycling and problematic waste services.

motions.title: 2020-21 Community Sporting and Recreation Facilities Fund Small Grant
motions.description: Application for $80,000 CSRFF small grant towards replacement of LED floodlighting at Alderbury Sports Ground with total project cost of $240,000, with grant application deadline of 14 August 2020.

motions.title: Council Policy Review Corporate and Community Services
motions.description: Biennial review of 31 Corporate and Community Services policies with amendments, deletions, and two new policies (Rates Recovery and Non-Rateable Properties). Committee discussion raised queries on Policy 2.1.7 (Events with Performing and Displayed Animals), Policy 2.2.1 (Collection Development), and Policy 2.2.2 (Library Services General Administration).

motions.title: Payment of Accounts June 2020
motions.description: Schedule of account payments for June 2020 submitted in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, including cheque payments totalling $220,786.24 and EFT payments totalling $15,753,090.95 (total $15,973,877.19).

motions.title: Investment Schedule – June 2020
motions.description: Council receives the Investment Schedule for 30 June 2020, detailing the performance of the council's investment portfolio during June 2020, including term deposits, managed cash funds, and internal loans.

motions.title: Council Policy Review – Office of the CEO
motions.description: Council approves updates to Council policies pertaining to the Office of the CEO, including Governance, Legal and Risk policies, with changes to be incorporated into a consolidated Policy Manual. Policy 1.2.12 (Complaints Management) is deferred to August 2020.

motions.title: Budget for the Year Ending 30 June 2021 – Adoption
motions.description: Council adopts the 2020-2021 annual budget following public consultation. The budget includes operating revenue of $47.6 million, capital grants of $2.6 million, and operating expenditure of $51.9 million with capital works of $21.6 million. General rates are maintained at $25.5 million. Includes approval of fees, charges, instalment options, and variations from budget thresholds.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge COVID-19 Committee – Receiving of Minutes and Amendment of Wording
motions.description: Council receives the minutes of the Town of Cambridge COVID-19 Committee meeting held on 20 July 2020 and approves amendment to delete clause 6(h) of the 23 June 2020 Council decision to remove reference to 'Other Town of Cambridge Officers, as nominated by the Chief Executive Officer' to ensure compliance with the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Extraordinary Election 2020 for Wembley Ward – Resignation of Cr James Nelson
motions.description: Council approves conducting a postal extraordinary election to fill the Wembley Ward vacancy created by Cr James Nelson's resignation effective 8 July 2020. The Western Australian Electoral Commissioner will conduct the election as a postal election on Friday, 16 October 2020, with estimated unbudgeted expenditure of $38,000 (including GST).

motions.title: Local Government Act 1995 – Section 5.127 – Report on Elected Member Training
motions.description: Council notes the Elected Member Training Report for the financial year 1 July 2019 to 30 June 2020, as required by the Local Government Legislation Amendment Act 2019. The report will be published on the Town of Cambridge website by 31 July 2020.

motions.description: Confidential report regarding COVID-19 impact on the Town's summer season community clubs.

motions.description: Confidential report regarding a parking agreement for Perry Lakes Reserve involving Edge Vision Living.

motions.description: Confidential report regarding Ocean Mia vacant lots and contracts of sale.

motions.title: Ocean Gardens (Inc) – Reappointment of Director
motions.description: Confidential report regarding the reappointment of a director to Ocean Gardens (Inc). Cr McKerracher declared an impartiality interest regarding association with the retirement village.

motions.title: State Administrative Tribunal Matter DR 277 2019
motions.description: Confidential report regarding State Administrative Tribunal matter DR 277 2019 Stuart Adrian Corp versus Town of Cambridge – further report.

motions.title: Meeting Re-opened to Public
motions.description: Procedural motion to re-open the meeting to the public following confidential session.

motions.title: Allow Mayor Shannon to participate despite financial interest
motions.description: Mayor Shannon declared a financial interest in the budget due to a road surfacing capital project in Wareen Place where she is a resident. This motion sought to allow her to remain present and participate under Section 5.68 of the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Adopt Budget for Year Ending 30 June 2018
motions.description: The 2017/2018 annual budget was presented for adoption following a period of public comment. The budget includes general rates increase of 1.5%, operating revenue of $50.075 million, operating expenditure of $66.794 million, and capital works of $11.086 million. Public submissions and responses were received on various matters including funding priorities, service reviews, and rate impacts.

motions.title: Amendment to Budget - Zero Rate Increase
motions.description: An amendment was moved to the budget to reduce the general rates increase to 0.00% by setting the amount of General and Minimum Rates budgeted for collection at $25,037,638. The amendment also required the CEO to provide a report outlining options for reductions in expenditure items of $375,000 to ensure a balanced financial outcome.

motions.title: Adopt Budget for Year Ending 30 June 2018 (as amended)
motions.description: The budget was formally adopted following the amendment reducing the rate increase to 0.00%. The final adopted budget reflects operating revenue of $49.6985 million, operating expenditure of $66.794 million, and capital expenditure of $11.0865 million.

motions.title: Adoption of Meeting Schedule 2001/2002
motions.description: Council meeting schedule from May 2001 to April 2002 with proposed change in commencement time.

motions.title: Appointment of Standing Committee Members
motions.description: Appointment of members to the four standing committees of the Council by absolute majority.

motions.description: Response to Minister for Local Government correspondence regarding settlement of outstanding infrastructure issues including Bold Regional Park, Ocean Gardens, Councillor car parking, Mayoral Chain of Office, new library, and plant hire fees.

motions.description: Matter concerning Local Government Advisory Board recommendations for potential extension of Town of Cambridge boundaries deferred to obtain further information on options 4 and 5.

motions.description: Conference held in Brisbane 9-12 November 1997, with proposed two-day Study Tour of Brisbane Libraries. Councillor Smith to make closing address as President of Australian Library Information Association. Estimated costs approximately $3,000

motions.title: Home Occupation - Carpet Cleaning Business at 35 Tarongo Way
motions.description: Application for approval to use 9 square metres room as administration office for carpet cleaning business. Applicant Mark Sinclair, sole operator, hours 7am-6pm, administrative work only

motions.title: Home Occupation - Security Business at 18 Clanmel Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for approval to use 28 square metres room as administration office for security business. Applicant Kevin Conaghan. Exceeds maximum 20 square metres floor area requirement - requires absolute majority decision. One formal objection received during advertising

motions.title: Home Occupation Renewal - Real Estate Settlement Agency at 11 Orana Crescent
motions.description: Renewal application for home occupation operating since 1991. 10.5 square metres office for Real Estate Settlement Agency. One letter of objection and two letters of support received. No complaints since 1992

motions.title: Entry Statements - Floreat Forum Shopping Centre
motions.description: Approval sought for three limestone block and wrought iron entry statements for Floreat Forum Shopping Centre at three locations: northern car park, corner of Howtree Place and The Boulevard, and intersection of Howtree Place, Brookdale Street and Cambridge Street/Oceanic Drive

motions.title: Two Lot Subdivision Refusal at 36 Windarra Drive
motions.description: Proposed two lot green title subdivision. Lots proposed are 700 and 633 square metres with average of 666.5 square metres, below the required 800 square metres average and 700 square metres minimum. Outside 10% variation allowed. WA Planning Commission referred application to Council for recommendation

motions.title: Church Building Mixed Use Development - Minister's Consent Sought
motions.description: Application to use existing Church as residence and office at 79 Woolwich Street, West Leederville. Amended plans reduce office floor area from 100 to 52 square metres net. Requires Minister for Planning consent as office is prohibited use in Residential R40 zone. Five formal submissions received during advertising, four expressing concern

motions.title: Two Single Storey Residences for Subdivision at Woolwich Street
motions.description: Development application for two single storey residences on subdivision of Lots 19 and 20 at 79 Woolwich Street, West Leederville. Three green title lots proposed including lot with existing Church. Minor discretions sought regarding internal boundaries, parking within front setback, and front setback reduction to 6 metre average

motions.title: Three Lot Subdivision Recommendation - West Coast Highway
motions.description: Application to re-subdivide two existing lots into three lots. Technically complies with R Codes but proposal effectively only subdivides Lot 290 by incorporating negligible boundary adjustment to Lot 289. Council advises commission of concerns regarding circumventing average lot size requirements

motions.title: Single Dwelling Refusal - 102 St Leonards Avenue
motions.description: Proposed single storey dwelling with garage in front setback area. Application non-compliant with Council Policy No 19 requiring vehicular access via rear laneway where available. Plot ratio exceeds policy. Side setback variations required. Rear laneway available and well-maintained

motions.title: Addition to Two Storey Residence Approval - Boscombe Avenue
motions.description: Addition of bedroom to upper floor increasing plot ratio from 0.47 to 0.49:1. Minor side setback variation of 100mm on north west corner. Absolute majority required. Adjoining property owners consent given. Proposal does not adversely impact streetscape

motions.title: Two Storey Residence at 230 Jersey Street - Approval
motions.description: Proposed two storey residence with plot ratio of 0.45:1 exceeding policy of 0.4:1. Side setback variation for second storey from southern boundary reduced from required 3.4m to 2.5m. Neighbouring property owners approve variation. Design integrates with streetscape character

motions.title: 230 Jersey Street, Wembley - two storey residence
motions.description: Application for building licence to construct a two storey residence with plot ratio variation from 0.4:1 to 0.45:1. Committee initially recommended refusal but on reconsideration approved the application following receipt of further correspondence from applicants explaining the lock-up garage design and its benefits.

motions.title: 18 Fortview Road, Mt Claremont - two storey residence with granny flat
motions.description: Application for preliminary approval to construct a two storey residence with granny flat. Proposal seeks variation to plot ratio policy from 0.4:1.0 to 0.47:1.0 (65 square metres excess). All other development standards met. Committee approved with conditions regarding dining room window and paving.

motions.title: Lot 265, 80 Blencowe Street, West Leederville - proposed two lot subdivision
motions.description: Subdivision of existing 647 square metre lot into two lots of 324.78 square metres each. Complies with R Codes but would require demolition of existing character dwelling. WAPC issued approval on 21 December 1994 valid for 3 years. Council recommends opposition to subdivision based on character heritage and streetscape concerns.

motions.title: Town Master Plan - motion amendment
motions.description: Notice of Motion by Cr Steele regarding preparation of Town Master Plan to year 2020. Two-stage process: Stage 1 to review data and prepare scope ($12,000); Stage 2 to prepare full plan. Steering Committee appointed. Amendment moved to refer Stage 2 decision to Council of the day rather than automatically proceeding.

motions.title: Brookdale Street, Floreat - name change request deferred
motions.description: Resident request to rename disjointed sections of Brookdale Street to improve property location identification. Street interrupted by Floreat Forum with complex routing requiring multiple turns. Committee deferred item pending preparation of specific proposal before inviting resident comment.

motions.title: Suburb name change - land south of Salvado Road
motions.description: Geographic Names Committee requests suburb boundary change for land south of Salvado Road between Station Street and Axon Street bridge from Wembley to Subiaco. Affects small TAFE campus, St Joseph's Church and former WA Government Printer site within Town of Cambridge. Town opposes change citing Subiaco redevelopment project timing.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications report received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for June 1997 including seven planning approvals (home occupation renewal, landscaping plan, subdivisions). Notifications of two planning appeals lodged with Minister for Planning: proposed billboard/roof sign at 138 Railway Parade West Leederville; existing poolshed on front boundary at 16 Windarra Drive City Beach.

motions.title: Building licences approved under delegated authority
motions.description: Report on building licences approved during June 1997. Total of 38 building licences with combined value of $2,357,270; one sign licence, five preliminary building licences and six demolition licences also approved. Year-to-date construction value $59,908,385 compared to $30,675,061 previous year.

motions.title: Information provided on plans for planning and building applications
motions.description: Report examining information requirements for residential planning and building applications. Discusses statutory requirements under Town Planning Scheme and Building Regulations. Recommends deferring further consideration pending presentation of Residential Design Guidelines draft which will incorporate review of information requirements.

motions.title: Town Master Plan - Council Motion (Main)
motions.description: Notice of Motion by Cr Steele for preparation of Town Master Plan to year 2020. Steering Committee to comprise two councillors, CEO and nominees, reporting monthly to Policy and Administration Committee.

motions.title: Templetonia Crescent/Kingsland Avenue Intersection - Traffic (Alternative Motion)
motions.description: Alternative motion to proceed with upgrading the intersection of Templetonia Crescent and Kingsland Avenue in accordance with the sketch plan.

motions.description: Motion to refer Item TS02.106 back to Administration to provide additional sketches and information on tree species and numbers.

motions.title: Grantham Street - Kenmore Crescent to Selby Street - Traffic Management and Street Enhancement
motions.description: Motion to approve traffic management and street enhancement works in Grantham Street, including bus stop removals, plan development, and noting budget allocation limits.

motions.title: Grantham Street/Nanson Street Intersection - Median Island
motions.description: Motion to approve construction works for median island at Grantham Street/Nanson Street intersection in accordance with plan and Black Spot grant application.

motions.title: Jersey Street Traffic Management and Street Enhancement
motions.description: Council consideration of community comment on the Jersey Street Local Area Traffic Management Plan and recommendation for an implementation program between Herdsman Parade and Grantham Street.

motions.title: Oceanic Drive/Alderbury Street Intersection Modification
motions.description: Council consideration of a Black Spot grant project to improve the safety of the intersection of Oceanic Drive and Alderbury Street, with modifications based on community consultation.

motions.title: Southport Street Kerbside Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Council consideration of Transperth Bus Service request to restrict on-street parking on Southport Street and alternative proposal from Committee not to implement parking restrictions.

motions.title: Floreat Beach Park Dune Rehabilitation Stage 2 Funding
motions.description: Council consideration of Perth Biodiversity Project Expression of Interest for funding Stage 2 dune rehabilitation works at Floreat Beach Park and approval of additional funds for Stage 1 completion.

motions.title: Floreat Avenue Landscape Plan Approval
motions.description: Council consideration of landscape plan for Floreat Avenue between The Boulevard and Oceanic Drive to establish new street tree theme with Jacaranda trees and provide screening for residents.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Reserve Entry Statements
motions.description: Council consideration of Perry Lakes Working Group recommendations for design and funding of entry statements and directional parking signs at Perry Lakes Reserve.

motions.title: Perry Lakes entry statements endorsement
motions.description: Design for four entry statements (Option 1) for Perry Lakes Reserve, with directional parking signs and budget reallocation from operating to capital budget.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Environmental Management Plan presentation
motions.description: Concept design for entry statements to Perry Lakes endorsed in the Perry Lakes Environmental Management Plan to be presented to Botanic Gardens and Parks Authority for comment, with a report to Council on outcome of discussions.

motions.title: Tender No 26 – Automatic irrigation supply and installation
motions.description: Tender submissions for supply and installation of automatic irrigation at Perry Lakes Reserve Stage 2 and Berkeley Park. Three tenders received. Preferred contractors identified as Malua Reticulation for Perry Lakes Reserve and Total Eden for Berkeley Park.

motions.title: Birkdale Park playground upgrade
motions.description: Additional funds required for playground upgrade including Soft-Fall rubber safety surface and security lighting. Current budget $12,000; additional $9,500 required.

motions.title: Mabel Talbot Reserve Management Plan acknowledgement
motions.description: Draft Management Plan for Mabel Talbot Reserve developed by City of Subiaco with Town of Cambridge representation on Steering Committee. Plan includes sections on biophysical and social environment, management plan, concept plan and implementation program.

motions.title: Review of Local Government Act 1995 proposed amendments
motions.description: Report on proposed amendments to the Local Government Act 1995 following comprehensive review commenced January 2000. Eighty-two proposed amendments reviewed including election matters, accountability, local law procedures, and financial management.

motions.title: Ward boundary change alignment with Endowment Lands
motions.description: Report relating to Ministerial approval of proposed ward boundary change to align with Endowment Lands boundary. The Local Government Advisory Board advised that the Minister for Local Government and Regional Development has accepted recommendations for dividing the district into two wards.

motions.title: Final adoption of Local Law Amendments 2002
motions.description: Adoption of the final version of the Town of Cambridge Local Law Amendments 2002 Local Law incorporating changes requested by the Joint Standing Committee on Delegated Legislation. Seven local laws gazetted on 22 March 2002 (Parking, Local Government and Public Property, Trading in Public Places, Private Property, Animals, Health, Health Food Premises) required amendment to remove provisions deemed to be 'ouster' clauses and other modifications.

motions.title: Strategic Plan 2002 to 2008 development
motions.description: Council to conduct workshops involving Elected Members, staff and the Town of Cambridge community to formulate a Strategic Plan for the next five years, scheduled April to June 2003. A shortlist of up to three suitably qualified facilitators to be presented to Council for consideration. This follows the original Strategic Plan adopted in March 1997.

motions.title: Risk Management Plan development
motions.description: Progress report on development of a risk management plan for the Town. A workshop was conducted on 14 November 2002 with the Town's Executive Management, Managers and Out-centre Managers, facilitated by representatives of Local Government Insurance Services WA (LGIS). The Manager, Policy and Administration has been nominated as the Risk Management Co-ordinator.

motions.title: Annual General Meeting of Electors decisions
motions.description: Report on decisions made at the Annual General Meeting of Electors held on 28 November 2002. The meeting received the contents of the Annual Report for 2001/2002 and conducted the Award Ceremony for the Annual Garden Competition. A matter relating to vehicle/birdlife conflict on Lake Monger Drive was raised and is to be considered by Council.

motions.title: Administration/Civic Centre security cameras purchase
motions.description: Approval to purchase and install security cameras and digital recording system at the Town's Administration Building. The system includes four high resolution dome cameras at the rear and southern side of the Centre at an estimated cost of $14,000. This is in response to escalating vandalism incidents over the past two years.

motions.title: Accounts for payment confirmation
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for expenses incurred by the Town in accordance with Regulation 13 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Schedule of cheques from Municipal and Trust Accounts for the period.

motions.title: Investment Schedule received
motions.description: Report on the amount of surplus funds invested, distribution of those funds and financial performance of each investment (interest earned) year to date for the period ended 30 November 2002. Summary shows total budget $567,000 with actual year-to-date investment of $252,644 (44.6%).

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements received
motions.description: Report to receive the Financial Statements for the period ended 30 November 2002.

motions.title: Documents sealed - noted
motions.description: Report noting that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to documents. One document sealed on 19 November 2002: Partial Withdrawal of Caveat H984975 and Lodgement of Replacement Caveat for property at 57B Northwood Street, West Leederville, to enable new title documents following a boundary adjustment.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre summer season 2002/2003
motions.description: Report on proposed 2002/2003 program of events at the Quarry Amphitheatre. Perth International Arts Festival (PIAF) advised they have no performance suitable for the venue for the 2002/2003 season (typically $16,000-$20,000 annual income). Starlight Theatre Lighting managing the venue will offer outdoor cinema January 2003 and family concerts March 2003 to minimise revenue impact. Motion includes funding advising PIAF of Council's valuing of their performances and noise restrictions report requirement.

motions.title: Night Surfing Competition City Beach funding and conditions
motions.description: Report on the 2002 City Beach Night Surfing Competition which experienced significant issues including poor organisation by JC Surfworks, irresponsible participant behaviour (alcohol consumption, anti-social behaviour, vandalism), and difficulty in coordination. Council approved $2,500 funding for 2003 competition to be managed by City Beach Surf Riders Club directly with strict conditions: no alcohol, no JC Surfworks involvement, no glass, alcohol sponsorship exclusion, two-month advance application, documented requirements at 20 working days prior, compliance with conditions of hire, and fund acquittal.

motions.title: Tender 28-2002/2003 Seniors Information Directory
motions.description: Acceptance of tender submission from CSD Network for design, development and production of 2003 Seniors Information Directory

motions.description: Adoption of guidelines for pricing policy of leased premises to community organisations

motions.title: Pricing Policy - Amendment 1
motions.description: Amendment to clause (i) removing reference to 'No charge for exclusive use of land'

motions.title: Pricing Policy - Amendment 2
motions.description: Amendment to clause (ii) setting uniform $2,000 annual rent for community organisations leasing premises without entry fees

motions.title: Pricing Policy Council Leased Premises - Committee Recommendation
motions.description: Committee recommendation on pricing policy guidelines for council leased premises, effective from 1 July 2003
