motions.description: Approval to proceed with legal recovery of outstanding debts owed by owner of 3 Kintyre Crescent Floreat, including potential sale of assets

motions.title: Refuse two storey dwelling at Lot 41 Windarra Drive
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling submitted by Beaumonde Homes at Lot 41 (No. 39) Windarra Drive, City Beach, with non-compliances to Residential Design Codes ground floor and upper floor side setback requirements and visual privacy requirements.

motions.title: Approve two storey dwelling at Lot 41 Windarra Drive with conditions
motions.description: Final approval of the application for a two storey dwelling submitted by Beaumonde Homes at Lot 41 (No. 39) Windarra Drive, City Beach, following amendments to address privacy screening on ground floor rear outdoor living area and upper floor rear balcony.

motions.title: Approve two storey grouped dwellings at Lot 32 Tower Street
motions.description: Application for two two storey grouped dwellings with variations to building height and roof design at Lot 32 (No.156) Tower Street, West Leederville, submitted by Paul Harford.

motions.title: Approve mixed-use development at Lot 8 Southport Street
motions.description: Application for a three storey mixed-use development (office and multiple dwellings) submitted by Land Alliance Pty Ltd at Lot 8 (No. 13) Southport Street, West Leederville with variations to plot ratio, car parking, and setback requirements.

motions.title: Bold Park Community School development approval recommendation
motions.description: Application for school development at Reserve 34689, Dodd Street, Wembley. Proposal for Pre-Primary and Primary school facility accommodating 150 students in Stage One, with 225 anticipated total capacity. Site includes parking provisions and shared use of existing Council carpark.

motions.title: Telecommunications tower - Administration recommendation for approval
motions.description: Application for 35-metre telecommunications monopole tower at Wembley Golf Course, Lot 2 The Boulevard. Facility for 3G mobile network deployment by Hutchison. Tower designed to accommodate co-location of multiple carriers.

motions.title: Telecommunications tower - Committee recommendation for refusal
motions.description: Following defeat of Administration recommendation, Committee moved alternative motion to recommend refusal to WAPC on grounds of health concerns and visual impact of tower height exceeding policy.

motions.title: Grouped dwelling development - two townhouses approval
motions.description: Application for two two-storey townhouses at Lot 100 (No. 13) Caddy Avenue, West Leederville. Site has irregular shape with corner truncation creating design challenges. Variations requested to setbacks, garage door width, roof pitch, and open space provisions.

motions.title: Three-storey residence - Absolute majority approval
motions.description: Application for three-storey residence at Lot 184 (No. 6) Yalgun Road, City Beach. Site on north-west corner of Yalgun and Lilika Road with significant slope from Lilika towards west. Variations sought to secondary street setback, wall height to west elevation, and privacy requirements.

motions.title: Two-storey dwelling, outbuilding, and front wall at Lot 760 Peebles Road
motions.description: Application for a two-storey dwelling, outbuilding, and front wall submitted by Glenway Homes at Lot 760 (No. 45) Peebles Road, Floreat, with variations to height and permeability of fencing in front setback area and outbuilding wall height.

motions.title: Two storey, split level dwelling at Lot 2 Fortview Road, Mt Claremont
motions.description: Application for building approval for a two storey, split level single residential dwelling at Lot 2 (No. 53) Fortview Road, Mt. Claremont, seeking variations to wall height and retaining wall heights.

motions.title: Two-storey dwelling at Lot 47 Highbury Street, Floreat
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for a new two-storey dwelling and double carport at Lot 47 (No. 10) Highbury Street, Floreat, seeking variations to primary street setback, driveway location, upper floor side setback, and wall height.

motions.title: Two storey residence at Lot 1034 Kintyre Crescent, Floreat
motions.description: Application for provisional building approval for a two storey residence at Lot 1034 (No. 19) Kintyre Crescent, Floreat, seeking variations to wall height and rear and side setbacks.

motions.title: Additions and alterations at Lot 266 Chidley Road, City Beach
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions and alterations to existing three-storey dwelling at Lot 266 (No. 3) Chidley Road, City Beach, seeking variation to wall height.

motions.title: Alterations and additions to dwelling, Hornsey Road Floreat
motions.description: Application by Ross and Jan Luckman for alterations and additions to an existing single storey dwelling at Lot 291 (No. 13) Hornsey Road, Floreat with variations to wall height and privacy setbacks.

motions.title: Alterations and additions to grouped dwelling, Jukes Way Wembley
motions.description: Application by Ashley de Prazer and Danielle Micich for alterations and additions to existing single storey grouped dwelling with variations to front setback and front fence requirements.

motions.title: Additions and alterations with zincalume roof, Oceanic Drive Floreat
motions.description: Application by Riemann and Co for additions and alterations to existing dwelling including replacement of asbestos roof with zincalume roof, seeking variation to Local Law 43 roofing material requirements.

motions.title: Patio within primary and secondary street setback areas, Windarra Drive City Beach
motions.description: Application by J & O Laskowski for open-sided patio located within primary and secondary street setback areas on corner property, requiring variation to setback requirements.

motions.title: Non-complying front fence, Pearson Place Floreat
motions.description: Application by Anthony and Julie Paul for traditional style picket front fence seeking variation to 80% visual permeability requirement in primary street setback area.

motions.title: Retaining walls, Teslin Road Mount Claremont
motions.description: Application by Daryl B Watts for retaining walls in rear yard seeking variations to R-Codes setback and privacy requirements. Previous application refused June 2002. Current application with proposed amendments.

motions.description: Comments on draft Western Australian State Sustainability Strategy referred to Sustainability Policy Unit and WALGA

motions.description: Approval of lease term variation from 21 years with renewal option to straight 42 year lease

motions.description: Authority for unbudgeted expenditure up to $20,000 for purchase of new Integrating Sound Level Meter

motions.description: Procedural motion to regard Australia Day 2003 Nominations item as confidential

motions.title: Australia Day 2003 Active Citizenship Awards granted
motions.description: Premier's Australia Day Active Citizenship Awards granted to nominees for presentation at Citizenship Ceremony

motions.title: Adoption of Meeting Schedule
motions.description: The Committee and Council Meeting Schedule from May 2005 to April 2007 has been circulated for adoption.

motions.title: Appointment of Standing Committee Members
motions.description: Appointment of members to the Council's five Standing Committees: Technical Services, Policy and Administration, Corporate and Customer Services, Development and Environmental Services, and Corporate Governance.

motions.title: Appointment to Botanic Gardens and Parks Authority Board
motions.description: Nomination of representatives to be submitted for consideration by the Hon Minister for the Environment for the Botanic Gardens and Parks Authority Board of Management (formerly Kings Park Board).

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Ordinary Meeting held 28 November 1995 with amendments to items 10.1.5 and 10.5.2

motions.title: 98 Nanson Street, Wembley - Home Occupation (Beautician's Salon)
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] to use a bedroom for beautician's business. Proposal does not comply with Town Planning Scheme provisions regarding scale and nature of home occupations. Applicant proposes three operating days weekly with up to eight clients per day. Planning officer recommends refusal due to adverse impact on residential amenity.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Review - Update on Progress
motions.description: Progress report on preparation of new Town Planning Scheme. Total of 777 submissions received during three-month advertising period. Council to consider submissions and issues report in February or March next year. Recommendations for further public consultation outlined.

motions.title: 4 Niribi Road, City Beach - Home Occupation (Physiotherapy Practice)
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] to use room for physiotherapy practice. Proposal does not comply with Town Planning Scheme provisions regarding scale and nature of home occupations. Applicant proposes five days weekly operation with maximum six clients per day. Four residents contacted Council; three objected. Planning officer recommends refusal due to adverse impact on residential amenity.

motions.title: Expressions of Interest - Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places
motions.description: Tender evaluation for preparation of Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places. Three qualified consultants submitted expressions of interest: O'Brien Planning Consultants ($29,500), Heritage and Conservation Professionals ($30,000), and Considine and Griffiths Architects with Erickson and Taylor ($30,000). Evaluation team recommends Heritage and Conservation Professionals based on knowledge of local history and ability to dedicate more resources to survey work.

motions.title: 16-18 Cambridge Street, West Leederville - Unauthorised Commercial Sign
motions.description: Illegal painted freestanding sign (approximately 0.8m x 1m) located at corner of Southport and Cambridge Streets in residential area, contravening Town Planning Scheme clauses 149 and 160. Sign advertises architectural firm. Property owner has not responded to two written notices. Council authorised to remove sign if not removed within 30 days of notice.

motions.title: 18 Oxford Close, Leederville - Local Government Act Notice - Illegal Alterations to Building
motions.description: Building non-compliant with fire separation and fire safety requirements. WA Fire Brigade inspection identified major deficiencies. Council issues notice under Section 401(1)(b) of Local Government Act 1960 requiring owners to carry out alterations, construction and upgrading works to comply with WA Uniform Building By-laws within 35 days of service.

motions.title: 66 Tate Street, Leederville - 2 Two Storey Attached Houses
motions.description: Application to construct 2 two storey attached townhouse-type residences. Proposal does not comply with Council Policy No. 13 (plot ratio 0.52:1.0 versus required 0.4:1.0) and does not comply with Council Policy No. 19. Concerns raised regarding scale inconsistent with surrounding character, steeply pitched zincalume roof creating excessive height (10.4 metres from street), and adverse visual impact on streetscape. Neighbouring properties did not object.

motions.title: 87 Gregory Street, Wembley - (Rear) Two Storey Residence
motions.description: Application for amended preliminary building licence to construct rear two storey residence with increased floor area. Proposal does not comply with Council Policy No. 13 (plot ratio 0.49:1.0 versus required 0.4:1.0), exceeding policy by 90 square metres (40 square metres additional over previous approval). Adjoining owners raised no objections. Motion to defer for further consultation with applicant regarding plot ratio reduction.

motions.title: 93 Woolwich Street, West Leederville - Proposed Single Dwelling and Double Garage
motions.description: Application for single storey dwelling and double garage with multiple non-compliance areas with R-Codes. Primary concern is front garage setback (proposed 1.5m versus required 4.5m). Applicant argues security concerns for high-performance vehicle and vehicle cannot negotiate speed humps in rear right-of-way. Adjoining neighbour objected. Deferral motion approved to enable further investigation of rear garage option.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for November 1995. Total 49 building licences with combined value of $2,542,842. Also includes 1 sign licence, 3 preliminary building licences, and 5 demolition licences. Cumulative totals July-November 1995: 182 building licences valued at $11,837,879.

motions.title: 47 Dampier Avenue, City Beach - Additions
motions.description: Application for renovations and additions including garage on boundary with nil side setback (required 1.0 metre). Adjoining neighbour opposed due to perceived loss of amenity. Council considers impact minimal due to wide driveway separation, swimming pool screen wall, lower site level, and garage setback 1.2 metres behind building line. Approval recommended subject to roof design amendment to minimize height.

motions.title: Lot 101 Glen Street Leederville - Proposed Double Storey Residence
motions.description: Application by Buildwise on behalf of Mr and [private individual — name withheld] to construct a two storey residence on a recently created lot with an area of 248 square metres. The application does not comply with Residential Planning Codes provisions pertaining to side, rear and front setbacks, and Council Policy No. 13 on Plot Ratio. Previous similar application was refused on 14 November 1995. This revised application includes modified plans with reduced side and rear setbacks, and upper bedroom windows reduced to minor openings.

motions.title: Immunisation - Australian Childhood Immunisation Register
motions.description: Council is invited to participate in a two year trial programme of the Australian Childhood Immunisation Register administered by the Health Insurance Commission. The register records immunisations for children 0-6 years old. Council would become a registered provider and receive payment of $6 per child for providing immunisation information in either paper or electronic format. Cr Smith expressed concern about collection and release of medical information.

motions.title: Traffic Management - Systems to Prioritise Projects and Public Consultation
motions.description: Report on traffic management proposals including process for allocating priorities and community consultation. Report addresses road hazards, signs, parking, traffic management treatments and community consultation procedures. Proposes that traffic management projects be prioritised based on road hierarchy, traffic volume, speed, accidents and social issues. Recommends community consultation approach including letter box drop surveys and community consultation committees.

motions.title: Waste Management - Concept and Objectives
motions.description: Report on waste management strategies and objectives. Council agreed on objectives for waste minimisation, collection and disposal. Project team identified five implementation options. Further work recommends two bin system (general waste and recycling) with re-tender exercise. Also considers bulk collection tender evaluation.

motions.title: Waste Management - Bulk Collection Tender Acceptance
motions.description: Four tenders received for bulk waste collection services. Project team evaluated against organisational profile and experience, and value for money. Alvito Pty Ltd identified as preferred tenderer with proven experience and lowest price of $81,000 per collection.

motions.title: Waste Management - Interim Agreement Extensions
motions.description: Current waste management contractors are Cleanaway (general, verge, commercial and public litter) and WA Recycling Co (recycled waste via crates and bulk collection points). Proposal to extend interim agreements until end of March 1996 at current agreed rates while re-tender exercise is undertaken.

motions.title: Waste Management - Re-tendering Exercise Deferred
motions.description: Motion to approve re-tendering exercise for waste management services on basis of two bins (general waste and recycling) with ownership alternatives for five year period was lost. Subsequent motion carried to further develop Council's position and prepare report for March 1996 with options on waste collection process.

motions.title: Waste Management - Monitoring Split Bin Systems
motions.description: Approval sought to monitor developments with split bin systems including regional trials in Perth WA and the enviro system.

motions.title: Waste Management - Budget Expenditure
motions.description: Approval sought to charge expenditure for bulk waste collection services and interim agreement extensions to Budget Item Community Amenities - Sanitation.

motions.title: Waste Management - BSD Consultants Engagement
motions.description: Approval sought to use BSD Consultants on an as required basis for waste management project to a maximum cost of $5,000, with expenditure charged to Infrastructure Funding - Consultancies.

motions.title: Waste Management - BSD Consultants Expenditure
motions.description: Approval sought to charge expenditure to engage BSD Consultants to a maximum cost of $5,000 to Infrastructure Funding - Consultancies.

motions.title: Waste Management - Conference Paper Distribution
motions.description: Request to provide all elected members with copy of Conference Paper issued by Australian Institute of Environmental Health at recently held National Environmental Health Conference.

motions.title: Tender - One Eight Tonne Tip Truck and One Seven/Eight Tonne Tip Truck with Crane
motions.description: Tenders called for purchase of two eight tonne tip trucks with side lifter (one with crane) for Council's road works team. Asset infrastructure funds allocated total of $182,000. Recommended supplier is Major Motors for Isuzu FVR 900 tip truck at $84,220 and Isuzu FVR 900 tip crane truck at $97,025 for total cost of $181,245 plus licensing. Selected supplier also supplies Council's bitumen truck.

motions.title: Metropolitan Local Road Fund Programme 1996/97
motions.description: Council resolved in August 1995 to prepare submissions for Main Roads WA under Metropolitan Local Road Fund Programme for 1996/97. Approved projects include improvement projects on The Boulevard, Empire Avenue roundabout, Howtree Place roundabout and Grantham Street T junction (total funds $670,000) and rehabilitation projects on Selby Street, Grantham Street and Cambridge Street (total funds $130,910). Regional meeting approved with Main Roads WA contributing $442,000 to improvement project and $87,274 to rehabilitation projects, with Council contributing one third ($228,000 improvement and $43,636 rehabilitation).

motions.title: Woolwich and McCourt Streets, West Leederville - No Verge Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Local residents reported indiscriminate parking on verges adjacent to park at corner of Woolwich and McCourt Streets, West Leederville, particularly during football season. Proposal to impose no verge parking restrictions on northern verge of Woolwich Street (40 metres westwards from McCourt Street) and western verge of McCourt Street (36 metres northwards from Woolwich Street), operative at all times.

motions.title: Station Street Wembley - Two Hour Parking Restriction
motions.description: Proprietor in area expressed concern that customers have difficulty finding parking. Investigation found private parking at rear of premises 100% utilised, Station Street parking 95% utilised with long term parking, and high demand for long term parking overall. Most local business proprietors receptive to two hour restriction. Proposal to impose two hour parking restriction on eastern side of Station Street commencing six metres north of Cambridge Street and extending 38.4 metres northwards, operative Monday to Sunday from 8.00am to 5.00pm.

motions.title: Stephenson Avenue, Rochdale Road Intersection - Road Upgrading
motions.description: Metropolitan Region Scheme Amendment 967/33 addresses proposed amendment to extend road reserve into M47. Report examines alternative road modifications to present intersection to direct traffic to West Coast Highway and regional road network while protecting vegetation and ethnographic sites. Council officers held discussions with City of Nedlands and Departments of Planning and Environmental Protection to identify constraints. Conclusion that only one alternative alignment exists with 300 metre radius that would remove some trees.

motions.title: Better Cities Programme - City to Sea Greenway
motions.description: Town of Cambridge approached by Better Cities Programme regarding construction of greenway for cyclists and pedestrians through parts of the Town. Programme includes plan to establish greenway from city to sea with some progress in areas east of Perth and plans for continuation through Subiaco Redevelopment area. Funding on two for one basis with initial expectation of $60,000 from Town. Funds available in financial year 1995/96 with requirement for expenditure in that year. Intent is for green route with no vehicle access.

motions.title: Garden Week Site - Preparation of Master Plan
motions.description: Council endorsed recommendation to obtain bids for preparation of master plan to improve Garden Week site at Perry Lakes. Set as joint project with Nursery Industries Association with Council contribution of $3,000 to projected cost of $6,000. Initial bids from landscape architects resulted in tendered price of $10,800 (above budget). Project team then identified competent landscape designers. Peter Coyne and Associates assessed as preferred tenderer with demonstrated experience in diverse public usage facilities and industry awards.

motions.title: Tender - Two Dual Cab 1.5 Tonne Trucks with Side Lifter and Steel Tray Body
motions.description: Tender 55-95 advertised for supply and delivery of two dual cab 1.5 tonne trucks with side lifter and steel tray body. Tender closed 5 December 1995 with three bids from three companies. Specification called for diesel engine, dual cab, seating capacity of six, manual transmission, air conditioning, power steering, window tinting, tow bar, mud flaps, sunvisor, fire extinguisher, hour meter and side lifter. Asset infrastructure funding of $70,000 available. Vehicles proposed for use by Parks staff for maintenance tasks.

motions.title: Tender - Supply of trucks
motions.description: Assessment and acceptance of tender for supply and delivery of two trucks for Town Parks operations. The Hino Dyna 200 was recommended as most suitable despite being 14% higher in price than the lowest bid, based on performance capability, organisation reputation, and value for money.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium lease to Western Reds
motions.description: Council amendment to lease offer for Western Reds Rugby League Club for office accommodation and gymnasium at Perry Lakes Stadium. Lease term modified from three to two years with five-year renewal option, and security requirement changed from $100,000 bank guarantee to bond equal to annual lease payment.

motions.title: Christmas/New Year arrangements and 1996 meeting schedule
motions.description: Council approval of Christmas/New Year office arrangements and 1996 ordinary meeting schedule to continue practice of two meetings per month on second and fourth Tuesdays.

motions.title: Delegated authority for Christmas recess 1995/96
motions.description: Establishment of delegated authority during Council recess from 13 December 1995 to 22 January 1996. Motion modified to delegate powers to Ward members rather than an Occasional Committee, subject to officer recommendation and Ward member agreement.

motions.title: Lake Monger Reserve - bicycle hire service refused
motions.description: Request by B Mosson to establish portable bicycle hire service at Lake Monger Reserve refused by Council due to existing conflict problems between cyclists and pedestrians on the dual-use path and need for pathway upgrades before allowing increased cycle use.

motions.title: Ocean Gardens Inc board representation
motions.description: Report on Ocean Gardens Inc constitutional amendments and deferral of appointment decision pending legal advice review scheduled for 23 January 1996 meeting.

motions.title: Dog Amendment Bill - dangerous dogs
motions.description: Report on proposed Dog Act amendments to give councils stronger powers to deal with dangerous dogs through declaration orders, muzzling requirements, and increased penalties.

motions.title: Appointment of authorised officers - various statutes
motions.description: Appointment of officers as authorised officers under Litter Act, Dog Act, Local Government Act and various bylaws effective from 11-12 December 1995 for beach inspectors and parks/reserves personnel.

motions.title: Appointment of authorised persons - Dog Act 1976
motions.description: Appointment of three officers as authorised persons to exercise powers of registration officer under Dog Act 1976.

motions.title: Chair and umbrella hire service at City Beach
motions.description: Approval of seasonal licence for portable chair and umbrella hire service on City Beach foreshore near No 1 Kiosk on trial basis from 16 December 1995 to 31 May 1996 at $50 per week.

motions.title: Wembley Pre Primary Centre lease to Education Department
motions.description: Transfer of lease from Wembley Kindergarten Inc to Education Department for five years from 1 January 1996 with five-year renewal option at $1,500 per annum plus CPI adjustments, allowing implementation of Good Start Program.

motions.title: Accounts for payment
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts and payment list totalling $653,023.73 including recoup advance accounts, wages transfer, and investments with Challenge Bank Limited and Home Building Society.

motions.title: Investment schedule and beneficial ownership policy
motions.description: Receipt of investment schedule as at 30 November 1995 showing $144,735 interest earned and confirmation of investment policy requiring assessment of beneficial ownership of financial institutions.

motions.title: Investment policy - beneficial ownership determination
motions.description: Council confirmation that investment policy limits be determined by beneficial ownership of financial institutions rather than trading names.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre financial position
motions.description: Report on final financial position as at 30 June 1995 showing deficit of $18,701 now resolved through Health Department grants, approval of payment of outstanding liabilities including employee entitlements, and authorisation of expenditure for safe installation.

motions.title: Neighbourhood Watch policy and funding allocation
motions.description: Acceptance of Neighbourhood Watch policy and approval of $3,000 budget allocation for Area Coordinator subsidies and equipment purchases. Separate motion authorised additional investigation into funding options.

motions.title: Neighbourhood Watch additional funding investigation
motions.description: Direction to administration to investigate additional funding and in-kind support options for Neighbourhood Watch program in consultation with other funding agencies.

motions.title: Outstanding issues with Hon Minister for Local Government
motions.description: Council request for meeting with Minister for Local Government regarding Mindarie Regional Council, asset recovery from City of Perth, reserve distribution, Ocean Gardens Inc dispute, Bold Regional Park, Subiaco redevelopment project, parking restrictions, and completion of 1994/95 accounts. Separate decision to hold strategic planning workshop.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval lights - notice of motion
motions.description: Council opposition to WAFC application for lights at Subiaco Oval citing serious adverse impacts on residents and ratepayers. Motion amended to include request for Mayor D'Orazio's support as WAPC representative. Agreement to seek Council deputation opportunity or coordinate with Subiaco representatives.

motions.title: WAMA - Indicative Planning Council for the Housing Industry
motions.description: Receipt of nomination request for membership vacancy on Indicative Planning Council for the Housing Industry, a WAMA-coordinated committee reviewing residential and commercial housing forecasts.

motions.title: WAMA - Community Housing Advisory Committee
motions.description: Receipt of nomination request for Community Housing Advisory Committee membership vacancy, a WAMA-coordinated committee advising Minister for Housing on community housing policy.

motions.title: Nomination of deputy member to Geographic Names Committee
motions.description: Request for the nomination of a deputy member to the Geographic Names Committee, with nominations closing 5 January 1996.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 27 April 1999
motions.description: Confirmation of the Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 27 April 1999 with amendment to Corporate and Customer Services Committee Item CCS99.28.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 4 May 1999
motions.description: Confirmation of the Minutes of the Special Meeting of Council held on 4 May 1999.

motions.title: The Boulevard/Grantham Street Traffic Report - Receive and Note
motions.description: Receipt and notation of the Final Report for the Traffic and Road Design contract for The Boulevard/Grantham Street prepared by Connell Wagner Pty Ltd. Recommendations to be further discussed at June 1999 Technical Services Committee Meeting.

motions.title: Designated Freight Routes - Agreement to Proposals
motions.description: Agreement by Town of Cambridge to designated freight routes in the Perth Metropolitan Area, including primary and secondary level roads. Motion was amended to reflect agreement rather than direction to effect proposals.

motions.title: Alexander Street Traffic Management - Plateau Work Not to Proceed
motions.description: Decision to not proceed with speed plateau work in Alexander Street adjacent Joan Watters Centre and to review traffic calming when footpath work is complete.

motions.title: 40 kph Speed Limit Review Report - Receive and Amend Position
motions.description: Receipt of report on 40 kph speed limit proposals with reaffirmation of Council's wishes and criticism of Main Roads WA methodology. Motion amended to direct communications to Main Roads WA and WAMA regarding the issue.

motions.title: Clanmel Road Petition - Traffic Concerns Review
motions.description: Receipt of petition from Clanmel Road residents concerning traffic volume and speed. Council to monitor traffic and review traffic management devices after Boulevard works completion.

motions.title: Bournville/Selby Street Median Island Construction - Refer Back
motions.description: Motion to construct median island at Selby/Bournville intersection with estimated cost $20,000. Motion to refer back to Technical Services Committee for further consideration was carried.

motions.title: Annual Review of Fees and Charges - Works Bonds and Sanitation
motions.description: Adoption of fees and charges for works bonds for 1999/2000 and sanitation fee of $120 for additional bins effective from 1 July 1999.

motions.title: Green Waste Contamination - Brown Lid Replacement Program
motions.description: Approval of program to replace green lids on 50% of green waste bins with brown lids during 1999/2000 financial year at estimated cost of $80,000.

motions.title: Railway Parade Kerbside Parking - Clearway Extension
motions.description: Extension of evening clearway on southern side of Railway Parade by 25.2 metres to accommodate Loftus Street road upgrading works and request to Main Roads WA to consider upgrading Railway Parade to Southport Street.

motions.title: Lake Monger wildlife crossing safety measures
motions.description: Following Main Roads WA's position on amber flashing lights for wildlife crossings at Lake Monger, and recommendations regarding options for addressing safety concerns.

motions.title: Landscaping requirements Oban Road Landra Gardens
motions.description: Assessment of landscaping improvements, tree planting, and dual use path access in the area adjacent to shopping centre development between Oban Road and Landra Gardens.

motions.title: Amended Guidelines for Community Bushland Rehabilitation Works
motions.description: Establishment of specific guidelines for community interest groups undertaking bushland rehabilitation works in remnant bushland areas within the Town of Cambridge, with six guidelines covering prior notice, qualified coordinators, site maps, rubbish removal, weed control, and tree pruning.

motions.title: Beecroft Park Millennium Time Capsule project
motions.description: Proposal to install a Millennium Time Capsule at Beecroft Park as a joint project between Council and the Lions Club of City Beach, with Administration to finalize details and cost sharing.

motions.title: Lake Monger Visitor Facilities Concept Plan approval
motions.description: Approval of the Facilities Overall Concept Plan for Lake Monger as prepared by Thompson Palmer, including public comment on access options from Powis Street based on feedback from Main Roads WA and City of Stirling.

motions.title: Lake Monger Dual Use Path removal liaison continuation
motions.description: Continuation of liaison with the Human Rights and Equal Opportunity Commission regarding Council's proposal to remove the section of Dual Use Path between Dodd Street and Powis Street.

motions.title: Tender acceptance for irrigation central control system
motions.description: Evaluation and acceptance of tender submissions for supply and installation of irrigation central control system and field units. Quinti and Company selected as most suitable tenderer for Rainbird Maxicom system with comprehensive review addressing technical issues and warranty specifications.

motions.title: Local Government Association Annual General Meeting 1999
motions.description: Advice on the Local Government Association Annual General Meeting held at Burswood Convention Centre from 1-3 August 1999, with procedural information for submission of motions and registration of delegates.

motions.title: Councillor attendance at professional development
motions.description: Participation by interested councillors in the 1999 Councillors' Weekend and Elected Member Development Program, with expenditure to be charged to Courses and Conferences budget.

motions.title: Ecologically sustainable development and biodiversity protection
motions.description: Motions lapsed for want of a mover were put forward (Recommendation 1 regarding no commercial dealings with companies exporting native forest woodchips, and Recommendation 2 regarding acknowledgement of community concerns). A motion was subsequently moved regarding ecologically sustainable development and protection of old growth forests.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Schedule of accounts in accordance with Regulation 13(2) of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at 30 April 1999
motions.description: Report on the amount of surplus funds invested, distribution of those funds, and financial performance of each investment.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements for period ended 30 April 1999
motions.description: Financial Statements for the period ended 30 April 1999.

motions.title: Documents Sealed with Common Seal of the Town
motions.description: Notification that documents have been sealed with the Common Seal of the Town.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre – Design Concept and Feasibility Study – Briefing with Consultants
motions.description: Receipt of information relating to the Design Concept and Feasibility Study for the Bold Park Aquatic Centre being undertaken by consultant team.

motions.title: Disability Services – Priority Ranking of Recommendations
motions.description: Priority ranking of the 18 recommendations from the 'Community Access to Council Facilities and Services Report' as recommended by the Disability Services Advisory Committee.

motions.title: Disability Services Advisory Committee – Terms of Reference Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of Terms of Reference for the Disability Services Advisory Committee as a Council policy.

motions.title: Multicultural Mobile Market – Permission to Operate
motions.description: Permission for the Multicultural Mobile Market to operate within the Town, subject to compliance with booking procedures.

motions.title: Joan Watters Respite Services – Fees and Financial Safeguards Policy
motions.description: Endorsement and adoption of the 'Fees and Financial Safeguards Policy' for Joan Watters Respite Services as a Council Policy, and delegation of authority to the CEO.

motions.title: Perth Netball Association – Loan Guarantor Approval
motions.description: Approval for the Town of Cambridge to act as guarantor for a loan of up to $50,000 for the upgrade of hard-surface courts at the Matthews Netball Centre in Wembley.

motions.title: Wembley Primary School – Financial Assistance for Basketball Courts and Oval Landscaping
motions.description: Council decision regarding financial assistance request from Wembley Primary School for basketball court development and oval landscaping.

motions.title: Graffiti Project – Central Metropolitan Graffiti Program
motions.description: Approval to include $22,000 in the 1999/2000 Budget for control of graffiti within the Town, in conjunction with neighbouring councils as part of the Central Metropolitan Graffiti Program. Quarterly progress reports to be submitted to Council.

motions.title: Plan of Principal Activities – Release for Public Consultation
motions.description: Review and approval to release the draft Plan of Principal Activities for the period 1999–2004 for statutory public consultation period of six weeks. The plan includes 19 principal activities: 12 ongoing programs and 7 specific projects including Wembley Town Centre Improvements, Coastal Improvements, and Bold Park Aquatic Centre Development.

motions.title: Financial Statements – March 1999 Quarterly Review and Budget Amendments
motions.description: Receipt of the Town's financial statements for the period ended 31 March 1999, noting budget variances, and approval of budget amendments and reallocations for electronic infringement device and playground equipment.

motions.title: Floreat Park Tennis Club – Sinking Fund Balance Release
motions.description: Approval to return approximately $24,300 remaining in the sinking fund to the Floreat Park Tennis Club after completion of synthetic court resurfacing, with condition that the club continues to contribute $15,000 per annum to the sinking fund from 1 April 1999 onwards.

motions.title: Right of Way Transfer – Wembley – Motion to Refer to Technical Services Committee
motions.description: Following initial motion not to acquire a portion of a privately owned right of way between Bournville, Harborne and Gregory Streets in Wembley, the item was referred to the Technical Services Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Right of Way Transfer – Wembley – Motion Not to Acquire
motions.description: Motion not to make an offer to [private individual — name withheld] to acquire free of charge a portion of a privately owned right of way between Bournville, Harborne and Gregory Streets in Wembley (Certificate of Title Volume 1921 Folio 590).

motions.title: City Beach Shopping Centre Parking Licence Extension – As Amended
motions.description: Approval of a new five-year extension of the parking licence at City Beach Shopping Centre, Gayton Road City Beach for Trickey Investments Pty Ltd and G J and M L Pethwick, effective from 1 August 1999 to 31 July 2004, subject to market valuation, with amendment adding condition regarding alternative parking if council requires access to the area.

motions.title: Community Halls – Fees and Charges Review for 1999/2000
motions.description: Approval of revised fees and charges for Floreat and Leederville Community Halls for 1999/2000, including removal of lesser hall fees, reduction of commercial use rate from $60 to $30 per hour, and introduction of booking cancellation fees.

motions.title: Sports Grounds and Reserves – Fees and Charges for 1999/2000
motions.description: Approval of fees and charges for sports grounds and reserves for 1999/2000, with no material changes proposed pending the outcome of the Sports Strategy review currently being conducted.

motions.title: Miscellaneous Fees and Charges for 1999/2000 – As Amended
motions.description: Approval of miscellaneous fees and charges for 1999/2000, with amendment to incorporate revised interest rates for instalments and overdue rates (from 13% to 11% and 6.5% to 5.5% respectively) as per amended Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Cr Smith recorded as voting against the library internet kiosk charge.

motions.title: Intergovernmental Agreement on Commonwealth-State Financial Relations
motions.description: Receipt and noting of information regarding the Intergovernmental Agreement (IGA) on Commonwealth-State Financial Relations signed on 9 April 1999, which transfers responsibility for Local Government Financial Assistance Grants from Federal to State Governments from 1 July 2000. The Town currently receives $602,000 in grants (4% of operating revenue).

motions.title: Private function approval – Perry Lakes Reserve
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] to conduct a private function in the Garden Week area of Perry Lakes Reserve on Friday, 31 December 1999

motions.title: Single dwelling approval – Kondil Place, City Beach
motions.description: Application by M Hartfield for a single dwelling (two storey) at Lot 3 (No.10) Kondil Place, City Beach. Amended plans submitted addressing side setback and privacy concerns.

motions.title: Single dwelling approval – Windarra Drive, City Beach
motions.description: Application by Milankov Designs for a two storey residence with undercroft at Lot 375 (No.18) Windarra Drive, City Beach. Amended plans received addressing filling, retaining walls, and open space issues.

motions.title: Single dwelling approval – Aruma Way, City Beach
motions.description: Application by Oswald Homes for a single dwelling (two storey and undercroft) at Lot 351 (No.50) Aruma Way, City Beach. Amended plans addressing primary street setback, side setbacks, and privacy concerns.

motions.title: Holy Spirit Catholic Primary School alterations/additions approval
motions.description: Application for alterations/additions to Holy Spirit Catholic Primary School at Lot 1 (No. 57) Brompton Road, City Beach. The Kindergarten is an existing use being relocated, Library expansion is internal with negligible impact, and proposed store is required distance from boundary with screening provided by retaining wall and fence.

motions.title: Newman Junior College Kindergarten and Pre-Primary building refusal
motions.description: Application for Kindergarten and Pre-Primary building at Lots 715-720/750-758 (No.184) Brookdale Street, Floreat. Committee expressed concern regarding existing traffic and parking congestion around the school and determined the application would intensify use and exacerbate existing problems, contrary to orderly and proper planning of the locality.

motions.title: Private road closure at Dodd Street and Walker Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application to initiate closure procedures for private street between Lot 1626 (No.203) Daglish Street and Lot 1 (No.3) Dodd Street, Wembley. The closure is for a portion of land abutting the applicants' properties after full closure proposal failed due to unwilling adjoining landowners.

motions.title: Three grouped dwellings and five single bedroom dwellings approval
motions.description: Application for redevelopment of land at Lots 2 and 3, Cambridge Street, West Leederville, comprising 3 two-bedroom grouped dwellings and 5 single-bedroom dwellings, two storeys in height. Variations sought include development density (50% bonus for single bedroom dwellings), side setbacks, and upper floor window setbacks requiring opaque glazing for privacy.

motions.title: Single dwelling two storey approval at Baramba Road
motions.description: Application for single dwelling (two storeys) at Lot 273 (No.16) Baramba Road, City Beach. Variations sought to side setbacks and upper floor side setback for privacy. Northern adjoining owner has no objection; southern adjoining owner objected to parapet wall but applicant amended plan.

motions.title: Second storey addition approval at Sudbury Way
motions.description: Application for second storey addition to existing single dwelling at Lot 97 (No.10) Sudbury Way, City Beach. Variations sought to front setback, side setbacks, building materials (timber cladding), and privacy screening for bedroom window. Both adjoining owners have no objection.

motions.title: Second storey addition withdrawn at Pindari Road
motions.description: Application for second storey addition to existing residence at Lot 599 (No.10) Pindari Road, City Beach. Variations sought to wall height, side setback, terrace and balcony setbacks. Property owner requested withdrawal of application via facsimile message.

motions.title: Additions to existing residence approval at Launceston Avenue
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing residence at Lot 257 (No.19) Launceston Avenue, City Beach, including conversion of carport to lounge and bedroom, new undercroft double garage, and stepped retaining walls due to steep 6.7 metre grade. Multiple variations sought to front setback, side setback, retaining walls, and privacy. Both adjoining neighbours have no objection.

motions.title: Alterations and additions approval at Tate Street
motions.description: Application for alterations and additions to existing single dwelling at Lot 470 (No.8) Tate Street, West Leederville. Variations sought to primary street setback, side setbacks, and front fencing. Previous approval from February 1998 had lapsed. Street is undergoing transition with eclectic character. Both adjoining neighbours have no objection.

motions.title: Lot 397 Bodmin Avenue - Proposed garage refusal
motions.description: Application for building approval to construct a garage at Lot 397 (No. 6) Bodmin Avenue, City Beach. The proposed brick and tiled garage would replace an existing metal carport on the common boundary. Non-compliances include side setback and parapet wall height/length. Adjoining neighbour objected to the proposal.

motions.title: Lot 36 Boronia Crescent - Off white colorbond roof approval
motions.description: Reconsideration of building licence condition pertaining to roofing materials for a single storey residence. Application for approval of off white colorbond roof which exceeds the 40% solar reflectivity requirement under Local Law 43. Council previously approved similar applications.

motions.title: Lot 56 Hesperia Avenue - Off white colorbond roof approval
motions.description: Reconsideration of building licence condition for roofing materials on a two storey residence. Application for approval of off white colorbond roof exceeding 40% reflectivity under Local Law 43. Applicant provided supporting grounds and both adjoining neighbours provided written statements with no objection.

motions.title: Lot 250 Woolwich Street - Garage door to carport refusal
motions.description: Application for planning approval to install a garage tilt door to existing carport. The carport is set back 3.6 metres from primary street boundary, below the required 4.5 metres for a garage. Applicant sought approval for reduced setback citing security concerns due to proximity to train station and pedestrian traffic.

motions.title: Lot 23 Tower Street - Proposed carport approval
motions.description: Application for building approval to construct an open sided carport at Lot 23 (No. 157) Tower Street, West Leederville. The carport is set back 0.5 metres from primary street boundary, with requested variations for reduced setback and open space. Adjoining neighbour has no objections.

motions.title: Lot 497 Joseph Street - Retrospective approval gatehouse and garage
motions.description: Application for retrospective approval of unauthorised development including solid street fence, gatehouse and carport at Lot 497 (No. 18) Joseph Street, West Leederville. Development was constructed with unauthorised variations to approved plans. Developer was previously convicted and fined $10,000. Order served for removal but appeal lodged with Minister.

motions.title: Lot 419 Alderbury Street - Secondary street fence approval
motions.description: Application for building approval to construct a picket fence 1.5 metres in height along secondary street boundary. Fence constructed on retained ground, resulting in total height of 2.3 metres from footpath level. Minor visual permeability variation from guidelines. Applicant noted this replaces existing fence which was longer and higher.

motions.title: Lot 384 Oceanic Drive - Consulting room sign refusal
motions.description: Application for planning approval to erect a sign to advertise consulting rooms. Sign measures 1.1 metres by 0.5 metres (0.5 square metres). Town Planning Scheme permits signs up to 0.2 square metres as of right in residential areas. Council previously approved additional consulting room but required removal of non-complying signage.

motions.title: Lot 4 Cambridge Street - Satellite dish removal requirement
motions.description: Unauthorised satellite dishes at Lot 4 Strata Lot 2 and 6 (Units 2 and 6 No.219-223) Cambridge Street, Wembley. Correspondence sent 18 March 1998 requiring removal within 28 days or application for approval. No application received, dish remains in place. Town Planning Scheme Policy Manual requires approval for satellite dishes greater than 1.0 metre.

motions.title: Local Government Act Notice - House number placement
motions.description: Confirmation of action by Chief Executive Officer in serving Local Government Act Notice on [private individual — name withheld] requiring correct house number on new dwelling at rear of 43 Barrett Street, Wembley. New house fronts Gregory Street. Incorrect number '2' was causing confusion with adjacent doctors surgery at 10 Gregory Street. CEO offered options of 43B Barrett Street or 10A Gregory Street.

motions.title: Asbestos disposal subsidy proposal
motions.description: Proposal to provide financial subsidy to promote safe disposal of products containing asbestos. Community Needs Survey recommended review of asbestos removal policy and report on options to subsidise removal. Annual Asbestos and Poisons Collection Days have shown small number of residents need to dispose of asbestos products. Environmental Health Officers dealt with 13 complaints about illegal dumping in past 33 months.

motions.title: Residential Design Guidelines - Final adoption of modifications
motions.description: Final approval of minor amendments to Residential Design Guidelines. Guidelines originally adopted in August 1998, with minor modifications adopted in February 1999 to enhance effectiveness and correct omissions. Draft modifications advertised for 28 days per Town Planning Scheme requirements.

motions.title: Review Local Law 43 Ancillary Accommodation provisions
motions.description: Review of existing policy and provisions of Local Law 43 in respect of Ancillary Accommodation to allow for this form of development with appropriate contemporary standards.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme amendment for dual coding R12.5/17.5
motions.description: Preparation of detailed Town Planning Scheme amendment based on principles outlined in the report to allow for dual coding within existing R12.5 areas of R12.5/17.5.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme amendment for grouped dwellings
motions.description: Preparation of detailed Town Planning Scheme amendment to allow for specifically designed aged persons grouped dwellings as discretionary uses in R12.5 areas.

motions.title: Adopt Wembley Town Centre Planning Study
motions.description: Final adoption of the Wembley Town Centre Planning Study and endorsement of recommendations including traffic, streetscape and green space provisions, with budget allocation for stage 1 implementation.

motions.title: Receive delegated decisions and notifications report
motions.description: Receipt of report relating to delegated decisions and notifications dealt with under delegated authority for the period ending 30 April 1999.

motions.title: Receive building licences report
motions.description: Receipt of Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for April 1999, with comparative statistics.

motions.title: Purchase of Mayoral Vehicle
motions.description: Proposal to purchase a Ford Fairlane Sedan mayoral vehicle for use by the Mayor to facilitate promotion and representation of the Town, at cost of $39,146 funded from Plant Replacement Reserve.

motions.title: Allow Mayor to participate in discussion and vote
motions.description: Motion under Section 5.68 of the Local Government Act 1995 to allow the Mayor to return to the meeting, participate in discussion and vote on the mayoral vehicle matter despite declared interest.

motions.title: Receive nomination request for CEO Workplace Relations Advisory Panel
motions.description: Receive request for nomination of a CEO to the Workplace Relations Advisory Panel with terms commencing August 1999.

motions.title: Receive nomination request for Regional Development Commission
motions.description: Receive request for nomination of a Local Government Member to the Regional Development Commission with term commencing August 1999.

motions.title: Petition - Youth Support Programs Funding
motions.description: Petition containing 354 signatures requesting continued support for City Beach High School Chaplaincy and additional funding for Cambridge Youth Centre.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Ordinary Meeting of 28 June 2005 and Special Meeting of 11 July 2005.

motions.title: Roads to Recovery Federal Government Funding Program
motions.description: Continuation of Federal Government's Roads to Recovery (R2R) program for road funding allocations over four years from 1 July 2005 to 30 June 2009, with Cambridge allocation of $170,305 annually.

motions.title: Gayton Road - Extension of Shopping Centre Road Closure
motions.description: Closure and amalgamation of portion of Gayton Road adjacent to The Boulevard Shopping Centre (Lot 13) to facilitate redevelopment, approximately 534m² between Oban Road and Landra Gardens.

motions.title: Catesby Street Kerbside Parking Kapinara Primary School
motions.description: Review and amendment of kerbside parking restrictions in Catesby Street adjacent to Kapinara Primary School to establish 'kiss and drive' zone and 'No Stopping' areas.

motions.title: Policy No. 4.2.8 Vehicle Crossovers Specification Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to Vehicle Crossovers - Specification Policy to add clauses requiring neighbour notification where crossover extends over verge in front of neighbour's property and to improve crossover safety specifications in Harborne Street.

motions.title: Policy No. 4.2.23 Road Verges Development Maintenance Deferred
motions.description: Deferral of amendment to Road Verges - Development and Maintenance Policy to allow further consideration of alternate verge treatment to grass to support water wise initiatives.

motions.title: Policy No. 4.2.26 Parking Restrictions Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to Parking Restrictions Policy to incorporate kerbside parking guidelines for general, business/commercial/medical, and residential precinct areas, including new parking meter provisions.

motions.title: Tender No. 47-04 Supply and Delivery Irrigation Parts Equipment
motions.description: Award of tender for supply and delivery of irrigation parts and equipment for 22 months from 1 September 2005 to 30 June 2007, with expected annual expenditure of $100,000 to $110,000.

motions.title: Street Trees – Management of Unauthorised Planting/Removal
motions.description: Council considered procedures for managing unauthorised planting and removal of trees and shrubs on council verge areas, and measures to address non-conforming shrubs and damage to crossovers/driveways caused by verge trees.

motions.title: Payment of Allowances in Lieu of Reimbursement
motions.description: Council considered providing Elected Members with annual allowances for telecommunications and information technology expenses instead of reimbursing expenses on a case-by-case basis.

motions.title: Waste and Recycle 2005 Conference Attendance
motions.description: Council authorised attendance at the Waste and Recycle 2005 Conference to be held at The Esplanade Hotel, Fremantle from 23 to 26 August 2005.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Council confirmed payment of accounts for expenses incurred by the Town to fund its operation.

motions.title: Investment Schedule
motions.description: Council received the Investment Schedule as at 30 June 2005, detailing surplus funds invested, their distribution, and financial performance.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Council noted that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge was affixed to a Restrictive Covenant document for 135–139 Cambridge Street and corner Northwood Street, West Leederville.

motions.title: Cambridge Youth Consultation – Revocation and Endorsement
motions.description: Council revoked its previous decision of 28 June 2005 and received the 2003/2004 Youth Consultation project with recommendations adopted, excluding the recommendation for Youth Centre Saturday afternoon operations. Council requested further reports on implementation progress and investigation of altered weekday hours.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre Operations Report
motions.description: Receipt of the 2004/2005 operational report and direction to prepare a report on future management options for the facility.

motions.title: Classics in the Park Event Approval
motions.description: Approval of the Classics in the Park classic car event at Perry Lakes Reserve on 4 December 2005, subject to specified terms and conditions.

motions.title: Tender T38-04 Beach Inspection and Lifeguard Services
motions.description: Award of contract to Surf Life Saving WA for beach inspection and lifeguard services at City and Floreat Beaches for five years commencing 1 September 2005.

motions.title: Pat Goodridge Pavilion Lease to Wembley Athletic Club
motions.description: Offering an exclusive use lease of the Pat Goodridge Pavilion to Wembley Athletic Club (Cricket) for nine months commencing 1 October 2005.

motions.title: Games Village Commemorative Feature - Grant Funding
motions.description: Approval to seek grant funding from appropriate bodies for the detailed design and construction of a commemorative feature for the Games Village, using Concept 3 design.

motions.title: Change of Use - Motor Vehicle Sales at 140 Railway Parade, West Leederville
motions.description: Approval for change of use from showroom to motor vehicle sales premises with parking variation. Application by Glenn Smith.

motions.title: Retrospective Approval - Cabana and Deck at 7 Larundel Road, City Beach

motions.description: Endorsement of nine Federal and State Black Spot grant submissions for traffic safety projects at nine intersections, with investigation of Cambridge Street/Birkdale Street intersection for future applications.

motions.title: Kerbside Parking Restrictions - Station Street and Connolly Street

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre opening hours approval
motions.description: Review of winter opening hours at Bold Park Aquatic Centre following a trial period from May to October 2009. Patrons embraced earlier opening Monday-Friday winter hours and to a lesser degree earlier Saturday morning time slot. Net result of approximately $8,000 occurred.

motions.title: Cambridge Library entertainment DVD rental charges
motions.description: Decision on whether to introduce charges for hiring entertainment DVDs from Cambridge Library. Report assessed copyright restrictions, potential markets, library service directions, and financial implications. Copyright Act 1968 differentiates between lending and renting; current stock carries warning that hiring is prohibited. Research identified two Australian libraries (Wyndham and Geelong) which have ceased charging for DVD hire.

motions.title: Cambridge Library overdue loan fines introduction
motions.description: Proposal to introduce fines for overdue library loans at Cambridge Library effective 1 July 2010. Report notes that Western Australian libraries have historically not been strong advocates of fines, but trend to introduce overdue fines has emerged. Library Board identified eleven library systems currently charging penalties. Proposed fee structure: 20 cents per item per day commencing first day after due date, with $5.00 maximum charge per item.

motions.title: Delegated authority Christmas/New Year recess 2009/2010 noting
motions.description: Report noting action taken over the 2009/2010 Christmas/New Year recess in accordance with powers delegated to the Chief Executive Officer by Council on 22 December 2009. One item dealt with under delegated authority: Tender No. T19-09 for design, manufacture, supply, delivery and installation of shade sail structures at various Council Parks.

motions.title: Payment of accounts January 2010 confirmation
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts in accordance with the Local Government Act (Financial Management) Regulations. Report presents list of cheques raised and Electronic Funds Transfers for period 1 December 2009 to 31 January 2010.

motions.title: Investment Schedule January 2010 reception
motions.description: Report advising Council of amount of surplus funds invested, distribution of those funds and financial performance of each investment. Total investment at end of January 2010 is $24.64 million consisting of Municipal Funds of $8.28 million, Reserve Funds of $8.83 million and Endowment Lands Funds of $7.53 million. Weighted average interest rate is 5.31% compared to 90 day Bank Bill Index benchmark of 4.16%.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements January 2010 reception
motions.description: Review of financial position for period ended 31 January 2010 with comment on permanent and timing variances. Cash assets increased by $1.5 million mainly due to sale of two Ocean Mia land lots, totalling $24.5 million. Current receivables are $3.7 million.

motions.title: Mid year budget review 2009/2010 approval
motions.description: Review of budget and assessment of financial performance for six month period ended 31 December 2009. Statement of Financial Activity shows projected budget for year end indicates variation of -$108K. Main permanent variations affecting general purpose (Municipal) funding: Rates ($25,000), Municipal Interest ($200,000), Planning Fees $90,000. Golf course variations result in extra draw on Wembley Golf Course reserve of $34k.

motions.title: Lake Monger Reserve memorial project deferral
motions.description: Proposal for memorial at North Lake Monger to commemorate civilians killed in all wars. Allen Stenhouse (resident since 1919, WWII veteran) and Phillip Skelton (Deputy Warden of State War Memorial) submitted proposal. Memorial would be different from existing Perth memorials in that it focuses on civilians rather than service personnel. Administration recommendation for in principle support was voted on Committee Meeting 15 February 2010 and lost 1/4. Motion deferred for further consideration.

motions.title: Pat Goodridge Car Park – Dedicated Parking
motions.description: Proposal to set aside 180 bays of the Pat Goodridge car park for dedicated parking to commercial, government and not-for-profit organisations for one year at $1,000 per bay per annum.

motions.title: City Beach Oval Reserve – Optus Telecommunications Facility Lease

motions.title: Documents Sealed – Common Seal Affixations

motions.description: Delegation to Chief Executive Officer to award Tender T20-09 for the design, construction and installation of driving range netting at Wembley Golf Course, with additional funding from Endowment Lands Account.
