motions.description: Receipt and notation of items dealt with under delegated authority by the Chief Executive Officer during the Christmas/New Year recess, including approval of offer to purchase Lot 501 and West Leederville Sporting Association lights.

motions.title: Floreat Beach Kiosk Design Upgrade Budget Allocation
motions.description: Approval of unbudgeted expenditure for detailed design of upgrade works to Floreat Beach Kiosk and Public Toilets, later amended to include amount in Draft 2014/2015 Budget.

motions.title: Sale of Property for Bold Park Aquatic Centre Funding
motions.description: Delegation of authority to Chief Executive Officer to sell three residential lots (40 and 42 Dampier Avenue and Lot 11036 Keaney Place) by auction or private treaty to fund the Bold Park Aquatic Centre upgrade project shortfall.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts December and January 2013/2014
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts in accordance with the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996 for December 2013 and January 2014.

motions.title: Investment Schedule January 2014
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule and investment portfolio performance report for January 2014.

motions.title: Mid Year Review 2013/14
motions.description: Receipt of mid-year budget review with variances, project budget increase for Wembley Sports Park, and adjustment of reserve transfers and borrowing allocations.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements January 2014
motions.description: Receipt of financial statements for January 2014 including review of revenue, expenditure, capital works and variances against budget.

motions.title: Local Government Master Lending Agreement
motions.description: Execution of Master Lending Agreement with Western Australian Treasury Corporation to consolidate existing and future loan arrangements.

motions.title: Local Government Reform Cambridge/Subiaco Boundary
motions.description: Update on Local Government Reform and City of Subiaco's decision to lodge proposals to merge with City of Perth and amend boundaries. Town's proposal to merge Cambridge with Subiaco and parts of Stirling and Nedlands. Request to reaffirm Town's proposal and fund community awareness campaign.

motions.title: Provision of Sewerage for City Beach Residents
motions.description: Motion of notice submitted by Cr Bradley requesting CEO investigation and report on progress of sewerage extension for City Beach ratepayers, future steps, likely start date, and foreseeable delays.

motions.title: Petition Reception - Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre
motions.description: Petition containing 297 signatures submitted by Sue Cutler requesting approval for the Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre to operate from 29 Jukes Way until May 2007 and for Council to convene a Working Party of key stakeholders to identify ways for the Centre to continue its activities.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting held on 27 June 2006 and Special Meeting held on 7 July 2006.

motions.title: Birkdale Street - Kerbside Parking
motions.description: Review of kerbside parking restrictions on the western side of Birkdale Street, just south of Cambridge Street, as requested by the Thai Restaurant business. Proposal to convert parking bays to short-term parking to benefit the restaurant's customers.

motions.title: Woolwich Street - Kerbside Parking
motions.description: Review of kerbside parking restrictions in Woolwich Street from Northwood Street to Holyrood Street, following community survey with strong support for the proposal. Multiple parking restriction zones to be implemented.

motions.title: Northwood Street - Kerbside Parking
motions.description: Review of kerbside parking restrictions in Northwood Street from Cambridge Street to Railway Parade. Mixed commercial and residential section with community survey showing varied support. Multiple parking and no-stopping restrictions to be implemented.

motions.title: Kimberley Street - Kerbside Parking
motions.description: Review of kerbside parking restrictions in Kimberley Street from Railway Parade to Lake Monger Drive. Community survey showed over 65% support. Extensive parking restriction zones to be implemented including permit parking for residential properties and timed parking for commercial premises.

motions.title: West Leederville Traffic Management Review - July 2006
motions.description: Progress report on reconsideration of traffic measures at the intersection of Northwood Street and Cambridge Street. The originally proposed half seagull island design has been found impractical and alternatives are being considered, including two half seagull islands to manage accident reduction.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council Resource Recovery Facilities
motions.description: Council support for MRC waste management strategy including development of Resource Recovery Facilities to reduce reliance on landfill disposal at Tamala Park

motions.title: Adoption of Town of Cambridge Amendment Local Law 2006
motions.description: Final approval and adoption of amendment local law to reflect current practices, procedures, terminology and ensure compliance with National Competition Policy requirements

motions.title: Postal Voting Elections 2007
motions.description: Council approval for conducting the 2007 ordinary election using postal voting method and declaration of Electoral Commissioner as responsible for conducting the election

motions.title: Development of Crime Prevention Plan – Community Survey
motions.description: Approval to use a questionnaire as mechanism to gather community information on safety and crime issues, and subsequent report to Council with results of community survey, stakeholder meetings and crime statistics analysis

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts to fund Town operations in accordance with Local Government Financial Management Regulations

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at 30 June 2006 – Received
motions.description: The Investment Schedule provides details of performance of individual investments and a summary of investment performance against budget for 2005/2006.

motions.title: Financial Statements – Monthly Review May 2006 – Received
motions.description: Monthly financial statements and budget variance analysis for the period ended 31 May 2006, including statement of financial position, rate setting statement, operating statement, program expenditure, capital works, and aged debtors report.

motions.title: Documents Sealed – Noted
motions.description: Notification that the Common Seal of the Town has been affixed to documents including a Deed of Assignment and Variation for Floreat Shopping Centre Carpark and an Employment Contract for the Chief Executive Officer.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre – Report on Operations – Received
motions.description: Operational report for the Quarry Amphitheatre for the period July 2005 to June 2006, including financial performance, management details, bookings, marketing, asset management, and café operations. Includes approval for presentation of strategic plans.

motions.title: Henderson Park Baseball Diamond and Netting Proposal
motions.description: Endorsement in principle of baseball diamond and netting proposal for Henderson Park, with further investigation and consultation required.

motions.title: Tender T28-05 Demolition Award
motions.description: Award of tender for demolition of former City Beach Bowling Club and Scout Hall at Kalinda Drive/The Boulevard development site.

motions.title: Confirmation of Development and Environmental Services Committee Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Development and Environmental Services Committee meeting held 20 June 2006.

motions.title: Lot 62 Kimberley Street West Leederville Deferral
motions.description: Deferral of application for eight two storey grouped dwellings to enable applicant to review plan and improve solar access to private courtyards.

motions.title: Lot 62 Kimberley Street West Leederville Referral to Committee
motions.description: Referral of application back to Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration of access road location.

motions.title: Lot 62 Kimberley Street West Leederville Approval
motions.description: Approval of application for eight two storey grouped dwellings with conditions relating to setbacks, privacy, landscaping and fencing.

motions.title: Lot 183 Dartmouth Avenue City Beach Two Storey Dwelling Approval
motions.description: Approval of application for two storey dwelling with conditions on roofing material.

motions.title: Lot 47 Branksome Gardens Three Level Dwelling Withdrawn
motions.description: Application for three level dwelling withdrawn at request of applicant.

motions.title: Lot 309 Harborne Street Wembley Garage and Patio Approval
motions.description: Approval of application for garage and patio with conditions on finished floor levels.

motions.title: Motion to Refer Back DES06.127 Item
motions.description: Item relating to Lot 1784 (No.8) Dunkeld Street, Floreat to be referred back to the Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Original Motion on DES06.127
motions.description: Application for alterations and additions to existing dwelling at Lot 1784 (No. 8) Dunkeld Street, Floreat - refusal with conditions for amendment.

motions.title: Approval of Amended Plans DES06.127
motions.description: Application for additions, alterations and carport to existing single house at Lot 1784 (No.8) Dunkeld Street, Floreat - approval based on amended plans dated 21 July 2006.

motions.title: Approval of Additions, Alterations and Carport at Harborne Street
motions.description: Application for additions, alterations and carport to existing single house at Lot 288 (No.19) Harborne Street, Wembley, noting variations to side setbacks, privacy setbacks, and separation distance of the carport.

motions.title: Approval of Metal Outbuilding at Oceanic Drive
motions.description: Application for colourbond metal outbuilding (shed) at Lot 158 (No. 9) Oceanic Drive, Floreat with variations to Local Law 43 requirements.

motions.title: Approval of Second Storey Addition at Oakdale Street
motions.description: Application for second storey addition to existing dwelling at Lot 611 (No. 4) Oakdale Street, Floreat, noting variations to wall height.

motions.title: Refusal of Portico-Verandah Extension at Templetonia Crescent
motions.description: Application for portico and verandah extension at Lot 1 (No. 62) Templetonia Crescent, City Beach - refused due to non-compliance with secondary setback requirements.

motions.title: Approval of Workshop Shed at Orrel Avenue
motions.description: Application for colourbond steel workshop shed at Lot 278 (No. 39) Orrel Avenue, Floreat with variations to Local Law 43 requirements.

motions.title: Approval of Two Storey Dwelling at Salvado Road
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling at Lot 2 (No. 262A) Salvado Road, Floreat, noting variations to setbacks.

motions.title: Approval of Twenty Two Storey Grouped Dwellings at Herdsman Parade
motions.description: Application for twenty (20) two storey grouped dwellings at Lot 4 (No. 127) Herdsman Parade, Wembley, noting variations to dwelling density, minimum site area, open space, building height and side setback.

motions.title: Additions to dwelling at Herdsman Parade, Wembley
motions.description: Application by J Stirbinskis for additions to existing dwelling including garage door to existing carport at Lot 1 (No. 138A) Herdsman Parade, Wembley. Committee considered amendment to modify conditions regarding shed specifications.

motions.title: Three storey dwelling and swimming pool at Peasholm Street, City Beach
motions.description: Application by McDonald Jones Architects for three storey dwelling with swimming pool at Lot 138 (No. 11) Peasholm Street, City Beach. Proposal included multiple variations to R Codes setback, height, and privacy requirements. Community submissions objected to bulk, height, privacy impacts and retaining walls.

motions.title: Zincalume roof re-roofing at Mount Claremont
motions.description: Application by G Dufour and S MacPherson for approval of Zincalume Trimdek re-roofing at Lot 56 (No. 27) Rochdale Road, Mount Claremont. Application sought variation to Local Law 43 regarding roof reflectivity and pitch. Applicant argued material appropriate for heritage reasons and energy sustainability, consistent with 1963 original design.

motions.title: Proposals to amend Occupational Safety and Health Regulations regarding bonded asbestos removal
motions.description: Council received Discussion Paper from Department of Consumer and Employment Protection and Commission for Occupational Safety and Health proposing to amend bonded asbestos removal licensing threshold from 200 to 10 square metres. Committee requested investigation of additional control methods and education campaign.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme amendments 14 and 15 - Cambridge Street and Salvado Road, Wembley
motions.description: Amendments to rezone Lot 57 (No. 323) Cambridge Street from Residential R40/60 to Local Centre and permit additional use of car parking on Lot 4 (No. 134) Salvado Road. Activ Foundation proposes three level office building with two retail tenancies. Twelve submissions received with mixed support and opposition, particularly regarding car parking use and impact on adjoining properties.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications for planning matters
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority in June 2006. Two lot subdivision and two storey grouped dwelling approved. Five lot and three lot subdivisions referred to WAPC with refusal recommendation. One application for review lodged against Council decision regarding temporary approval for Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre.

motions.title: Building licences approved under delegated authority - June 2006
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data of building licences approved under delegated authority for June 2006. 39 building licences, 0 sign licences, 4 provisional building licences, and 5 demolition licences issued. Total value of construction $6,556,289.

motions.title: Change to Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre decision - extension of approval period
motions.description: Cr MacRae submitted motion of which notice was given to extend temporary approval for Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre from 6 months (ending 30 November 2006) to 12 months (ending 31 May 2007), and to establish a Jukes Way Working Group to address neighbouring concerns. Centre requires more time to secure alternative accommodation as investigations of potential sites were unsuccessful.

motions.title: Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre approval period amendment
motions.description: Motion to amend Council's 23 May 2006 decision on the continuation of operations of the Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre by extending the approval period from 6 months to 12 months and establishing a Jukes Way Working Group.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Underground Power Strategy report
motions.description: Motion requesting a report on the Underground Power Strategy including State Government program review, current project status in City Beach, and alternative funding strategies.

motions.title: Underground Power Strategy amendment to funding strategies
motions.description: Amendment to add additional funding sources to the Underground Power Strategy motion.

motions.title: Budget adoption 2006/2007
motions.description: Motion to adopt the budget for the year ending 30 June 2007, including general rates and charges, levying of rates, instalment options, incentive scheme, reserve transfers, CEO delegations, and additional budget items.

motions.title: Budget amendment - instalment dates and additional items
motions.description: Amendment to change instalment payment dates and add Perth Bicycle Network Grant, Main Roads Rehabilitation Grant, and Kapinara Pre Primary School items to the budget.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council Resource Recovery Facility Deed of Guarantee
motions.description: Motion to support and authorize signing of a Deed of Guarantee for the Mindarie Regional Council Resource Recovery Facility financial security requirements.

motions.title: Members on Leave of Absence - Cr K Smith
motions.description: Request for leave of absence for specified periods in April and May 1997.

motions.title: Confirmation of Special Meeting Minutes - 4 March 1997
motions.description: Confirmation of revised minutes from the Special Meeting held on 4 March 1997.

motions.title: Confirmation of Ordinary Meeting Minutes - 25 March 1997
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting held on 25 March 1997, with recorded amendment regarding Item DES97.52.

motions.title: Confirmation of Special Meeting Minutes - 15 April 1997
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Special Meeting held on 15 April 1997.

motions.title: Local Area Traffic Management - West Leederville referral
motions.description: Report on Local Area Traffic Management in the West Leederville area bounded by Southport/Cambridge/Harborne and Lake Monger Drive. Community survey conducted, concerns raised about entry statements and locations. Matter referred back to Committee for further consideration following council discussion.

motions.title: Huddleston Road Mount Claremont - Closure continuation
motions.description: Road closure continuation in accordance with Local Government Act 1995 Section 3.50. Previous closure in 1995, requires annual re-advertisement. Council supports continuing closure and advises WAMA that renewal process is unnecessary.

motions.title: Council Carpark Pay to Park System Trial - Referral
motions.description: Trial of pay-to-park system at Cambridge Street, West Leederville carpark. Analysis of data collected February-April 1997 shows low usage (average $16/day) but some relocation of vehicles to surrounding streets. Amendment proposed to limit payment hours. Matter referred back to Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Abbotsford Street West Leederville - No Verge Parking Restriction
motions.description: No verge parking restriction imposed on eastern side of Abbotsford Street to protect verge from vehicular damage. Property owner requested protection due to vehicles parking all day and causing damage to reticulation system.

motions.title: Black Spot Funding - Federal Grants Application
motions.description: Federal Government grants for road safety improvements at sites with accident history. Multiple intersections qualify. Council supports application for Herdsman Parade and Selby Street intersection upgrade, estimated cost $50,000.

motions.title: Fix Australia Fix the Roads Campaign - Donation
motions.description: Campaign supported by WAMA seeking increased fuel excise allocation to roads. Council previously approved $500 in 1996. Further contribution approved with funds charged to Members of Council Subscriptions.

motions.title: Beecroft Park - Facilities Community Project
motions.description: City Beach Lions Club community service project to install barbecue tables and bench seats at Beecroft Park. Council approval for materials cost up to $800 with quality control and community notification conditions.

motions.title: Floreat Croquet Club - Retaining Wall Replacement
motions.description: Retaining wall at Floreat Croquet Club is unsafe and requires demolition and replacement. Estimated cost $21,050-$29,050. Temporary fence erected for safety. Budget reallocation approved for urgent repairs.

motions.title: Budget 1996/97 - Equipment Replacement Funds Reallocation
motions.description: Equipment items stolen from Parks storage areas. Replacement items required: Boya Edger, Tanaka Whipper Snipper, Cylinder Mower, Toro Leaf Vacuum/Blower (total $4,032). Budget reallocation from Perry Lakes and Lake Monger rubbish bin projects.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Progress Report
motions.description: Project progressing to tender stage for construction. Routing approved by Council in November 1996. Consultant contract finalised. Tenders closing 21 April 1997 with recommendation to Council on 22 April 1997. Better Cities Program funding constraints require majority expenditure in 1996/97.

motions.title: Lake Monger Rehabilitation - Progress Report
motions.description: Lake Monger Rehabilitation Project underway. Steering group established with project consultant David Kabay. Funding applications submitted to Swan Avon River Trust and National Heritage Trust. Design work in progress for earthworks and planting.

motions.title: Financial Statement Technical Services - February 1997
motions.description: Financial report for Technical Services as at end February 1997. Parks and Landscaping operating expenses exceed budget by $220,000 (including $33,000 depreciation and $45,000 approved over-expenditure). Other programs tracking toward balanced budget outcomes.

motions.title: Technical Services - Project Update
motions.description: Updated information on various technical services projects including Coastal Issues, Subiaco Redevelopment, Asset Management, Lake Monger, West Leederville Sewer Upgrade, and Garden Week 1997 scheduled for 12-20 April.

motions.title: Special Meeting of Council - 6 May 1997
motions.description: Special meeting to be held following half-council elections on 3 May 1997. Meeting will involve swearing-in of councillors, election of Deputy Mayor, appointment of committees, and appointment of council delegates and representatives to various external bodies and working groups.

motions.title: Special Meeting - Election of Deputy Mayor deferral
motions.description: Cr Johnston requested deferral of Deputy Mayor election due to anticipated absence from Special Meeting on 6 May 1997. Motion sought concurrence of Minister for Local Government to defer appointment.

motions.title: Special Meeting - Functions and Appointments
motions.description: Special Council Meeting scheduled for 6 May 1997 to perform swearing in of councillors, election of Deputy Mayor, appointment of committees and council delegates and representatives to various bodies.

motions.title: Development and Environmental Services Policies - Deletion and Amendment
motions.description: Review and amendment of Development and Environmental Services policies relating to planning, building and environmental health in compliance with Local Government Act 1995. Policies reviewed and amended as appropriate with remaining policies to be renumbered.

motions.title: Mayor and Councillors - Protocols and Procedures Manual Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to Protocols and Procedures Manual regarding retention of equipment by outgoing elected members, including facsimile/telephone answering machine and filing cabinet. Manual to be amended to reflect changes.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre Draft Strategic Plan Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of Draft Strategic Plan for Quarry Amphitheatre following Advisory Committee meetings in March 1997. Plan to guide preparation of documents for operation of the Quarry Amphitheatre.

motions.title: Meeting with Regional Parliamentary Representatives - Main Motion
motions.description: Invitation to Members of Parliament and Ministers to attend meeting with Council Elected Members at date to be determined following local government elections. Suitable refreshments to be provided.

motions.title: Meeting with Regional Parliamentary Representatives - Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to add Hon Minister for Sport and Recreation to list of invitees.

motions.title: Meeting with Regional Parliamentary Representatives - Amended Motion
motions.description: Amended motion inviting Members of Parliament, Ministers and Hon Minister for Sport and Recreation to meeting with Council Elected Members.

motions.title: Financial Statements - Receipt and Library Strategic Planning
motions.description: Receipt of Committee and Management Financial Statements for period ended 31 March 1997 and authorisation to prepare report on establishment of strategic planning exercise for Library and Information Services.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment - Confirmation
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - Receipt
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule as at 31 March 1997 detailing surplus funds invested, distribution, and financial performance of each investment.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - Notation
motions.description: Noting that Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to specified documents including Deed of Novation for Mitec Computer Systems and approval for Town Planning Scheme Amendment No. 2.

motions.title: Sport and Recreation Future Directions Discussion Paper - Receipt
motions.description: Receipt of WA Sport and Recreation Council discussion paper on Strategic Directions for Western Australia Sport and Recreation for next three years.

motions.title: Wembley Occasional Care Centre - Deferral of Consideration
motions.description: Deferral of consideration of options available for future service provision for Wembley Occasional Care Centre pending further information on program impacts, viability, and advertising strategies.

motions.title: Beach Inspection Service - Contract Extension
motions.description: Extension of contract for Beach Inspector/Lifeguard service provided by Surf Life Saving WA from 1 June to 31 August 1997 for winter months coverage, with review prior to 31 August 1997.

motions.title: After Hours Service - Rangers Continuation
motions.description: Continuation of after hours Rangers service in existing format with improved response to non-urgent calls on next working day and investigations into infringement notice procedures and parking law provisions.

motions.title: Street Parking - Parking Ombudsman Deferral
motions.description: Deferral of appointment of Councillor as Parking Ombudsman for issues relating to parking infringements in Subiaco Oval vicinity to 16 June 1997 meeting when football parking impacts will be more evident.

motions.title: Workers Compensation Insurance - Renewal
motions.description: Renewal of Workers Compensation Insurance with Municipal Workcare Scheme for 1997/98 financial period under same terms as previous two periods.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Expenditure Authorisation
motions.description: Authorisation of Council contribution of $80,000 for City to Sea Greenway Project from Area Improvement Reserve to be funded through Commonwealth Better Cities Program and Bikewest, with expenditure contingent on receipt of proportionate contributions.

motions.title: Erosion Control and Stormwater Conference - No Attendance
motions.description: Decision that no Elected Members be nominated to attend the Fifth Annual International Erosion Control Association and Stormwater Industry Association Conference in Brisbane, 9-12 September 1997.

motions.title: Pathways to Sustainability Conference Attendance
motions.description: Motion on whether to nominate Elected Members to attend the Pathways to Sustainability: Local Initiatives for Cities and Towns Conference to be held in Newcastle from 1 to 5 June 1997. Provision for conference attendance had been made in the 1996/97 Budget.

motions.title: 3 Dundalk Road, Floreat - Second Storey Additions Approval
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to 3 Dundalk Road, Floreat, including a portico, lobby, and second storey with two bedrooms, living area, walk-in robe and ensuite. A timber balcony and verandah to the front were proposed. Initially deferred, then modified plans submitted reducing verandah width from 2.1 metres to 1.5 metres and increasing proposed setback from 7.5 metres to 8.1 metres, with re-survey indicating setback of 8.22 to 9.02 metres.

motions.title: Lots 43-45 Cambridge Street, Wembley - Shops and Fast Food Outlet
motions.description: Application for two storey retail and office development with drive through fast food outlet on the site of a disused Caltex Service Station and operational car wash. Previous application in December 1996 was refused. Redesigned proposal addresses parking and loading requirements. Site inspection conducted 10 April 1997. Minister for Planning appeal upheld regarding previous application.

motions.title: Lot 2 Alderbury Street, Floreat - Three Grouped Dwellings Deferred
motions.description: Application for three grouped brick, render and tile dwellings to be constructed one behind the other, accessed via common driveway. Single storey, moderate sized dwellings with three bedrooms, two bathrooms and double garages. Similar application refused in December 1996. Resubmitted with minor modifications. WA Planning Commission granted preliminary approval for subdivision into two green title lots in February 1997. Application deferred pending finalisation of subdivision.

motions.title: 39 Kingsland Avenue, City Beach - Carport Side Wall Enclosure
motions.description: Application to enclose the southern wall of a recently constructed carport approved in June of the previous year. Carport was approved 2.5 metres from front boundary. Letter of objection received from neighbouring property owners at No. 41 Kingsland Avenue. Council approval required under Clause 2b of By-law No. 43 which allows variation of By-law provisions.

motions.title: 50 Kimberley Street, West Leederville - Home Occupation Approval
motions.description: Application to use one room of residence as office for security and enquiry agency. Previously approved in March 1995 but approval lapsed. Applicants unaware approval was temporary for twelve months. Room is 14 square metres. Equipment comprises telephone, facsimile, computer, photocopier and paper shredder. No client visits to residence; all contact at clients' premises. Only occasional staff or contractor visits.

motions.title: 86 St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville - Two Storey Houses Application Withdrawn
motions.description: Application for two 2 storey single houses. Proposed residences have plot ratio of 0.70:1.0 and 0.60:1.0 for houses A and B respectively, exceeding limit. Side and balcony setbacks do not comply with Residential Planning Codes. Preliminary subdivision approval granted by WA Planning Commission for two lots of 323 and 324 square metres. Existing cottage on site would be demolished. Application was withdrawn by applicant at Council Meeting 2 April 1997.

motions.title: 9 Kildare Road, Floreat - Front Setback Variation Single Storey
motions.description: Application for building approval for single storey residence with three bedrooms, two bathrooms and study. Front patio encroaches into setback area with proposed setback of 8.2 metres against required 9.0 metres under Endowment Lands By-Law No. 43. Garage proposed with parapet wall on side boundary. Adjoining landowners sighted plans and raised no objections.

motions.title: 189 Gregory Street, Wembley - Two Storey Residence Application Lost
motions.description: Application for two storey residence. Plot ratio of 0.53:1.0 exceeds limit of 0.4:1.0 by 86 square metres. Double garage set back 6 metres from primary street with nil setback on southern boundary. Adjoining neighbour indicated no objection to side setback variation. Committee Meeting 15 April 1997 - Cr MacRae requested to be recorded as voting against the motion. Motion was put and lost.

motions.title: 46 St Leonard's Avenue, West Leederville - Garage and Renovation Refusal
motions.description: Application for renovation and refurbishment of existing residence including bullnosed veranda, timber fretwork, new colorbond roof, double garage 1.8 metres from primary street alignment, and open view fence with limestone piers and wrought iron infill panels. Applicant cited precedent for similar developments. Adjoining property owners at No. 44 raised no objections. Council identified sight line concerns for vehicle and pedestrian safety.

motions.title: 70 Moray Avenue, Floreat - Two Lot Subdivision Non-Support
motions.description: Western Australian Planning Commission referred to Council for comment a proposed two lot green title subdivision. Existing single storey brick and tile house would be demolished. Lot of 1434 square metres proposed to be subdivided into two lots of 717 square metres each. Proposed corner lot has awkward configuration with rear boundary dimension of 8 metres. Subdivision 166 square metres short of required 1600 square metres to comply with average lot area requirement.

motions.title: 5 Callington Avenue, City Beach - Home Occupation Administration Office
motions.description: Application to use 13 square metre room of residence as administration office for health consultancy business addressing public health policy issues. Most work carried out in Canberra and other capital cities. No additional traffic expected as clients are interstate and WA-based clients would be visited by applicant. Communication mainly by telephone, email and fax. No storage necessary; nothing distributed from site.

motions.title: Lot 97 Oban Road City Beach - Consulting Rooms Extension
motions.description: Application for extension of existing consulting rooms at Lot 97, No. 1 Oban Road, City Beach to accommodate additional two consulting rooms. The land is currently occupied by a four room consulting room development and is proposed to be extended by approximately 50 square metres. Four submissions were received offering no objections.

motions.title: No. 79 Woolwich Street West Leederville - Church Demolition and Residential Development
motions.description: Applications for demolition of church hall, development of two single storey residences and three lot subdivision at heritage listed property. The site contains a brick and iron church and timber and iron church hall constructed around the turn of the century. Property is in Municipal Heritage Inventory with recommendation for State Heritage Register nomination.

motions.title: Lot 165 Cambridge Street Wembley - Consulting Room Extension
motions.description: Application for extension of existing consulting rooms at Lot 165, No. 210 Cambridge Street, Wembley. Land currently occupied by two room consulting room development proposed to be extended by approximately 55 square metres to accommodate additional consulting room and ancillary office space. No submissions received.

motions.title: Lot 302 Clune Avenue Wembley - Grouped Dwelling
motions.description: Application for rear two storey grouped dwelling at Lot 302 Clune Avenue (behind residence at 47 Lake Monger Drive), Wembley. Comprises four bedrooms, three bathrooms and a study. Proposed to be strata titled or retained as one lot.

motions.title: No. 16 Windarra Drive City Beach - Pool Shed Outbuilding
motions.description: Application for outbuilding (pool shed) constructed of rendered brick walls and tiled roof located at Tumut Road frontage of residence under construction. Structure would be visible above the boundary wall and would breach front setback provisions. Structure already under construction at time of refusal consideration.

motions.title: After Hours Service - Noise
motions.description: Report on Council's after hours noise complaint service policy. Comparative analysis with other local authorities. Survey shows Town of Cambridge provides superior service compared to most councils. Current policy includes response to registered complaints, amplified music at licensed premises, and specific noise issues.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Schedule of 31 building licences approved for the month of March 1997 with combined value of $2,202,164. Two preliminary building licences and three demolition licences also approved.

motions.title: Wembley Town Centre Planning Study
motions.description: Adoption of preliminary brief for Wembley Town Centre Planning Study, seeking consultant submissions, and budgeting for the project.

motions.title: Options for Acquisition of Public Open Space in Wembley Ward
motions.description: Council decision regarding approach to acquiring additional public open space in Wembley Ward, including rejection of resumption powers and consideration of community needs survey.

motions.title: Heritage Properties and Town Planning Scheme Inclusion
motions.description: Council decision to retain Municipal Heritage Inventory as non-statutory reference document pending further investigation, with review in 12 months and allocation of funds for conservation advice service.

motions.title: Expressions of Interest to Host Regional Coastal Facilitators
motions.description: Council decision to submit expression of interest to Ministry for Planning to host a Coastal Facilitator and to contact other local authorities for participation in regional initiative.

motions.title: Decision of the Minister for Planning on Draft Town Planning Scheme
motions.description: Receipt of notification that the Minister for Planning has granted conditional approval to the draft Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme.

motions.title: Home Occupations Workshop

The wall provides protection from noise and headlight glare from West Coast Highway and enhances security. Previous similar applications approved at other properties.

motions.description: Application for Extended Trading Permit (Area) at JB O'Reilly's Tavern, 99 Cambridge Street, West Leederville for Diageo Australia 250th Anniversary Guinness Celebration on 25 September 2009. Falls outside standard arrangements and requires Council approval. Event to utilise car park for additional 200 patrons.

motions.title: Support Directions 2031 spatial framework
motions.description: Council consideration of the Directions 2031 Draft Spatial Framework for Perth and Peel, a spatial framework setting the vision for future growth of the Perth and Peel region. The Town of Cambridge forms part of the central sub-region and will need to contribute towards accommodating targets of an additional 121,000 dwellings and an additional 147,000 jobs proposed for the sub-region.

motions.title: Draft State Planning Policy Activity Centres for Perth and Peel
motions.description: Council consideration of the Draft State Planning Policy – Activity Centres for Perth and Peel released for public consultation. The policy replaces previous State Planning Policy 4.2 Metropolitan Centres for Perth in guiding the planning and development of new and existing activity centres throughout the Perth and Peel region. Within Town of Cambridge, both Floreat Forum and West Leederville have been designated District Town Centre under the Draft Policy.

motions.title: Purchase of extra parking ticket machine for Salvado Road, Wembley
motions.description: Council approval for the purchase and installation of one extra parking ticket machine in Salvado Road, Wembley as a result of a reduction in the unit cost per ticket machine. Following a June 2009 Council decision to purchase 12 parking ticket machines for Oxford Close precinct, a revised quotation from Wilson Technology Solutions resulted in approximately 20% cost reduction. The assessment revealed that the section of on-street parking on the north side of Salvado Road is most suitable for ticket parking.

motions.title: Review of Town Planning Scheme Policy Manual
motions.description: Council adoption for advertising of amendments to the Town Planning Scheme Policy Manual. The policy manual has not been reviewed in its entirety since adoption in 1998. Changes proposed are primarily to tidy up the document, with grammatical corrections, format standardisation, and removal of outdated provisions. Some policy content amendments include changes to residential development policies, delegation of authority, and precinct planning policies.

motions.title: Electronic Billboard Sign - Lot 43 Cambridge Street refusal

Approximately 19 metres long and 6.5 metres high. Applicant AdBrands Media. Application assessed against Advertising Signs Policy which does not permit electronic billboard signs on private property. Proposal fails due to advertising third parties for commercial gain, dominating building, detracting from road safety, and adversely impacting streetscape and amenity. Main Roads WA advised proposal not acceptable from road safety perspective due to high crash rate, complex road alignments, location at intersection, and building height.

motions.title: Deferral of Electronic Billboard Sign application

Future subdivision layout considered in assessment. Amended plans submitted addressing roof pitch, street surveillance, visual privacy, and balcony screening.

motions.description: Planning application DV16.102 for a patio at No. 2A Marlow Street, Wembley. The application required assessment against rear setback design principles of the Residential Design Codes and one objection was received.
