motions.description: Committee considered administration recommendation to construct a coloured concrete path 2.5 metres wide on the west side of Meagher Drive. Members were not prepared to support the construction as it was considered unnecessary duplication and preferred to preserve landscaping in the area.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Estate parking plan - circulation for comment
motions.description: Perry Lakes Estate development is at advanced stage with most lots developed. Parking pressures are evident and Town prepared parking estate plan. Proposal to circulate plan to landowners for 2 week comment period and then finalise parking plan.

motions.title: Cambridge Street parking modifications - adopt restrictions
motions.description: Urban on Cambridge development nearing completion. PTA removed bus stop on north side of Cambridge Street between Alexander and Jersey Streets. Proposal to introduce additional parking in redundant bus zone area and modify restrictions on south side following committee amendment.

motions.title: Bus shelter management program - install shelter and annual funding
motions.description: Review of options for upgrading hardstands and shelters at various bus stops. Current funding level $30,000 per year adequate for maintenance but not for increasing number of shelters. New shelters cost $10,000-$15,000 each. PTA may provide 50% funding for shelters with 15+ daily boardings.

motions.title: Blackspot funding application - Cambridge Street/McKenzie Street
motions.description: Proposal to re-submit Black Spot funding application to Main Roads WA for Cambridge Street/McKenzie Street intersection which had 5 crashes in previous 5 years. Project involves installing pedestrian refuge island with benefit cost ratio of 2.01. Local government contribution required $6,000 with project estimate $18,000.

motions.title: Treescape Plan amendment - alternate large canopy verge trees
motions.description: Council approved Notice of Motion on 24 May 2016 allowing applications for alternate verge trees not listed in Town's Treescape Plan 2010-2020. Committee agreed one species per street and included all varieties of Corymbia Ficifolia and Poinciana. Amendment approved allowing property owners to choose variety by majority vote for entire street or where street exceeds 300 metres, between major intersections.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council meeting items - report received
motions.description: Report on items considered at Mindarie Regional Council meeting on 7 July 2016 including 2016/17 budget adoption with members' gate fee increase from $155 to $165 per tonne (6.5% increase) and capital budget program of $16,593,900.

motions.title: MRC Constitution amendments - support proposed changes
motions.description: MRC endorsed concept of Waste Precinct and requires constitutional amendments to enable it to enter contracts for waste treatment/disposal at facilities not owned/managed/controlled by MRC or outside the region. Proposed amendment to clauses 5.1(a) and 5.1(b) to include provision for waste delivery to alternative facilities by agreement.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Local Government and Public Property Local Law 2016 - Commencement
motions.description: Council to commence the law-making process for the Town of Cambridge Local Government and Public Property Local Law 2016, following review to modernise existing local laws and update legislative language requirements.

motions.title: 2017 Holi Festival of Colours Event - Approval
motions.description: Seeking Council support for the Indian Society of Western Australia to hold the 2017 Holi Festival of Colours event at Perry Lakes on Sunday 12 March 2017. The event was previously held at Lake Monger but 2016 attendance of approximately 5,000 people (compared to estimated 300) caused issues including inadequate parking, waste disposal, and facilities. Event is now subject to Category 2 event requirements.

motions.title: Wembley Sports Park Playground - Tender Rejection
motions.description: Motion to reject all tenders for the Wembley Sports Park Playground construction. Committee members expressed concerns regarding parking impact during netball season and requested further information on rubber softfall and maintenance costs.

motions.title: Wembley Sports Park Playground - Tender Award to Phase 3
motions.description: Following the rejection of the motion to reject all tenders, a subsequent motion to award the contract to Phase 3 Landscape Constructions for $556,025.15 plus GST for construction of the playground, picnic area and landscaping at Wembley Sports Park.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - June 2016
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts paid in June 2016 in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Cheque payments totalling $207,753.14 and electronic funds transfers totalling $12,018,523.81, for a total of $12,226,276.95.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - June 2016
motions.description: Receipt and noting of Investment Schedule as at 30 June 2016, reporting on Council funds invested with various financial institutions, including performance against budget and interest rate indicators.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - July 2016
motions.description: Noting of documents affixed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge, including Withdrawal of Caveat at 16 Omaroo Tce, City Beach and the Town of Cambridge Parking Local Law 2016.

motions.title: West Coast Sporting Association - Update Report
motions.description: Noting of report on the orderly winding up of the West Coast Sporting Association and the Town's agreements regarding debt write-off, voluntary winding up process, and future operating models for member clubs and Coastal Playgroup.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment 31 - Legal Action Report
motions.description: Noting of report regarding ongoing Supreme Court judicial review proceedings initiated by the Coast Ward Ratepayers Association against Council's decision to adopt Town Planning Scheme Amendment 31. Total legal costs to end of June 2016 were $136,365.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre Redevelopment - Pool Heating
motions.description: Authorization to implement supplemental heating system at Bold Park Aquatic Centre for the outdoor 50m pool. New budget of $120,000 approved to be funded from Endowment Lands Account and repaid from St John's Wood development proceeds. CEO authorized to commit single-source contract for tertiary heat pumps with installation capacity of 230 kW.

motions.title: Adoption of 2016/2017 Annual Budget
motions.description: Adoption of the draft annual budget for the year ending 30 June 2017, including operating budget, capital budget, reserve budget, endowment lands account budget, and cash flow budget, with associated rates and charges.

motions.title: Budget rate increase amendment to 2.5%
motions.description: Amendment to clause (ii)(a) to reflect an increase of no more than 2.5% overall increase on 2015/16 rates, with proposed budget savings of $573,000.

motions.title: Legal advice on JDAP extension of time for Vita development
motions.description: Request for legal advice from Moharich & Associates regarding whether the Metro West JDAP decision on 20 June 2016 to grant an extension of time to Georgiou Developments Pty Ltd was correct, specifically concerning the change to the Town's development framework for the Residential Interface Node in the West Leederville Precinct Policy.

motions.title: Bamford Lane traffic and access study
motions.description: Request for Administration to prepare a report regarding traffic and access issues in Bamford Lane associated with current and future development, considering options for the landowner ceding 1 metre of land or adjusting development controls to ensure continued rear access to properties fronting Oxford Close.

motions.title: Parking in lieu policy amendment
motions.description: Proposal to amend the parking in lieu policy to limit the 20% discount to properties within 250 metres of train stations or high-frequency bus services (every 15 minutes between 8am-6pm) and only for commercial enterprises suited to customers using public transport.

motions.title: Paved verges and traffic islands landscaping
motions.description: Request for CEO to instruct Director of Infrastructure to cease paving internal spaces on traffic islands and verges and instead plant large to medium trees interspersed with shrubs and woodchips where practicable, to improve streetscape and reduce heat island effect.

motions.title: Indian Coral tree investigation for verge planting
motions.description: Request for CEO to obtain a report from the Arbor Centre regarding the suitability of Indian Coral (Erythrina x Sykesii) trees as large canopy verge trees, specifically addressing limb failure predisposition and suitability for windy conditions.

motions.title: Temporary commercial parking permits trial
motions.description: Proposal for a three-month trial of a commercial parking permit system in areas with limited parking, allowing local businesses access to reduced-fee all-day parking in streets near their business at $10 per day, limited to 2 permits per business.

motions.title: Wembley Athletics Centre Playground - deferred/withdrawn
motions.description: Motion by Mayor Shannon to defer awarding the tender and investigate alternative sites (Perry Lakes or Lake Monger) for the playground construction, and to review design modifications to reduce maintenance costs.

motions.title: Leederville Station Pedestrian Bridge - withdrawn
motions.description: Motion by Mayor Shannon to undertake community consultation regarding amendments to the pedestrian bridge to Leederville station and surrounding area to provide access to Cambridge high street in West Leederville, and conduct a traffic assessment.

motions.title: Leave of Absence for Cr MacRae
motions.description: Application for leave of absence from 3 to 15 July 2000 inclusive

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting held on 23 May 2000

motions.title: Perth Metropolitan Transport Strategy
motions.description: Report on the status of development of the Perth Metropolitan Transport Strategy and introduction of a representative from the Department of Transport

motions.title: Black Spot Program 2000/2001 – The Boulevard/Grantham Street Traffic Management
motions.description: Establishment of a construction program for Federal Black Spot Program works on The Boulevard and Grantham Street in Floreat

motions.title: The Boulevard, Grantham Street, Howtree Place – Landscape
motions.description: Establishment of landscape plans for road works at specified locations including The Boulevard, Grantham Street, and Howtree Place

motions.title: Shenton Park Integrated Transport Study
motions.description: Update on progress of the Shenton Park Integrated Transport Study and briefing by Department of Transport and consultant Ove Arup

motions.title: Nicholson Road/Railway Road Intersection
motions.description: Council position on the proposal for additional right turning phase for traffic signals at Nicholson Road/Railway Road intersection in Subiaco

motions.title: Telecommunications Code of Practice
motions.description: Authorization for Chief Executive Officer to sign an Agreement with Telstra Corporation Ltd for notification prior to works within the Town

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment traffic monitoring report
motions.description: Report on monitoring program for traffic signals at Station Street/Salvado Road intersection and Harborne Street extension into Roberts Road, Subiaco.

motions.title: Railway Parade/Loftus Street signal phasing
motions.description: Support for right turn traffic signal phase for westbound traffic in Railway Parade to turn right into Loftus Street, requested by Department of Transport, Path Transit, and public to improve bus service efficiency.

motions.title: Branksome Gardens carpark negotiation with Botanic Gardens
motions.description: Negotiation with Botanic Gardens and Parks Authority for carpark development on western side of Challenger Parade; allocation of $45,000 from Endowment Lands Account for off-street carparking.

motions.title: Woolwich Street kerbside parking amendment
motions.description: Removal of one 15-minute parking bay on south side of Woolwich Street to permit extended parking in front of residential property.

motions.title: Cambridge Forum carpark directional signs approval
motions.description: Approval of Cambridge Forum directional signs; relocation of sign at Simper Street cul-de-sac to carpark property.

motions.title: Denton Street verge parking restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of 'No Verge Parking' restrictions on western side of Denton Street from Cambridge Street southwards.

motions.title: Cambridge Street kerbside parking restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of parking restrictions on northern side of Cambridge Street during winter Saturday Netball season.

motions.title: Herdsman Parade Road Improvement Grant application
motions.description: Support for City of Stirling Road Improvement Grant application for Herdsman Parade reconstruction from Dodd Street to Marlow Street, with conditions on design and $250,000 commitment over two years.

motions.title: Empire Avenue reconstruction – no contribution
motions.description: Town's position on City of Stirling request for contribution to Empire Avenue road works already completed without prior Council agreement.

motions.title: Tender No 34 – Floreat Beach landscape improvements
motions.description: Acceptance of tender from BLG Australia for Floreat Beach landscaping improvements; allocation of $800,000 from Endowment Lands Account.

motions.title: CEO delegated authority for sewerage tender
motions.description: Delegation of authority to Chief Executive Officer to accept tenders for sewerage disposal system for restaurant development at City Beach, with contract value limit of $120,000.

motions.title: Road Treatment Services – Tender 01-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and laying of asphalt, bitumen and pavement profiling services for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Six tenders received. Hotmix Pty Ltd provides most comprehensive range and competitive pricing.

motions.title: Drainage and Associated Products – Tender 03-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of drainage products including pipes, manhole liners, gully covers and concrete items for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Six tenders received from CSR Humes, Georgiou, Tyson, Ingal Civil Products and others.

motions.title: Concrete Supply and Delivery – Tender 04-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of concrete for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Three tenders received from BGC Concrete, Boral Concrete and CSR Readymix. BGC Concrete offers most competitive pricing for both standard and small loads.

motions.title: Cast-in-situ Concrete Paths and Footpaths – Tender 05-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for construction of cast-in-situ concrete dual use paths and footpaths for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Three tenders received. Westside Concrete Contractors is current contractor with proven performance and lowest prices.

motions.title: Plant Hire Services – Tender 06-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for hire of plant including trucks, backhoes, front end loaders, rollers and other equipment for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Nine tenders received. Recommendation to accept all tenders with first preference to lowest hourly hire rates due to competitive pricing and equipment availability issues.

motions.title: Sprinklers and UPVC Pressure Pipes – Tender 07-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of sprinklers, UPVC pressure pipes and ancillary irrigation equipment for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Three tenders received: Hugall & Hoile (current contractor), Total Eden, and Elliotts Irrigation.

motions.title: Crushed Limestone Supply and Delivery – Tender 08-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of crushed limestone for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Two tenders received. WA Limestone is current contractor with competitive pricing and satisfactory material specification.

motions.title: Irrigation Design and Contract Administration – Tender 10-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for consultancy services for automatic irrigation design and contract administration for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Five tenders received. Hydroscapes Australia is current contractor with lowest prices and excellent track record.

motions.title: Plant and Equipment Fleet Maintenance – Tender 13-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for plant and equipment fleet maintenance services Category B, C and D for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Two tenders received from TFM Engineering and McCoy. McCoy demonstrates greater expertise and lower routine service pricing.

motions.title: Extension of Annual Contracts to 30 June 2001
motions.description: Extension of thirteen existing contracts for procurement of services and materials for period 1 July 2000 to 30 June 2001 at same rates subject to up to 10% GST. Contracts relate to park irrigation, pumping units, irrigation bores, tree services, pest control, tree planting, signs, sand supply, kerbing, bus shelter repairs, bitumen sealant, and professional consultancy.

motions.title: Elections – Postal Voting 2001
motions.description: Seek approval to conduct ordinary election on 5 May 2001 using postal voting method. Electoral Commissioner to be declared responsible for conducting the election. Requires Special Majority decision.

motions.title: Council Policies – Deletion, Amendment, Retention or Adoption
motions.description: Review and approval of Council policies across Corporate and Customer Services, Development and Environmental Services, and Technical Services areas. Policies to be deleted, amended, retained or adopted as appropriate. Includes incorporation of Town Planning Scheme Policy Manual by reference.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts to pay for expenses incurred by the Town. Regulation 13 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996 requires a list of accounts to be prepared and presented to Council. Schedule of cheques from Municipal Account totalling $2,013,026.66.

motions.title: Investment Schedule
motions.description: Report advising Council of the amount of surplus funds invested and the distribution of those funds for the period ended 31 May 2000. Investment portfolio shows performance of 118.7% against budget of $749,000.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements
motions.description: Receipt of Financial Statements for the period ended 31 May 2000. Financial statements provide an indication of the Town's performance against budget.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Notification of documents sealed with the Common Seal of the Town between 11 May and 2 June 2000. Five documents sealed including Deed of Agreement with The Speech and Hearing Centre, Deed of Release for Charles Christian Garden Funds, Car Parking Licence, Lease of Sir Thomas Meagher Pavillion, and Town Planning Scheme Amendment.

motions.title: Sandakan War Memorial
motions.description: Council support for construction of Sandakan War Memorial to commemorate soldiers who died at Sandakan Prisoner of War Camp. Sandakan Association proposed construction at Floreat Rose Garden, estimated cost $15,000. Committee recommended plaque on existing West Leederville War Memorial instead.

motions.title: Community Garden
motions.description: Request from resident for establishment of Community Garden in Wembley Ward. Administration identified four possible sites including Lot 99 rear of Cambridge Gardens as most suitable. Proposal deferred to enable investigation of community support and commitment for three months.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre Tender – Plant and Filtration Equipment
motions.description: Tender evaluation for installation of new plant and filtration equipment, shade and wind structures at Bold Park Aquatic Centre. Three tenders received. Walter J Pratt Pty Ltd recommended at $594,620. Additional allocation of $50,000 from Endowment Lands Account required. Three month construction period with approximately two week pool closure approved.

motions.title: Arts and Cultural Advisory Committee Minutes
motions.description: Receipt of minutes from Arts and Cultural Advisory Committee meeting held Thursday 8 June 2000. Art Acquisition Fund allocation recommended for 2000/2001 Budget to replace artwork currently on loan from private gallery. Amount of $5,000 proposed.

motions.title: Crime Prevention Advisory Committee Minutes
motions.description: Receipt of minutes from Crime Prevention Advisory Committee meetings held Thursday 4 May 2000 and Thursday 25 May 2000.

motions.title: Disability Services Advisory Committee Minutes
motions.description: Receipt of minutes from Disability Services Advisory Committee meeting held Friday 28 April 2000.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre Kiosk Lease Release
motions.description: Request from kiosk lessees Jamie and Carol Vivian-Williams to be released from remaining lease term due to business viability issues and safety concerns related to harm minimisation obligations under liquor licence. Lease commenced October 1998 for three years at $4,680 per annum. Council agreed to release lessees and include kiosk operation in forthcoming Management contract tender.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre Management Contract Tender
motions.description: Approval of tender process for management of Quarry Amphitheatre including operation of QC's (Quarry Café), with selection criteria weighting determined.

motions.title: Subiaco Football Club Floreat Oval Training Venue Proposal Refused
motions.description: Request from Subiaco Football Club to use Floreat Oval as a training venue. Committee members expressed concerns about extended use and lighting proposals.

motions.title: Insurance Renewal 2000/2001 Approved
motions.description: Approval of Council Insurance Portfolio renewal for 2000/2001 financial period, including Workers' Compensation, Public Liability/Professional Indemnity and other commercial insurance classes. Total premium $298,225.

motions.title: Speech and Hearing Centre Lease Renewal Option Granted
motions.description: Grant of 21 year option of renewal to Speech and Hearing Centre for Deaf Children for Crown Reserve 34689, with review clause at expiration of first term.

motions.title: Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion Lease Referred Back to Committee
motions.description: Motion to refer back the surrender of lease by Junior Soccer Association of WA and proposed new lease with Athletica due to expression of interest by Soccer Administration of WA.

motions.title: Appointment of Authorised Officers Dog Act 1976
motions.description: Appointment of Jacqui Blaydes as authorised officer for dog registration and deletion of Neil Costello.

motions.title: Parking for Disabled Motorists ACROD Permits
motions.description: Amendment of parking policy to allow ACROD permit holders double the permitted parking time in time-restricted street kerbside areas.

motions.title: City Beach High School International School Application Recommendation for Refusal
motions.description: Application by Woods and Bagot for international school, student accommodation, theatre and office at City Beach High School, Reserve 29923. Committee voted to recommend refusal to Western Australian Planning Commission citing excessive intensity, duplication of facilities, change of use, and lack of public consultation.

motions.title: Take-away food outlet application - J Dickson, Lot 3 Cambridge Street
motions.description: Application for take-away food outlet/café with seating capacity for 20 persons. Planning merit exists but proposal does not comply with parking requirements of the Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme No.1, with a 9 bay parking shortfall. Council to advise applicant of non-approval unless amended plans provided deleting formal seating area.

motions.title: Home occupation (part time beauty salon) - Alec and Maureen Boddam-Whetham, Lot 237 Harborne Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for home occupation (part time beauty salon) at Lot 237 (No. 88) Harborne Street, Wembley. Use classified as 'AA' (discretionary) in residential zone. Applicant proposed operating Mondays-Fridays 10am-3pm with 2-3 clients per day. Committee refused the application due to vehicle access safety concerns at intersection and erosion of residential amenity from regular client visits.

motions.title: Two dwellings (two-storey) - A Rechichi, Lot 15 St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two two-storey dwellings at Lot 15 (No. 110) St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville on a 759 square metre lot. Applicant seeks to vary side setbacks under R Codes and variations to height, upper storey setback, and roof pitch under Residential Design Guidelines. Contemporary design with face brickwork and curved colorbond roof. Initial submission included three-storey housing but was revised following extensive consultation with neighbours to address concerns about visual impact.

motions.title: Two-storey dwelling refusal - West Court, Lot 19 Northwood Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two-storey dwelling at Lot 19 (No.80) Northwood Street, West Leederville. Applicant West Court seeks approval to vary upper storey front setback and ground floor side setback. Original motion to refuse lost. Foreshadowed alternative motion passed authorizing CEO to approve subject to amended plans incorporating modifications: development moved back 1 metre from front boundary and improved aspect to adjoining park.

motions.title: Two-storey dwelling - deferral and alternative approval - West Court, Lot 19 Northwood Street
motions.description: Foreshadowed alternative motion by Cr MacRae following original refusal motion. Applicant indicated willingness to move development back 1 metre from front boundary and improve aspect to adjoining park. Motion authorizes CEO to approve application subject to amended plans incorporating these modifications.

motions.title: Single dwelling (two-storey) - Oswald Homes, Lot 10 Alderbury Street, Floreat
motions.description: Application for single two-storey dwelling at Lot 10 (No. 76A) Alderbury Street, Floreat on 700 square metre lot. Applicant seeks discretion to vary wall height compliance standard from 6 metres to 6.4 metres under Residential Design Guidelines. Contemporary design with brick and render construction. Council recommends maximum wall height of 73 courses or finished floor level lowered by 0.4 metres to ensure compatibility with surrounding development.

motions.title: Two storey residence - Renowned Homes, Lot 86 Olinda Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Application for two-storey residence at Lot 86 (No.2) Olinda Avenue, corner Gayton Road, City Beach on 850 square metre lot. Applicant seeks variation to front setback requirement from 7.5 metres to 4.35 metres. Residence oriented towards park on Olinda Avenue. Absolute majority decision required due to Town Planning Scheme variation. Proposal meets performance criteria for setback variation.

motions.title: Two storey residence with undercroft - Milankov Designs, Lot 311 Kinkuna Way, City Beach
motions.description: Application for two-storey residence with undercroft at Lot 311 (No. 35) Kinkuna Way, City Beach on 769 square metre lot. Applicant seeks discretion for variations to upper storey setback (west), wall height, roof height, and raised floor levels. Design includes four car garage and multiple habitable spaces. Neighbouring property raised concerns regarding raised floor level impacts on privacy, overlooking, and boundary treatment.

motions.title: Milankov Designs Lot 219 Kinkuna Way application approval
motions.description: Planning application for residential development at Lot 219 (No. 35) Kinkuna Way, City Beach. Application was initially recommended for refusal due to floor level concerns, overlook risk, and non-compliance with setback requirements. Committee votes were equally divided on both refusal and approval motions. Presiding Member cast deciding votes against refusal, then in favour of approval.

motions.title: Lot 205 Linden Gardens Floreat application withdrawal
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing residence at Lot 205 (No. 30) Linden Gardens, Floreat. Non-compliance with side setback requirements (1.0 metre proposed vs 1.5 metre required). Adjoining neighbour objection received. Applicant requested withdrawal to bring proposal into compliance with Residential Planning Codes for approval under delegated authority.

motions.title: Lot 1015 Kintyre Crescent Floreat additions approval
motions.description: Application for additions to existing three-bedroom single storey residence at Lot 1015 (No. 12) Kintyre Crescent, Floreat. Variations sought to open space provision (48% proposed vs 55% required) and front setback for store (6.9 metres proposed vs 9 metres required). No neighbour objections.

motions.title: Lot 106 Lissadell Street Floreat carport recommendation
motions.description: Application for porch and double carport/garage at Lot 106 (No. 105) Lissadell Street, Floreat. Non-compliance with side setbacks (nil metres proposed vs 1 metre required) and front setback (4.9 metres proposed vs 9 metres required for garage). Officer recommendation against approval; Committee recommended refusal in present form but supported amended plans for open carport with piers on northern boundary. Delegated authority authorised to CEO to approve amended application.

motions.title: Lot 1 Evandale Street Floreat double garage refusal
motions.description: Application for double garage and storeroom within front setback area at Lot 1 (No. 29) Evandale Street, Floreat. Non-compliance with primary street setback (3.0 metres proposed vs 6 metres required) and side setback (nil proposed vs 1 metre required). No neighbour objections. Officer recommendation to refuse due to adverse impact on streetscape and non-compliance with design guidelines.

motions.title: Lot 333 Simon Place City Beach zincalume roof approval
motions.description: Application for new Zincalume roof to replace existing asbestos roof at Lot 333 (No. 3) Simon Place, City Beach. Non-compliance with Local Law 43 (zincalume has greater than 40% solar reflectivity). Roof pitch only 6 degrees, constituting 1 degree variation from threshold. Motion approved by absolute majority. During discussion, Cr Smith requested adjoining neighbours be consulted. Motion to refer back to committee for neighbour consultation was then carried.

motions.title: Lot 692 Dilali Road City Beach outbuilding refusal
motions.description: Application to amend approved building licence for gazebo at Lot 692 (No. 5) Dilali Road, City Beach. Original approval included 9 metre gazebo wall setback 1 metre with 0.96 metre section setback 1.5 metres. Amended plans seeking variation to set entire 9.96 metre wall at 1 metre setback due to changes in residence level. Neighbour strong objection citing visual impact, overlooking concerns, and blocking of light/air circulation to family room and study.

motions.title: Lot 1180 Dumfries Road Floreat colorbond shed approval
motions.description: Application for colorbond shed (green, 23.56 square metres, 2.4 metres height, 9 degree roof pitch) at Lot 1180 (No. 36) Dumfries Road, Floreat. Non-compliance with Local Law 43 (shed exceeds 12 square metre limit for metal outbuildings). Existing 12 square metre shed on site; total area 35.56 square metres. Not visible from street. Absolute majority required for discretion under Local Law 43.

motions.title: Lot 231 Gregory Street Wembley rear garage approval
motions.description: Application for single garage (4.7m x 5.7m, 26.79 square metres) accessed off 4.5 metre right of way at Lot 231 (No. 69) Gregory Street, Wembley. Non-compliance with open space (44% vs 50% required), manoeuvring distance from right of way (5.8 metres vs 6 metres required), and side setback (nil vs 1 metre required). Previous application (February 2000) for larger double garage refused. Reduced size garage now acceptable.

motions.title: Lot 1530 Dundalk Road Floreat front fence and gazebo recommendation
motions.description: Application for front fencing, gazebo and swimming pool in front setback area at Lot 1530 (No. 3) Dundalk Road, Floreat. Non-compliance with front fence height (ranges 1.8-2.8 metres vs maximum 1.8 metres) and visual permeability (55% open view vs required 80%). Filling and retaining approximately 1 metre proposed. Gazebo 2.2 metres height, 4 metres diameter. Officer concern about departing from 'Garden Suburb' principles. Motion not to approve in present form but to authorise CEO to approve amended plans with reduced wall height and additional open view panels.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions and notifications for May 2000. Delegated decisions included: carport door at 37 Woolwich Street West Leederville; grouped dwelling at 484 Cambridge Street West Leederville. No appeals lodged against Council decisions during May 2000. No appeals determined by Minister for Planning.

motions.title: Building licences approved under delegated authority
motions.description: Monthly statistics on building licences issued for May 2000. 52 building licences issued (45 in May 1999). Construction value $2,228,145 (down from $3,687,941 in May 1999). Year-to-date figures show 471 building licences (down from 549), $41,796,671 construction value (down from $47,597,416).

motions.title: Stephenson Highway MRS Reservation removal
motions.description: Town of Cambridge position on Department of Transport Review regarding removal of Stephenson Highway Primary Road reservation from the Metropolitan Region Scheme, and the connector road between Empire Avenue and Pearson Street.

motions.title: Amendment to Stephenson Highway motion
motions.description: Amendment to delete the second sentence of Clause (i)(b) relating to the connector road between Empire Avenue and Pearson Street.

motions.title: Leave of Absence - Mayor Anderton January 2006
motions.description: Request for leave of absence for Mayor Anderton for the month of January 2006.

motions.title: Petitions Received
motions.description: Two petitions received: one containing 146 signatures in support of proposed child care centre at 58 Reserve Street, Wembley; another containing 23 signatures requesting cancellation of approval for Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre at 29 Jukes Way, Wembley.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Ordinary Meeting held 22 November 2005 and Special Meeting held 24 November 2005.

motions.title: West Coast Highway Median – Landscape/Irrigation Review Deferred
motions.description: Review of existing landscape strategy and irrigation system in West Coast Highway median. Technical Services Committee recommended deferral to Technical Services Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Boulevard Landscape Strategy Review - Survey Endorsed
motions.description: Review of landscape strategy for The Boulevard. Workshop recommended survey of residents to seek comments on preferred street tree species between Floreat Avenue and Bold Park Drive.

motions.title: Cambridge Street kerbside parking restrictions
motions.description: Establishment of kerbside parking restrictions on Cambridge Street from Daglish Street to Harborne Street to improve traffic safety and reduce accidents.

motions.title: McCourt Street and Station Street kerbside parking restrictions
motions.description: Establishment of kerbside parking restrictions in McCourt Street and Station Street south of Cambridge Street based on community survey results supporting the proposed amendments.

motions.title: Cambridge Street/McCourt Street partial road closure - committee recommendation
motions.description: Partial road closure at the intersection of Cambridge Street and McCourt Street (north side) to prevent certain traffic movements and improve traffic safety.

motions.title: Cambridge Street/Kimberley Street/Northwood Street intersections deferral
motions.description: Deferral of partial road closure proposals at Cambridge Street/Kimberley Street and Cambridge Street/Northwood Street intersections to allow further discussions with Main Roads WA on design.

motions.title: Road resurfacing five year program 2006-2010
motions.description: Adoption of a five year road resurfacing program for budget years 2006/2007 to 2010/2011 based on ARRB assessment requiring approximately $1,130,000 annual expenditure to maintain road network condition.

motions.title: Footpaths and shared paths five year program
motions.description: Adoption of a five year program for upgrading the Town's footpath and shared path network based on condition assessment and community requests, with annual funding of approximately $310,000.

motions.title: Selby Street/The Boulevard Intersection Traffic Signal Review
motions.description: Review of traffic signal phasing, turning movements and traffic accidents at the Selby Street/The Boulevard intersection in Floreat to determine next stage for improving traffic safety.

motions.title: Beaches and Dunes Solar Power Lights Replacement
motions.description: Consideration of replacement of two vandalised solar power lights at beach car parks north of Floreat Beach with street lights to improve security and address vandalism issues.

motions.title: Tender T06-05 Fleet Maintenance Services Plant and Equipment
motions.description: Tender for provision of fleet maintenance services for plant and equipment for a thirty month period following expiry of existing contract with McCoy Mowers on 31 December 2005.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Reserve Weed Survey and Control Program
motions.description: Request from Perry Lakes Reserve Working Group to fund production of a weed survey and control program for Perry Lakes Reserve to commence removing non-native trees, shrubs and grasses from the reserve.

motions.title: Road Improvement Capital Works Program 2006/2007 to 2010/2011
motions.description: Review and upgrade of five year program for Town's road improvement capital works projects to assist with preparation of future design and draft budget preparation.

motions.title: Lake Monger Reserve Install Shade Shelter Petition
motions.description: Consideration of petition containing 110 signatures requesting installation of shade shelter over south western playground at Lake Monger Reserve to address hot play equipment and surfaces.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Reserve Working Group Terms of Reference Review
motions.description: Review of Perry Lakes Reserve Working Group's Terms of Reference to reflect current operation of the working group and provide guidance on running and conduct of meetings.

motions.title: Parks and landscape works programs 2006/2007
motions.description: Receipt of report on 21 major works programs managed within Parks and Landscape area of Technical Services and consideration of projects for inclusion in 2006/2007 Draft Budget totalling $1,067,000

motions.title: Tender T07-05 Supply and delivery of two trucks
motions.description: Acceptance of tender for replacement of two trucks used by Works and Engineering, both purchased in 1995 and now 10 years old. One truck fitted with hydraulic crane, one with side platform hoist. Tender advertised 12 November 2005, closed 29 November 2005. Four tenderers received: WA Hino Sales and Service, Major Motors (Isuzu), Skipper Trucks (Mitsubishi), Smith Broughton and Sons. Evaluation against compliance and qualitative criteria (experience 10%, fit for purpose 35%, value add 10%, pricing/whole of life costs 45%). WA Hino identified as best value tender.

motions.title: Enterprise Bargaining Agreement Municipal Employees 2005

Development of final stage of St John's Wood Estate subdivision and formalisation of Banksia Farm as bushland reserve. 29 submissions received during advertising with majority objecting, primarily regarding traffic/access impacts and loss of native vegetation.

motions.title: Bath Street Wembley Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of parking restrictions on Bath Street, Wembley following petition by 28 residents in March 2014 and community survey conducted in June-July 2014. Survey responses support proposed parking restrictions to address overflow from multi-residential developments in City of Stirling on opposite side of Herdsman Parade.

motions.title: Blackspot funding application approval
motions.description: Request to approve a Blackspot funding application to Main Roads WA for traffic signal modifications and installation of right turn pockets at the intersection of Grantham Street and Harborne Street, with funding consideration in the 2015/16 Budget and resident survey.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre Hospitality Contract award
motions.description: Award of RFT 20-14 for the Quarry Amphitheatre Hospitality Contract to manage the Quarry Café. The successful contractor will have sole responsibility for the liquor licence and will pay 10% of gross takings to the Town.

motions.title: Surf Club Building C lease award
motions.description: Award of lease for Commercial Building C (middle tenancy) at City Beach Surf Club development to a suitable hospitality operator. Details of the operator and lease terms are in a confidential attachment.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre redevelopment tender progress noted
motions.description: Progress report on tender assessment for Bold Park Aquatic Centre Redevelopment construction works. Five tenders received, assessment nearing completion with recommendation for August 2014 Council meeting.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Course hospitality EOI shortlist approval
motions.description: Approval of shortlist from Expressions of Interest for hospitality facilities at Wembley Golf Course. Two of five submissions to proceed to commercial negotiations phase.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Course business plan adoption
motions.description: Adoption of business plan for Hospitality Development at Wembley Golf Course prepared in accordance with section 3.59 of the Local Government Act. No public submissions received.

motions.title: Payment of accounts July 2014
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts paid in July 2014 in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, Regulation 13. Total payments: $19,347,748.62.

motions.title: Investment Schedule July 2014 received
motions.description: Monthly investment report for July 2014 showing portfolio performance and asset allocation. Total investments: $39.2 million with weighted average interest rate of 3.48%.

motions.title: 2013/2014 financial year end review received
motions.description: Year end financial review for 2013/2014 showing net cash surplus of $15k after accounting for operating revenues, expenditure, capital grants, capital expenditure and reserve transfers. Comprehensive analysis of variations against budget included.

motions.title: IP Telephony Solution tender not accepted
motions.description: Decision not to award tender RFT 07-14 for IP Telephony Solution as no tenders sufficiently met Town's requirements or tender conditions. Budget, technical specifications and requirements to be reviewed following Local Government reform announcement.

motions.title: Internal audit reports noted and endorsed
motions.description: Internal audit reports on Food Assessment and Follow Up of Completed Internal Audits 2010-2014. Food Assessment found no major areas of concern but identified areas for improved management control. Follow-up audits show six outstanding items from 2010-2014 period.

motions.title: Significant accounting policies for fair value implemented
motions.description: Implementation of amended Significant Accounting Policies for Property, Plant and Equipment to reflect fair value measurement following revaluation of land and buildings conducted by Griffin Valuation Advisory as at 1 January 2014.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre Redevelopment tender award
motions.description: Award of tender RFT 10-13 for main works and approval of total budget including construction, fees, headworks, public art and contingency.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Course Trail unbudgeted funding
motions.description: Request to approve unbudgeted expenditure of up to $20,000 for detail design and tender documentation for Wembley Golf Course Trail project, following successful grant award of $100,000 from Lotterywest/Department of Sport and Recreation.

motions.title: Wembley Town Centre Activity Centre Plan - preferred scenario adoption
motions.description: Adoption of preferred scenario for Wembley Town Centre development plan and authorization for consultants RPS Group to proceed to Part 2 detailed planning phase.

motions.title: Wembley Town Centre Activity Centre Plan - amendment to clause (ii)
motions.description: Amendment to clause (ii) of the motion to add consideration of overshadowing impacts on residential areas, traffic calming for Cambridge Street, and development principles for building setbacks.

motions.title: Surf Club Building external finish - revoke previous decision
motions.description: Revocation of previous Council decision regarding coloured concrete finish to surf club building facade, to revert to natural grey finish due to manufacturing, delivery and cost impacts.

motions.title: Retrospective approval - carport door refusal
motions.description: Refusal of retrospective planning application for carport door installation, with requirement for removal within 60 days.

motions.title: Leave of Absence for Cr Grinceri
motions.description: Request for leave of absence for 24 March 2015

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting of 16 December 2014

motions.title: Lot 800 Gayton Road City Beach - Shopping Centre Additions and Alterations
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing shopping centre at No. 31 Gayton Road, City Beach. Shopping centre was fire damaged in May 2014. Proposal includes general repairs, new toilet block, and wider internal walkway.

motions.title: DV15.1 Amendment - Deletion of Clause (v)
motions.description: Amendment to motion regarding parking bay requirements - proposed deletion of clause (v)

motions.title: DV15.1 Amendment - Deletion of 'to the satisfaction of Council'
motions.description: Amendment to modify clause (v) regarding carparking bay requirement by removing satisfaction condition

motions.title: DV15.1 Amendment - Additional Footnote on Toilet Location
motions.description: Amendment proposing additional footnote regarding preference for female toilet location on north side

motions.title: Closed Session Discussion on DV15.1
motions.description: Motion to discuss item behind closed doors in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(d) of the Local Government Act 1995

motions.title: Lot 500 Connaught Street West Leederville - Ten Multiple Dwellings
motions.description: Application for two storey development comprising ten multiple dwellings at No. 31 Connaught Street, West Leederville. Eighteen objections received during consultation. Application requires assessment against R-Codes design principles.

motions.title: Approve ten multiple dwellings at Lot 500 Connaught Street
motions.description: Application for ten multiple dwellings submitted by Harden Jones Architects at Lot 500 (Street No. 31) Connaught Street, West Leederville. Council approval required under Part 4 of Town Planning Scheme No. 1.

motions.title: Approve change of use to veterinary hospital at Lot 8 Oxford Close
motions.description: Application for change of use from 'Consulting Rooms' to 'Veterinary Hospital' at Lot 8 (No. 52) Oxford Close, West Leederville. The applicant proposes a veterinary hospital for the exclusive care of cats.

motions.title: Approve additions and alterations to office building at Lots 12 and 30 Rosslyn Street
motions.description: Application for two storey addition to rear of existing single storey office at No. 2 Rosslyn Street, West Leederville. The proposed second storey addition comprises upper floor office space and parking below accessed from Harms Lane.

motions.title: Approve change of use to medical consulting rooms at Lot 580 Grantham Street
motions.description: Application for change of use from 'Office' to 'Consulting Rooms' at No. 69 Grantham Street, corner Keane Street, Wembley. The applicant proposes converting the existing office to two medical consulting rooms specialising in travel vaccination and risk planning.

motions.title: Approve single storey dwelling at Lot 1 Cambridge Street, Floreat
motions.description: Application for single storey dwelling at No. 426A Cambridge Street, Floreat. The dwelling is a rammed earth construction with an open-air interior courtyard. The front lot is a survey strata battleaxe subdivision.

motions.title: Three storey dwelling at Lot 166 Talgarth Way, City Beach
motions.description: Application for a three storey dwelling as submitted by Palazzo Exclusive Homes Pty Ltd at Lot 166 (No. 38) Talgarth Way, City Beach. The proposal was assessed against the Residential Design Codes of Western Australia and required determination due to variations to setbacks, building height, and visual privacy provisions.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling with undercroft at Lot 1 Clune Avenue, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at No. 18C Clune Avenue, West Leederville. The proposal required Council determination due to assessment against building height design principles and an objection received from a rear neighbour regarding loss of views to Lake Monger.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling at Lot 123 Sudbury Way, City Beach
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling with flat roof, pool deck and alfresco area at the upper level at No. 28 Sudbury Way, City Beach. Required determination due to assessment against building height, setback, fill and visual privacy design principles, with objections received from adjoining properties.

motions.title: Third storey additions and alterations at Lot 44 Branksome Gardens, City Beach
motions.description: Application for third storey additions and alterations to existing single storey dwelling with undercroft garage, including expanded undercroft garage with home office, new third storey, landscaping/retaining walls and pool house within rear setback area at No. 23 Branksome Gardens, City Beach. Required determination due to variations to street setback, lot boundary setback, building height and garage setback design principles.

motions.title: Lot 170 Talgarth Way City Beach second storey addition
motions.description: Application for a second storey addition to an existing dwelling at Lot 170 (No. 46) Talgarth Way, City Beach. The plans show a second storey with balcony proposed above the central portion of the existing dwelling. The proposal requires assessment against building height design principles of the Residential Design Codes of WA and an objection was received during consultation.

motions.title: Lot 809 Turriff Road Floreat second storey additions
motions.description: Application for two storey additions and alterations to the existing dwelling at No. 1 Turriff Road, Floreat. The plans show the existing dwelling being modified with the addition of a second storey with a flat roof. The application requires assessment against building height and street setback design principles of the Residential Design Codes of WA.

motions.title: Lot 341 Tumut Road City Beach external staircases and balustrade
motions.description: Application for two external staircases for service access at No. 2 Tumut Road (formerly known as 240 Oceanic Boulevard). The plans show two external staircases attached to the north side of the dwelling. Service Steps 'B' lead to the lower terrace and Service Steps 'A' lead to a flat roof proposed to act as a service deck. The upper service deck is currently vacant except for balustrading and planters set back approximately 1 metre from the perimeter.

motions.title: Housing Options Scheme Amendment for Initiation
motions.description: Council has undertaken a Housing Options Study to explore opportunities for greater housing choice by preparing housing typology designs. An amendment to Town Planning Scheme No.1 (Scheme Amendment 31) has been prepared to implement four housing typologies: Manor House Apartment, Cambridge Street Apartments, corner lot developments with two grouped dwellings, and corner lot developments with three grouped dwellings.

motions.title: Wembley Town Centre Activity Centre Plan - endorsement for advertising
motions.description: The draft Wembley Town Centre Activity Centre Plan was presented for endorsement prior to public advertising. The plan guides long-term development of the Wembley Town Centre, including zoning changes, building height controls, land use provisions, and improved pedestrian connections.

motions.title: West Leederville Precinct Policy - Residential Interface Node adoption
motions.description: The revised West Leederville Precinct Policy introduces a new Residential Interface Node to provide more sensitive development controls at the interface between the West Leederville Activity Centre and adjoining lower density residential areas. The policy was advertised between 27 November and 22 December 2014 with 15 submissions received. The revised policy limits building heights in the Residential Interface Node to four storeys with buildings presenting as two storeys to adjoining residential properties.

motions.title: Scheme Amendment - Hospital Special Purposes
motions.description: Application to initiate a Scheme Amendment for an Additional Use 'Hospital Special Purposes' with ancillary uses at Lot 181 (No. 61-69) Cambridge Street, West Leederville (Abbotsford Private Hospital).

motions.title: Shenton Park Hospital Masterplan Response
motions.description: Response to Landcorp's draft Shenton Park Hospital Masterplan for public redevelopment of the former hospital site.

motions.title: Metropolitan West JDAP Nominations
motions.description: Nomination of local government members to the Metropolitan West Joint Development Assessment Panel, with current appointments expiring 26 April 2015.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for December 2014 and January 2015.

motions.title: Building Permits Report
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data of building permits approved under delegated authority for December 2014 and January 2015.

motions.title: CEO Delegated Authority on Submission
motions.description: Delegation to Chief Executive Officer to lodge a submission to the Minister for Planning regarding the Draft Planning and Development (Local Planning Scheme) Regulations 2014.

motions.title: Beach Access Paths Shower Facilities Proposal
motions.description: Review of beach access paths shower facilities proposal with new design plan and scope of works. Administration recommended endorsement of design and prioritised program for installation at six locations.

motions.title: Beach Access Paths Shower Facilities - Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to move path No 16 to 2015/2016 budget instead of path No 7

motions.title: Five Year Program Drainage
motions.description: Five year program for drainage improvements addressing flood issues identified from storms in 2010, 2011 and 2014. Program includes maintenance, CCTV inspection, pipe rehabilitation and network capacity improvements.

motions.title: Mabel Talbot Gross Pollutant Trap Contribution
motions.description: City of Subiaco seeking contribution from Town of Cambridge for gross pollutant trap installation in stormwater pipe draining Wembley area into Mabel Talbot Lake.

motions.title: Lowanna Way Reallocation of $111,000
motions.description: Reallocation of funds for resurfacing due to Sewer Infill Project conflict. Proposed to defer Lowanna Way resurfacing and reallocate funds to Camborne Avenue resurfacing.

motions.title: RFT 27-14 Perry Lakes Skate Park and Basketball Court Tender Award
motions.description: Tender award for design and construction services for expansion of Perry Lakes Skate Park and outdoor basketball court Stage 1.

motions.title: Surf Club Public Art Procurement
motions.description: Appointment of artist Anne Neil to design and procure public art for Surf Club Building and Commercial Development at City Beach.

motions.title: Surf Club Traffic and Parking - Fred Burton Expansion
motions.description: Endorsement of Fred Burton car park expansion proposal for community consultation and traffic calming measures on Challenger Parade.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - February 2015
motions.description: Notification of documents affixed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge.

motions.title: Annual General Meeting of Electors 2013/14 - Decisions
motions.description: Consideration of decisions made at the Annual General Meeting of Electors held on 16 December 2014.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - December 2014 and January 2015
motions.description: Schedule of accounts payment in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule January 2015
motions.description: Report on investment portfolio performance for January 2015, including interest earned and compliance with Investment Policy No. 3.2.5.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements January 2015
motions.description: Review of financial position for period ended 31 January 2015 showing year-to-date surplus of $14 million against budget of $10 million.

motions.title: Mid Year Budget Review 2014/2015
motions.description: Budget review conducted after considering changes in operating environment since beginning of financial year, forecasting financial impacts for remainder of year.

motions.title: Tamala Park Regional Council Meeting December 2014
motions.description: Report on items considered at the Tamala Park Regional Council Ordinary Meeting held on 11 December 2014, including business report, sales and financial performance, project forecast, and sponsorship policy.

motions.title: Henderson Park Improvement Facilities
motions.description: Installation of shade structure, barbecue and canteen facilities at Henderson Park following demolition of BJ Giles Hall to accommodate Wembley Junior Football Club and other users.

motions.title: Local Government Reform - State Government Announcement Not to Proceed
motions.description: Following poll results on 7 February 2015 defeating three proposed amalgamations, State Government put local government reform agenda on hold. Town to determine position on proposed merger with City of Subiaco.

motions.title: Review of Waste Management Policy
motions.description: Submission by Cr Bradley for CEO to initiate review of waste management policy, particularly waste management arrangements at multiple dwelling developments and similar locations.

motions.title: Confidential Reports – Behind Closed Doors
motions.description: Motion to regard matters as confidential in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995

motions.title: DV15.23 – Retrospective Approval Carport Door SAT Reconsideration
motions.description: Application for retrospective approval of a carport door; State Administrative Tribunal reconsideration matter. Council decision regarding Section 31(1) of the State Administrative Tribunal Act 2004 (WA) – advising the SAT that Council is not prepared to reconsider its decision to refuse the retrospective application.

motions.title: Meeting Reopened to Public
motions.description: Following confidential discussion of DV15.1, motion to reopen the meeting to the public. Item DV15.1 – Lot 800 (No.31) Gayton Road, City Beach – Proposed Additions and Alterations to Shopping Centre was discussed behind closed doors but no vote outcome was recorded in the minutes.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 26 November 1996, with amendments to voting records on two items.

motions.title: Technical Services Financial Statements Noted
motions.description: Information relating to financial statements for the period ending 31 October 1996 for Technical Services area.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Course Redevelopment Contract Variations Not Approved
motions.description: Consideration of variations to the GHD project management contract for Wembley Golf Complex redevelopment totalling $39,716, with recommendation that variations of $12,589 be approved.

motions.title: Dodd Street Road Widening Approved
motions.description: Road widening on the southern side of Dodd Street adjacent to Lake Monger Primary School to assist with kerbside parking and school access.

motions.title: Alexander Street Road Widening Approved
motions.description: Road widening on the western side of Alexander Street south of the cul-de-sac adjacent to Wembley Primary School to assist with parking and traffic flow.

motions.title: Alexander Street Parking Restrictions Imposed
motions.description: Proposed parking restrictions on Alexander Street adjacent to Wembley Primary School and Joan Watters Centre to manage school traffic and parking.

motions.title: Styne Road Parking Restrictions Imposed
motions.description: Proposed parking restrictions on Styne Road adjacent to Kapinara Primary School to manage school traffic and parking.

motions.title: Patonga Road Parking Restrictions Imposed
motions.description: Proposed parking restrictions on Patonga Road adjacent to City Beach Primary School to improve safety and manage school traffic.

motions.title: Annual Contracts Approved
motions.description: Approval of annual contracts for supply of goods and services to Parks and Landscape section, including broad acre mowing, reticulation equipment and supplies, maintenance, park furniture repairs, and beach cleaning.

motions.title: Jubilee Park and Henderson Park Non-Budgeted Works Approved
motions.description: Approval of bore and pump replacement and repair at Jubilee Park and Henderson Park at total cost of $45,000, funded by reductions in maintenance procedures, authorised as unbudgeted expenditure by absolute majority.

motions.title: Technical Services Project Update Received
motions.description: Report on updated information on range of projects associated with Technical Services business including coastal issues, Subiaco redevelopment, asset management, West Coast Highway, Roadwise, Lake Monger rehabilitation, Local Area Traffic Management, and City to Sea Greenway.

motions.title: Financial Statements Received
motions.description: Committee and Management Financial Statements for the period ended 30 November 1996.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment Approved
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule Received
motions.description: Investment Schedule as at 30 November 1996 showing performance of investment portfolio against budget.

motions.title: Documents Sealed Noted
motions.description: Documents sealed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge since 12 November 1996.

motions.title: Parking Facilities Local Law Amendment
motions.description: Revision of prescribed infringement notice format to accommodate new electronic infringement devices (Auto Cite units) and updated manual notice layout under the Parking Facilities Local Law.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council Rebate on Operational Surplus
motions.description: Transfer of rebate payments from Mindarie Regional Council (arising from operational surplus on refuse disposal) to the Waste Management Reserve, and correspondence to Minister regarding unequal distribution to City of Perth.

motions.title: Transfer of Records from City of Perth
motions.description: Support for Town of Vincent proposal to obtain copies of City of Perth archives and historical records relating to Town of Cambridge, contingent on Infrastructure funding from Minister for Local Government.

motions.title: Financial Assistance for Floreat Park Parish Book
motions.description: Application by Floreat Park Parish for financial assistance towards printing of 'Adventure in Faith' book on local church history. Recommendation to decline under policy due to retrospective nature but approve ex gratia donation.

motions.title: Sixth Annual National Hazardous Materials Conference
motions.description: Consideration of attendance by elected members at Sixth Annual National Hazardous Materials Conference to be held in Sydney from 24 to 26 February 1997, addressing new Hazardous Substances and Dangerous Goods Regulations.

motions.title: 1997 Annual Recreation Conference Attendance
motions.description: Approval for attendance by interested elected members at 1997 Annual Recreation Conference in Fremantle from 23 to 26 March 1997 at cost of $350 per attendee.

motions.title: Floreat Pre-Primary Centre Ground Lease Extension
motions.description: Enlargement of ground lease area at Floreat Pre-Primary Centre in Birkdale Street to accommodate full-time pre-primary education for five-year-old children from 1998. Site meeting proposed to consult with Education Department, school representatives, parents and community.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Fees Review
motions.description: Review and adoption of green fees and additional fees (driving range, club hire, buggies) at Wembley Golf Complex effective from 1 January 1997, adopting Option 2 pricing strategy with upper-end fees comparable to other metropolitan courses. Absolute majority required.

motions.title: Development and Environmental Services Financial Statements
motions.description: Financial statements for Development and Environmental Services for period ending 31 October 1996, noting over-expenditure on swimming pool inspections due to non-complying pools and legal action initiated.

motions.title: Three Grouped Dwellings at Alderbury Street Floreat
motions.description: Application for planning approval for three grouped brick, render and tile dwellings on Lot 2, No. 76 Alderbury Street, Floreat. Application refused due to non-compliance with Clause 52 of Town Planning Scheme limiting grouped dwellings to maximum of two per lot in residential areas, and conflict with recent decision to reduce density coding of South Floreat.

motions.title: Home Occupation (Travel Agent) at 41 Newry Street
motions.description: Assessment of home occupation approval for travel agent business at 41 Newry Street with one-year approval granted in March 1996. Concerns raised that business may be operating at greater scale and intensity than originally stated, operating as part of travel agent association. No evidence of breach found. Matter to be reconsidered at March 1997 renewal.

motions.title: Public Open Space Provision in Wembley Ward Study
motions.description: Comprehensive study identifying areas of Wembley Ward deficient in public open space using 400-metre catchment radius principle. Northern Wembley identified as key priority area with approximately 900 lots affected. Study recommends proceeding with land acquisition investigation, estimated cost $450,000 for pocket park in target area, with additional development and maintenance costs to follow.

motions.title: Engagement of Ken A Adam and Associates
motions.description: Shortlisting and selection of consultant to prepare Residential Design Guidelines following interview process. Consultant selected on basis of relevant experience in residential heritage design, infill and redevelopment projects, and local government background.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment Project - Report received
motions.description: Report on modifications made to Subiaco Redevelopment Town Planning Scheme following Minister for Planning approval and gazetting. Modifications address Council's earlier submission regarding residential density, Harborne Street extension, retail floorspace, car parking, and public open space.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment - Residential subdivision and greenway
motions.description: Proposed residential subdivision creating 189 lots (184 single dwelling, 5 group housing) and 2.583 ha public open space. Total dwelling yield approximately 206. Based on traditional street grid pattern with rear laneway access. Concerns raised regarding traffic impacts and requirement for SRA to contribute to traffic management costs.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions processed for month ending 30 November 1996. Nine items dealt with under delegated authority including dwelling additions, strata subdivisions, and other proposals deemed to comply with Town Planning Scheme and Council Policy. No appeals received or determined during November.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment No 2
motions.description: Amendment to Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme to introduce provisions enabling Council to formally adopt planning policies under the scheme. Necessary to give statutory authority to Residential Design Guidelines anticipated for completion May-June 1997. Amends clause 34(2AA) and adds new clause 164 (Planning Policies) based on Model Town Planning Scheme text.

motions.title: Consulting Room at 284 Cambridge Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for planning approval to use existing vacant shop premises as consulting room (chiropractic centre). Use classified as 'IP' (incidental) in Shopping S1 zone. No alterations other than internal partitioning proposed. Advertised for public comment with no submissions received. Vehicle parking requirement of 1 bay per 50 sq m (1 bay required for 66 sq m). Eight bays available at rear, shared with adjoining uses.

motions.title: Mechanical repairs workshop at Railway Parade
motions.description: Application for change of use from warehouse to mechanical repairs workshop at Tenancy Unit 7, 166 Railway Parade, West Leederville. 980 square metre tenancy within mixed commercial complex. Proposal rejected on grounds of incompatibility with adjoining residential zoned properties. Land abuts two residential unit developments zoned R60.

motions.title: Serviced apartments and document storage development
motions.description: Application for serviced residential apartments (36 units) and document storage facility at corner of Loftus and Cambridge Streets, West Leederville. Modified proposal following October 1996 deferral. Plot ratio reduced from 2.23:1 to 1.58:1. Height 4 levels above Loftus Street with basement. Building setbacks increased to 4.5m on Cambridge Street, 2.25m on Loftus Street. Vehicle parking 61 bays (5 bays short of requirement for 66 required). Application deferred for advertising and further consideration.

motions.title: Medical Suite at St Leonards Avenue
motions.description: Application for planning approval to use existing local shop premises as medical suite (laboratory, surgery, reception area) at corner of Cambridge Street and St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville. Use classified as 'SA' (requiring approval and advertising) in Residential R20 zone. Building previously approved for local shop use only. Advertising completed with four submissions received (2 objections, 1 support conditional, 1 objection from nearby doctor). Application refused on grounds of incompatibility with residential uses and traffic/parking concerns.

motions.title: Illuminated street name signs - submission held
motions.description: Submission by SJB Town Planners on behalf of Claude Neon for installation of 22 illuminated street name signs at key intersections (Railway Parade, Cambridge Street, Grantham Street, The Boulevard, Hale Road, Flynn Street). Signs to incorporate advertising to fund installation and operation. Council proposed to defer consideration pending resolution of other priorities. Claude Neon has installed similar signs in 73 councils nationally including 10 in Western Australia.

motions.title: Wembley Piazza Shopping Centre modification
motions.description: Application for modifications to 1995 planning approval (CP210/95) for refurbishment of Wembley Piazza Shopping Centre at 346-350 Cambridge Street, Wembley. Modified proposal reduces plot ratio from 2.23:1 to 1.58:1 through reduction of serviced apartments from 40 to 36 and reduction in document storage area. Parking provision 309 bays (128 basement, 181 ground level). Council expressed caution regarding future Wembley Hotel extensions.

motions.title: Shop, Office and Fast food outlet development - Wembley
motions.description: Application for planning approval for a shop, office and fast food outlet development at Lots 43, 44 and 45 Cambridge Street, Wembley. The proposal does not comply with parking and loading/unloading area provisions and the Council requires retail buildings to be constructed on the front boundary.

motions.title: 2 Two storey residences - Carlton Street, West Leederville - Refusal motion
motions.description: Application for 2 two storey residences at Lot 27, 6 Carlton Street, West Leederville. Committee recommended refusal due to bulk and scale, non-compliance with front setback provisions and Plot Ratio Policy. Motion for refusal was put and lost.

motions.title: 2 Two storey residences - Carlton Street - Approval motion
motions.description: Following amendment of plans dated 13 December 1996, amended motion for approval by delegated authority subject to front and rear balconies being in compliance with R Codes. This motion was put and lost.

motions.title: Delegated authority for Carlton Street residences matter
motions.description: Motion to authorize Development and Environmental Services Committee to deal with the Carlton Street residences matter under delegated powers.

motions.title: 2 Two storey residences - Blencowe Street - Refusal
motions.description: Application for 2 two storey residences at Lot 281, 73 Blencowe Street, Leederville. Committee recommended refusal due to bulk and scale exceeding Council's plot ratio policy. Motion carried.

motions.title: Two storey residence with undercroft garage - Yaringa Way - Approval
motions.description: Application for two storey residence with undercroft garage at Lot 56, 18 Yaringa Way, City Beach. Minor plot ratio variation of 0.44:1 against policy limit of 0.4:1. Approved by absolute majority.

motions.title: Two storey residence - Tintagel Court - Front setback variation approval
motions.description: Application for building licence for two storey residence at Lot 18, 13 Tintagel Court, City Beach. Minor front setback encroachment of garage approved by absolute majority.

motions.title: Colorbond garage - Jubilee Crescent - Refusal
motions.description: Application for colorbond garage at rear of existing residence at Lot 10, 11 Jubilee Crescent, City Beach. Exceeds maximum allowable size under By-law 43. Committee and Council recommended refusal.

motions.title: Colorbond garage - Pandora Drive - Refusal
motions.description: Application for colorbond garage at rear of existing residence at Lot 183, 65 Pandora Drive, City Beach. Exceeds maximum allowable size under By-law 43. Committee and Council recommended refusal.

motions.title: Carport and front fencing - Nanson Street - Refusal
motions.description: Application for brick and rendered carport with front fencing at Lot 1407, 108 Nanson Street, Wembley. Proposed carport at 2 metres from front boundary with solid front fence. Refusal recommended due to loss of visual permeability and blank streetscape presentation.

motions.title: Two storey residence - Meelah Road - Approval
motions.description: Application for two storey residence at Lot 2, 6 Meelah Road, City Beach. Plot ratio variation of 0.44:1 against policy limit of 0.4:1 and western side setback variation. Approved by absolute majority.

motions.title: Additions to two storey residence - Tate Street - Approval
motions.description: Application for additions to existing two storey residence at Lot 476, 26 Tate Street, West Leederville. Plot ratio variation of 0.51:1 against policy limit of 0.4:1 and minor side setback variation. Approved by absolute majority.

motions.title: Garage - Grantham Street, Floreat - Front setback variation approval
