motions.description: Application for revised preliminary building licence for a two storey residence addition at Lot 2 No 10 Clune Avenue, West Leederville, submitted by Summit Constructions on behalf of Mr and [private individual — name withheld], with variation to plot ratio.

motions.title: 3 Bernard Street two storey residence approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licence for a two storey residence at 3 Bernard Street, West Leederville, submitted by Kensington Design on behalf of [private individual — name withheld] and [private individual — name withheld], with variations to side setbacks.

motions.title: Lot 188 No 91 Grantham Street secondary street setback variation approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licence for a single storey two bedroom residence at No. 91 Grantham Street, Floreat, with variation to secondary street setback under Endowment Lands By-Law No. 43.

motions.title: Support for reinstatement of Cyclone Structural Testing Station funding
motions.description: Motion to request Federal funding reinstatement for the Cyclone Structural Testing Station at James Cook University, Townsville, and to seek support from the Western Australian Municipal Association.

motions.title: 437 Cambridge Street Floreat change of use Minister approval sought
motions.description: Application to seek approval from Minister for Planning to determine an application for change of use at 437 Cambridge Street, Floreat from residence and squash courts to office and residential units, under Clause 26(2) of Town Planning Scheme.

motions.title: 28 Kenmore Crescent two storey residence and secondary structure approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licence for a two storey residence and secondary structure (drawing studio) at 28 Kenmore Crescent, Floreat, with variations to primary street setback and secondary structure floor area.

motions.title: Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places consultation and adoption
motions.description: Motion to release the draft Town of Cambridge Municipal Heritage Inventory and Townscape Precinct Study for public comment and adoption as a non-statutory reference document.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Municipal Heritage Inventory adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the draft Town of Cambridge Municipal Heritage Inventory and Townscape Precinct study, with various provisions regarding entry into the Town Planning Scheme and the Heritage Council of WA's Register of Heritage Places.

motions.title: 368 Cambridge Street, Wembley - side setback condition
motions.description: Reconsideration of a side setback condition for four single storey grouped dwellings at Lot 395 (No.368) Cambridge Street, Wembley. The applicant sought rescission of the condition requiring a minimum 1 metre setback from the northern boundary, noting the adjoining landowner's written consent.

motions.title: Building licences approved under delegated authority
motions.description: Receipt of the schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for the month of November 1996. A total of 48 building licences with a combined value of $32,001,426 were approved, including a medical centre at St John of God Hospital. Four preliminary building licences and six demolition licences were also approved.

motions.title: Leave of Absence for Councillor Smith
motions.description: Application for leave of absence in accordance with Clause 2.9 of the Standing Orders.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting held on 26 June 2001.

motions.title: Boulevard/Grantham Street Roundabout – Street Lighting
motions.description: Review of street lighting design at The Boulevard/Grantham Street roundabout to assess conformity with Council's Street Lighting Policy. Residents raised concerns about excessive lighting levels.

motions.title: Grantham Street – Roadworks Median Island
motions.description: Establishment of design criteria for development of median island in Grantham Street from The Boulevard to Selby Street, including road widening and landscaping.

motions.title: Sewerage Infill Area 4A – Pumping Station Location
motions.description: Approval of proposed sewerage pump station location for Infill Area 4A in South City Beach, to be positioned adjacent to City Beach Tennis Club on reserved land.

motions.title: Traffic Signs and Devices for Road Works
motions.description: Notification of changes to requirements for erection of traffic signs and devices introduced by Main Roads WA and need for Council to establish procedures to comply with the Code of Practice.

motions.title: Cambridge Street Intersections – Public Notification for Black Spot Works
motions.description: Public notification requirement for proposed Black Spot works at intersections of Cambridge Street with Kimberley Street and Northwood Street to implement seagull islands.

motions.title: Cambridge Coastcare – City Beach Dune Restoration Stage 2
motions.description: Support for Cambridge Coastcare funding application for City Beach dune restoration stage 2 with Council contribution if application is approved.

motions.title: Tender 01 – Park Irrigation Systems Repairs
motions.description: Acceptance of tender for Park Irrigation Systems repairs to reticulation and associated electrical equipment for financial year 2001/2002.

motions.title: Tender 02 – Supply and Maintenance of Irrigation Pumping Units
motions.description: Acceptance of tender for supply and maintenance of irrigation pumping units within road reserves and parks for financial year 2001/2002.

motions.title: Tender 03 – Construction and Maintenance of Irrigation Bores
motions.description: Acceptance of tender for construction and maintenance of irrigation bores within road reserves and parks for financial year 2001/2002.

motions.title: Tender No 04-2001/2002 Street Tree Pruning Removal
motions.description: Annual tender for street tree pruning and removal works within road reserves and parks, including power line clearance, tree removals, stump removal/grinding, tree planting and arboricultural inspection reports. One submission received from Classic Tree Services.

motions.title: Tender No 05-2001/2002 Weed Pest Disease Control
motions.description: Annual tender for weed, pest and disease control in the Town including control of nominated weeds in kerbs, footpaths, garden beds and remnant bushland areas. Four submissions received. Turfmaster Facility Management recommended as successful tenderer.

motions.title: Tender No 06-2001/2002 Tree Watering Removal Prunings
motions.description: Annual tender for tree watering and removal of prunings from road reserves and parks. Works include watering trees after planting and follow-up watering in non-irrigated areas, plus removal of prunings by truck to holding area where they are converted to mulch. Three submissions received, all conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 07-2001/2002 Supply Erection Signs
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and erection of signs including street name signs, directional signs, parking signs, advisory signs and temporary traffic management signs. Five submissions received, all conforming. De Neefe Signs Pty Ltd identified as preferred contractor based on lowest price for majority of items.

motions.title: Tender No 09-2001/2002 Supply Delivery Sand
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of sand to the Town including supply to Council depot, supply to work sites, and option for Council to pickup sand from supplier's quarry. Current contract with Rocla Quarry Products. Two submissions received, both conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 10-2001/2002 Supply Laying Extruded Concrete Kerbing
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and laying of extruded concrete kerbing in association with budgeted roadworks and maintenance works. Current contract held by WA Kerbing, expired 30 June 2001. Four submissions received, all conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 12-2001/2002 Supply Laying Bitumen Crack Sealant
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and laying of bitumen crack sealant on roads within the Town. Cracks are sealed before laying new seal to reduce reflective cracking. Current contract held by Hotmix Pty Ltd, expired 30 June 2001. Four submissions received, all conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 13-2001/2002 Plant Fleet Maintenance Services
motions.description: Annual tender for maintenance of Council's truck and bus fleet including routine maintenance and service breakdowns. Current contract held by Major Motors, expired 30 June 2001. One conforming submission received.

motions.title: Tender No 14-2001/2002 Professional Consultancy Services
motions.description: Annual tender for professional consultancy services in engineering surveying, drafting, traffic management/design and landscape architecture design. Works include survey, drafting, design and landscaping associated with roadworks and development projects. Current contracts held jointly by Connell Wagner, BSD Consulting Engineers and Thompson Palmer Pty Ltd. Ten submissions received.

motions.title: Motion to Refer Back Tender 36 Light Vehicle Supply Maintenance
motions.description: Following further report and discussion at committee, Cr O'Connor moved that the tender regarding light vehicle supply and maintenance be referred back to the Technical Services Committee for preparation of revised light vehicle management strategies.

motions.title: Bulk Waste Verge Collection Service
motions.description: Consideration of tenders for bulk waste verge collection service. Five tenders were received. The administration recommended D&M Waste (an alternative proposal with lower cost), but the committee preferred to continue with the existing contractor Alvito to maintain current service.

motions.title: Review of Ward Boundaries and Representation
motions.description: Review of the Town's ward boundaries and representation in accordance with Schedule 2.2 of the Local Government Act 1995. The review must be undertaken once every eight years. The Town has been a local government in its own right for 7 years.

motions.title: Glendalough Boundary Realignment Proposal
motions.description: Council considers request from Jukes Way (Glendalough) Residents Committee to realign the local government boundary between the City of Stirling and the Town of Cambridge. The proposal seeks to transfer a small residential area (23 houses, 5 duplexes, 8 villas and townhouses, and 10 units) from Glendalough (City of Stirling) to Wembley (Town of Cambridge), with Jon Sanders Drive proposed as the new boundary.

motions.title: Withdrawal from WESROC Membership
motions.description: Proposal for the Town to withdraw as a participating Member of the Western Suburbs Regional Organisation of Councils (WESROC). The Town joined WESROC in September 2000 with a commitment to review membership after twelve months. After nine months of participation, no real benefits have accrued as a result of WESROC membership.

motions.title: Continuation of Current Committee Meeting System
motions.description: Council reviews the operation, efficiency and effectiveness of its current Committee meeting system (four standing committees meeting monthly with one monthly Council meeting). The administration proposed fortnightly Council meetings without committees, citing efficiency gains used by 16 of 29 metropolitan councils. During committee discussion on 10 July 2001, members did not support this change.

motions.title: Australia/New Zealand Planning Congress Attendance
motions.description: Council considers attendance at the inaugural joint Australia/New Zealand Planning Congress to be held in Wellington, New Zealand from 8 to 12 April 2002. The Congress theme is 'Impacts' covering governance, innovation, natural environment, and built environment. It is proposed that the Town's Executive Manager Development and Environmental Services attend.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for expenses incurred by the Town to fund its operation. Regulation 13 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996 requires a list of accounts to be prepared and presented to Council.

motions.title: Investment Schedule
motions.description: Report to advise Council of the amount of surplus funds invested, the distribution of those funds, and the financial performance of each investment (interest earned) for the period ended 30 June 2001. Performance exceeded budget targets: General 104.9%, Reserves 125.9%, Endowment Lands 121.6%, Total 116.7%.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Report on documents sealed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge. One document sealed on 5 July 2001: State Underground Power Program agreement between the Hon Minister for Energy and Western Power and the Town of Cambridge for North Wembley/West Leederville Underground Power Project (3 copies).

motions.title: Subiaco Floreat Cricket Club – Turf Wicket Maintenance
motions.description: Motion to request Subiaco Floreat Cricket Club to prepare a comprehensive business plan and to approve budget allocations for turf wicket installation and club facility relocation feasibility study.

motions.title: Review of Community Development Financial Assistance Policies
motions.description: Motion to adopt amended versions of three financial assistance policies for community organisations, local schools, and individual achievement.

motions.title: Cambridge Junior Triathlon Event Endorsement
motions.description: Motion to endorse the delivery and conduct of a Junior Triathlon event and to allocate additional budget funds for the event.

motions.title: Tender 38-2000/2001 – Cambridge Youth Centre Extension
motions.description: Motion to accept the alternative tender from Aspect Construction for design and construction of extension to Cambridge Youth Centre and to allocate additional budget for contingency.

motions.title: Crime Prevention Advisory Committee – Minutes Received
motions.description: Motion to receive the minutes of the Crime Prevention Advisory Committee meeting held on 14 June 2001.

motions.title: Arts and Cultural Advisory Committee – Minutes and Shakespeare Sculpture
motions.description: Motion to receive minutes of Arts and Cultural Advisory Committee and to approve purchase of Shakespeare face sculpture for Quarry Amphitheatre.

motions.title: Manager Library Services Conference Attendance
motions.description: Motion to authorise Manager Library Services to attend ALIA 5th Biennial Public Libraries National Conference in Melbourne and to approve associated costs.

motions.title: Sowilo Community School – Retrospective Planning Approval
motions.description: Motion to approve retrospective planning approval for secondary school use at Lot 5, No 52 Salvado Road, Wembley with condition on maximum student and staff numbers.

motions.title: Fortview Road, Mount Claremont – Two Storey Single House Withdrawn
motions.description: Motion to withdraw the application for a two storey dwelling at Lot 8 (No.41) Fortview Road, Mount Claremont from Council's consideration at the applicant's request.

motions.title: Lot 4 Bernard Street two storey dwelling approval
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling with variations to setback, side setbacks, rear setback and roof pitch requirements at Lot 4 Bernard Street, West Leederville, submitted by Riverstone Constructions.

motions.title: Lot 747 Peebles Road portico and upper storey addition approval
motions.description: Application for upper level addition and portico at Lot 747 (No. 61) Peebles Road, Floreat, seeking variation to building height provisions of Residential Design Guidelines.

motions.title: Lot 390 Catesby Street alterations and additions refusal
motions.description: Application for alterations and additions including rear addition, front addition with swimming pool and additional level at Lot 390 (No. 23) Catesby Street, City Beach, seeking variations to multiple requirements.

motions.title: Lot 204 Penryn Avenue carport approval
motions.description: Application for construction of carport with front setback variation at Lot 204 (No. 1) Penryn Avenue, corner Callington Street, City Beach.

motions.title: Lot 106 Poolya Road landscaping feature fence approval
motions.description: Application for construction of landscaping feature fence with height variation at Lot 106 (No. 8) Poolya Road, City Beach.

motions.title: Legal action against JAG Demolition Pty Ltd for unlicensed demolition
motions.description: Authorisation to initiate legal action against JAG Demolition Pty Ltd for illegal demolition of dwelling at 73 Simper Street, Wembley without a demolition licence.

motions.title: Floreat Forum appeal mediation outcome - motion lost then amended motion carried
motions.description: Motion to not support the outcome of mediation for Floreat Forum redevelopment appeal, followed by amended motion to support the outcome with additional clauses noting resident association remarks.

motions.title: Floreat Forum mediation outcome support - amended motion carried
motions.description: Motion to support outcome of mediation for Floreat Forum redevelopment appeal with amended clause noting Floreat Ratepayers Association remarks and Lend Lease position.

motions.title: WA Football Commission Additional Night Games Opposition
motions.description: Response to WA Football Commission submission for approval to conduct additional night fixtures at Subiaco Oval in years 2002-2005. Council considering whether to oppose or support based on public transport patronage levels.

motions.title: Holyrood Street Heritage Area Study Support and Implementation
motions.description: Council consideration of Holyrood Street Heritage Area study prepared by Considine and Griffiths Architects. Study includes detailed historic, built form and architectural survey of Holyrood Street, West Leederville and recommends conservation policies and design guidelines for the heritage area.

motions.title: Walls and Fences Design Guidelines Community Consultation
motions.description: Council consideration of whether to review provisions relating to walls and fences facing the street in Residential Design Guidelines. Motion to canvas community opinion on current guideline provisions relating to front walls and fences.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment - Subdivision Policy
motions.description: Amendment to Town Planning Scheme Policies 8.1 and 8.2 regarding subdivision in the R20 area of Wembley Precinct (P4), restricting side-by-side subdivision where alternative vehicular access is not available, and requiring parking to take up no more than 40% of lot frontage.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for June 2001 including subdivision, office, service industry, grouped dwelling, and fence approvals; notifications of appeals and decisions by Minister for Planning.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data on building licences issued in June 2001 including 38 building licences, 5 preliminary building licences, and 2 demolition licences with total construction value of $3,288,256.

motions.title: Review of Delegated Authority to Building Surveyor
motions.description: Review of delegation limits to the appointed Building Surveyor; promotion of Building Surveyor Mark Rubie to Senior Building Surveyor position with expanded authority to approve or refuse all building licence applications.

motions.title: Budget for the Year Ended 30 June 2002
motions.description: Adoption of 2001/2002 Budget with 9.9% gross rental rate increase, minimum rate increase from $442 to $486, and capital works increase of $533,000. Major items include $244,000 additional waste management costs and rates levied.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 25 October 2016
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 25 October 2016, with amendment to correct the figure for Amendment 31 legal fees in response to [private individual — name withheld] question.

motions.title: Second Storey Addition - West Leederville Primary School
motions.description: Application for second storey addition to library building for five new classrooms and staff room at West Leederville Primary School, Lot 302 (No. 58) Northwood Street, West Leederville. Referral from Department of Finance, Building Management and Works. Committee amendment added requirement for full contribution from Department of Education for parking and road network improvements.

motions.title: Chinese Massage and Consulting Room - Wembley
motions.description: Application for Chinese Massage and consulting room for acupuncture and cupping at Lot 2 (No. 228A) Cambridge Street, Wembley. Committee amended approval to acupuncture and cupping only, excluding massage, with 6-month approval period. Applicant certified as registered Chinese Medicine Practitioner with general registration as acupuncturist.

motions.title: Home Occupation - Health Coach - Referred Back
motions.description: Application for home occupation (health coach) at Lot 59 (No. 35) Evandale Street, Floreat, referred back from 25 October 2016 council meeting for consideration of reducing client numbers. Application involves fitness and nutrition coaching from front garage with multiple clients.

motions.title: Home occupation (health coach) approval
motions.description: Application for home occupation (health coach) submitted by Rachelle Teune at Lot 59 (No. 35) Evandale Street, Floreat. Applicant proposed reducing sessions from 9 to 6 hours per week with options for client parking, carpooling, and client number reduction.

motions.title: Three storey dwelling approval
motions.description: Application for a three storey dwelling at Lot 280 (No. 9) Callington Avenue, City Beach. Dwelling has multiple levels, flat roof, extensive glazing, rendered walls and cladding. Lower floor partly cut into site, garage not visible from street, top floor set well back. Applicant Karl Spargo Building Design. Multiple amended plans submitted to address design principles and neighbour concerns regarding building setbacks.

motions.title: Roofed deck application refused
motions.description: Application to construct a roof over previously approved open roof deck of two storey dwelling under construction at Lot 334 (No. 110) Branksome Gardens, City Beach. Original approval from 23 September 2014 with condition that no roof or cover be placed over roof deck. Proposal includes roof and window enclosure creating height variation and adverse impact on amenity of adjoining properties.

motions.title: Privacy screen and alterations approved
motions.description: Two retrospective applications for a two storey dwelling with undercroft under construction at Lot 379 (No. 40) Challenger Parade, City Beach. Applications for side boundary privacy screen (3 metre high steel frame with vertical timber slats) and modifications to upper floor privacy screening (extended to ceiling with window opening). Original approval from 23 April 2013 required privacy screen maximum 1.6 metres high with no opening.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling approved
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling at Lot 2 (No. 67a) St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville on rear existing survey strata lot with vehicle access from Tolano Lane. Modern design with nil setbacks at ground level to side boundaries and open space via internal courtyard. Amended plans submitted to address privacy concerns raised by adjoining property No. 65b.

motions.title: Grouped dwelling alterations approved
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to front dwelling in strata development at Strata Lot 1 of Lot 220 (No. 433A) Cambridge Street, Floreat. Plans show new vehicular access from Cambridge Street to double carport, fencing in front setback, and rear living/dining addition. Applicant Swell Homes. Amended plans submitted to reduce boundary wall height from 4.5-5.3 metres to 3.3 metres.

motions.title: Patio application referred back
motions.description: Application for a patio at Lot 374 (No. 74) Branksome Gardens, City Beach. Plans show 7.15 metre by 2.75 metre patio setback 0.2-0.47 metres from northern boundary. Applicant Glasshouse Conservatories. Administration recommended approval subject to setback increase to minimum 0.5 metres. Committee recommendation was to refuse. Item referred back to Development Committee.

motions.title: Lot 2 Salvado Road Floreat - Fencing Condition Clearance
motions.description: Request to satisfy planning condition requiring rear boundary fence to be increased to 2.1 metres in height. Applicant proposed powder-coated aluminium slats but administration did not support this option. Motion relates to approval of the proposed metal slats with conditions.

motions.title: Lot 3 Blencowe Street West Leederville - Reconsideration of Fence Conditions
motions.description: Request for reconsideration of conditions of planning approval for front fencing. Applicant requested removal of infill panel ratio requirement and truncation condition. Motion relates to support for deleting the truncation requirement.

motions.title: Closure of Pedestrian Access Way - Perry Lakes
motions.description: Request to close Pedestrian Access Way (Lot 8008) between Lot 232 Tomlinson Boulevard and Lot 233 Stadium Drive, Floreat. Edge Visionary Living seeks to purchase the PAW for amalgamation with adjoining lots. Motion proposes advertising the closure and imposing conditions including an easement and building setback requirements.

motions.title: Local Planning Strategy - Community Engagement Strategy Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of the Community Engagement Strategy prepared for the Local Planning Strategy preparation. Strategy outlines three-stage engagement approach: preliminary engagement (November 2016), detailed engagement (February-March 2017), and formal advertising (mid-2018).

motions.title: Wembley Activity Centre Plan consultation outcomes
motions.description: Report on progress with the Wembley Activity Centre Plan and outcomes of community consultation following advertising of the draft Detailed Plan

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Review Steering Committee Meeting Notes
motions.description: Meeting notes of the Town Planning Scheme Review Steering Committee held on 1 November 2016 to be noted by Council

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Private Property Local Law 2016 Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the proposed Town of Cambridge Private Property Local Law 2016 following public consultation period with no submissions received

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Trading in Public Places Local Law 2016 Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the proposed Town of Cambridge Trading in Public Places Local Law 2016 following public consultation period with no submissions received

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Animals Local Law 2016 Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the proposed Town of Cambridge Animals Local Law 2016 following public consultation period with no submissions received

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Health Local Law 2016 Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the proposed Town of Cambridge Health Local Law 2016 following public consultation period with no submissions received

motions.title: Waterwise Council Annual Endorsement and Water Efficiency Action Plan
motions.description: Approval of Waterwise Council endorsement and Water Efficiency Action Plan with goals for corporate and community water use reduction

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications - October 2016
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for October 2016 including development applications across City Beach, Mount Claremont, Floreat, Jolimont, Wembley and West Leederville

motions.title: Building Permits Approved Under Delegated Authority - October 2016
motions.description: Monthly statistics of building permits approved under delegated authority in October 2016 showing 86 total permits and construction value of $10,578,602

motions.title: Jubilee Reserve City Beach - Temporary Parking Arrangements Approval
motions.description: Approval of temporary overflow parking on Jubilee Reserve City Beach when temperature forecast exceeds 30°C and parking demand exceeds supply

motions.title: Abbotsford Street and Railway Parade West Leederville - Minor Parking Amendments
motions.description: Amendment of parking restrictions on three car-parking bays (two in Abbotsford Street and one in Railway Parade) from 1P to 1/4P to provide short-stay parking near Hylin café

motions.title: Kimberley Street Loading Zone Installation
motions.description: Installation of a loading zone (1/2P) on the west side of Kimberley Street immediately south of Cambridge Street to replace No Stopping zone and assist business activity

motions.title: Cambridge Street Gregory Street Black Spot Project
motions.description: Endorsement of plan E 303 16 02 for constructing Black Spot project with traffic island installation, parking bay redesignation, and budget allocation from parking in lieu funds reserve.

motions.title: Grantham Street Marlow Street Black Spot Project
motions.description: Endorsement of plan E 308 16 02 for constructing intersection islands and safety improvements at the intersection of Grantham and Marlow Streets.

motions.title: Laneway Upgrade Program 2017-18 to 2019-20
motions.description: Endorsement of draft laneway upgrading program and listing of three priority lanes (Clohessy Lane, Connor Lane, Edeson Lane) for inclusion in Draft 2017/18 Budget with allocated funding.

motions.title: Five Year Program Drainage - Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to motion to change the drainage improvement program years from 2017/18 to 2018/2019 start date.

motions.title: Five Year Program Drainage
motions.description: Endorsement of proposed Five Year Program for Drainage Improvement (2018/19 to 2021/22) and allocation of funding for 2017/18 drainage maintenance, inspection, rehabilitation, and network capacity improvements including McCourt Street underground sump.

motions.title: Indian Coral Trees (Erythrina x Sykesii) for Street Use
motions.description: Receipt and acceptance of Arbor Centre report on appropriateness of Indian Coral Trees for use as verge/street trees, with endorsement for consideration where requested in accordance with adopted criteria.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Garden Awards 2016
motions.description: Award of prizes in 2016 Garden Awards across four categories: Best Residential Front Garden, Best Water Wise Front Garden, Best Commercial/Group Housing Front Garden, and Best Street/Part Street.

motions.title: RFT31-16 Turf Maintenance Services - Tender Award
motions.description: Award of tender RFT31-16 for Provision of Turf Maintenance Services for three years commencing 1 December 2016 to Turfmaster with authorization for CEO to negotiate contract.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council Meetings Report
motions.description: Receipt of report on items considered at Mindarie Regional Council meetings on 1 September 2016 and 20 October 2016.

motions.title: Waste Local Law 2016 - Adoption
motions.description: To adopt the proposed Town of Cambridge Waste Local Law 2016 following public consultation. No submissions received from the general public during the consultation period closing 1 July 2016.

motions.title: Local Government and Public Property Local Law 2016 - Adoption
motions.description: To adopt the proposed Town of Cambridge Local Government and Public Property Local Law 2016, which will replace the law adopted on 24 April 2001. No submissions received from the general public during the consultation period closing 14 September 2016.

motions.title: Cambridge Bowling Club Five-A-Side Soccer - Sub-lease Approval
motions.description: To approve the Cambridge Bowling Club's sub-lease to Fox Football Fives Pty Ltd for a Five-A-Side soccer facility. Community consultation received 4 responses; all supported the competition but 2 residents requested reduced hours. Hours amended from 9.30am to 10.15pm to 9.30am to 9.30pm following consultation feedback.

motions.title: Expression of Interest 47-16 - Children's Theatre at Quarry Amphitheatre - Result Noted
motions.description: EOI process for provision of a children's theatre at the Quarry Amphitheatre (8 October to 31 October 2016) resulted in no written submissions. Constraints include limited venue availability and lack of heating.

motions.title: West City Church Nanson Street Christmas Party - Approval
motions.description: To approve the 2016 West City Church of Christ Nanson Street Christmas Party event on Sunday 18 December 2016. Expected attendance of approximately 2,000 people requiring Category 2 event status and council approval.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic - Small Pool Inflatable Hire Fee
motions.description: To adopt a new fee of $75 (ex GST) per hour for exclusive use of the small pool inflatable (suitable for ages 5-7 years) at Bold Park Aquatic Centre, effective from 5 December 2016. Requires statutory advertising under Local Government Act 1995 section 6.19.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic - Heating Study
motions.description: To approve unbudgeted expenditure of $50,000 for a scoping study into pool heating options at Bold Park Aquatic. Three existing 200 kW electric heat pumps are reaching end of service life. Study to be completed by end March 2017 to guide budget allocation in FY18 for construction works in summer 2017/2018.

motions.title: South City Beach Kiosk & Toilets - Future Use and Demolition
motions.description: To approve funding for demolition of the old South City Beach Kiosk and Toilet building following engineering assessment showing significant damage ($40,000), heritage recording ($5,000), and community consultation prior to demolition.

motions.title: Lake Monger Activity Plan - Community Engagement
motions.description: To endorse the draft Lake Monger Activity Plan for community engagement and approve the proposed engagement process. Community workshop held 29 June 2016 with approximately 30 participants. Elected member workshop held 5 October 2016. Consultation period proposed to extend through February 2017.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - 22 November 2016
motions.description: To note that documents have been affixed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge. Three documents listed: Professional Golfers Association Lease (25 Oct 2016), Kidsafe WA Public Art Notification (25 Oct 2016), and Mindarie Regional Council Deed of Variation (8 Nov 2016).

motions.title: Committee for Perth membership
motions.description: Administration recommended the Town of Cambridge become a Member of the Committee for Perth at a cost of $5,500 ex GST. The administration recommendation was voted upon and lost 0/5 at committee meeting on 14 November 2016.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - October 2016
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for October 2016 as required by Regulation 13 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - October 2016
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule as at 31 October 2016 showing investment portfolio performance and distribution across various financial institutions.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements, Review and Variances - October 2016
motions.description: Review of financial position for period ended 31 October 2016 including permanent and timing variances. Included capital works reallocations for South City Beach Toodyay Retaining Wall repairs and Perry Lakes South toilet block refurbishment.

motions.title: Internal Audit - IT General Controls, Cash, Wembley Golf Course Operations and Stocktake Audits
motions.description: Internal audit reports covering IT general controls, cash verification, Wembley Golf Course year end stocktake, administration operations, and follow up of outstanding audit issues from prior years.

The amendment allows manor homes and corner lot developments. Two heritage properties (Lot 3 No.6 and Lot 6 No.12 The Boulevard, Floreat) are to be excluded from qualifying for Additional Use 10.

motions.title: Scheme amendment rezoning Cambridge Street Wembley
motions.description: Application to initiate a Scheme Amendment to rezone a portion of Lot 8 (No 350) Cambridge Street, Wembley from 'Public Purpose (Car Park)' and 'Residential (R20)' to 'Local Centre' to facilitate mixed use redevelopment. The site includes the Cambridge Forum and a 296-space car park. Rezoning is proposed to enable development consistent with the draft Wembley District Centre Activity Plan.

motions.title: Policy 4.1.1 Allocation of Street Numbers review
motions.description: Review and update of Council's Development and Sustainability Policy 4.1.1 Allocation of Street Numbers to reflect the Australian Standard Rural and Urban addressing AS/NZS 4819:2011. The policy was due for biennial review in April 2014. Changes align street numbering for subdivided and strata titled properties with the Australian Standard and allow for allocation of street numbers for ancillary dwellings.

motions.title: Beach Users Forum Report 2015 and Beach Users Advisory Group
motions.description: Report on April 2015 Beach Users Forum with approximately 80 community members. Three main issues addressed: surfing and surf appliance restrictions at City Beach, kite surfing safety concerns, and designated bathing area location. Proposal to replace annual Beach Users Forum with a Beach Users Advisory Group meeting on quarterly basis.

motions.title: Clancy's Fish Bar liquor licence area extension
motions.description: Application by Clancy's Fish Bar to amend conditions of existing Extended Trading Permit (ETP) to extend the area where liquor can be sold to patrons not being served a meal. Currently permitted in 50% of licensed area; applicant seeks to extend to entire upper floor restaurant. No increase in patron limit (200 patrons) requested. No liquor-related incidents reported in past six years.

motions.title: Odyssea Beach Cafe Section 40 liquor licence application
motions.description: Application by proposed licensee of Odyssea Beach Café (Tenancy B, new City Beach commercial precinct) for Extended Trading Permit (ETP) to allow sale of liquor to patrons not eating a meal. Licence is for Restaurant with proposed ETP conditions limiting consumption without meal to restaurant and alfresco areas where meals are consumed, maximum 50% of building capacity.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications for July 2015
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for July 2015, including 30 development approvals across various suburbs (City Beach, Mount Claremont, Floreat, Wembley, West Leederville) and three subdivisions/amalgamations referred to WAPC. No applications for review were lodged or determined by SAT during the period.

motions.title: Fair Value Infrastructure Assets – Interim Report noted
motions.description: Third year of fair valuation of assets. Internal valuation of infrastructure assets conducted. Change from historical cost to fair value basis decreases Town's net assets by $10M (9%). Annual depreciation increases by $537,000 per annum. Valuation methodology independently reviewed by Griffin Valuation Services.

motions.title: Internal Audits – Property, Leases and Golf Course Stocktake noted and endorsed
motions.description: Internal audits performed on property and leases management process and year-end stocktake at Wembley Golf Course. Property and Leases audit concluded Town's Governance and Property Services complying with Local Government Act and Town policies. Stocktake was well supervised with proper segregation of duties.

motions.title: Risk Management Report and Policy Amendment

motions.description: Application for a deck and rear fence at Lot 155 (No. 33) Tarongo Way, City Beach. Proposed extension to an existing deck on the western side of the property and rear wall to screen pool.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment No. 18 - Medical Centre and Pharmacy Wembley
motions.description: Proposed amendment to Town Planning Scheme No.1 to add an additional use of 'Medical Centre and Pharmacy' for Lots 1 and 2 (Nos. 272 and 274) Cambridge Street, Wembley. The amendment was advertised and three submissions were received, none of which objected to the amendment.

motions.title: Lots 11, 10, 9 and 6 Truro Place - Restrictive Covenant Variation
motions.description: Request to vary restrictive covenant to allow modification of existing boundary fence by increasing height of limestone wall at rear boundary by 0.6 metres for four properties at 8, 10, 12 and 18 Truro Place, City Beach.

motions.title: WESROC Study of Landuse Patterns and Residential Densities
motions.description: Consideration and response to WESROC report on land use patterns and residential densities in the western suburbs including recommendations on housing choice and development opportunities.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications September 2008
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority during September 2008 and notifications of applications for review.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved September 2008
motions.description: Report of building and demolition licences approved under delegated authority for September 2008 with comparative data from previous year.

motions.title: Northwood Street/Woolwich Street - Kerbside Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Review of kerbside parking restrictions at request of West Leederville Primary School principal and school P&C in Northwood Street and Woolwich Street to address parking issues for kindergarten and pre-primary parent drop-off.

motions.title: Kavanagh Street / Rosmunde Court / Tara Vista - Street Parking
motions.description: Consideration of community comments on kerbside parking restrictions in Kavanagh Street, Rosmunde Court and Tara Vista in West Leederville to address parking issues from Subiaco Oval events and medical premises.

motions.title: Cambridge Street - Indented Parking Review
motions.description: Review of options for indented verge parking in Cambridge Street between Northwood Street and Holyrood Street to accommodate future pedestrian crossing design.

motions.title: Cambridge Street - Pedestrian Crossing and Streetscaping
motions.description: Approval of signalised pedestrian crossing installation in Cambridge Street 15 metres west of Lesser Street and associated parking restrictions and streetscaping works.

motions.title: Cambridge Street - Street Tree Feasibility Investigation
motions.description: Proposed amendment to investigate feasibility of planting street tree in median of Cambridge Street between Kimberley Street and Northwood Street.

motions.title: Railway Parade/Kimberley Street - Roundabout Construction
motions.description: Deferral of expenditure on pre-construction activities for roundabout at Railway Parade and Kimberley Street intersection pending State Government determination on Major Stadium Development and extension of Subiaco Redevelopment Authority boundary.

motions.title: Underwood Avenue Roadworks - AK Reserve Sporting Facilities
motions.description: Approval of proposal from Department of Housing and Works to widen Underwood Avenue to construct deceleration lane for access to new basketball and athletics facilities on AK Reserve.

motions.title: Gayton Road Traffic Management - Boulevard Shopping Centre
motions.description: Review of traffic count results following 2006/07 roadworks modifications around Boulevard Shopping Centre in City Beach to assess impact on traffic flow.

motions.title: Tender T14-08 Traffic Management Services
motions.description: Contract for traffic management services for one year commencing 1 November 2008. Existing contract with Australian Traffic Engineering expired 1 October 2008. Value approximately $120,000 in 2007/2008. Six tenders received: Altus, ATM, Australian Traffic Engineering, Carrington's Traffic Services, Contraflow, and Warp Group.

motions.title: Tender T15-08 Oceanic Drive Median Irrigation System
motions.description: Contract for replacement of irrigation system from West Coast Highway to Bold Park Drive. Existing system approximately 40 years old. Two tenders received: Malua Reticulation and Total Eden. Budget allocation $225,000 for irrigation replacement.

motions.title: Rose Gardens Precinct Landscape Improvement
motions.description: Amended landscape plan for Rose Garden area bounded by The Boulevard, Selby and Cambridge Streets. Design incorporates water wise principles with central garden bed. Poinciana tree selected as centrepiece. Stage 1 cost $36,000 budgeted in 2008/09. Stages 2 and 3 estimated $15,100 and $16,100 respectively for future budgets.

motions.title: 2008/2009 Financial Assistance Community Organisations
motions.description: Grant program for community organisations. Total budget $12,000 GST exclusive. Ten applications received requesting $14,518 total. Funding approved for projects including equipment purchases and entertainment costs.

motions.title: 2009/2010 CSRFF Fund Applications
motions.description: Community Sporting and Recreation Facilities Fund applications prioritised for Department of Sport and Recreation submission. Three applications: Lake Monger Recreation Club (synthetic bowling greens and lighting, $500,185), Reabold Tennis Club (court resurfacing, $90,000), and Wembley Lacrosse Club (storage facility, $39,036). All rated Medium/High priority.

motions.title: Business Plan Wembley Golf Complex Stage 1
motions.description: Business Plan approval for major trading undertaking under Local Government Act 1995 Section 3.59. Stage 1 estimated cost $10.4 million including architect and consultant fees. Plan to be advertised for six weeks public comment. Facilities include automated driving range, Centre of Excellence, practice facilities, car park, and piazza.

motions.title: Delegation of Authority CEO Annual Review
motions.description: Annual review of Schedule of Delegations to Chief Executive Officer under Local Government Act 1995 Section 5.46. Schedule reformatted and amended following Department of Local Government Operational Guidelines. Additional formal delegations incorporated. Schedule divided into three parts: LGA 1995 delegations, Local Government Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1960 delegations, and Council policy delegations by Program Area.

motions.title: Annual Report 2007-2008
motions.description: Acceptance of 2007/2008 Annual Report for submission to Annual General Meeting of Electors. Financial audit completed September 2008. AGM date rescheduled from 4 December 2008 to 10 December 2008 to avoid conflict with Tamala Park Regional Council meeting. CEO authorised to make minor amendments to draft report prior to printing.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts
motions.description: Confirmation of accounts paid from Municipal Account and Trust Account for period 1 September to 30 September 2008. Total cheque payments $1,273,619.65. Total EFT payments $5,589,621.93. Total payments $6,863,241.58.

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at September 2008
motions.description: Review of investment performance for the two-month period ended 31 August 2008 and September 2008, with administration recommendation to receive the investment schedule and review Policy No. 3.2.5.

motions.title: Financial Statements - Financial Review - August 2008
motions.description: Review of financial statements for the two-month period ended 31 August 2008, including financial position, operations, capital works, and budget reallocations including replacement of shade sails at Floreat Beach.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements
motions.description: Receipt of Financial Statements for the period ended 30 September 2008, including key financial indicators and comparison with previous financial year.

motions.title: Application for Trading in Public Place - Satmat Pty Ltd (City Beach)
motions.description: Application from Satmat Pty Ltd to operate a commercial business hiring beach equipment on City Beach during summer months. Council supported in principle and authorised the Administration to issue a licence for the summer 2008 season.

motions.title: Application for Trading in Public Place - Pedal OZ (Lake Monger Reserve)
motions.description: Application from Pedal OZ for a bicycle hire operation at Lake Monger Reserve. Council refused permission due to potential conflict with pedestrians and cyclists.

motions.title: Request for Proposal No. 17-08 - Lake Monger Reserve Ice Cream and Drink Vendor Licence
motions.description: Consideration of submission from Giuseppe and Lidia Topini trading as [private individual — name withheld] to provide mobile ice cream/drink vending services at Lake Monger Reserve for three years. Council accepted the proposal and set the licence fee.

motions.title: Annual Financial Report for Year Ended 30 June 2008
motions.description: Consideration of the Annual Financial Report for the year ended 30 June 2008, including audit completion and compliance with accounting standards.

motions.title: Significant Accounting Policies
motions.description: Consideration of amendments to the Town's significant accounting policies to reflect new Australian Accounting Standards and Financial Management Regulations.

motions.title: Internal and Interim Audit Reports 2008
motions.description: Receipt of further information relating to internal audit stage 4 and interim audit reports, including implementation of auditor recommendations on asset registers, reserve funds, sundry debtors, and bonds and guarantees.

motions.title: Risk Management
motions.description: Status report on risk management implementation including establishment of risk management plan and risk management training on ISO 31,000 standard, with amended Audit Committee Terms of Reference.

motions.title: Extension of Underground Power - Salvado Road
motions.description: Notice of Motion by Cr Bradley requesting CEO to investigate feasibility of providing underground power to properties on northern side of Salvado Road between Selby Street and Station Street, with ratepayers to pay costs. Motion deferred to next meeting to enable composite motion.

motions.title: Underground Power - Town of Cambridge
motions.description: Notice of Motion by Cr Grinceri requesting a report on feasibility of bringing underground power to parts of the Town without it, including options, minimum dwelling requirements, funding options, and strategy. Motion deferred to next meeting to enable composite motion.

motions.title: Bring forward Item DV08.107 for consideration
motions.description: Motion to bring forward a development application item for discussion ahead of scheduled agenda position.

motions.title: Suspend Standing Orders Clause 9.7
motions.description: Motion to suspend standing orders to allow two motions to be considered simultaneously.

motions.title: Revoke deemed refusal and approve small bar use change
motions.description: Application by Dunross Group Pty Ltd for change of use from shop to small bar at 294 Cambridge Street, corner Nanson Street, Wembley. Motion to revoke deemed refusal and approve with conditions addressing patron numbers, operating hours, parking, noise management, and resident parking scheme.

motions.title: Extension of time to speak for Councillor Berry
motions.description: Motion under Standing Orders Clause 8.14 to extend speaking time for Councillor Berry during debate.

motions.title: CEO Performance Review - receive report and adopt recommendations
motions.description: Confidential item relating to performance appraisal of Chief Executive Officer Jason Buckley for period July 2007 to September 2008, conducted by CEO Review Committee with external facilitator.

motions.title: Petitions received and referred to Committee
motions.description: Two petitions submitted to Infrastructure and Community Committee: one with 29 signatures requesting modifications to Arbordale/Ferndale Street intersection, and one with 290 signatures requesting outdoor basketball court at Perry Lakes skate park redevelopment.

motions.title: Leave of Absence approved
motions.description: Three leave of absence requests approved for councillors.

motions.title: Minutes confirmed
motions.description: Confirmation of Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting held on 27 April 2010.

motions.title: Mixed use development Cambridge Street Wembley approved
motions.description: Five storey mixed use development at Lot 48 (No. 343-343A) Cambridge Street, Wembley comprising one shop, 22 offices and two residential apartments. Proposal includes variation to plot ratio from 1.0:1.0 to 1.64:1.0 and reduction in car parking from 47 required bays to 30 provided bays. Applicant is Realflow Pty Ltd.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling with undercroft City Beach approved
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling with undercroft at Lot 12 (No. 18) Wayeela Place, City Beach submitted by Architecture-Ejo on behalf of landowner [private individual — name withheld]. Requires assessment under Residential Design Codes for variations to building height and setback requirements.

motions.title: Patio to existing dwelling City Beach approved
motions.description: Application for patio at Lot 124 (No. 2) Sellenger Court, City Beach submitted by Poulter Installations. Patio is free standing at established ground levels with setback of 1.25 metres from rear boundary, requiring variation to 6.0 metre rear setback requirement.

motions.title: West Leederville Planning Study adoption and advertising
motions.description: Amendment to add clause regarding the Bethel Site as an 'icon' site with building height allowance up to 8-10 storeys subject to provision of public car park and pedestrian link.

motions.title: Section 5.65 interest declaration - allowance to participate
motions.description: Motion to allow Cr King to participate in discussion and decision-making despite declared financial interest, on the basis the interest is common to a significant number of ratepayers.

motions.title: West Leederville Planning and Urban Design Study adoption with conditions
motions.description: Main motion to adopt the Part 2 Detailed Planning Report for the West Leederville Planning and Urban Design Study for public advertising, incorporating multiple design options and provisions including the Bethel Site amendment.

motions.title: Draft Local Planning Strategy adoption as working paper
motions.description: Motion to adopt the Draft Local Planning Strategy as a working document, conduct a values and attitudes survey, and allocate budget for specialist studies and consultation.

motions.title: Development Assessment Panels Policy Statement noted
motions.description: Motion to note the Policy Statement for Implementing Development Assessment Panels in Western Australia released by the Department of Planning in April 2010.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications April 2010 received
motions.description: Motion to receive the report on delegated decisions and notifications for the period ending 30 April 2010.

motions.title: Building Licences April 2010 schedule received
motions.description: Motion to receive the schedule of building and demolition licences approved under delegated authority for April 2010.

motions.title: Council Infrastructure Policies review - retained with amendments
motions.description: Motion to retain, amend or delete Council infrastructure policies as detailed in the review report, and incorporate changes into the Council Policy Manual.

motions.title: Brookdale Street intersection improvements - funding contribution endorsed
motions.description: Motion to endorse proposed intersection improvements at Brookdale Street/Brockway Road/Underwood Avenue and consider a $31,500 contribution for inclusion in the 2011/2012 budget.

motions.title: Kerbside parking restrictions amendments - three locations
motions.description: Motion to implement parking restrictions at Berkeley Crescent and Alba Lane, and remove restrictions at Clanmel Road.

motions.title: Drainage Improvement Program
motions.description: Storm on 22 March 2010 caused flooding in various roads and properties. Investigation identified leaves blocking drainage grates and private property runoff as main causes. Proposal to improve drainage network capacity.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council - 22 April 2010 Report
motions.description: Report on strategic items considered at Mindarie Regional Council meeting held 22 April 2010, including review of member fees model, Cambridge tonnage estimates, resource recovery facility report, and business planning.

motions.title: 2010 Local Schools Financial Assistance Disbursement
motions.description: Financial assistance program for local schools to fund worthwhile initiatives and programs benefiting Cambridge community. Two applications received totalling $4,560: West Leederville Primary School (Classroom Vegetable Garden $560) and Bold Park Community School (Banners Around The Lake $4,000). Committee expressed concern about northern and eastern side of Bold Park Community School being untidy.

motions.title: St Christopher's Anglican Church Funding Application Refusal
motions.description: St Christopher's Anglican Church, City Beach applied for $22,537 for construction of accessible toilet and upgrade of northern entry door for wheelchair access. Application reviewed after biannual policy review. New policy inclusion prevents financial assistance for facilities on land not owned freehold by the Town. Church is no longer eligible.

motions.title: 2010-2011 Fees and Charges for Sportsgrounds and Reserves
motions.description: Review of current fee structure for sports grounds and reserves. Fee structure includes 3.4% average increase consistent with Perth Region CPI to March 2010 quarter. Revision of Corporate Functions fee (changed to 50+ participants from 100+) and introduction of two new fees: Wedding Reception and Driver Training.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Cambridge Library 2010/2011
motions.description: Annual review of Cambridge Library fees and charges. Benchmarking analysis shows current fees remain competitive with other libraries. No amendments proposed. New charges introduced for overdue library loans: 20 cents per day per item to commence first day after due date, maximum $5.00 charge per item, effective 1 July 2010.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Cambridge Senior Services
motions.description: Annual review of Cambridge Senior Services fees and charges. Services include domestic assistance, social support, personal care, centre-based day care, in-home respite, transport, home maintenance, delivered meals, allied health podiatry, assessment, and client care coordination. Competitive analysis shows Cambridge charges are higher than three of four service providers analysed. Increases proposed for Allied Health, Centre Based Program meal, Home Maintenance, and Transport.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Wembley Community Centre and Leederville Town Hall
motions.description: Annual review of fees and charges for Wembley Community Centre and Leederville Town Hall. Both facilities operating on tiered fee structure. Fee structure for 2010/2011 includes 3.4% increase consistent with Perth Region CPI for March 2010 quarter.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Youth Services
motions.description: Annual review of Youth Services fees and charges. Services facilitated and delivered from 86 Cambridge Street, West Leederville and other locations within Town. Activities attract small fee. Charges for Perth CPI increase of 3.4% recommended for 2010/2011 financial year. No increase to telephone charges or photocopying.

motions.title: Appointment of Alternate Member to Mindarie Regional Council
motions.description: Cr MacRae, Council's delegate to Mindarie Regional Council, on leave of absence from 27 May to 29 June 2010. Appointment of alternate member required under Section 52 of Interpretation Act. Mayor Simon Withers previously appointed as alternate member at Special Meeting on 6 April 2010 and sworn in as Regional Council member.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - April 2010
motions.description: Schedule of accounts for payment from Municipal Account (and Trust Account where applicable) for period 1 April 2010 to 30 April 2010. Includes cheque payments totalling $1,466,768.54 and EFT payments totalling $4,625,856.95, for total payments of $6,092,625.49.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - April 2010
motions.description: Report on investment performance of Council's surplus funds. Total investment at end of April 2010 is $22.65 million comprising Municipal Funds of $5.7 million, Reserve Funds of $7.65 million and Endowment Lands Funds of $9.29 million. Weighted average interest rate of 5.74% compared favourably against benchmarks. Reserve Bank increased official cash rate by 0.25% to 4.50% at May 2010 meeting.

motions.title: Financial Statements 30 April 2010 received
motions.description: Report on financial statements for the period ended 30 April 2010, including analysis of receivables, cash surplus, capital works, budget reallocations, and key financial variations.

motions.title: Tamala Park Regional Council meeting 15 April 2010 received
motions.description: Report on items considered at the Tamala Park Regional Council Ordinary Meeting held on 15 April 2010, including Project Steering Committee partnering proposal, Structure Plan update, and office premises considerations.

motions.title: Documents sealed noted
motions.description: Report advising Council of documents that have been affixed with the Town of Cambridge Common Seal, with schedule of documents provided as attachment.

motions.title: General Fees and Charges 2010/2011 approved
motions.description: Review of fees and charges for miscellaneous Council services for 2010/2011 financial year, including proposed increases to Special Payment Arrangement Fee, new fee for rate notice reprints, and Settlement Agents Enquiry increase.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Course driving range fees and charges approved
motions.description: Implementation of new fee model for driving range and associated facilities at Wembley Golf Course, including driving range balls pricing, membership levels, teaching fees, and function centre charges, scheduled to open mid-June 2010.

motions.title: Subsidence at 30 Barrett Street Wembley investigation amended and carried
motions.description: Motion requiring CEO to investigate and report on causes and consequences of subsidence at 30 Barrett Street, Wembley. Original motion was amended to require report to set out Council's powers to intervene in such circumstances.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council single fee model noted and legal action endorsed
motions.description: Report on Mindarie Regional Council decision to move from multi-fee to single-fee waste disposal model, and City of Stirling's Supreme Court action to prevent implementation. Council noted cost implications and endorsed CEO's action to jointly engage legal representation with other member councils to oppose the Supreme Court action.

motions.title: Bold Park Agreement CEO authorised to prepare Deed
motions.description: Confidential report regarding Bold Park Agreement for areas F & G, Mt Claremont. CEO authorised to prepare Deed in accordance with guiding principles and submit to State Government.

motions.title: Petition - Quarry Amphitheatre Heritage List
motions.description: A petition containing 650 names and addresses requesting that the Quarry Amphitheatre be placed on the State Heritage List was received through the Town's website. Although not in prescribed form, Council accepted the 650 names and addresses as a letter.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 24 July 2018
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary Council Meeting held on 24 July 2018.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 8 August 2018
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Special Council Meeting held on 8 August 2018.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 14 August 2018 (Amended)
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Special Council Meeting held on 14 August 2018, with amendment to Item 5.1 vote record.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 7 June 2018
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Special Council Meeting held on 7 June 2018 at 5.30 pm.

motions.title: DV18.108 - Two Storey Dwelling with Roof Terrace - SAT Reconsideration
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling and roof terrace at Lot 395 (No. 114) Rosedale Street, Floreat. The application was refused by Council on 24 April 2018. Following SAT appeal and mediation, amended plans were submitted for reconsideration. An absolute majority decision is required.

motions.title: Construction of three open-framed baseball shelters
motions.description: Application for construction of three permanent shelters at Wembley Sports Park for use by Wembley Baseball Club, located at Lot 9003 (No. 180) Selby Street, Jolimont. The shelters are 2.5m high and open on all sides.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling with undercroft - balcony enclosure
motions.description: Application for amended plans to enclose approved balcony with clear glazing at Lot 8 (No. 17) Jubilee Crescent, City Beach. The amendments include full height floor to ceiling glazing to eastern elevation, frameless bi-fold windows to northern and western elevations, and removal of approved metal cladding.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling at Branksome Gardens
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling with basement and upper floor balcony at Lot 85 (No. 59) Branksome Gardens, City Beach. The dwelling seeks variations to street setback and rear lot boundary setback.

motions.title: Additions and alterations to existing dwelling - SAT reconsideration
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing dwelling at Lot 1075 (No. 204) Harborne Street, Wembley. This is a reconsideration of a previous refusal (24 April 2018) following State Administrative Tribunal invitation based on amended plans from mediation dated 9 July 2018.

motions.title: Lot 1275 Clanmel Road Floreat - Additions and Alterations
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to an existing dwelling including an alfresco area. Amended plans received 26 July 2018 removed the store from the proposal. Proposal seeks variation to Clause 20 regarding minimum street setback requirement in Floreat Precinct.

motions.title: Amendment to DV18.113 - Alfresco Area Condition
motions.description: Amendment moved during Committee Meeting 21 August 2018 to add further clause regarding alfresco area enclosure requirements

motions.title: Lot 279 Orrel Avenue Floreat - Carport
motions.description: Application for construction of a skillion roofed carport 2.7 metres tall, set back 0.6 metres from adjoining lot boundary and 5.0 metres from primary street. Proposal seeks variations to Clause 20 regarding minimum street setback and to element 5.2.5 Sightlines of R-Codes.

motions.title: Draft Sustainability Strategy 2018-2023 - Adopt for Advertising
motions.description: Council endorsement of draft Town of Cambridge Sustainability Strategy prepared by Emerge and Associates and Creating Communities. Strategy developed following consultation with residents, Elected Members, local schools and Administration staff. Contains six themes: Water, Waste, Natural Environment, Energy and Transport, Climate Resilience, and Leadership.

motions.title: Amendments to Local Planning Policy 2.3 - Final Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of draft revised Local Planning Policy 2.3: Public Notification of Planning Proposals following advertising period. Policy sets out requirements and procedures for notification and advertising of applications for planning approval. No submissions received during 24-day consultation period.

motions.title: Local Planning Policy 2.8 - Amendment and Extension to Term of Development Approval
motions.description: Adoption of draft Local Planning Policy 2.8: Amendment and Extension to the Term of Development Approval. Policy provides guidance on matters to be considered in determining applications for amendment or extension of development approvals. No submissions received during 24-day consultation period. Minor administrative re-wording made to Section 3.0 Fees during adoption.

motions.title: Local Planning Policy 5.1 Parking - Final Adoption
motions.description: Draft revised Local Planning Policy 5.1: Parking was advertised for 24 days with no submissions received. The purpose was to include alfresco areas in parking calculations and address inconsistencies with Town Planning Scheme No. 1.

motions.title: Local Planning Policy 2.9 SAT Matters - Final Adoption
motions.description: Draft Local Planning Policy 2.9: Response to State Administrative Tribunal Matters was advertised for 24 days with no submissions received. The policy provides guidance to Town officers in responding to SAT applications for review of planning decisions.

motions.title: Local Law 43 Review - Deferral
motions.description: Initiation of review of Bylaw 43 (Local Law 43) - Buildings on Endowment Land and Limekiln Estate, which has been in existence since 1939 with last amendments in 1993. The review is required under Section 3.16 of the Local Government Act 1995 (every 8 years). The item was deferred to allow a reviewed version to be presented prior to public notice.

motions.title: West Leederville Hub Project - Deferral
motions.description: Consideration of West Leederville Hub project previously deferred from 28 November 2017 for 9 months. The project involves master planning and feasibility assessment of the Town's land holdings in the West Leederville area, which includes potential community facility redevelopment. Deferral sought to allow discussion at Elected Member forum before end of 2018.

motions.title: West Leederville Hub Project - Amendment Motion
motions.description: Amendment to deferral motion to change the forum timing from 'end of 2018' to 'before November 2018'.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions Report - Reception
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for the period April to July 2018, covering planning decisions across multiple suburbs including City Beach, Mount Claremont, Floreat, Wembley, Jolimont, West Leederville, and Subiaco.

motions.title: Building Permits Report - Reception
motions.description: Schedule of Building and Demolition Permits approved under delegated authority for March to July 2018. Report provides monthly statistics and comparative data of building licences.

motions.title: Luxxe Cafe Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Parking restriction amendment requested by Luxxe Café at 151 Herdsman Parade, Wembley. Current designation is 'No Stopping' on the east side of Selby Street. Proposed amendment to 1P 9am-5.30pm Monday-Friday, 8am-12 noon Saturday, with No-Stopping 7.30am-9am Monday-Friday.

motions.title: Beachfront Food Establishments Parking Amendment
motions.description: Parking restriction amendments for beachfront businesses (Odyssea, Hamptons, The Rise) along Challenger Parade service road, City Beach. Northern Embayment: 9am-5pm Loading Zone (30 min commercial), 5pm-9am 1/4P. Southern Embayment: 6am-2pm Loading Zone (30 min commercial), 2pm-6am 1/4P.

motions.title: Wembley Sports Park Parking Restrictions - 4 Hour Limit
motions.description: Introduction of 4 hour parking restrictions in Wembley Sports Park carparks W100 and W105 with ticket parking fees ($1/hour max $5/day) and purchase of reconditioned ticket machines. Approved by absolute majority with support from North Metropolitan Health.

motions.title: Wembley Sports Park Parking Restrictions - 3 Hour Limit
motions.description: Alternative administration recommendation for 3 hour parking restrictions instead of 4 hours, with permits for State Netball Centre employees and volunteers, and review by December 2019 instead of June 2019.

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders - Clause 8.13
motions.description: Suspension of limitation of number of addresses to allow open discussion on Wembley Sports Park parking proposal.

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders - Clause 8.13
motions.description: Resumption of the limitation of number of addresses clause following discussion.

motions.title: Submission of Wembley Sports Parking to Council
motions.description: Item relating to Wembley Sports Park parking restrictions to be submitted to Council for determination.

motions.title: Reabold Tennis Club - Padel Tennis Facility
motions.description: Application from Reabold Tennis Club to sub-lease area for Padel Tennis facility and request to extend lease term. Committee recommendation followed amendment to clause 1.3 regarding rental use.

motions.title: Amendment to Padel Tennis Motion - Clause 1.3
motions.description: Amendment to modify clause 1.3 concerning annual rent use by Reabold Tennis Club from Play Padel Pty Ltd.

motions.title: Odyssea Beach Cafe - Financial Assistance and Events Support
motions.description: Application from Odyssea Beach Cafe for financial contribution and support for events in City Beach foreshore precinct, including New Year's Eve fireworks display request.

motions.title: Amendment - Power Outlet Installation Report
motions.description: Amendment to add clause requesting administration report with quotes for power outlet installation.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - August 2018
motions.description: Notification of documents affixed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge during August 2018.

motions.title: Model Litigant Policy - Civil Litigation Status Report
motions.description: Consideration of civil litigation status report for August 2018 as required by Model Litigant Policy.

motions.title: Clancy's Fish Bar - Lower Kiosk Renovation Permission
motions.description: Permission for Clancy's Fish Bar to alter and renovate lower floor kiosk by enlarging roller shutter opening and creating new door access.

motions.title: Leederville Sporting Club - School Garden Licence
motions.description: Permission for Leederville Sporting Club to enter Licence Agreement allowing West Leederville Primary School to use portion of unused land for school garden.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - July 2018
motions.description: Confirmation of accounts paid during July 2018 including cheque payments and electronic fund transfers.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - July 2018
motions.description: Receipt and review of investment portfolio schedule and performance as at 31 July 2018.

motions.title: Policy 1.1.5 - Media Communications - Amendment - Deferral
motions.description: Council considered amendments to Policy No 1.1.5 - 'Media Communications' to include matters concerning social media. The policy had previously been deferred from 24 July 2018 to an Elected Member Forum for further consideration.

motions.title: Policy 1.1.13 - Public Question Time - Deferral
motions.description: Council considered adoption of draft Policy No 1.1.13 - 'Public Question Time' to formalise the Town's approach to Public Question Time in accordance with legislative requirements and assist orderly management at Council and Committee Meetings.

motions.title: Wards and Boundaries - Statutory Review - Main Motion
motions.description: Council considered options for statutory review of the Town's ward boundaries and representation required under Schedule 2.2 of the Local Government Act 1995. The review must be undertaken every eight years.

motions.title: Wards and Boundaries - Statutory Review - Amendment Motion
motions.description: Amendment to delete clause 3 of the main motion regarding the Council's preferred position on retaining the existing ward structure.
