motions.title: Lot 45 (No. 63) Evandale Street - Ancillary Dwelling, Studio and Garage
motions.description: Application for ancillary dwelling, studio and double garage at Lot 45 (No. 63) Evandale Street, Floreat. Two storey development with double garage and studio on ground floor and ancillary dwelling on upper floor. Requires assessment against garage width design principles.

motions.title: Lot 331 (No. 10) Chandler Avenue East - Retrospective Approval for Patio
motions.description: Application for retrospective approval for patio structure at Lot 331 (No. 10) Chandler Avenue East, Floreat. Timber structure with retractable shade sail roof. Requires assessment against side setback design principles with objection received. Item referred back.

motions.title: Retrospective approval for pergola - Oliver
motions.description: Application for retrospective approval for a pergola at Lot 331 (No. 10) Chandler Avenue East, Floreat. Committee recommended approval for a patio, but amendment changed it to pergola with modified conditions.

motions.title: Access and Parking Strategy update
motions.description: Status report on implementation of the 2012 Parking and Access Strategy, review of parking management in West Leederville, and development of strategy for cash in lieu parking funds.

motions.title: Draft Planning Policy 5.7 - Construction Management Plans adoption
motions.description: Final adoption of Planning Policy 5.7: Construction Management Plans following public advertising period with no submissions received.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications - August 2015
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for August 2015, including 20 development applications and review notifications.

motions.title: Harborne Grantham Black Spot - traffic signal modifications
motions.description: Update on design and investigation of traffic signal modifications at Grantham Street/Harborne Street intersection. Members questioned the need for right turn filters in both directions and agreed Option B should also be investigated alongside Option C.

motions.title: MRC Carbon Price and Waste to Energy
motions.description: Council to receive MRC decision regarding carbon price proceeds refunds to member councils and waste to energy regional collaboration proposal.

motions.title: Lake Monger Entry Statement Signs Budget Reallocation
motions.description: Council to reallocate $45,000 from Lake Monger Barbecues project to Lake Monger Reserve Upgrade Interpretive Signs project to fund three entry statement signs totalling $74,816.

motions.title: City Beach Oval Lighting Upgrade Cost Overrun
motions.description: Council to approve $16,250 unbudgeted expenditure as 50% Town contribution to cost overruns on City Beach Oval lighting upgrade, and amend Policy 2.1.15 to require Town coordination of major lighting and building works.

motions.title: 2015 Community Recognition Awards
motions.description: Council to award 2015 Club Volunteer of the Year Award jointly to Nominees 2 and 3, review Disability Access and Inclusion Award, and undertake review of awards to broaden appeal.

motions.title: Former Nursery Site Jolimont Land Sale Payment Method
motions.description: Council to determine method of receiving balance consideration for sale of former nursery site at Jolimont to Landcorp - deferred contingent payment based on land sales versus single valuation-based payment.

motions.title: Underground Power Program Design Proposal
motions.description: Council to approve $46,000 from Area Improvement Reserve for Western Power to undertake Package 1 preliminary design works for underground power in remaining areas of Town, with future decision on Package 2.

motions.title: Sublease Tenancy B City Beach Commercial Precinct
motions.description: Council to authorize Mayor and Chief Executive Officer to execute sublease between Fabio and Eleanor Hupfer and Darius H Pty Ltd for Tenancy B at City Beach Commercial Precinct.

motions.title: Documents Sealed September 2015
motions.description: Council to note documents affixed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge including Town Planning Scheme Amendment 30 and Wembley Sports Park Pavilion Agreement.

motions.title: City of Perth Bill 2015 Advocacy Position
motions.description: Council to note contents of City of Perth Bill 2015 and raise concerns regarding proposed Section 37 (LGAB special regard to City of Perth) and Section 29 (Executive Director Public Health powers over Botanic Gardens and Parks Authority), and position that Bill should be withdrawn.

motions.title: Delegation of Authority for Chief Executive Officer
motions.description: Annual review of Delegation of Authority Register for the Chief Executive Officer in accordance with Section 5.46 of the Local Government Act 1995. Includes one new delegation for CEO approval of purchases greater than $100,000.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - August 2015
motions.description: Submission and confirmation of accounts paid in August 2015 under Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996 Regulation 13. Total payments of $11,787,801.25 comprising cheque payments and electronic fund transfers.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - August 2015
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule as at 31 August 2015. Total investment portfolio of $30.495 million with weighted average interest rate of 2.83%, outperforming the cash rate of 2.00%.

motions.title: Financial Assistance Grants to Local Government
motions.description: Council resolution acknowledging importance of Commonwealth Financial Assistance Grants program and commitment to promoting federal funding in publications. Town's 2015/16 allocation is $944,754 (2% of $43 million operating revenue).

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements - August 2015
motions.description: Review of financial position for period ended 31 August 2015. Operating revenue YTD $28.2 million (budget $27.8m), operating expenses YTD $6.6 million (budget $6.9m), net operating surplus $21.6 million. Capital expenditure YTD $3.7 million against budget $6.9 million (timing variance $3.1 million).

motions.title: Meeting go behind closed doors
motions.description: Procedural motion to close the meeting to the public for confidential discussion of CEO recruitment matters

motions.title: CEO Recruitment Matters - Approve Confidential Recommendation
motions.description: Confidential report relating to CEO recruitment matters, including discussion of proposed panel members

motions.title: Meeting come out of behind closed doors
motions.description: Procedural motion to exit closed session and resume open meeting

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Organisational Structure 2019
motions.description: Council consideration of the Organisational Review and Change Management Consultancy recommendations. The purpose is to obtain Council's approval of a new Organisational Structure for the Town of Cambridge and to authorise the Acting Chief Executive Officer to implement the new structure and Change Management Plan.

motions.title: Newspaper Advertising Campaign
motions.description: Motion to consider the newspaper advertising campaign outlining Council's decision of 28 June 2005 relating to the proposed redevelopment of Perry Lakes Stadium site.

motions.title: Motion to put the question
motions.description: Procedural motion to put the question regarding the newspaper advertising campaign consideration.

motions.title: Meeting Behind Closed Doors
motions.description: Motion to regard a matter as confidential in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(c) of the Local Government Act 1995

motions.title: Property Acquisition West Leederville
motions.description: Confidential recommendation regarding property acquisition in West Leederville

motions.title: Reopen Meeting to Public
motions.description: Motion to reopen the meeting to the public following closed session

motions.title: Adoption of Outline Development Plan for Kalinda Drive/The Boulevard
motions.description: Consideration of the revised Outline Development Plan (ODP) for the Kalinda Drive/The Boulevard land development area (Lot 723 and 724 The Boulevard, City Beach) for adoption and referral to the Western Australian Planning Commission for endorsement. The report details the consultation process, design refinements following 160 public submissions, and key design criteria applied to develop the preferred development option.

motions.title: Leave of Absence applications
motions.description: Applications for leave of absence from Cr Anderton and Cr Burkett for specified periods.

motions.title: Petition reception and referral
motions.description: Petition with 115 signatures submitted by [private individual — name withheld] requesting street boundary setbacks be minimum 7.5 metres from primary street, referred to Development and Environmental Services Committee.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 25 July 2000.

motions.title: Road Verges – Development and Maintenance Policy referral
motions.description: Motion to refer Road Verges – Development and Maintenance Policy back to Technical Services Committee for further consideration after members expressed difficulty understanding the policy.

motions.title: Nicholson Road/Railway Road traffic signal adjustment reception
motions.description: Report on Main Roads WA's revised traffic signal phasing proposal for the Nicholson Road/Railway Road/Nash Street intersection in Subiaco with lead lag right turn design.

motions.title: Federal Road Safety Black Spot Program 2001/2002 applications
motions.description: Submission of Black Spot Program applications for four dangerous intersections: Harborne Street/Cambridge Street, Oceanic Drive/Brookdale Street/Howtree Place, Kimberley Street/Cambridge Street, and Alderbury Street/Oceanic Drive.

motions.title: Cambridge Street kerbside parking restriction
motions.description: Implementation of no parking restrictions on south side of Cambridge Street from The Boulevard to Marlow Street on Saturdays 8am-6pm during netball season (April to September).

motions.title: Perry Lakes Working Group meeting scheduling
motions.description: Amended motion to arrange Perry Lakes Working Group meetings with dates to be agreed by Administration and members of the Group.

motions.title: Lake Monger Visitor Facility redesign approval
motions.description: Approval of redesign of Lake Monger Visitor Facilities with carpark abutting Powis Street and design options for remnant public open space, funded from existing Consultancy Budget.

motions.title: Integrated Transport Planning North America delegation
motions.description: Nomination of Cr Steele and Chief Executive Officer to participate in State/Local Government delegation to North America for integrated transport planning at approximately $8,000 cost.

motions.title: General Business at Committee Meetings report received
motions.description: Report providing information and clarification of procedures for participation in and conduct of business at Committee meetings in response to enquiries from Elected Members.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment confirmed
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts to pay for expenses incurred by the Town to fund its operation in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at 31 July 2000 received
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule advising Council of surplus funds invested, distribution of funds, and financial performance for period ended 31 July 2000.

motions.title: Interim Financial Statements for period ended 30 June 2000 received
motions.description: Receipt of Interim Financial Statements for the period ended 30 June 2000, subject to audit, providing a reasonably reliable position for the Town at end of 1999/2000 financial year with a surplus of $743,000.

motions.title: Documents Sealed noted
motions.description: Notification that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to various documents including Deeds of Access, Leases, and Covenants.

motions.title: Cambridge Scout Group facility - consideration deferred
motions.description: Consideration of request from Cambridge Scout Group for Council funding towards development of new Scout facility. Original motion to revoke prior funding decision and support refurbishment of City Beach Scout Hall was put and lost.

motions.title: Scout facility at Perry Lakes - report requested
motions.description: Foreshadowed motion moved after original motion lost, requesting report on basis of Council providing suitable site at Perry Lakes for Cambridge Scout facility and Administration meeting with Scout Group on funding options.

motions.title: Sport and Recreation Strategy progress report received
motions.description: Report on progress of Cambridge Sport and Recreation Strategy and Floreat Sporting Precinct Study. Report recommends consultant coordination and convening of meetings with sporting club delegates.

motions.title: National Local Government Community Development Conference site visit approved
motions.description: Approval of allocation of $2,500 for Town to host site visit showcasing Lake Monger regeneration for National Local Government Community Development Conference.

motions.title: Floreat Surf Life Saving Club Swim Through sponsorship approved
motions.description: Approval of $2,000 sponsorship for Floreat Surf Life Saving Club's inaugural Swim Through event to be held at Floreat Beach in November 2000 to raise funds for members to attend Australian Surf Life Saving Titles.

motions.title: Floreat Surf Life Saving Club sub lease approved
motions.description: Approval of request from Floreat Surf Life Saving Club to sub lease approximately 128 square metres to Lucent Technologies for erection of low impact telecommunication antennae at $12,000 per annum for two years and two months expiring 29 November 2002. Item referred to Development and Environmental Services Committee for planning implications.

motions.title: Beach Inspection Services tender accepted
motions.description: Acceptance of tender from Surf Life Saving WA for provision of beach inspection and patrol service at Floreat and City beaches for five year period commencing 1 September 2000 at $125,000 per annum including Beach Safety Audit, with over-expenditure of $8,500 approved.

motions.title: Seniors' Needs Study project brief - consideration deferred
motions.description: Deferral of consideration of Project Brief for Seniors' Needs Study for one month. Study addresses review of existing services, planning for future services, and retirement accommodation for elderly residents.

motions.title: Crime Prevention Advisory Committee minutes received
motions.description: Receipt of Minutes of Crime Prevention Advisory Committee meeting held on Thursday 27 July 2000 to form part of public record of Council business.

motions.title: ALIA 2000 Biennial Conference attendance approved
motions.description: Approval for Manager Library Services to attend 2000 Australian Library and Information Association 6th Biennial Conference in Canberra 23-26 October 2000 to address strategic issues facing public libraries.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting of the Development and Environmental Services Committee held on 18 July 2000

motions.title: Zincalume Roof Approval at Simon Place
motions.description: Application for building approval for replacement zincalume roof at Lot 333 (No. 3) Simon Place, City Beach. Neighbours consulted and have no objection.

motions.title: Home Occupation Approval - Bookkeeping Services
motions.description: Application for planning approval for home occupation (bookkeeping/accounting service) at Lot 78 (No. 3) Whitney Crescent, Mt Claremont. Sole operator. No neighbour objections received.

motions.title: Home Occupation Refusal - Corporate Advisory
motions.description: Application for planning approval for home occupation (corporate advisory and communications) at Lot 126 (No. 75) Newry Street, Floreat. Proposed 31.5 square metre business with two employees. One neighbour objection received regarding traffic and amenity.

motions.title: Grouped Dwelling Approval - Wembley Corner Lot
motions.description: Application for planning approval for two storey grouped dwelling at Lot 1178 (No. 179B) Harborne Street, corner Johnson Street, Wembley. Corner lot policy application with reduced front setback variation for upper storey balcony.

motions.title: Grouped Dwelling Approval - West Leederville with Variations
motions.description: Application for planning approval for additional two storey grouped dwelling at Lot 2 (No.57B) Kimberley Street, West Leederville. Variations sought to plot ratio and setbacks. Absolute majority required. Both neighbours have no objection.

motions.title: Single Dwelling Approval - West Leederville with Variations
motions.description: Application for building approval for single dwelling (two storey and undercroft) at Lot 277 (No. 81) Blencowe Street, West Leederville. Variations sought to side setbacks, privacy (major openings), and roof pitch. All neighbours provided no objections.

motions.title: Grouped Dwelling Additions - Jersey Street (Reconsidered)
motions.description: Application for building approval for additions to grouped dwelling at Lot 1 (No.196) Jersey Street, Wembley. Variations sought to side setback (garage and store on boundary) and private open space. Neighbour objected. Motion initially lost when two members absent; reconsidered and carried by absolute majority.

motions.title: Reconsidering Item DES00.128
motions.description: Motion to reconsider Item DES00.128 relating to Lot 1 (No.196) Jersey Street, Wembley - Proposed Additions to a Grouped Dwelling after initial motion was lost due to absent members.

motions.title: Dwelling Additions Approval - Northwood Street
motions.description: Application for building approval for additions and alterations to existing dwelling at Lot 500 (No. 120) Northwood Street, West Leederville. Variations sought to rear and side setbacks and open space. Rear neighbour objected to rear setback, overlooking, and stormwater issues.

motions.title: Additions and alterations at Lot 500 Northwood Street
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing timber cottage in West Leederville. Rear fencing and boundary setback issues discussed. Original dwelling to be retained with single storey addition.

motions.title: Major additions and alteration at Lot 1663 Glengariff Drive Floreat
motions.description: Application for preliminary approval seeking variations to Town Planning Scheme requirements. Major additions to existing single storey dwelling including carport, dining, bar area, upper floor guestrooms, office, family room, balcony, ensuite, walk-in robe, portico and bedroom. Variations sought for privacy windows, carport setback, hard paving, and side setbacks. South neighbour has no objection; west neighbour objected to upper storey window due to privacy and height concerns.

motions.title: Porch, patio, front fence, rear pergola and bedroom extension at Lot 76 Perina Way
motions.description: Application for construction of porch, patio, front fence, rear pergola and bedroom extension at City Beach. Variations sought for primary street setback fencing and side setback. East neighbour has no objection to side setback variation.

motions.title: Proposed front fence at Lot 303 Clune Street West Leederville
motions.description: Application for building approval seeking variations for front fence construction on boundary. Variations sought for primary street visual permeability and pier height. Majority of existing fencing (65%) is existing construction prior to Residential Design Guidelines.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Administration Centre - Request to Change Street Address
motions.description: Council considered request from Department of Land Administration Geographic Names Committee regarding street address of Town Administration Centre. Centre located in City Beach but on cusp of Floreat boundary. Postal address is P O Box 15 Floreat. Decision sought whether to change stationery to reflect City Beach address or request suburb boundary amendment.

motions.title: Name Change Proposal - Dumfries Place Floreat to Cargen Crescent
motions.description: Council considered renaming Dumfries Place, Floreat to Cargen Crescent to distinguish it from adjoining Dumfries Road and avoid mail delivery confusion. Geographic Names Committee recommended Cargen as preferred name. Owner of No. 3 supported proposal. No. 9 expressed initial objection but subsequently has no objection. Three affected owners consulted and generally support proposed name.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications - July 2000
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for July 2000 covering travel agency, survey strata subdivision, subdivisions, alfresco dining, grouped dwelling and kiosk approvals. Notifications of appeals received and determined.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority - July 2000
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data on building licences issued for July 2000. Total of 33 building licences, 0 sign licences, 1 preliminary building licence, 2 demolition licences issued. Value of construction $3,140,915.

motions.title: Floreat Surf Life Saving Club – Sub Lease for Telecommunications Antennae
motions.description: Council considered request from Floreat Surf Life Saving Club to sub lease area to Lucent Technologies Australia Pty Ltd for low impact telecommunication antennae. Sub lease fee $12,000 per annum for 2 years 2 months expiring 29 November 2002. Club to use funds for beach patrol equipment and clubroom maintenance. Area approximately 128 square metres.

motions.title: Illegally Erected Carport Doors - Prosecution
motions.description: Council sought authority to undertake legal proceedings against property owners for illegal installation of carport doors in front setback areas. Cases in Tower Street and West Leederville. Property owners given 14 days notice (1 August 2000) to remove doors. One case also has Building Notice issued under Local Government Act.

motions.title: Representation on Statutory Authorities and Public Bodies - Nominations Received
motions.description: Council received requests for nominations for various bodies: WAMA Member – State Tourism Council; Four WAMA Members – WA Tourism Commission Visitor Servicing Reference Group; WAMA Member – Forest Health Advisory Committee; WAMA Member – 2001 International Year of Volunteers Committee.

motions.title: Shenton Park Integrated Transport Study - Package B Endorsement
motions.description: Council considered completion of Draft Report from Shenton Park Integrated Transport Study. Steering Committee recommended Package B as best option incorporating new subway south of Aberdare Road and Bus Only bridge north of Aberdare Road with shared pathway improvements. Study evaluated 29 options resulting in 6 packages (A-F). Package B universally accepted by Mayors on 20 July 2000. Comprehensive support and consultation program proposed.

motions.title: Parking Facilities Local Law Amendments - Confirmation
motions.description: Council confirmed proposed amendments to Town of Cambridge Parking Facilities Local Law originally adopted in principle on 22 February 2000. Amendments include overlength vehicle parking (max 8 metres for 1 hour in 24 hours), parking on reserves, and prohibited parking provisions (exposed for sale, unlicensed, unattached trailers/caravans, illegal repairs). Public advertisement period expired with no submissions received.

motions.title: Boulevard construction works deferral and reporting
motions.description: Deferral of construction works for The Boulevard between Kirkdale Avenue and Floreat Avenue pending review of Floreat Forum development plans. Committee meeting on 8 August 2000 discussed concerns about deferral and agreed to request progress reports in September and October 2000. Administration to advise Lend Lease that construction works will be deferred until October 2000, with commencement as planned if development plans not finalised by that date.

motions.title: Petition - Dogs off leash at Bent Park
motions.description: Petition containing 146 signatures requesting that dogs be exercised off leash at Bent Park between 7 pm and 8 am, submitted by Juliet Gisbourne.

motions.title: Petition - Chipping Road reticulation and maintenance
motions.description: Petition signed by 97 residents requesting reticulation of grass along Chipping Road from Kinkuna Way to Aruma Way, beautification of adjacent scrub, removal of rubbish, and removal of rusted wire fence.

motions.title: Leave of Absence approvals
motions.description: Approval for leave of absence for Cr MacRae from 9 May to 6 June 2011 and Cr Pelczar from 30 April to 10 May 2011.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 22 March 2011.

motions.title: Mixed use development - Loftus Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for mixed use development comprising nine storey building with basement car park, offices, multiple dwellings, restaurant and local shop at Lots 1, 9 and 10 (Nos. 3-5) Loftus Street, West Leederville.

motions.title: Two single storey grouped dwellings - Jersey Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for two single storey grouped dwellings in battleaxe configuration at Lot 264 (No. 161) Jersey Street, Wembley with nil setbacks to northern side boundary.

motions.title: Two storey grouped dwelling - Kimberley Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two storey grouped dwelling with skillion roof and parapet wall at rear strata lot, Lot 2 (No. 59B) Kimberley Street, West Leederville.

motions.title: Two storey grouped dwelling, Kimberley Street
motions.description: Application for a two storey grouped dwelling submitted by B Ansems and G Petkovic at Lot 2 (No. 59B) Kimberley Street, West Leederville. Amended plans dated 12 April 2011 satisfy the initial parapet wall condition.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling, McKenzie Street
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at Lot 1295 (No. 124) McKenzie Street, Wembley. Proposed skillion roof ranges from 18 to 35 degree pitch in lieu of 22 to 35 degrees requirement. Assessment against performance criteria regarding roof pitch and architectural character.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling with undercroft garage, Barnsley Road
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at Lot 39 (No. 10) Barnsley Road, Mount Claremont. Building height variation and setbacks from boundary. Site slopes down 4 metres from west to east boundary. Skillion roof ranges from 6.5 to 8.5 metres in lieu of 7.5 metres maximum.

motions.title: Additions and alterations to existing dwelling, Carlton Street
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to an existing single storey dwelling at Lot 9 (No. 10) Carlton Street, West Leederville. Extension is new living room and deck to rear. Living room extension set back 1.0 metre in lieu of 1.5 metres from northern side boundary.

motions.title: Amendment to roofing material, Dampier Street
motions.description: Amended development application for use of off-white (Surfmist) colorbond roofing material on second storey addition at Lot 788 (No. 2) Dampier Street, City Beach. Original approval prohibited zincalume or off-white Colorbond. Applicant seeking approval to match existing ground floor roof.

motions.title: Amendment to roofing material approved, Dampier Street
motions.description: Foreshadowed motion after initial refusal motion was lost. Application for use of off-white (Surfmist) colorbond roofing on upper floor addition to match existing ground floor roof.

motions.title: Nominations for Development Assessment Panel representatives
motions.description: Nomination of elected members as members and alternate members on the Development Assessment Panel to be submitted to the Department of Planning by 13 June 2011. DAPs scheduled to commence operation from 1 July 2011.

motions.title: Biodiversity Action Plan 2011-2015 endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of the Biodiversity Action Plan 2011-2015 for implementation. Plan provides prioritized actions for protecting biodiversity of Town's natural areas and consolidates existing policy. Includes suite of actions at organisational, on-ground and community level.

motions.title: Amendments to Animals Local Law
motions.description: Proposed amendments to the Town of Cambridge Animal Local Law regarding dog exercise areas, prohibited areas, and on-leash areas as recommended by committee.

motions.title: Amendment to Animals Local Law - Additional Parks
motions.description: Committee amendment to add four additional parks (Bent Park, Cowden Park, Lothian Park West, Rutter Park) as dog exercise areas with restricted hours (on-leash 8am-6pm).

motions.title: Appointment of Acting Chair
motions.description: Procedural motion to appoint Cr MacRae as chair in the absence of Mayor Withers during consideration of the Animal Local Law amendments due to declared proximity interest.

motions.title: Permission to Allow Interested Councillors to Remain
motions.description: Procedural motion under Local Government Act 1995 s5.68 to allow Mayor Withers, Crs Langer and Pinerua who declared proximity interests to remain present, participate in discussions and vote as their interest is common to a significant number of electors or ratepayers.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications March 2011
motions.description: Receipt of report on matters dealt with under delegated authority during March 2011, including building permits and applications referred to Western Australian Planning Commission.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Receipt of monthly statistics of building licences approved under delegated authority for March 2011, showing 68 licences approved with construction value of $10,464,088.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council - City of Stirling Withdrawal
motions.description: Council decision regarding the methodology for valuing assets and liabilities of Mindarie Regional Council in relation to City of Stirling's proposed withdrawal, including rejection of Discounted Cash Flow method and support for Adjusted Book Value approach.

motions.title: Road Rehabilitation and Road Improvement Grants 2012/2013
motions.description: Endorsement of nine road rehabilitation projects for submission to Main Roads WA for Metropolitan Regional Road Grants funding in 2012/13 financial year, with total estimated cost of $1,195,200 and estimated grant of $796,800.

motions.title: Salvado Road - Proposed Cycle Path
motions.description: Approval for design and public consultation process for proposed cycle path on Salvado Road between Selby Street and Haydn Bunton Drive (2,200 metres) in conjunction with City of Subiaco, with $800,000 contribution proposed for 2011/12 Draft Budget.

motions.title: Park Trees Management Plan 2011-2021 deferral
motions.description: Draft Park Trees Management Plan 2011-2021 was to be received and circulated for public comment. During discussion at committee meeting, Members agreed the item should be further discussed at a Council Forum.

motions.title: 2011 Financial Assistance to Local Schools
motions.description: Financial assistance disbursement of funds for the 2011 Financial Assistance to Local Schools program. Three applications received from City Beach Primary School, Kapinara Primary School and Wembley Primary School, totalling approximately $4,599 (GST exclusive) with total recommendation of $4,000.

motions.title: City Beach Tennis Club upgrade - deferral motion
motions.description: Proposed upgrade to facilities at City Beach Tennis Club involving installation of lights on courts 13-16, with concerns raised about anti-social behaviour, visual impact, and noise. Committee meeting discussion revealed member concerns.

motions.title: City Beach Tennis Club upgrade - refer back to committee
motions.description: Motion to refer the City Beach Tennis Club upgrade item back to Community and Resources Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: City Beach Tennis Club upgrade - first amendment
motions.description: Amendment to add conditions regarding use of lights (Monday-Thursday only), management plans, boundary fence covering, and Town actions including bollards, fencing, decommissioning lights, and playground investigation.

motions.title: City Beach Tennis Club upgrade - second amendment (two sets)
motions.description: Amendment to add the words 'two sets of' following the words 'the installation of' in clause (ii) of the motion.

motions.title: City Beach Tennis Club upgrade - third amendment (playground)
motions.description: Amendment to add a further clause investigating with the club the option of establishing a playground within the eastern boundary of the tennis club.

motions.title: City Beach Tennis Club upgrade - final decision
motions.description: Final council decision on City Beach Tennis Club proposed upgrade to facilities including lighting installation on courts 13-16.

motions.title: Constitutional recognition of local government
motions.description: Council decision on whether to support the Australian Local Government Association's campaign for constitutional recognition of local government. Administration recommended support for ALGA campaign and federal referendum.

motions.title: Review of Ward Boundaries and Representation
motions.description: Review of ward boundaries and representation conducted in accordance with Local Government Act 1995 Schedule 2.2. Public consultation period closed 11 April 2011 with no submissions received. Four options considered; recommendation is to maintain existing two-ward structure.

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - March 2011
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for March 2011 in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Schedule includes cheque payments, electronic fund transfers for investments, direct bank charges, accounts payable, golf course, and payroll.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - March 2011
motions.description: Report on council's surplus funds invested, distribution, and financial performance including interest earned year to date. Total investment at end of March 2011 is $23.6 million with weighted average interest rate of 6.07%.

motions.title: Purchase of Storage Area Network (SAN) Hardware and Software
motions.description: Council approval to purchase Storage Area Network hardware and software from Xpanse Pty Ltd for $136,000 without calling for tenders, as it is the sole supplier willing to provide Netapp technology before 30 June 2011. Part of disaster recovery strategy implementation.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements, Review and Variances - March 2011
motions.description: Review of financial position for period ended 31 March 2011 with analysis of permanent and timing variances. Key indicators show working capital of $25,913k, investments of $23,556k, capital expenditure of $9,820k against budget of $8,886k, and operating profit of $7,017k.

motions.title: Community Facilities Management Advisory Committee - Minutes
motions.description: Presentation of minutes from Community Facilities Management Advisory Committee meetings held on 18 February and 22 March 2011. Committee established to develop policy on Community Building Management (Leasing and Maintenance).

motions.title: Community Facilities Asset Management and Leasing Policy
motions.description: Adoption of Community Facilities Asset Management Policy and standard lease document for associations leasing Town-owned facilities, with effective date 1 July 2011. Includes provisions for maintenance fund contributions, recycling bins, and lease termination provisions.

motions.title: Lease Clause 18.1 Amendment - Premises Destruction
motions.description: Amendment to clause 18.1 of the Community Facilities Lease regarding termination provisions when premises are substantially destroyed.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - 20KW hydraulic mowers

Three complying tenders assessed on specification conformity, historical performance, organisation profile, and value for money. Victa Lawnmowers selected based on superior performance capability at Wembley Golf Course.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - 15-18KW ride on rotary mowers

Eight complying bids assessed on specification, performance, organisation, and value. CJD Equipment selected for John Deere F1145 based on superior historical performance and lowest cost.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - triplex greens mowers
motions.description: Tender for the supply and delivery of three 12KW triplex greens mowers for golf complex. Five bids received with two non-complying. Three complying bids assessed. motions.title: Tender acceptance - 47KW 4WD tractors
motions.description: Tender for the supply and delivery of two 4 wheel drive 47KW tractors for golf complex. Seven bids received with all complying with specification. Assessed on performance, organisation, and value. Wattleup Tractors selected for Massey Ferguson 390 based on historical performance and operator knowledge, consistent with existing fleet.

motions.title: Street tree removal and replacement - Marlow and Grantham Streets
motions.description: Request from Councillor regarding removal and replacement of street tree at corner of Marlow and Grantham Streets, Wembley. Tree fell on 12 September 1995 due to termite infestation. Report from tree surgeon details poor condition. Council Policy No. 151 requires trees planted minimum five metres from driveway crossover. Amendment moved to plant replacement tree as mature as possible with metal guard.

motions.title: National Public Libraries Conference attendance
motions.description: Council registration for 1995 National Public Libraries Conference in Sydney 12-15 November 1995. Theme 'Public Libraries - What are they Worth?'. Policy No. 49 allows max two councillors and one officer attendance at interstate conferences. Councillor K Smith and Executive Manager Corporate & Customer Services proposed. Clauses (i) and (ii) carried; Clause (iii) requiring absolute majority for unbudgeted expenditure lost.

motions.title: Disability Services Plan - consultant engagement
motions.description: Western Australian Disability Services Act (1993) requires each local government to develop and implement a disability service plan. Town must lodge plan by 1 January 1996. Due to restructuring, Council engaged consultant to prepare plan. Geof Whyte & Associates recommended at cost of $3,000.

motions.title: Commission on Government - political finance submissions

motions.title: Beach inspection services contract - Surf Life Saving WA
motions.description: Former City of Perth provided beach inspection/lifeguard services for Floreat and City Beaches. Town of Cambridge employs casual beach inspector. Council held discussions with Surf Life Saving WA to provide service on contract basis. Proposal includes full-time and part-time inspectors, lifeguards, patrols from 6am-7pm summer, 9am-5pm winter. Cost $90,296 without vehicle.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre children's services funding agreements

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre respite services funding agreement

motions.title: West Coast Highway realignment
motions.description: Council re-briefed by project consultants Mitchell McCotter at public meeting 27 September 1995. Council expresses concern that Department of Environmental Protection imposed unreasonable constraints on project area, sacrificing safety factors. Urges department review to expand boundary for junction system design. CEO authorised to request DEP action.

motions.description: Identification and prioritisation of twelve future tree planting strategies within Lake Monger Reserve to be included in the Lake Monger Reserve Improvement Program.

motions.title: Road Funding Model for Five-Year Capital Works Program
motions.description: Council considered a report providing background data for the development of the 2000/2001 Budget for Works and Engineering under Asset Management and Capital Projects. The report reviewed Asset Management Programs for laneways, road resurfacing, and footpaths, with expenditure levels previously increased. It proposed a five-year road program framework with specific funding allocations across projects including Boulevard/Grantham Street works, Black Spot programs, District Distributor Road upgrading, Traffic Management, Road Intersection Issues, and School Parking and traffic calming.

motions.title: Parks and Landscape Budget 2000/2001 with Service Improvements
motions.description: Council considered a report providing background information for the development of the Parks and Landscape Budget for 2000/2001 under Operating and Capital Works headings. The report detailed existing funding levels for maintenance of ocean beaches, sportsgrounds, parks, road reserves, street trees, and Wembley Golf Complex. It recommended continuing current service levels while providing improved funding for Street Trees Management, Playground Management, Park Trees Management, Remnant Bushland Management, and Road Reserves Maintenance, requiring an additional Technical Officer position.

motions.title: Adopt Local Government Statutory Compliance Assessment Return 1999
motions.description: Council considered the Local Government Statutory Compliance Assessment Return for the period 1 January to 31 December 1999, as required by the Department of Local Government. The 1999 Return was noted as the last voluntary return; from January 2000 there is a legal requirement to annually complete such returns. The completed return was attached to the notice paper.

motions.title: Confirm Delegated Authority Decisions - Christmas Recess 1999/2000
motions.description: Council considered a report noting action taken over the Christmas recess 1999/2000 in accordance with delegated powers given to the Chief Executive Officer on 21 December 1999. Two items were dealt with: a proposed single dwelling application at Lot 35 (No. 120A) Kimberley Street, West Leederville, which was approved; and approval for the Western Australian Tourism Commission to hold a launch event at Lake Monger with matched grant funding for environmental works.

motions.title: Endorse Prospectus for Single Association of Local Government in WA
motions.description: Council considered advice from the Western Australian Municipal Association (WAMA) regarding a proposal to form a single Association of Local Government in Western Australia. A discussion paper developed from an options paper previously circulated was finalised and endorsed for distribution to member Local Governments. WAMA requested feedback by 3 March 2000, with a final report anticipated for the August 2000 AGM of relevant associations.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium Redevelopment - Deferred for Internal Workshop
motions.description: Council considered a comprehensive report on the future use of Perry Lakes Stadium and associated sporting facilities. A Joint Working Group comprising council and state government representatives had met three times and progressed investigations. The report detailed proposals for relocation of athletics, rugby, and basketball facilities, rezoning of the stadium site, bridging finance arrangements, and delegated authority for a development committee. During discussion, council members agreed to defer consideration pending an internal workshop on the matter.

motions.title: Approve Town of Cambridge Enterprise Bargaining Agreements 2000
motions.description: Council considered and approved Enterprise Bargaining Agreements (EBA) for the Town's Salaried Officers and Outside Workers, following negotiations over six to ten months. A secret ballot conducted 3 February 2000 resulted in 78 votes in favour and 6 against for the Salaried Officers Agreement, and 13 in favour and 19 against for the Outside Workers Agreement. The agreements provided wage increases, workplace flexibility, sick leave incentives, effectiveness indicators, and multi-skilling provisions over a two-year period with total financial implications of $494,000.

motions.title: Nominate Councillor to Attend ENVIRO 2000 Conference
motions.description: Council considered nominations for attendance at ENVIRO 2000, the first integrated environment event combining five Australian Waste Convention, Odour Conference, Watertech Conference, and Australian Greenhouse Conference, to be held at Sydney Convention and Exhibition Centre from 9 to 13 April 2000 at an approximate cost of $2,555. Cr MacRae was nominated during discussion.

motions.title: Nominate Mayor, CEO and Executive Manager to IMM National Congress
motions.description: Council considered attendance at the Institute of Municipal Management (IMM) National Congress 'InterActive 2000' to be held at Melbourne Convention Centre commencing 28 May 2000. The Congress provides 30 sessions covering management, governance, and interactive streams, recognised as a quality congress internationally. The Chief Executive Officer is a past State and Federal President of IMM. The recommendation was amended during committee discussion to include the Mayor and an Executive Manager selected by the CEO.

motions.title: West Coast Bridge Club rent review increase
motions.description: West Coast Bridge Club requested waiver of 1.7% rent review increase ($225 per annum) due 1 November 1999. Club has 513 members with 33% from Town of Cambridge. Financial statements show club is financially well off with $171,674 invested. Expected operating cost increases of $7,371 due to increased fees and GST. Recommendation made not to accede to request given club's strong financial position.

motions.title: Parking Facilities Local Law amendments
motions.description: Amendments to Town of Cambridge Parking Facilities Local Law to incorporate additional offences and accompanying penalties. Three new clauses proposed: (i) Overlength Vehicle Parking - vehicles over 8 metres length not to park on carriageway/verge for more than 1 hour in 24 hours, penalty $40; (ii) Parking on Reserves - prohibition on parking vehicles in public reserves without permission, penalty $60; (iii) Prohibited Parking of Vehicles - covering vehicles exposed for sale, unlicensed vehicles, unattached trailers/caravans, and vehicles undergoing repairs on roads, penalty $40. Amendments to be advertised for public comment.

motions.title: Underground Power North Wembley/West Leederville project
motions.description: North Wembley/West Leederville Underground Power project selected for State Government Round 2 Underground Power Program. Project will be completed over two years commencing July 2000, with physical work expected to commence early 2002. Project includes 1,430 lots with estimated total cost of $5.72 million (50% State Government, 50% local). Proposal includes Herdsman Parade, Cambridge Street from Southport to Jersey Street. Daglish properties (approximately 30 lots south of Hay Street) may be included in City of Subiaco's Underground Power Project. Funding model based on principles including fixed connection charge ($500) and network charge based on Gross Rental Value. CEO to negotiate and enter into agreement with State Government. Residents in expanded areas to be consulted prior to agreement execution.

motions.title: Lot 102 Tower Street West Leederville retrospective solid door carport approval - REFUSED
motions.description: Application by DS and M Kestel for retrospective approval of solid door installed on carport at Lot 102 (No 132) Tower Street, West Leederville. Preliminary building licence granted 26 November 1997 required carport remain open on all sides. Carport enclosure reclassifies structure as garage requiring 6 metre front setback; structure set back only 0.3 metres. Applicant argued security concerns due to car break-ins and pedestrian thoroughfare to freeway footbridge/train station. Council found proposal contravenes Residential Design Guidelines and R Codes, presents loss of visual permeability and blank facade adverse to streetscape amenity and continuity. Applicant advised solid door must be removed but Council would consider see-through iron doors/gates as alternative.

motions.title: Wembley Hotel three flag poles approval
motions.description: Planning approval sought for three flag poles at Wembley Hotel, Lot 7 (No 344) Cambridge Street, Wembley. Poles proposed at 7 metres height attached to hotel front wall fence piers; flags 2.4 metres long by 0.8 metres wide (1.92 square metres each). Non-compliant with Policy Manual standards (max 6 metres height, max 2 poles per 20 metres frontage, max 1.5 square metres per flag). Council found proposal adds character to streetscape, consistent with Wembley Town Centre Study recommendations for high profile locations, complements hotel as focal point. Approval granted by absolute majority subject to flag size condition limiting to 1.5 square metres maximum.

motions.title: Lot 139 St Vincents Avenue home occupation approval
motions.description: Retrospective planning approval sought for home occupation (Computer Consultant and Personal Growth Facilitator) at Lot 139 (No 16) St Vincents Avenue, West Leederville. Applicant P Graham operates registered business as computer consultant conducting work mostly internet/e-commerce context, contracted to TEDIS Pty Ltd working part-time from home office, and part-time personal growth facilitator work. Floor area of business 16.5 square metres. Average 3-4 clients per week, mostly one-on-one sessions 1.5 to 2 hours duration, before 10pm. Ample parking available. No neighbour complaints received. Council found operation small scale and compatible with surrounding residential uses given 3-year operating history without complaints, consistent with Home Occupation Policy aims.

motions.title: City Beach High School international school development - APPROVED with conditions
motions.description: Application for planning approval on MRS Reserve for international school, student accommodation, theatre, teaching block and sports pavilion at City Beach High School, Reserve 29923 Kalinda Drive, City Beach (10.6 hectares). International day and boarding school offering curriculum grades 6-10, projected 240 students (half boarders) for 2001. Proposed residential units (two storey, blocks of 3-6) accommodating 8 students and 1 tutor per unit. Students not permitted to own cars; tutors allocated one space, two visitor bays per three units. Total 105 additional parking bays. Three phases: Phase 1 - 21 residential units; Phase 2 - 21 residential units/performing arts centre; Phase 3 - 21 residential units/teaching block/sports pavilion. Development would provide underutilised school continued use. Council expressed concern regarding potential impact on local school viability; requested WAPC investigate this matter. Condition requires landscaping plan prior to building licence issue.

motions.title: Lot 339 Pangbourne Street aged persons housing - REFUSED
motions.description: Application for planning approval for three single storey aged persons dwellings (over 55 residences) at Lot 339 (No 16) Pangbourne Street, Wembley (951 square metres). R20 zoning permits two grouped dwellings. Applicant seeks approval for three units exercising 50% density bonus available under R Codes for aged persons dwellings. Units range 152-177 square metres with two bedrooms plus all-purpose room potential. Non-compliances include: primary street setback 5.89 metres (required 6), carport setback 1.515 metres (required 2), open space 49% (required 50%), private open space 81 square metres per dwelling (required 150), paving 77% of front setback (guideline 40%). Council found units not designed as special purpose for aged persons, lacking wheelchair access features, and development out of character with low density R20 residential area. Recommendation refused due to built form inconsistent with locality and failure to meet aged persons policy design criteria.

motions.title: Lots 5 and 6 Cambridge Street five residences preliminary building approval

Five lots total: 4 lots of 220 square metres, 1 lot of 221 square metres. Each residence comprises living room, dining area, kitchen, laundry and double garage ground floor; three bedrooms, bathroom and ensuite upper floor. Garages built to side boundary with nil setback; rear accessway access. Church (Municipal Inventory listed, to be retained); presbytery to be demolished.

Regional route proposal deferred due to existing $80,000 contribution to City to Sea Greenway.

Nine tenders received in March 1997. Tender designed to allow providers to tender for any one or more categories.

motions.title: Lake Monger Rehabilitation
motions.description: Progress on Lake Monger Rehabilitation Project approved February 1997. Steering Group established with Executive Manager Technical Services, Parks Manager, Technical Officer (Parks), and project consultant David Kabay. Department of Environmental Protection clearance sought. Implementation plan for Zones 5 and 6 includes removal of above ground biomass, earthworks for fauna refuges, and planting. Indicative cost $109,000 excluding project management. Timeframe end May 1997 to mid September 1997.

Preferred location for planting is Hale Road south side from West Coast Highway junction proceeding eastwards. Plantings would be conducted in winter season with volunteer labour from community groups. Town to coordinate volunteers and arrange insurance.

motions.title: Financial Statement Period Ending 31 March 1997

Works and Engineering programs expected to achieve on or below budget outcome.

Business rules applied: major projects funded from appropriate Reserves; Parks/Landscapes funding guidance $211,000; Works/Engineering funding guidance $510,000. Lake Monger and Perry lakes proposed for final phase.

motions.title: Single dwelling at Pandora Drive, City Beach

motions.title: Two single storey residences at Salvado Road, Floreat

motions.title: Two two-storey single dwellings at Joseph Street
