motions.title: Single dwelling at Glenties Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for single storey residential dwelling with variation to front setback for double garage encroachment.

motions.title: Refuse application - Preliminary Building Licence (46 St Leonards Avenue)
motions.description: Application for additions and renovations to existing residential dwelling at Lot 332, No. 46 St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville. Non-compliance with Council Policy No. 13 – Plot Ratio and Residential Planning Codes in relation to side setback and open space provisions.

motions.title: Approve Building Licence - Lot 34 Elimatta Way, City Beach
motions.description: Application for proposed additions and alterations to single residential dwelling (two storey) at Lot 34 (No.13) Elimatta Way, City Beach. Applicant seeks approval to vary front setback from 7.5 metres to 1.8 metres (carport) and 5.8 metres (verandah). Adjoining landowners have no objection.

motions.title: Approve Building Licence - Lot 475 McKenzie Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for proposed additions and alterations (two level) to existing dwelling at Lot 475, No.41 McKenzie Street, Wembley. Includes family/dining room, carport, two bedrooms and bathroom. Applicant seeks approval for side setback variations and side wall highlight window.

motions.title: Approve Restaurant - Lot 3 The Boulevard, City Beach
motions.description: Application for Planning Approval to use one of the tenancies at new shopping centre at 316 The Boulevard, City Beach as a Restaurant and Take Away Food outlet. Tenancy 4 is the largest tenancy directly abutting main entry plaza, offering 40 customer seats. Minor variation to car parking standards required (11 bays proposed vs. 13 required).

motions.title: Refuse office extension - Lots 1 and 580 Grantham Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for extension to existing vacant shop premises (granted conditional Planning Approval for office use) by 79 square metres at corner of Grantham and Keane Streets, Wembley. Site has non-conforming use rights. Council previously refused 118 square metre extension in February 1998.

motions.title: Refer back to Committee - Lot 452 McCourt Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Motion to refer the item relating to proposed second storey extension to existing consulting room at Lot 452 (No. 42) McCourt Street, West Leederville back to Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration, as requested by the applicant.

motions.title: Refer back to Committee - Pylon and Facia Signs, Cambridge Street, Wembley
motions.description: Motion to refer back to Development and Environmental Services Committee the application for pylon sign and facia signs at Lots 43, 44 and 45 (No. 353) Cambridge Street, Wembley to enable further discussions with applicant regarding building-mounted sign.

motions.title: Approve retaining wall and front fence - Lot 96 Wayeela Place, City Beach
motions.description: Application for retaining wall and front fence along front boundary with varying heights from 1.5 to 2.4 metres at Lot 96, No.14 Wayeela Place, City Beach. Property is elevated above street level approximately 1.5 metres. Applicant amended plans to show minimum 50% open view fencing above 1.2 metres to reduce streetscape impact.

motions.title: Refuse garage application - Lot 680 Holland Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for proposed garage to existing residential dwelling at Lot 680, No.54 Holland Street, Wembley. Applicant seeks approval for side setback variation. Adjoining owners object to proposed parapet wall as it will block sunlight into their bedroom and bathroom.

motions.title: Approve patio - Lot 3 Kimberley Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for patio (approximately 35 square metres) at rear of single residential dwelling at Lot 3 (No. 73) Kimberley Street, West Leederville. Variation to open space provisions from 50% to 46.4%, equating to 12.5 square metres shortfall.

motions.title: Adopt Interim Delegation Policy - Town Planning Scheme No 1
motions.description: Motion to adopt interim delegation policy following gazettal of Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme No 1 on 31 March 1998. Policy sets out matters that may be determined by Chief Executive Officer (or nominated representative) versus those presented to Council. Delegation policy cannot be finalised until Scheme Policy Manual review is completed.

motions.title: Write to Minister opposing planning appeal amendments
motions.description: Motion to write to Minister for Planning, State Members of Parliament, and Opposition Spokesperson regarding opposition to amendments to Town Planning and Development Act 1928 to introduce right of appeal against decision of Local Authority not to initiate amendment to Town Planning Scheme. WA Municipal Association opposes proposal.

motions.title: Planning Policy for Corner Lots in Wembley
motions.description: Proposal to permit corner lots within the area bounded by Gregory Street, Grantham Street, Harborne Street and the rear of lots fronting Cambridge Street to be developed with a maximum of two dwellings in accordance with R30 standards. This matter was previously considered in August 1996 and deferred for reconsideration within 12 months. The proposal has been discussed by the Committee.

motions.title: Closure of Private Street - Dodd Street and Walker Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application to initiate closure procedures for a private street (right of way) between Dodd Street and Walker Street, Wembley, comprising approximately 470 square metres. The closure is sought to enhance security of adjoining owners and alleviate disputes about maintenance. The laneway is unsealed but well maintained. Eight properties abut the laneway.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment - Harborne Street Extension Response
motions.description: Response to Subiaco Redevelopment Authority regarding a subdivision application and the extension of Harborne Street from Roydhouse Street to Hood Street, creating seven new lots. The Town had previously opposed the Harborne Street extension through to Roberts Road. The proposal is consistent with the redevelopment plan but the Town has ongoing concerns about traffic impacts.

motions.title: Outcome of Legal Action - Illegal Building at 50 Simper Street
motions.description: Report on the outcome of legal proceedings against [private individual — name withheld] of 50 Simper Street, Wembley for contravention of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1960. The case was heard on 30 March 1998 before Magistrate Malley. [private individual — name withheld] entered a plea of guilty. The magistrate found her guilty and imposed a fine of $400, ordered costs of $649, and ordered removal of the illegal structure within 56 days.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for the month of March 1998. For March 1998: 51 building licences issued (compared to 31 in March 1997), 2 preliminary building licences, 13 demolition licences, with construction value of $3,410,591 (compared to $1,977,164 in March 1997).

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions and notifications for March 1998, including subdivision decisions, appeals received and determined. Two subdivisions approved under delegation: 4 Alexander Street, Wembley and 107 St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville. Two appeals received against Council decisions with the Minister for Planning. One appeal determined by the Minister for Planning (upheld).

motions.title: Refusal of Consulting Rooms Application - Niola Hospital
motions.description: Motion to refuse an application by Greg Rowe and Associates Pty Ltd on behalf of owners E J Bevan and C S Coyne for consulting rooms at Lots 5 and 4 (Nos. 10 and 12) Abbotsford Street, West Leederville. The application is opposed because the uses proposed are prohibited under Town Planning Scheme No. 1. The motion includes serving notices requiring cessation of office, consulting room and hospital uses, and removal of a temporary transportable used for patient accommodation at Nos. 61-69 Cambridge Street. The application represents an ad hoc expansion of commercial activities beyond appropriately zoned areas.

motions.title: Western Suburbs Highway Fighting Fund Contribution
motions.description: Motion to include $10,000 in the 1998/99 budget as the Town's contribution to a Western Suburbs Highway fighting fund. The fund is being developed by the Mayors' Steering Committee to provide a cohesive approach by local governments along the 40km highway length (from Innaloo to Rockingham) to work with the State Government on highway construction. An amendment to reduce the amount to $5,000 was moved but lost.

motions.title: Transform WA Initiative - Transport Policy Response
motions.description: Motion noting the Western Australian government's Transform WA initiative and expressing Council's views on transport policy. The Council reaffirms its support for a modern, efficient and environmentally friendly network of transport options, expresses disappointment at the lack of public consultation, criticises the overwhelming emphasis on buses and lack of emphasis on other commuter options, and advocates for greater emphasis on rail transport solutions.

motions.title: Appointment to WAMA - National Parks and Nature Conservation Authority
motions.description: Nomination of Cr McConnell as a WAMA Member to the National Parks and Nature Conservation Authority. The position is for a one-year term, meeting monthly at CALM, Hackett Drive, Crawley. Nominations close with WAMA on Monday 18 May 1998.

motions.title: Underground Power Program - Staging Approval
motions.description: Urgent business item regarding the staging of underground power installation throughout the Town of Cambridge. A submission must be prepared by 30 April 1998 for the State Government's Underground Power Steering Committee. The revised staging proposes five stages covering approximately 5,600 lots total. Amendment 1 swapped the priority of Floreat North West and Wembley West stages. Amendment 2 added a clause requiring contact with adjoining councils regarding coverage of Mt Claremont, Jolimont and Daglish portions.

motions.title: 1998/99 Budget and Special Meetings
motions.description: Confidential item regarding the 1998/99 budget. Administration requested to incorporate Council amendments for further consideration in May 1998. Two special meetings scheduled: one for Council on 5 May 1998 at 5:30pm to consider the budget, and one for Development and Environmental Services Committee on 7 May 1998 at 5:30pm to consider the Coastal Planning Study.

motions.title: Meeting Behind Closed Doors
motions.description: Procedural motion to regard CEO recruitment matters as confidential in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(e)(ii) of the Local Government Act 1995

motions.title: CEO Recruitment Matters Approval
motions.description: Council decision to approve the confidential recommendation as amended and outlined in the confidential CEO recruitment report

motions.title: Exit Closed Session
motions.description: Procedural motion to exit closed session and return to open council

motions.title: Endorsement of Draft 2012/2013 Budget
motions.description: A Special Meeting of Council was held to consider the Draft 2012/2013 Budget for the year ending 30 June 2013. The budget includes a general rate increase of 5.5% and allocates funding to infrastructure capital works, parks improvement and sustainability programs.

motions.title: Amendment to Draft 2012/2013 Budget
motions.description: An amendment was proposed to the Draft 2012/2013 Budget to add and delete various works and projects, with net changes to capital works and funding sources.

motions.title: Committee Recommendation for Draft 2012/2013 Budget
motions.description: Following the amendment moved by Mayor Withers and seconded by Cr MacRae, the Committee Recommendation incorporated the amended budget details.

motions.title: Receipt of Petitions
motions.description: Two petitions relating to traffic management in Wembley were submitted to the Technical Services Committee. The first from CJ Proud (36 signatories) regarding left-out restrictions at Herdsman Parade and Collier Street. The second from residents of Daglish Street North (78 signatories) supporting the Wembley Traffic Management Community Consultative Committee report recommendations.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 24 April 2001.

motions.title: Wembley Traffic Management Plan - Council Workshop
motions.description: Response to Wembley Traffic Management Community Consultative Committee report and other associated traffic management reports for the Wembley precinct; issues include recommendations for road hierarchy, traffic calming, and Daglish Street management.

motions.title: Street Lighting Strategy Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the Street Lighting Strategy Report February 2001, prepared by Sage Consulting Engineers Pty Ltd, to establish upgraded street lighting policy for the Town in accordance with new Australian Standards AS/NZS 1158.

motions.title: Australian Pedestrian Charter Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of the Australian Pedestrian Charter developed by the Pedestrian Council of Australia, promoting walking as an integral part of sustainable communities and neighbourhood design.

motions.title: TravelSmart Individualised Marketing Partnership
motions.description: Expression of interest in Transport WA's Partnership Funding proposal for TravelSmart Individualised Marketing program to reduce local traffic movements through alternative transport modes.

motions.title: TravelSmart Amendment - Budget Inclusion Wording
motions.description: Amendment to motion relating to TravelSmart proposal changing wording from 'included' to 'considered for inclusion' within the 2001/2002 Draft Budget.

motions.title: Tender Acceptance - Lake Monger Reserve Parking
motions.description: Acceptance of tender submission for construction of carparking facility with access road at Powis Street/Dodd Street, Lake Monger Reserve.

motions.title: Local Government Association Annual General Meeting 2001
motions.description: Registration of Mayor, Council delegates, Chief Executive Officer and interested Councillors to attend the 2001 Local Government Week Convention at Burswood Convention Centre, 5-7 August 2001.

motions.title: Policy on Legal Representation and Costs Indemnification
motions.description: Adoption of a Council policy to provide financial assistance to Elected Members and employees for legal representation costs in specified situations involving civil legal proceedings.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for expenses incurred by the Town in accordance with Regulation 13 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - April 2001
motions.description: Presentation of the investment schedule for surplus Council funds for the period ended 30 April 2001, showing distribution and financial performance of investments.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements - April 2001
motions.description: Financial Statements for the period ended 30 April 2001 to be received.

motions.title: Financial Statements Review - March 2001
motions.description: Review of the Town's financial performance and budget variations for the period ended 31 March 2001, including budget reallocations and adjustments.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge affixed to various documents including employment contracts and deed of amalgamation.

motions.title: Seniors Needs Study - Endorsement of Objectives
motions.description: Presentation and endorsement of the Seniors Needs Study report, policy objectives, and implementation schedule.

motions.title: Cambridge Youth Centre Operations Report
motions.description: Report for the period July 2000 to April 2001 covering operations including grants, Perry Lakes Skate Park completion, and future plans for youth services expansion.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges – Sports Grounds and Reserves
motions.description: Review of fee structure for sports grounds and reserves for 2001/2002 financial year, incorporating 2.5% CPI increase and amendments to Policy Number 2.1.18 regarding junior discount rates to avoid unrealistic fee increases for junior sporting clubs.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Community Halls
motions.description: Review of fee structure for Floreat and Leederville Town Community Halls for 2001/2002 with proposed 2.5% increase in line with CPI and removal of liquor permit fee.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre – Review of Fees and Charges
motions.description: Review of fees and charges for Quarry Amphitheatre including reduction of off-peak season rates to encourage usage, consolidation of performance and wedding rates, and reduction of Quarry Cavern fees to improve competitiveness.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre – Review of Fees and Charges
motions.description: Review of entrance, program and service fees for Bold Park Aquatic Centre following $680,000 refurbishment in 2000/2001. Proposed minor increases to keep facility competitive while maintaining position at lower end of market.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre – Review of Fees and Charges
motions.description: Review of fees for Joan Watters Community Centre, Cambridge Senior Services, and Joan Watters Children's Services for 2001/2002. Includes room hire increases, program fees, and new fee structures for children's services.

motions.title: Disability Services Advisory Committee – Minutes
motions.description: Receipt of minutes from Disability Services Advisory Committee meeting held Friday 27 April 2001 as part of public record of council business.

motions.title: Beach Users Working Group – Minutes
motions.description: Receipt of minutes from Beach Users Working Group meeting held Wednesday 11 April 2001 as part of public record of council business.

motions.title: Floreat Sporting Precinct Master Plan Financial Options – First Motion (Lost)
motions.description: First motion proposing implementation of works under Floreat Sporting Precinct Master Plan upon availability of funds from City Beach Bowling Club site sale, with administration to meet with clubs regarding leases and rents.

motions.title: Floreat Sporting Precinct Master Plan Financial Options – Second Motion (Carried)
motions.description: Second motion (foreshadowed by Cr Burkett) proposing implementation of works upon completion of Metropolitan Region Scheme Amendment, with bridging finance for Stage 1 works at $3.7 million.

motions.title: Library and Community Amenities Development - Approval
motions.description: Approval of schematic design by Peter Hunt Architects for Library and Community Amenities development, authorization to proceed with detailed documentation and construction tender, display of plans for public information, funding arrangements, statutory procedures, CEO authorization to negotiate land acquisition, naming of new Library, and tender documentation for staged development consideration.

motions.title: Lot 432 McCourt Street - Survey Strata Subdivision
motions.description: Two lot survey strata subdivision application for recommendation to the Western Australian Planning Commission. Non-compliant with lot area requirements for R30 coding but site capable of supporting two dwellings under green title subdivision.

motions.title: Lot 136 Salvado Road Floreat - Survey Strata Subdivision
motions.description: Two lot survey strata subdivision application for recommendation to WAPC. Non-compliant with R15 lot area requirements. Council does not support the application due to significant variation and impact on established character.

motions.title: Lot 4 Cambridge Street - Change of Use to Theological College, Café and Showroom
motions.description: Planning application for change of use from showroom/offices to theological college, café, and showroom offices with renovations. Initial recommendation was refusal due to parking and access issues. Committee majority supported approval with conditions.

motions.title: Two grouped dwellings, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two grouped dwellings (two-storey) at Lot 12 (No.44) Ruislip Street, corner St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville, seeking approval under Town Planning Scheme No. 1.

motions.title: Two two-storey residences, Connolly Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for two two-storey residences at Lot 10 (No. 39) Connolly Street, Wembley, seeking variations to setback, building height, front setback and roof pitch requirements under Town Planning Scheme No. 1.

motions.title: Two storey residence, Tate Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two storey residence at Lot 51 (No.70) Tate Street, West Leederville, seeking variations to setback, front setback and fencing requirements under Town Planning Scheme No.1.

motions.title: Two storey residence, Carlton Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two storey residence at Lot 5 (No.20) Carlton Street, West Leederville, seeking variations to upper floor setback, privacy provisions and open space requirement under Town Planning Scheme No.1.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling, Hovea Crescent, City Beach
motions.description: Amended application for two storey dwelling at Lot 65 (No. 24) Hovea Crescent, City Beach, seeking approval with amendments addressing overshadowing concerns.

motions.title: Additions to single house, Holland Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for additions to existing dwelling including carport and loft at Lot 1663 (No. 136) Holland Street, Wembley, seeking variations to upper floor front setback, side setback and roof pitch requirements.

motions.title: Deck over carport, Helston Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Application for deck over existing carport within front setback area at Lot 238 (No.11) Helston Avenue, City Beach, seeking variations to front setback and privacy requirements under Town Planning Scheme No.1.

motions.title: Carport enclosure, Salvado Road, Wembley
motions.description: Application for carport enclosure with roller door at Lot 816 (No.110) Salvado Road, Wembley, seeking approval for partial enclosure of carport and variation to front setback requirements under Town Planning Scheme No. 1.

motions.title: Carport enclosure at Lot 816 Salvado Road
motions.description: Application for carport enclosure to existing carport at Lot 816 (No. 110) Salvado Road, Wembley submitted by G Ossolin ski. The dwelling either side have solid brick walls to the front boundaries. The reduction in setback combined with use of solid garage door would not be out of context with existing streetscape.

motions.title: Front fence at Lot 301 Kinkuna Way
motions.description: Application for front fence by A Di Bucci and Son at Lot 301 (55) Kinkuna Way, City Beach. Landowner D and V Bartulovic. The proposal has a brick and wrought iron fence facing the street and solid brick walls along the side boundaries within the front setback area. Applicant seeks to vary the Town's 80% primary street visual permeability clauses under the Residential Design Guidelines. The proposed fence is 81% solid within the front setback area.

motions.title: Bush Forever report received
motions.description: Report on the State Government's Bush Forever policy released by Ministry for Planning for protection and management of regionally significant vegetation on Swan Coastal Plain portion of Perth Metropolitan Region. Three bush plan sites identified within Town of Cambridge: Area 310 Floreat Bushland, Area 312 Bold Park and adjacent bushland, Area 315 Swanbourne Bushland. Plan protects about 18% of total original vegetation in study area, amounting to 51,200 hectares of regionally significant bushland.

motions.title: Local Government Act Notice for 67 Ruislip Street
motions.description: Notice of departure from approved plans and enforcement action at 67 Ruislip Street, West Leederville. Building licence issued to [private individual — name withheld] as owner/builder on 1 February 2000 for construction of boundary wall and retaining wall. Wall not constructed in accordance with approved plans. Multiple issues identified: walls higher than approved by 600 mm, retaining more fill than approved, constructed with 90mm reconstituted limestone blocks rather than 110mm clay bricks, not suitable for vehicular loads, piers not reinforced.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for April 2001 including two grouped dwellings at 5 Barrett Street and 22 Connolly Street Wembley, two lot subdivisions at multiple locations. Also notifications of appeal determined by Minister for Planning regarding eight single bedroom dwellings at Lots 398 and 399 (No. 150) Cambridge Street, West Leederville, which was upheld on appeal.

motions.title: Building licences approved April 2001 received
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data on building licences issued in April 2001. In April 2001: 34 Building Licences, 0 Sign Licences, 6 Preliminary Building Licences, 4 Demolition Licences. Value of construction $3,604,593. Comparative year to date July 2000 – April 2001: 384 Building Licences, 1 Sign Licence, 30 Preliminary Building Licences, 32 Demolition Licences. Value of construction $33,212,478.

motions.title: Statutory authorities representation nominations
motions.description: Request for Council nominations for appointments to statutory authorities and public bodies. Vacancies include WAMA Metropolitan Member (Elected Member) and WAMA Metropolitan Member (Serving Officer) for State Recycling Advisory Council. Reference to Non-Metropolitan Members deleted during discussion as irrelevant.

motions.title: Amendment to statutory authorities motion
motions.description: Amendment motion to delete reference to Non-Metropolitan Members from the nominations request during discussion, as members suggested these are irrelevant.

motions.title: Policy and Administration Committee meeting time
motions.description: Urgent business item regarding change to meeting commencement times for Policy and Administration Committee from 8.00 pm to 7.30 pm from June 2001, following decision at Special Meeting of Council held on 7 May 2001.

motions.title: Suspend Standing Orders sub-clause 3.3.4
motions.description: Suspension of Standing Orders to allow open discussion on the draft budget

motions.title: Resume Standing Orders sub-clause 3.3.4
motions.description: Resumption of Standing Orders after open discussion

motions.title: Amendment to Draft 2006/2007 Budget
motions.description: Amendment to adjust draft budget items including lighting replacement, community perception survey, and toilet upgrades

motions.title: Adopt Draft 2006/2007 Budget for public comment
motions.description: Final decision to advertise draft budget for public comment and further consideration at July council meeting

motions.title: Fair Value to Land and Buildings noted
motions.description: The Town's Land and Building assets have been revalued in accordance with the Australian Accounting Standard AASB13 Fair Value Measurement. Overall, there is a $0.18 million change to the $152 million portfolio. Land value has increased by $1.2 million and the fair value of buildings has decreased by $1.4 million.

motions.title: Annual Financial Report for year ended 30 June 2017 accepted
motions.description: The audit of the Annual Financial Statements has been completed and an unqualified audit opinion is expected to be issued shortly. The Annual Financial Report is submitted for consideration and referral to Council for adoption.

motions.title: Annual Financial Report amendment - remove minor audit amendments clause
motions.description: During discussion, the Auditor advised that the report was now final and there were no minor amendments to be made. An amendment was moved to delete the words 'subject to any minor audit amendments.'

motions.title: Appointment of Community Representatives to Audit Committee
motions.description: The current external community members of the Town's Audit Committee terms expired in October 2017. The Town is required to appoint new members. This report seeks to advertise for two new members and appoint the members of the interviewing panel.

motions.title: Audit Committee panel amendment - include elected member
motions.description: During discussion, Mayor Shannon suggested that an Elected Member of the Audit Committee should also be on the Panel. An amendment was moved to include Cr Nelson on the interviewing panel.

motions.title: Meeting Behind Closed Doors
motions.description: A motion to regard confidential matters as confidential in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(d) and (e) of the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace, City Beach - Repurchasing Options
motions.description: Council consideration of information with respect to the repurchasing options of Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace, City Beach. This confidential matter was discussed behind closed doors.

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders - Clause 8.13
motions.description: Suspension of Standing Orders Clause 8.13 (Limitation of Number of Addresses) to allow open discussion during the Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace matter.

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders - Clause 8.13
motions.description: Resumption of the operation of Standing Orders Clause 8.13 (Limitation of Number of Addresses) following discussion of the Lot 501 Omaroo Terrace matter.

motions.title: Reopen meeting to public
motions.description: Motion to reopen the meeting to the public following closed session discussion of confidential matters.

motions.title: Petition Reception - Marlow Street
motions.description: Petition containing 309 signatures requesting Council reject application for Automasters/Car Wash Facility at 59 Marlow Street, Wembley

motions.title: Petition Reception - Town Hall Carpark
motions.description: Petition containing 33 signatures requesting Council cancel notice of motion to close Leederville Town Hall carpark to general public

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 27 November 2018
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Ordinary Council Meeting held on 27 November 2018

motions.title: DV18.176 - Lot 423 Marlow Street Wembley - Refuse Light Industry and Car Wash
motions.description: Development application for Industry-Light (Mechanical Workshop) and Motor Vehicle Wash at Lot 423 (No. 59) Marlow Street, Wembley. Application received 28 August 2018. 127 objections and 1 no-objection submission received during public consultation.

motions.title: Lot 2 Abbotsford Street West Leederville - Two Storey Grouped Dwelling
motions.description: Application for a two-storey grouped dwelling on a 168m² vacant lot in West Leederville, with variations to street setback and building boundary requirements.

motions.title: Lot 1 Lake Monger Drive West Leederville - Two Storey Dwelling
motions.description: Application for a two-storey dwelling with variations to street setbacks, building height, side setbacks, front fencing, buildings on boundary and outdoor living area. One objection received.

motions.title: Lot 1576 Johnson Street Wembley - Garage
motions.description: Application for a garage with variations to sight lines and building boundary requirements. Application deferred at applicant's request.

motions.title: Lot 1681 Holland Street Wembley - Two Storey Dwelling
motions.description: Application for a two-storey dwelling with variation to buildings on boundary requirement. Objection received from adjoining owner.

motions.title: Lot 415 Marlow Street Wembley - Two Grouped Dwellings
motions.description: Development application for two grouped dwellings at Lot 415 (No.43) Marlow Street, Wembley. The application does not meet deemed-to-comply provisions for boundary walls and variations are sought in relation to side setbacks, open space and garage frontage occupancy.

motions.title: Lot 50 Selby Street Wembley - Single Storey Dwelling
motions.description: Development application for a single storey dwelling at No. 236A Selby Street, Wembley. The application does not meet deemed-to-comply provisions due to a proposed landscaping planter in the front setback area and variations are sought in relation to lot boundary setbacks, front fencing and site works.

motions.title: Lot 701 Dilkara Way City Beach - Secondary Street Fencing Retaining Wall
motions.description: Development application for proposed secondary street fencing, retaining wall and site works at Lot 701 (No.25) Dilkara Way, City Beach. The application requires Council determination by absolute majority as it does not comply with deemed-to-comply standards. Three objections received relating to building height/bulk, public safety/sightlines and consistency with established streetscape character.

motions.title: Lot 701 Dilkara Way City Beach - Committee Recommendation Refusal
motions.description: Committee recommendation to refuse the application for secondary street fencing, retaining wall and site works. The Development Committee recommended refusal on grounds that the proposal does not meet requirements of Clause 39(3) of the Town Planning Scheme, is not consistent with established streetscape, and does not meet design principles.

motions.title: Lot 411 Grovedale Road Floreat Single Storey Dwelling
motions.description: Application for a Single Storey Dwelling at Lot 411 (No.112) Grovedale Road, Floreat by Webb & Brown-Neaves Pty Ltd. The proposal includes variations to deemed-to-comply provisions including primary street setback of 7.5 metres (required 9 metres), double garage at 8.125 metres, and retaining walls with maximum heights of 0.78 metres (north) and 0.59 metres (south). Development value $833,430.

motions.title: Lot 208 Karla Place City Beach Retrospective Shade-Sail
motions.description: Retrospective application for a shade-sail at Lot 208 (No. 5) Karla Place, City Beach by Perth Better Homes. The shade-sail is located in the front setback area with posts set back 0.5 metres from the primary street and heights ranging from 2.2 to 3.0 metres. Development value $5,456.
