motions.description: Report on delegated development approvals and notifications for October 1995. Includes enclosure of verandah at Child Care Centre, WAPC amalgamation approval, and appeal dismissal regarding conversion to consulting rooms.

motions.title: Building licences approved under delegated authority
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for October 1995. Total of 36 building licences with combined value of $1,602,303. Also includes preliminary, demolition and interim licences.

motions.title: Private swimming pool inspection programme progress report
motions.description: Progress report on Private Swimming Pool Inspection Programme. Establishment of reliable pools database using multiple information systems. Physical inspection of private pools to commence in second week of November, starting with City Beach.

motions.title: Lot 101 Glen Street, Leederville - Proposed Double Storey Residence
motions.description: Application for preliminary approval to construct a two storey residence on Lot 101 Glen Street, Leederville. The proposal does not comply with Residential Planning Codes or Council Policy No. 13 regarding plot ratio, setbacks, and open space provisions. Issues include non-compliance with setback requirements and concerns about privacy and visual impact on the streetscape.

motions.title: Immunisation Clinics - Report Received
motions.description: Report on two late afternoon immunisation clinics conducted on 24 October 1995 at Wembley Infant Health Clinic and 26 October 1995 at City Beach Infant Health Clinic. Clinics immunised 103 people across three target groups (Grade 1 students, Grade 7 students, and adults). A comparison with previous school immunisation programme results shows reduced attendance of school-aged children but successful adult immunisation.

motions.title: 3 Kintyre Crescent, Floreat Park - Health Act Notice
motions.description: Health Act Notice relating to 3 Kintyre Crescent, Floreat Park (Lot 1023, Volume 1192, Folio 791, Plan 6558). Property found to be substandard, insanitary, and unfit for human habitation. Owner/occupier (Estate of late Lina Didus) to be required to clean and disinfect within seven days. Property currently occupied by [private individual — name withheld] d'Unieville (alias [private individual — name withheld]).

motions.title: Tender - One Bitumen Road Patching Truck Tender No. 18VP-95
motions.description: Tender for purchase of one bitumen road patching truck with Flocon body and equipment. Budget allocation: $100,000. Recommended tender: Major Motors Isuzu FSR500 chassis with Flocon body. Total cost: $97,048.

motions.title: Tenders for Supply of Truck Hire, Plant Hire, Bitumen Supply and Related Services
motions.description: Multiple tenders for supply of truck hire, plant hire, bitumen supply and lay, brick paving, bitumen pavement profiling, sand, premixed concrete, and crushed limestone. Period contracts for 12 months with preferred suppliers based on lowest price.

motions.title: Tender - One Four Tonne Truck - Tender No. 35-95
motions.description: Tender for purchase of one four tonne truck to carry water for road construction work. Budget allocation: $100,000. Truck specified with 3,000 litre water tank, pump, spray bar, hydraulic side lifter, and tipping body. Recommended tender: Major Motors Isuzu NPR400 equipped with water tank and fittings at total cost of $53,298.

motions.title: Tender for Supply and Delivery of Two 3 Tonne Dual Cab Trucks with Side Lifter
motions.description: Tender for supply and delivery of two 3 tonne dual cab trucks with side lifter. Vehicles proposed for use by Works staff in road repairs and drainage. Recommended tender: Midway Ford for two Ford Trader 0509 trucks at cost of $36,755 each with $795 engine upgrade. Second truck to be reconfigured to single cab with tipper hoist, resulting in $3,048 saving.

motions.title: Huddleston Road, Mount Claremont - Closure
motions.description: Request from Wollaston College Management Committee to close Huddleston Road, a partially made, disused, and isolated road running along the southern boundary of the College grounds. Road is approximately 170 metres long, mostly overgrown, with deteriorating surface. Issues include unauthorised dumping and anti-social behaviour. Closure to be implemented via Section 331B of Local Government Act.

motions.title: Challenger Parade, City Beach No Standing and No Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of no standing and no parking restrictions on Challenger Parade between Jubilee Crescent/Oceanic Drive and West Coast Highway to improve safety for motorists exiting car parks and for pedestrians and cyclists. Amendment made during discussion to change terminology from 'bus stops' to 'bus/coach stops'.

motions.title: Challenger Parade Restrictions - Amendment to Motion
motions.description: Amendment to change terminology in original motion from 'bus stops' to 'bus/coach stops' to allow for coaches in addition to buses.

motions.title: Grantham Street, Floreat - No Standing Restriction
motions.description: Implementation of no standing anytime restriction on northern side of Grantham Street, Floreat to improve sight distance for motorists exiting Kenmore Crescent. Restriction to commence 6 metres west of Kenmore Crescent and extend 14 metres westwards.

motions.title: Realignment - West Coast Highway
motions.description: Project to realign section of West Coast Highway at City Beach scheduled for early 1996. Progress report from Main Roads WA addressing key issues raised at public meeting on 27 September 1995 including safety, intersection improvements, underpass, noise, traffic volumes, and related matters. Town of Cambridge to continue liaison with Main Roads WA.

motions.title: Tender for Supply and Delivery of One Seven Gang Tractor Mower - Tender 44-95
motions.description: Tender for supply and delivery of one seven gang tractor mower with specifications including 38 KW diesel engine, fully enclosed cab, roll-over protection, maximum 85 dB noise level. Tender advertised 30 September 1995, closed 16 October 1995, attracted three bids from two companies. Assessment panel: Co-ordinator Parks and Landscaping, Section Crew Leader, Mowing Crew Leader. Recommended: Wattleup Tractors Option A (Massey Ferguson 362 with Ransomes mower) at $91,609.

motions.title: Tender for Supply and Delivery of One Six Cylinder Diesel Four Wheel Drive Utility - Tender No 45-95
motions.description: Tender for supply and delivery of one six cylinder diesel four wheel drive utility for use in Parks area for fire fighting role. Specifications include manual transmission, air-conditioning, power steering, alloy dropside tray, towbar, mud flaps, mirrors, off-road tyres, heavy-duty suspension, alloy roobar, front winch. Tender advertised 30 September 1995, closed 16 October 1995, attracted four bids from three companies. Recommended: Melville Toyota for Toyota Landcruiser HZJ75 at $36,597.

motions.title: Policy - Management of Street Trees
motions.description: Review and recast of existing policies on street trees (Policy No 36, No 150, No 151). New single comprehensive policy addresses planting, pruning and removal of street trees. Original motion for adoption followed by deferral motion after discussion and proposed amendments.

motions.title: Floreat Library - Submission to LISWA for Additional Library Stock
motions.description: Submission to Library and Information Service of Western Australia (LISWA) for additional library stock for Floreat Library for 1996/97 and four outyears to 2001. Current stock allocation (27,370 items) falls short of recommended standards (46,062 items). Stock shortfall: 18,692 items. Library is 30 years old and requires major refurbishment. Budget provision: $10,000 for architectural assessment. Motion initially proposed adoption of three clauses, but amendments made during discussion to clarify language regarding facility improvements and strategic review.

motions.title: Floreat Library Motion - Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to clarify and revise Clauses (ii) and (iii) of the Floreat Library motion to address confusion about facility improvements versus strategic review.

motions.title: Assignment of Lease - City Beach Kiosk No 2, Challenger Parade, City Beach
motions.description: Assignment of existing kiosk lease from current operator Andrea Simonelli (20 years operation) to William Jim Taylor and Valma Taylor, both of City Beach. Lease assignment effective 16 November 1995. Assignees to be granted three-year option of renewal from 1 April 1997 to 31 March 2000. Business purchase price: $45,000. Current annual rent: $3,250. Taylors have extensive retail and small business experience including operation of souvenir shops, wildflower business, and community involvement in City Beach for 34 years.

motions.title: Shell Service Station Site - Sale or Lease by Tender
motions.description: Invitation to five applicants to submit tenders for the purchase or lease of Lot 3 The Boulevard, City Beach, formerly Shell Service Station. Site to be sold or leased to the most acceptable tenderer under Section 266(2)(b) of the Local Government Act 1960. A sign to be erected indicating proposed change of use and that proposals may be viewed at Floreat Library.

motions.title: Soccer Administration WA Sub-lease to Coaching Foundation
motions.description: Approval for Soccer Administration of WA to sub-lease a portion of their leased premises at Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion, Perry Lakes Stadium to Western Australian Coaching Foundation. Sub-lease area approximately 86 square metres at $2,660 per annum. Subject to approval of Hon Minister for Local Government and Section 267 of Local Government Act 1960.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium Lease and Licence to Western Reds Rugby League Club
motions.description: Offer of lease and licence to Western Reds Rugby League Club for accommodation within Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion (864 square metres at $30,000 per annum) and use of inner athletics track for training (licence at $36,000 per annum). Five-year terms with five-year options. Includes break clause for special events, insurance requirements, and condition that night lighting approval is not granted.

motions.title: WA Indoor Rock Climbing Gym Sub-lease Approval
motions.description: Approval for 1st Wembley Scout Association to sub-lease portion of their premises to WA Indoor Rock Climbing Gym for construction of outdoor climbing wall. Area approximately 20m x 15m. Sub-lease on monthly tenancy basis. Requires indemnity from gym and implementation of security/safety measures.

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at 31 October 1995
motions.description: Receipt and review of investment schedule showing surplus funds invested and their distribution. Total interest earned at 31 October 1995 was $99,598, representing 41.5% of investment budget. Council investments comply with policy limiting 25% of available funds to any one institution.

motions.title: Financial Statements for Period Ended 31 October 1995
motions.description: Receipt of financial statements for the period ended 31 October 1995. Cr Moore requested commentary on items significantly over or under budget and suggested surplus over budgeted interest be set aside for community projects and special donations.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Clause 8(3)(e) of Local Government Accounting Directions 1994. Four recoup advance accounts totalling $419,788.80.

motions.title: Audit Services Tender 1995-1998 Triennium
motions.description: Joint tender for audit services by Towns of Cambridge, Victoria Park and Vincent for three-year period 1 July 1995 to 30 June 1998. Nine tenders received; two late tenders excluded. Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu selected as most suitable for group price of $16,000 (three years). Grant Thornton selected as alternative if other towns do not accept group arrangement.

motions.title: Appointment to Graffiti Programme Steering Committee
motions.description: Nomination and appointment of Cr MacRae as member of WAMA Graffiti Programme Steering Committee for three-year term. Committee meets every six weeks and includes representatives from government and non-government agencies coordinating graffiti programme action.

motions.title: Vary Order of Business - Urgent Business
motions.description: Variation of order of business to bring forward urgent business item relating to West Leederville/Wembley Football Parking Assessment for discussion prior to related matter on night lighting of Subiaco Oval.

motions.title: Nomination for Curtin University Heritage Studies Committee
motions.description: Receipt of request for nomination of council member to Curtin University's Centre for Cultural Heritage Studies Advisory Committee. Three-year term. Committee meets yearly at Curtin University for two hours. Member should have knowledge of local government heritage issues.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes 22 March 2016 - Amendment to Q3(b)
motions.description: Motion to confirm minutes subject to amendment deleting reference to Cr Bradley in Question 3(b)

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes 22 March 2016
motions.description: Motion to confirm minutes of 22 March 2016

motions.title: Public Parking Station - Lot 18 Railway Parade West Leederville
motions.description: Application for public parking station with 143 car parking bays and 14 motorcycle bays at Lot 18 No. 164 Railway Parade, West Leederville. Temporary use approved for two years pending future apartment development.

motions.title: Relocation of Existing Billboard Sign - Lot 2 Railway Parade West Leederville
motions.description: Application to reposition existing billboard sign from eastern side of building to above roofline facing south onto Railway Parade. Billboard contains third party advertising. Policy 5.2 has been amended to prohibit new billboard and electronic billboard signs.

motions.title: Refuse billboard relocation application
motions.description: Application to relocate existing billboard sign at Lot 2 (No. 138) Railway Parade, West Leederville. The sign is 42.411 square metres and contains third-party advertising. Proposal would relocate sign to face Railway Parade and railway line rather than Loftus Street intersection.

motions.title: Approve change of use from shop to restaurant
motions.description: Application for change of use from shop (previously beautician) to restaurant at No. 442-444 Cambridge Street, Floreat. Located within Birkdale Street local centre. Proposed Italian restaurant with 20.6sqm seating area. Applicant to pay cash-in-lieu contribution of $15,000 for parking shortfall of 1 bay.

motions.title: Refuse home occupation motor vehicle air-conditioning servicing
motions.description: Application for home occupation at No. 205 Selby Street, Floreat. Proposal to operate motor vehicle air-conditioning servicing business from residential property. Involves specialist equipment and storage of refrigerant in liquefied form. Adjacent neighbour at No. 1 Evandale Street raised concerns about noise and amenity impacts.

motions.title: Refuse two storey dwelling application
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling at Lot 7 (No. 93) Blencowe Street, West Leederville. Proposal includes double garage with nil side setback adjacent to street rather than access from adjoining right-of-way (Porter Lane). Upper floor roofed balcony setback only 4 metres from street. Roof pitch 26 degrees rather than required 30-40 degrees.

motions.title: Approve amended plan for loft space in two storey dwelling
motions.description: Application for amended plan to include loft space in two storey dwelling at No. 48 Hesperia Avenue, City Beach. Originally approved dwelling is currently under construction. Amended plans extend roof ridge to rear to create loft space. Minor wall height variation at rear (6.65m vs 6.5m deemed-to-comply). Four objections received from neighbouring properties during consultation.

motions.title: Approve additions and alterations including second storey and double carport
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to original brick and tile bungalow at No. 59 Daglish Street, Wembley. Proposes double carport adjacent to street, bike store on south side, and two storey addition at rear replacing single storey addition. One objection received from adjoining property to south regarding wall height, site works and visual privacy.

motions.title: Approve fencing in front setback area
motions.description: Application for fencing within front setback area at No. 16 Alyth Road, Floreat. Proposes visually permeable fencing along southern end of front boundary and combination of visually permeable and solid fencing along southern side boundary. First 2.0 metres visually permeable, remainder solid. Condition requires extension of visually permeable fencing to 6.0 metres to enhance streetscape.

motions.title: Fencing front setback area - Lot 167 Hesperia Avenue approval
motions.description: Application for fencing within the front setback area as submitted by E Mangerf at Lot 167 (No. 34) Hesperia Avenue, City Beach. Originally recommended for refusal but amended plans received 21 April 2016 addressing design principles concerns.

motions.title: State Administrative Tribunal reconsideration - 10 dwellings Connaught Street West Leederville
motions.description: SAT reconsideration of Council's refusal of amended plans for ten multiple dwellings at Lot 501 (No. 31) Connaught Street, West Leederville. Amended plans dated 1 April 2016 address previous reasons for refusal regarding building height, site works, overshadowing and ground level fill.

motions.title: Draft Perth and Peel Green Growth Plan for 3.5 Million submission
motions.description: Council submission on the Draft Perth and Peel Green Growth Plan for 3.5 Million to Department of Premier and Cabinet. Plan addresses environmental and conservation matters to facilitate implementation of draft Perth and Peel @ 3.5 million. Submission period closes 13 May 2016.

motions.title: Local Planning Strategy Project Plan endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of the Local Planning Strategy Project Plan to guide the preparation of a Local Planning Strategy in accordance with Planning and Development (Local Planning Schemes) Regulations 2015. Project plan outlines objectives, key steps, community engagement, project management and milestones.

motions.title: Support Design Review Panel introduction
motions.description: Support for introduction of independent Design Review Panel to provide advice on planning proposals and projects; adoption of draft Local Planning Policy 2.7 for advertising

motions.title: Ocean Gardens Scheme Amendment - Motion Lost
motions.description: Proposal to initiate amendment to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 for Ocean Gardens Retirement Village rezoning and Lot 560 Balandi Way

motions.title: Amendment to clause (i) of Ocean Gardens motion
motions.description: Amendment to motion regarding development standards/conditions for Ocean Gardens Retirement Village rezoning proposal

motions.title: Ocean Gardens development standards motion - Council decision
motions.description: Council decision regarding Ocean Gardens Retirement Village rezoning - applicant advised Council does not support amendment at this time pending preparation of development standards

motions.title: Local Planning Policy 5.2 Advertising Signs adoption
motions.description: Consideration of Local Planning Policy 5.2 Advertising Signs following a 31-day public advertising period from 4 March 2016 to 4 April 2016. Five submissions were received objecting to the policy on grounds of over-regulation and negative business impact. The modified policy seeks to clarify signage requirements, prohibit third-party advertising and large billboards, and exempt temporary and minor signs from approval.

motions.title: Native Animal Rescue funding contribution
motions.description: Request for funding contribution from Native Animal Rescue (NAR), a not-for-profit organisation providing native animal rehabilitation and release services. The Town recorded the fourth highest number of local government admissions to NAR in 2015 with 124 admissions. NAR operates at approximately $15,000/month and is seeking funding support. The City of Swan contributes $15,000-$25,000/year and City of Bayswater contributes $11,000/year.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications Report - March 2016
motions.description: Monthly report on matters dealt with under delegated authority during March 2016, including 17 development applications, 1 item referred to WAPC, and 1 application for review (appeal) received.

motions.title: Building Permits Approved under Delegated Authority - March 2016
motions.description: Monthly statistics of building permits approved in March 2016. Total of 50 permits issued in March 2016 compared to 78 in March 2015. Year to date total of 516 permits. Value of construction for March 2016 was $9,152,262.

motions.title: City Beach BioLINC Stage 1 - deferred
motions.description: Consideration of Cambridge Coastcare's request for matching funding of $150,000 to complement a Lotterywest grant of $150,000 for the City Beach BioLINC Stage 1 project. Council had previously committed to up to $152,000 funding in December 2015. The committee recommendation included a four-part amended motion requiring detailed design submission and approval before works commence.

motions.title: The Boulevard - Durston Road to Templetonia Crescent median extension
motions.description: Decision on design option for final median extension on The Boulevard between Durston Road and Templetonia Crescent. Two options were considered: Option 1 with central brown median islands ($90,000), and Option 2 with on-road cycle lanes ($190,000). Item was deferred from October 2015 to allow for development of the Town's Five Year Bike Plan.

motions.title: Roads to Recovery Grant 2015-16 additional project
motions.description: Endorsement of additional road resurfacing project for Essex Street (Ruislip Street to Grantham Street) using surplus Roads to Recovery Grant funding of $60,000 from three under-budget projects (Crofts Lane, Donegal Road, Launceston Avenue). Total surplus available is $141,657.

motions.title: Ruislip Street chicane removal between McKenzie and Daglish Streets
motions.description: Approval for removal of the last remaining chicane in the Wembley area traffic management program, to be replaced with speed plateaux. Works can be coordinated with upgrading of Waddington Lane. Funding of $18,000 from surplus completed project funds.

motions.title: Denton Street parking restrictions adoption
motions.description: Adoption of parking restrictions on Denton Street between Cambridge Street and Salvado Road. Parking survey distributed in March 2016 received 100% resident support for 2-hour parking with Residential Permit Parking Excepted on the west side. Estimated signage cost $420.

motions.title: Grantham Street/Harborne Street Black Spot project - Council decision
motions.description: Council decision on Grantham Street/Harborne Street Black Spot project. Main Roads WA reaffirmed Option C (dedicated right turn pockets) as preferred after Option B was rejected as ineffective and not addressing pedestrian safety. Preliminary cost estimates $1,100,000 exceeds $700,000 Federal grant. Council requests extension and reconsideration of Option B.

motions.title: Receive report on alternatives to herbicide use
motions.description: Public information report on weed control methods used by the Town of Cambridge, including herbicide and non-herbicide alternatives across Parks Operations, Works Operations, Wembley Golf Course, and Sustainability areas.

motions.title: Waste Minimisation Program Review - Amended Motion
motions.description: Council decision on waste minimisation initiatives including recycling collections, waste programs, and charity bins on public land.

motions.title: Waste Local Law 2016 - Commence law-making process
motions.description: Statutory review of local laws and commencement of the law-making process for the Town of Cambridge Waste Local Law 2016, replacing waste-related provisions in the Health Local Law.

motions.title: 30th Anniversary of the Quarry Amphitheatre
motions.description: Proposal to celebrate the 30th Anniversary of the Quarry Amphitheatre with activities including a free concert, historical exhibition, and documentary screening, with $20,000 budget allocation.

motions.title: 30th Anniversary of the Quarry Amphitheatre - Amended Motion
motions.description: Amended proposal to celebrate the 30th Anniversary with free concert, historical exhibition, and documentary screening, excluding cocktail sundowner.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre - Amendment to Documentary Clause
motions.description: Amendment to change clause (iii) regarding the documentary from being screened to being produced only.

motions.title: 2016 Financial Assistance to Local Schools - Disbursement of Funds
motions.description: Approval of financial assistance grants to five local schools for various community benefit projects totaling $8,815, funded through a combination of budgeted amounts and Recreation Services budget savings.

motions.title: Alderbury Sportsground Needs Assessment
motions.description: Proposal to undertake a needs assessment and concept master plan for Alderbury Sportsground to guide future facility development for various sports clubs and community users.

motions.title: Alderbury Sportsground - Amendment for Two-Stage Process
motions.description: Amendment to clarify the two-stage process of needs assessment followed by concept master plan with conditional funding.

motions.title: Dodd Street Toilets - CCTV and Lighting Installation
motions.description: Proposal to install permanent lighting towers at Dodd Street cul-de-sac following successful trial, with community survey showing 94% support for the initiative.

motions.title: Dodd Street Toilets - Amendment to Remove CCTV
motions.description: Amendment to remove CCTV component and proceed with lighting towers only as primary crime prevention strategy.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Water Bodies - Funding for Options Study
motions.description: Proposal to fund a high level technical study into options for replenishing water levels in Perry Lakes, examining feasibility, costs, and regulatory issues of various approaches.

motions.title: City Beach Development Parking Expansion - Detail Design Approval
motions.description: Approval to undertake detail design of 120 bay expansion of Fred Burton Carpark with improved pedestrian crossings, following community consultation showing evenly divided feedback.

motions.title: City Beach Parking - Amendment to Remove Coastcare Consultation Requirement
motions.description: Amendment to delete the requirement for further consultation with Coastcare regarding carpark design modifications.

motions.title: Underground Power Program - Four Revised Proposals
motions.description: Four revised proposals to be submitted for funding under Round 6 of the State Underground Power Program, each covering approximately 800 properties. Following an amendment, the motion addresses the handling of remaining lots and communication to property owners.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - April 2016
motions.description: Report advising Council of documents that have been affixed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge. Three documents were sealed during March 2016, relating to heritage agreement caveat replacements and withdrawals for properties in City Beach and West Leederville.

motions.title: Ocean Gardens (Inc.) - Nomination for Director Appointment
motions.description: Report on the nomination of [private individual — name withheld] for appointment as a sixth Director of the Ocean Gardens (Inc.) Board. The Administration recommended approval, but the Committee voted against it (2/3). Council voted in favour of the appointment (6/3).

motions.title: Payment of Accounts - March 2016
motions.description: Report on payments of accounts made by the Town during March 2016 under the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Includes cheque payments totalling $293,867.44 and electronic fund transfers totalling $11,146,291.16.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - March 2016
motions.description: Report on the Council's investment portfolio performance for March 2016. Total investment of $27.3 million consisting of Municipal Funds of $11.7 million, Reserve Funds of $7.2 million, Endowment Lands Funds of $6.5 million and Trust Funds of $1.9 million. Weighted average interest rate of 2.96%.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements, Review and Variances - March 2016
motions.description: Report on the financial position for the period ended 31 March 2016 including analysis of operating revenue, operating expenses, capital works programs, and cash surplus with variances against budget.

motions.title: Tamala Park Regional Council Meetings - October 2015, December 2015, February 2016
motions.description: Report on items considered at Tamala Park Regional Council meetings held on 15 October 2015, 10 December 2015, and 18 February 2016. Covers project status, sales strategy, distributions, and infrastructure works for the Catalina development.

motions.title: City of Perth Surf Lifesaving Club - Financial Support Request
motions.description: Report on financial support request from the City of Perth Surf Lifesaving Club due to delays in handover of new premises. Council approved payment of balance grant and compensation for delay to be funded from liquidated damages.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment 31 - Legal Action Report
motions.description: Report on ongoing legal action by Coast Ward Ratepayers Association challenging Council's decision to adopt Town Planning Scheme Amendment 31. Dismissal hearing was held in February 2016 with Justice Pritchard's decision pending. Costs to date total $132,666.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment No. 31 - Modified Proposal
motions.description: Minister for Planning directed Council to modify and readvertise Scheme Amendment No. 31 with alternative density coding proposals for City Beach and Floreat Precincts, including R20 density bonus for corner lots, R30 split coding around local centres, and R40/R60 split coding along Cambridge Street.

motions.title: Scheme Amendment - Allow Councillor Grinceri to Participate (First Motion)
motions.description: Motion to allow Cr Grinceri to participate in discussion and vote on Scheme Amendment No. 31 matter on the basis that her financial interest is common to a significant number of electors or ratepayers.

motions.title: Scheme Amendment - Allow Councillor Grinceri to Participate (Second Motion)
motions.description: Motion to allow Cr Grinceri to participate in discussion (but not vote) on Scheme Amendment No. 31 matter on the basis that her financial interest is common to a significant number of electors or ratepayers.

motions.title: Ocean Gardens (Inc) Board Composition
motions.description: Motion regarding governance of Ocean Gardens (Inc) retirement village, requesting the Town write to the CEO about board diversity, seek membership list, and have CEO review appointment criteria.

motions.title: Reimbursement of Legal Costs for Elected Members
motions.description: Motion to authorize reimbursement of legal costs up to $5,000 for elected members' independent legal advice regarding declaration of interest under s5.65 of the Local Government Act on complex scheme amendments.

motions.title: Prohibition of Gifts for CEO and Planning Staff
motions.description: Motion to prohibit gifts of entertainment for the Chief Executive Officer and planning staff from developers, architects and planners.

motions.title: Record Planning Staff Contact with Developers
motions.description: Motion requiring planning staff to record and report contact with developers, architects and planners for multiple dwelling developments and developments exceeding $2 million in value.

motions.title: Independent Legal Advice - Corner Contiguity Interest Declaration
motions.description: Motion to obtain independent legal advice regarding whether a councillor with corner contiguity to an affected property has a declarable interest under s5.65 of the Local Government Act.

motions.title: Policy - Taking of Leave by Chief Executive Officer
motions.description: Motion to develop a policy regarding the Chief Executive Officer's taking of leave and performance of duties while absent from Council offices.

motions.title: Underground Power Round 6 Funding Applications
motions.description: Council considered recommendations for submitting proposals for funding under Round 6 of the State Underground Power Program to provide underground power for remaining parts of the Town.

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders - Limitation of Addresses
motions.description: Procedural motion to suspend Clause 8.13 of Standing Orders to allow open discussion on Underground Power item.

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders
motions.description: Procedural motion to resume Clause 8.13 of Standing Orders after discussion on Underground Power item.

motions.title: Amendment to Underground Power Motion - Property Owner Contribution Cap
motions.description: Amendment to set a cap on property owner contributions to underground power projects.

motions.title: Amendment to Underground Power Motion - Phased Approach
motions.description: Amendment to divide remainder of Town into at least four proposals and present areas to March 2016 meeting for ratification.

motions.title: Underground Power Council Decision (Amended Motion)
motions.description: Final council decision on Underground Power Round 6 funding applications with phased approach.

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders - New Secondary School Item
motions.description: Procedural motion to suspend Clause 8.13 of Standing Orders to allow open discussion on secondary school site options.

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders - Secondary School Item
motions.description: Procedural motion to resume Clause 8.13 of Standing Orders after discussion on secondary school.

motions.title: Deferral of Secondary School Item
motions.description: Council deferred the item to March 2016 pending further information from Department of Education.

motions.title: Leave of absence for Mayor
motions.description: Mayor Ross Willcock JP requested approval for leave of absence from 3 to 24 May 1996 inclusive, in accordance with Clause 2.9 of Standing Orders.

motions.title: Confirmation of minutes 9 April 1996
motions.description: Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of 9 April 1996 with amendment to Item 11, Page 80 to add discussion note about safety and fire hazards.

motions.title: 3 Dodd Street Wembley - Proposed additional grouped dwelling
motions.description: Planning application for proposed additional grouped dwelling at 3 Dodd Street, Wembley (PRO1073, 8SD/96) for use by aged or dependent persons. Application does not comply with open space, courtyard and setback provisions of R-Codes or design requirements.

motions.title: 174 Cambridge Street Leederville - Two storey dental consulting rooms
motions.description: Planning application for two storey dental consulting rooms building at 174 Cambridge Street, Leederville (5DA-96). Proposal fully complies with Town Planning Scheme. Four consulting rooms on ground floor, four offices on upper floor, twelve car parking bays.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval lights - Plans and conditions
motions.description: Consideration of plans for lighting towers at Subiaco Oval submitted by Peter Hunt and Daryl Jackson Architects in response to Condition 7 of WA Planning Commission approval (issued 31 January 1996). Four towers 65 metres high with revised design head frames.

motions.title: 16 Windarra Drive City Beach - Three storey residence
motions.description: Building application (155 BA-96) for proposed three storey residence at 16 Windarra Drive, City Beach. Does not comply with required primary and secondary street setbacks per Endowment Lands and Limekilns Estate By-Law No 43. Absolute majority approval required.

motions.title: 4 Tralee Road Floreat - Additions to existing residence
motions.description: Building application (142 BA-96) for proposed additions to existing residence at 4 Tralee Road, Floreat. Does not comply with required primary street setback. Absolute majority approval required.

motions.title: 77 Simper Street Wembley - Variation to setback
motions.description: Building application (90 BA/96) for proposed additions to rear of existing residence at 77 Simper Street, Wembley. Does not comply with required side setback. Adjoining property owners have objected.

motions.title: 43 Barrett Street Wembley - Two storey grouped dwellings
motions.description: Building application (101BA/96) for construction of 2 two storey grouped dwellings at 43 Barrett Street (corner Gregory Street), Wembley. Does not comply with Council plot ratio policy and rear setback for upper storey balcony. Deferred at 9 April 1996 meeting for additional neighbour consultation.

motions.title: 173 Gregory Street Wembley - Two storey residence
motions.description: Building application (134BA-96) for construction of two storey residence at 173 Gregory Street (corner Johnson Street), Wembley. Does not comply with Council plot ratio policy and side setback requirements of R-Codes. Neighbouring owners have certified no objection.

motions.title: 6 Felton Road City Beach - Proposed front fence
motions.description: Building application (154 BA-96) for proposed front fence to existing residence at 6 Felton Road (corner Catesby Street), City Beach. Does not comply with fence height requirements within 6.0 metres of street alignment per Endowment Lands and Limekilns Estate By-Law No 43.

motions.title: Health Act prosecution - Bellos Meats
motions.description: Food sampling at Bellos Meats, 344 Cambridge Street, Wembley on 6 March 1996 revealed meat products containing sulphur dioxide in violation of Food Standards Code. Proprietor has received nine warnings since February 1991. Four charges recommended.

motions.title: Floreat Hotel Extended Trading Permit Opposition
motions.description: Previous applicant for extended trading permit withdrew application in January 1995. Multiple resident objections received. Some historical noise complaints from Perth City Council. Council to prepare and submit formal submission to Liquor Licensing Division opposing the application.

motions.title: Matthews Netball Centre Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Netball season runs May to September with games Saturday 9am to 4pm. Current parking restrictions 11am to 6pm. Motorists parking in restricted zones 8am-11am causing congestion. Proposal to extend restrictions to 8am-6pm on Saturdays in surrounding streets.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval Events Advertising Contribution Refused
motions.description: Western Australian Football Commission requested $7,400 contribution for joint advertising campaign to promote public transport use and minimise street parking impacts for Subiaco Oval football events in 1996. This is 25% of total $29,600 advertising cost.

motions.title: Roads Management Report Reception
motions.description: Report by David Porter Consulting Engineer reviewing Metropolitan Region Road Improvement Projects. Priority One proposal identified as The Boulevard (Howtree to Empire) for further work including public consultation and investigation of parks/planning/financial aspects.

motions.title: Defer Road Report Resubmission for Consultant Address
motions.description: Request to resubmit items relating to David Porter Consulting Engineer report on Metropolitan Region Road Improvement Projects to enable consultant to address the meeting.

motions.title: Roads Report Reception (Resubmitted)
motions.description: Resubmitted motion to receive David Porter Consulting Engineer report after consultant address to council.

motions.title: Boulevard Improvements Priority One Approval
motions.description: Approval of Boulevard (Howtree to Empire) as Priority One project for further work including public consultation. Proposed improvements include two lanes each way plus medians, roundabouts at intersections, and traffic signals.

motions.title: Boulevard Improvements Amendment - Delete 'Proposed'
motions.description: Amendment to delete the word 'proposed' from the Boulevard improvements motion.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval Parking Terms of Reference Clarification
motions.description: Clarification sought regarding Subiaco Oval Impact Management Committee's role in reviewing parking restrictions for both day and night football games, and request for meeting with Hon Minister for Local Government regarding parking strategies.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway Approval and Funding
motions.description: Approval of City to Sea Greenway concept prepared by Mike Maher and Associates. Council contribution of $80,000 from Area Improvement Reserve Fund, subject to Commonwealth Better Cities Program and BikeWest providing $270,000. Mike Maher and Associates engaged for design and contract administration.

motions.title: Tractor Mower Equipment Purchase Additional Expenditure
motions.description: Council approval to authorise additional expenditure of $1,837 for improved Sportscutter mower attachment (in lieu of Ransomes 5/7 gang magna mower) for Massey Ferguson 362 tractor, bringing total cost to $93,446.

motions.title: Reserves Naming Policy Geographic Names Committee Report Reception
motions.description: Report from Department of Land Administration's Geographic Names Committee proposing new policy for naming of parks and reserves. Policy includes guidelines for personal names, living persons, community support evidence, and approval processes.

motions.title: Association Honours Nominations Report Reception
motions.description: Report on nomination of recipients for Association Honours (Life Membership, Certificate of Appreciation, Meritorious Service Award) to be submitted to Western Australian Municipal Association by 10 May 1996.

motions.title: Bold Regional Park Matters Resolution
motions.description: Resolution to refrain from preparing Environmental Management Plan for degraded areas pending Department response, not proceed with Deed of Agreement survey and subdivision matters, decline Kings Park Board fire vehicle offer, and approve $20,000 budget allocation for 1996/97 for potential Environmental Management Programme.

motions.title: Regional Facilities Funding Priorities to Minister
motions.description: Motion to draw attention to regional facilities needing urgent/high priority treatment and remind Hon Minister of unfavourable treatment Town received regarding assets and reserves from former City of Perth.

motions.title: Standing Orders Question Time Suspension Continuation
motions.description: Continuation of suspension of Standing Orders to allow Public Question Time at commencement of meetings following successful 8-week trial period in February-March 1996.

motions.title: Floreat Rotary Club Pride of Workmanship Awards Sponsorship Refused
motions.description: Request for sponsorship of $1,500 for Floreat Rotary Club's annual Pride of Workmanship Awards covering publicity, awardee dinner invitations, and award plaques/certificates.

motions.title: Civic Administration Building Inspection and Closure Approval
motions.description: Approval for councillors to conduct formal inspection of new Civic/Administration Building at Bold Park Drive, Floreat on 11 May 1996 at 10am, and closure of Administration on 7 June 1996 for removal of furniture and equipment.

motions.title: Direct Radio Link Installation Administration/Civic Centre to Library
motions.description: Approval to install direct radio link from new Administration/Civic Centre to Floreat Library at estimated cost of $3,775, which will enable high-speed data transmission and network connectivity.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment Confirmation
motions.description: Schedule of accounts for payment totalling $474,038.12 comprising recoup advance accounts and wages transfer.

motions.title: Financial Statements Period Ended 31 March 1996 Reception
motions.description: Financial statements for the period ended 31 March 1996 received.

motions.title: Wembley Playgroup - Rutter Park Fence Realignment
motions.description: Request by Wembley Playgroup Inc to realign boundary fence into Rutter Park to expand children's play area. Officer recommendation was to not support ceding of area B, but to approve realignment to incorporate area C only (137.5 square metres). Site visit was arranged for 15 April 1996.

motions.title: Wembley Ward Name - Deferral to Next Meeting
motions.description: Selection of new ward name for Wembley Ward. Multiple suggestions received from community. Consideration was deferred from 26 March 1996 meeting to 23 April 1996. Motion moved to defer further to next ordinary meeting.

motions.title: Council Committee System - Establishment of Four Committees
motions.description: Establishment of four Occasional Committees under the Local Government Act 1960, to operate until the new Local Government Act 1995 comes into effect on 1 July 1996. Committees to comprise four members each. Detailed purposes and functions specified for each committee including Development and Environmental Services, Technical Services, Corporate and Customer Services, and Policy and Administration committees.

motions.title: WAMA - Environmental Health Officers Professional Review Board Nomination
motions.description: Request from Western Australian Municipal Association (WAMA) for nomination of a member to the Environmental Health Officers Professional Review Board. Two-year term. Qualifications required: Interest or qualifications in Environmental Health. Meetings quarterly at Grace Vaughan House, Shenton Park.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary Meeting held on 23 May 1995 and Special Meeting held on 30 May 1995.

motions.title: 78 Kimberley Street - Nursing Home Additions
motions.description: Single storey additions to Kimberley Street Nursing Home involving relocation of two 2 bed wards and additional kitchen storage space. Application complies with Town Planning Scheme except for plot ratio (0.53:1.0 vs required 0.5:1.0) and side setback (0.8m vs required 1.0m). Applicant is Milcon Properties Pty Ltd.

motions.title: 438 Cambridge Street, Floreat - Veterinary Clinic Extension
motions.description: Application to extend existing veterinary clinic at Lot 239 (No. 438) Cambridge Street, Floreat with 140 square metre extension for caretaker quarters, cattery, store room and grooming/display area. Deferred for further consideration.

motions.title: 19 Norbury Crescent, City Beach - Residential Respite Care Centre
motions.description: Application for redevelopment of existing residence for use as residential respite care centre. New single storey 5 bedroom brick and tile dwelling with facilities for disabled persons. Secondary street setback varies from policy (3.0m vs 3.75m required) but adjoining owners have not objected. No objections received; four letters in support from nearby residents and shopkeepers.

motions.title: 438 Vincent Street West, Leederville - Office Building Extensions
motions.description: Application for extensions to existing two storey office building. Extension includes basement car park for 15 vehicles and two levels of office space (approximately 342 square metres GFA). Non-compliance with rear setback requirement (3m provided vs 5.2m required). Main considerations regarding overlooking and overshadowing of adjoining residential properties.

motions.title: 40 Alderbury Street, Floreat - Home Occupation Office
motions.description: Application to operate home occupation office for electrical and security service from single room (16 square metres) in residential dwelling. Sole operator. Operating hours 8am-5pm weekdays. One written submission received expressing no objection subject to no two-way radio use. One telephone response received with no objection.

motions.title: 2 Peebles Road, Floreat - Proposed Subdivision
motions.description: Application for subdivision of Lot 796 (1467 square metres) into two lots (702 and 765 square metres). Does not comply with R Code requirements for average lot size (733.5m² proposed vs 800m² required) and Council Policy 4 for Endowment Lands minimum lot size. WA Planning Commission referred application for comment. Council recommends refusal due to non-compliance and irregular boundary configuration.

motions.title: 107 Grovedale Road, Floreat - Home Occupation Settlement Agent Office
motions.description: Application to operate home occupation settlement agent office from single room (9.25 square metres) in residential dwelling. Sole operator. Operating hours 9am-5pm weekdays with work mostly conducted in the city. Clients visit only on rare occasions. One telephone response received with no objection.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications
motions.description: Information item regarding delegated development approvals, subdivisions/amalgamations, and notifications of appeals and decisions by other authorities.

motions.title: Metropolitan Regional Scheme - Bold Park Amendment No 967/33
motions.description: MRS Amendment relating to Bold Park and Environs currently released for public comment. Submissions close 23 June 1995. Amendment involves land classification changes and realignment/reclassification of regional roads. Key issues include Bold Park creation, Stephenson Avenue alignment, and West Coast Highway realignment.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority during period 19 April 1995 to 31 May 1995.

motions.title: Procedure for Building Application Approval/Refusal
motions.description: Establishment of procedure for approval/refusal of building applications by delegating authority to appointed Building Surveyor. Authority limited by building class and value. Class 1 and 10 buildings delegated fully; Class 2-9 buildings over $175,000 to be submitted to Council. Also seeks approval to appoint Manager of Building Services to office of Building Surveyor.

motions.title: Building Licences Requiring Council Approval
motions.description: Two building licence applications exceeding $175,000 in value requiring Council approval: (1) Woolworths WA refurbishment at Floreat Forum Shopping Centre ($650,000); (2) Cambridge Private Hospital additions and alterations ($650,000).

motions.title: 9 Arbordale Street, Floreat - Single Storey Residence
motions.description: Application for new four bedroom, two bathroom home. Does not comply with Council Bylaw 43 and Policy 20 regarding front setback. Garage extends into 9.0 metre setback to 6.5 metres. Remainder of residence set back 13.0 metres. Variation from 'Garden Suburb' design principle supported due to changing area character.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval - Aircraft Noise and Safety
motions.description: Report on progress in restricting aircraft flying over and around Subiaco Oval during AFL games. Residents have expressed concerns regarding noise and safety. Discussions held with Civil Aviation Authority, Melbourne Cricket Club, and WA Football Commission. New aviation regulations to come into force 1 July 1995 with expanded powers to control environmental issues such as aircraft noise.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Design Project
motions.description: Tender assessment for design and construction phases of new course layout at Wembley Golf Complex. Three tenders received. Project Team assessment based on organisation profile, design capability, construction capability, and value for money. GHD achieved high grading on each criterion. Contract to be let for execution of work by 4 July 1995.

motions.title: Waste Management - Contract for Service
motions.description: Tender process for waste management services previously provided by City of Perth. Service no longer available after 30 June 1995. Five responses received including four tenders and one alternative offer. Assessment conducted by panel including Executive Manager Technical Services, Co-ordinator Works, Purchasing Officer, and Waste Management Consultant. Recommended contractors: Cleanaway for majority of services, Green Recycling for community recycle bins. Six month contract period recommended.

motions.title: Green Recycling Contract Acceptance
motions.description: Acceptance of Green Recycling contract with WA Recycling for residential household recycle crates and community recycle bins at a cost of $39,000 for six months from 1 July 1995.

motions.title: Council Meeting Schedule 1995/96
motions.description: Adoption of the schedule of meeting dates for ordinary meetings of Council for the 1995/96 year, providing for two meetings per month generally on the second and fourth Tuesdays commencing at 5.30 pm, with one meeting each in December and January 1996.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Noting that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to documents listed in the attached schedule since 6 May 1995.

motions.title: Town Logo Design Competition
motions.description: Approval for a logo competition open to individuals who live, work, recreate or are educated in the municipality, with a selection panel to be formed comprising the Mayor, Deputy Mayor, CEO and Executive Manager Corporate & Customer Services.

motions.title: National General Assembly Attendance - Initial Motion
motions.description: Initial motion to authorize the Mayor to attend the 1995 National General Assembly of Australian Local Government in Canberra from 12-15 November 1995 and charge expenditure to Budget Item Members - Course/Conference Expenses.

motions.title: National General Assembly Attendance - Deferral
motions.description: Motion to defer further consideration of nomination of Council representatives to attend the 1995 National General Assembly of Australian Local Government until further information on costs is available.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Fees Review - Initial Motion
motions.description: Initial motion to approve new fee schedule for Wembley Golf Complex effective 1 July 1995, including green fees and driving range fees, and to discontinue time restrictions for Senior concession rates.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Fees Review - Deferral
motions.description: Motion to defer further consideration of the Wembley Golf Complex fees review to the next Ordinary Meeting of Council to enable provision of additional financial information.

motions.title: Insurance Renewal 1995/96 - Initial Motion
motions.description: Motion to note the insurance renewal report and adopt in principle the Self Insurance Scheme proposed by the Western Australian Municipal Association.

motions.title: Insurance Renewal 1995/96 - Amended Motion
motions.description: Motion to amend the insurance renewal recommendation to request an independent assessment of the proposed Self Insurance Scheme from H R Manners, former Managing Director of Sedgwicks, prior to 20 June 1995.

motions.title: Assignment of Lease - City Beach Kiosk No 2
motions.description: Motion to assign the existing lease of City Beach Kiosk No 2, Challenger Parade, City Beach from Andrea Simonelli to MacDuff Pty Ltd, subject to Minister approval, with conditions regarding endorsement and lease renegotiation.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre - Consultative Committee Setup
motions.description: Establishment of an Advisory/Consultative Committee for the Joan Watters Community Centre comprising a Councillor Chairperson and four members from the Centre.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre - Amend Terms of Reference
motions.description: Amendment to the Consultative Committee terms of reference to change 'undertake' to 'assist' in relation to research and investigation into uses of the Centre.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre - Mayor as Chairperson
motions.description: Nomination of the Mayor as Chairperson of the Joan Watters Community Centre Consultative Committee.

motions.title: Fairway Tavern - Valuation Authority
motions.description: Authorization for the Chief Executive Officer to engage a Valuer to determine a fair market rent for the Fairway Tavern at the Wembley Golf Complex, with the note that the valuation will not be binding on the Council or Lessee.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of the Council held on 23 March 1999

motions.title: Petitions Received
motions.description: Receipt of two petitions: one concerning through traffic on Clanmel Road, Floreat (29 signatories) and one requesting investigation of smaller residential lots in City Beach (27 signatories)

motions.title: Salvado Road/Station Street Intersection
motions.description: Council decision on proposed installation of traffic signals at the intersection of Salvado Road and Station Street, in conjunction with Subiaco Redevelopment Authority works

motions.title: Bus Shelters and Seats
motions.description: Deferral of motion to call tenders for replacement and maintenance of bus shelters pending submission of further information on tender documentation

motions.title: Budget Considerations 1999/2000
motions.description: Receipt of capital works projects list for 1999/2000 budget and request for councillors to submit priority projects

motions.title: Vincent Street West - Parking
motions.description: Deferral of street parking plan proposal in favour of conducting an audit of street parking in Vincent Street precinct

motions.title: Newman College Junior Campus Parking
motions.description: Establishment of working group to review parking and traffic issues at Newman College Junior Campus with specified guidelines and composition

motions.title: Metropolitan Regional Road Funding Program 2000/2001–2004/2005
motions.description: Application to Main Roads WA for road rehabilitation grant funding for five-year program with specified roads and costs

motions.title: Vincent Street West/Lake Monger Drive - Regional Road Reserve Rationalisation
motions.description: Endorsement of proposed amendments to rationalise regional road reserves at eastern end of Lake Monger Drive

motions.title: Lake Monger Visitor Facilities - Endorsement and Public Consultation
motions.description: Consideration of Thompson Palmer Pty Ltd consultant's recommendations for visitor facilities development at Lake Monger Reserve, including carpark, bus parking, toilet and information facility at multiple locations following public consultation.

motions.title: Lake Monger Works Update - Fence Installation and Additional Works Approval
motions.description: Report on various works issues at Lake Monger Reserve including fence installation to protect vegetation, additional works expenditure, Main Roads WA contributions, and WA Tourist Commission grants.

motions.title: Ocean Beaches Works Update - Coastal Maintenance and Capital Works
motions.description: Report to inform Council of upcoming budgeted maintenance and capital works plus unbudgeted future works on the Town's coastline divided into three sections: Ocean Beaches, Beachfront Park, and Floreat Beach Park.

motions.title: Automation of Irrigation - Tender Withdrawal
motions.description: Withdrawal of recommendation regarding supply and installation of irrigation central control system and field units following request for additional warranty information.

motions.title: Ficus Hillii Street Tree Removal and Replacement Program
motions.description: Implementation of three-year management program for removal and replacement of Ficus hillii (Hills Fig) trees in streets within the Town of Cambridge following public consultation with residents.

motions.title: Review of Operation and Functions of Committees
motions.description: Review of existing Committee system for dealing with Council business comprising one Council meeting per month supported by four Committee meetings. Decision on whether to continue or change the structure.

motions.title: Special Meeting of Council - 4 May 1999
motions.description: Approval to hold Special Meeting of Council following Local Government elections on 1 May 1999 to perform swearing-in of Mayor and Councillors, election of Deputy Mayor, appointment of Standing Committees, and appointment of delegates and representatives.

motions.title: Bowling Club Amalgamation
motions.description: Proposal to amalgamate City Beach and Floreat Park Bowling Clubs, with new facility at Floreat Park site, funded by sale of City Beach land. A Working Group to investigate implications.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Schedule of accounts to be confirmed and list of payments included in Council minutes, pursuant to Regulation 13(2) of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at 31 March 1999
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule detailing surplus funds invested, distribution of funds, and financial performance including interest earned.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements
motions.description: Receipt of Financial Statements for the period ended 31 March 1999.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Notification of documents sealed with the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge, including land discharge, Main Roads compensation authority, liquor licence assignment, planning scheme amendment, and lease documents.

motions.title: Skate Facilities Study Implementation
motions.description: Receipt of Skate Facilities Study and approval to proceed with skate park construction at Perry Lakes Reserve and Lake Monger, subject to external funding for City Beach facility. Includes approval for funding applications and further investigation of Dodd Street implications.

motions.title: Arts Advisory Committee Terms of Reference Deferred
motions.description: Deferral of motion to endorse Terms of Reference for Arts and Culture Advisory Committee pending consideration by the Arts Committee.

motions.title: Art Acquisition – Contemporary Artwork Purchase
motions.description: Purchase of two contemporary artworks by Amanda McHenry ($800) and Margaret Vinciguerra ($700) recommended by Arts Advisory Committee for Administration/Civic Centre display.

motions.title: Restoration of Historical Aerial Photograph
motions.description: Restoration of historically significant pre-1960s aerial photograph (1.9m x 1.3m) requiring reframing and conservation, with professional photography, reprinting, and retouching work.

motions.title: Reprinting and Reframing of Historical Photographs
motions.description: Reprinting and reframing of 54 historical photographs in Administration/Civic Centre corridors that have developed pink/orange tinge due to defective AGFA chemicals, with new mat board and frames.

motions.title: Disability Services Advisory Committee Terms of Reference Deferred
motions.description: Deferral of motion to endorse Terms of Reference for Disability Services Advisory Committee pending consideration by the Disability Services Advisory Committee.

motions.title: Community Needs Assessment Report – Receive and Adopt Budget Guidance
motions.description: Analysis of recommendations from the Community Needs Assessment Report to guide budget preparation for the 1999/2000 financial year.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre – Adopt Fees and Charges
motions.description: Annual review and adoption of fees and charges for the Bold Park Aquatic Centre, including introduction of a new family pass category.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre – Adopt Fees and Charges
motions.description: Annual review and adoption of fees and charges for the Joan Watters Community Centre, Respite Services, Out of School Care, and Occasional Care Services effective from 1 July 1999.

motions.title: Safer WA Initiative and Community Security Grants Program – Receive Report
motions.description: Report on the State Government's Safer WA initiative structure and funding available for community security and crime prevention activities.

motions.title: City Beach Surf Riders Club – Grant Use of Shed
motions.description: Motion to grant the City Beach Surf Riders Club continued use of the shed at South City Beach for a further two year period under the same terms and conditions.

motions.title: City Beach Surf Riders Club – Amendment for Public Comment
motions.description: Amendment to motion requesting that public comment be sought on the change of use to the South City Beach shed.

motions.title: Assignment of Lease – Sport Science Centre
motions.description: Assignment of [private individual — name withheld] interest in the lease at Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion at Perry Lakes Stadium to joint lessee Peter Trench (The Stadium Gymnasium).

motions.title: Provision of Insurance Services – Appointment
motions.description: Appointment of insurance brokers for a three-year contract commencing 1 July 1999.

motions.title: Lord Mayor's Relief Fund – Donations
motions.description: Consideration of donations to Lord Mayor's Relief Funds for Moora (flood relief) and Exmouth (cyclone relief) following tropical cyclones Elaine and Vance.

motions.title: Residential Building – Disability Services Commission Staff Accommodation
motions.description: Application for planning approval for use of an existing residence to accommodate country staff visiting Perth for the Disability Services Commission at Lot 100, No.44 Scadden Street, Wembley.

motions.title: Aged Persons Serviced Apartments – Ocean Gardens
motions.description: Application for planning approval for twelve aged persons serviced apartments (two storey) at Ocean Gardens Retirement Village, Lot 3 (No.60) Kalinda Drive, City Beach.

motions.title: Conditions of Planning Approval – Additional Grouped Dwelling
motions.description: Imposition of conditions on planning approval granted by Minister for Planning for an additional grouped dwelling at Lot 122 (No. 281) Salvado Road, Floreat, following the Minister's decision to uphold the appeal.

motions.title: Single Dwelling – Branksome Gardens
motions.description: Application for planning/building approval for a single dwelling (two storey and undercroft) at Lot 197 (No.77) Branksome Gardens, City Beach.

motions.title: Single Dwelling – Windarra Drive (Refused)
motions.description: Application for planning approval for a single dwelling (two-storey with undercroft) at Lot 375 (No.18) Windarra Drive, City Beach. Initially refused but amended plans were submitted and referred back to committee.

motions.title: Single Dwelling – Windarra Drive (Approved with Conditions)
motions.description: Following amended plans addressing concerns about site levels, retaining walls, and open space provision, the application for a single dwelling at Lot 375 (No.18) Windarra Drive was approved by the committee with conditions.

motions.title: Windarra Drive – Referral Back to Committee
motions.description: Motion to refer the Windarra Drive application back to the Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration as amended plans had not been fully considered by Council.

motions.title: Single Dwelling – Aruma Way (Refused)
motions.description: Application for building approval for a two-storey residence and undercroft garage at Lot 351 (No.50) Aruma Way, City Beach. Application refused due to multiple non-compliances and setback variations.

motions.title: Aruma Way – Referral Back to Committee
motions.description: Motion to refer the Aruma Way application back to the Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Grouped Dwelling – Alderbury Street
motions.description: Application for planning approval for a single storey grouped dwelling at Lot 11 (No.22) Alderbury Street, Floreat, to replace the existing front residence.

motions.title: Lot 2 Evandale Street Floreat - Grouped Dwelling Application
motions.description: Application for additional grouped dwelling at Lot 2 (No.14A) Evandale Street, Floreat. Plans show single storey dwelling with non-compliance to rear setback, private open space, and reversing bay requirements.

motions.title: Lot 2 Evandale Street Floreat - Grouped Dwelling Approval
motions.description: Foreshadowed motion for approval of additional grouped dwelling at Lot 2 Evandale Street following rejection of initial motion to refuse.

motions.title: Lot 2 Evandale Street - Amendment to Require 6 Metre Rear Setback
motions.description: Amendment to motion for approval proposing condition that average rear setback be increased to 6.0 metres.

motions.title: Lot 78 Evandale Street Floreat - Grouped Dwelling Approval with Conditions
motions.description: Application for single storey rear grouped dwelling at Lot 78 (No.4) Evandale Street, Floreat with variations to rear setback and side setbacks. Applicant has provided amended plans addressing setback variations.

motions.title: Lot 129 Salvado Road Floreat - Grouped Dwelling and Carport Approval
motions.description: Application for single storey rear grouped dwelling and additions including carport to front dwelling at Lot 129 (No.267) Salvado Road, Floreat with variations to lot size, carport setback and crossover width.

motions.title: Lot 50 Connaught Street West Leederville - Three Grouped Dwellings Approval
motions.description: Application for three two-storey grouped dwellings at Lot 50 (No.21) Connaught Street, West Leederville with revised plans addressing previous Committee concerns. Application includes minor variations to side setbacks and privacy/window setback discretions.

motions.title: Lot 3 Pt 4 Salvado Road Wembley - Five Grouped Dwellings Approval
motions.description: Application for five single storey (with loft) grouped dwellings at Lot 3 and Pt Lot 4 (No.132 and 134) Salvado Road, Wembley with variations to side/rear setbacks, front setback for gatehouses, and private open space.

motions.title: Lot 186 Barrett Street Wembley - Two Single Dwellings Approval
motions.description: Application for two single storey dwellings at Lot 186 (No.15) Barrett Street, Wembley with variations to parapet wall requirements on boundaries and minimal open space variation.

motions.title: Lot 3 Kondil Place City Beach - Single Two-Storey Dwelling Refusal
motions.description: Application for single two-storey dwelling at Lot 3 (No.10) Kondil Place, City Beach with variations to side setbacks and privacy window requirements. Recommended for refusal due to neighbour objection and non-compliance with Codes.

motions.title: Lot 3 Kondil Place City Beach - Refer Back to Development Committee
motions.description: Motion to refer the single dwelling application back to the Development and Environmental Services Committee for further consideration following amended plans submitted post-committee meeting.

motions.title: Lot 53 Woolwich Street West Leederville - Single Storey Residence Approval
motions.description: Application for single storey residence at Lot 53 (No.92A) Woolwich Street, West Leederville with variations to front setback, side setbacks (parapet walls), open space provision, and roof pitch. Applicant proposes to remove street tree.

motions.title: Lot 1009 Kintyre Crescent Floreat - Single Two-Storey Dwelling Approval
motions.description: Application for single two-storey dwelling at Lot 1009 (No.24) Kintyre Crescent, Floreat with discretion for balcony setback and retaining wall height. Neighbouring property has no objection subject to no adverse impact.

motions.title: Lot 11 Alderbury Street Floreat - Single Two-Storey Dwelling Approval
motions.description: Application for two-storey single dwelling at Lot 11 (No.76B) Alderbury Street, Floreat on rear battleaxe lot with discretion for privacy window setbacks less than 6 metres from common boundary.

Further amended plans submitted showing 2 metre planter box.

Committee meeting 19 April 2006 agreed that owner and builder be advised of offence for commencing development without approval.

motions.description: Retrospective application for off-white colorbond roof seeking variation to Local Law 43. Building licence issued January 2005 for grey roof but off-white roof installed. Applicant submitted detailed submission on merits and environmental sustainability. One objection from adjoining northern property regarding excessive glare. Committee meeting 19 April 2006 agreed owner and builder be advised of offence and if plans submitted regarding impact on 34 Sudbury Way, further report be submitted to Council.

Variation to front setback requirement from Salvado Road. Committee meeting 19 April 2006: Cr Bradley declared proximity interest (wife owns adjacent property). Allowed to remain and participate. Council meeting 26 April 2006: Cr Bradley declared same interest and left meeting. Motion to allow Cr Bradley to participate lapsed for want of seconder.

motions.title: Home Occupation bed and breakfast, Lot 107 Tranmore Way, City Beach

Maximum three guests at any one time. Advertised for public comment. Adjoining landowners at 43, 44, 45, 47 Tranmore Way submitted support. One objection from owner of 48 Tranmore Way regarding security, noise, guest control, and concern about commercial use in family residential area.

motions.title: Home Occupation Bed and Breakfast at Frinton Avenue

Five objections received regarding height, privacy, setbacks, shadowing, parking, bulk, traffic, noise and asbestos. Amendment moved during Committee meeting to add footnote regarding parking shortfall decision.

motions.title: Two Storey Dwelling at Boronia Crescent, City Beach
motions.description: Application by Manor Home Builders for two storey dwelling at Lot 19 (No. 23) Boronia Crescent, City Beach with variation to wall height of 7.689 metres exceeding requirement of 6.5 metres. All three adjoining neighbors signed plans with no objection.

Revised plans address concerns regarding roof pitch, fencing, driveway design and setbacks. Northern neighbour commented on ivy wall proposal and colorbond usage.

motions.description: Application by Dale Alcock Development Solutions for single storey dwelling at Lot 2 (No. 2B) Reserve Street, Wembley on rear strata lot. Owner of front lot objected to garage parapet wall on western boundary. Council decision includes refusal of current application and delegation to CEO to approve amended plans with garage setback increased to 1.0 metre.

motions.title: Second Storey Addition at Kimberley Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application by National Estate Builders (WA) Pty Ltd for second storey addition to existing post-war brick and tile dwelling at Lot 2 (No. 96) Kimberley Street, West Leederville. Variations to wall height, overshadowing, side setbacks, and retaining walls. No neighbour objections received.

motions.title: Additions and Alterations at Catesby Street, City Beach
motions.description: Application by Distinction Homes for additions and alterations to existing three-level dwelling at Lot 403 (No. 9) Catesby Street, City Beach. motions.title: Fencing variation at Lot 5 Ruislip Street, Wembley

Applicant Peter Mitchell proposes solid brick fencing to 1.8 metres height for 3.5 metres length, with timber slat fencing for remainder.

Car parking shortfall of 4 bays (22 provided vs 26 required) was deemed acceptable given limited land and Western Power substation accommodation requirements.

Pool patio roof height reduction required as a condition.

One objection received regarding noise from entertaining area near neighbour's bedroom.

Proposal utilizes Wembley Corner Lot policy allowing two dwellings on R20 zoned corner lots under R30 density standards. Ground floor includes double garage, living areas and bedroom; upper floor includes four bedrooms and family/theatre/study room. Neighbour objection received regarding setbacks and building scale; amended plans submitted addressing side setback and visual privacy concerns.

motions.title: Loft and spa addition and alterations at Ruislip Street West Leederville

Proposal includes loft area in existing roof with two bedrooms, bathroom and retreat; alterations to existing basement to create gym; outdoor spa with fence and decking. Wall height variations assessed under performance criteria. Neighbour objections received regarding privacy and boundary issues; amended plans with fixed obscure glass windows to west and east facing loft windows submitted.

motions.title: Second storey addition and alterations at Goonang Road City Beach

Proposal includes new ensuite, WIR and laundry on ground floor on south-eastern side adjacent to Gunee Road; new upper floor with main bedroom, retreat, ensuite, walk-in-robe and balconies above ground floor closest to corner. Secondary street setback and building height variations assessed. Neighbour objections addressed; neighbours of some adjacent properties provided written consent.

motions.title: SAT direction to review shed Building Approval Certificate application
motions.description: Application for Building Approval Certificate for unauthorised shed at Lot 809 (No. 1) Turriff Road, Floreat. Applicant [private individual — name withheld]. At State Administrative Tribunal direction, Council reconsidered application for shed existing since 2006 constructed without approval. Shed measuring 10.259m long by 4.23m wide, 2.1m high, located on southern boundary with nil setback (1.5m required). Building Code of Australia compliance assessment identified multiple breaches in structural fixing and roofing specifications. Neighbour submission received objecting to eyesore appearance affecting area amenity and property values.
