motions.description: Proposal to cease immunisation clinics at City Beach Child Health Centre, Boronia Crescent and relocate the service to Wembley Child Health Centre (Joan Watters Centre, Jersey Street, Wembley). City Beach clinic has poor attendance (average 1.5 patients per month in recent years) while Wembley clinic is consistently busy (6-16 patients per month).

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme No.1 Amendment No.3 – Rectification of Zoning
motions.description: Adoption of amendment No. 3 to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 to rectify zoning anomalies by rezoning Lots 1 and 1084 Harborne Street (corner Johnson Street, Wembley) from Residential Zone to Local Centre Zone and Lots 1104, 1105 and 1106 Harborne Street (corner Scadden Street, Wembley) from Local Centre Zone to Residential Zone. Two submissions received during 28-day advertising period: one objection from adjoining resident on safety/lifestyle grounds and one support from business occupying affected premises.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme No.1 Amendment No.4 – Modifications to Scheme Text
motions.description: Adoption of amendment No. 4 to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 to make administrative changes including deletion of reference to Subiaco Redevelopment Act area, correction of clause references, replacement of 'Use Area' terminology with 'Zone', insertion of Conference Centre definition, and insertion of new Use Classes (Conference Centre and Hospital) in the Zoning Table. One submission received from Subiaco Redevelopment Authority with no objection.

motions.title: Regent Street, West Leederville – Proposed Street Closure and Park Modification
motions.description: Proposal to modify Regent Street road reserve by reducing the carriageway width to 3 metres to maintain access to adjoining property at 108 Tower Street while incorporating balance of land into Tower Park. Initial closure proposal advertised; nine submissions received including objection from Water Corporation regarding water main, objection from original applicant who withdrew support, objections from residents citing parking needs, and support from residents favouring park expansion. Committee recommended deferral for three months to explore further options.

motions.title: Appointment of Authorised Persons under Various Statutes
motions.description: Authorisation of three recently appointed officers under various Acts and Local Laws effective 9 October 2000: Noel Alexander Myers (Planning Officer), Rebecca Jane Biltoft (Customer Services Officer as Dog Act Registration Officer), and Todd Emson Dewar (Projects Co-ordinator). Authorisations enable officers to enforce Town Planning and Development Act, Local Government Act, Litter Act, Dog Act, Bush Fires Act, Environmental Protection Regulations, and various Town Local Laws.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications – September 2000
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions and notifications for September 2000 including two delegated approvals (change of use to office and illuminated signs at Cambridge Street locations), appeals received against Council decisions (two story dwelling at Kinkuna Way and retaining walls at Empire Avenue), and appeals determined by Minister for Planning (dismissal of appeal for two storey residence at Tate Street for failure to meet setback requirements; upheld appeal for outbuilding at Dilali Road).

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority – September 2000
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data on building licences issued in September 2000: 39 building licences, 1 sign licence, 3 preliminary building licences, 3 demolition licences, with construction value of $2,327,183. Comparative figures for July-September 2000 show decreases in licence numbers and construction value compared to same quarter 1999.

motions.title: Annual Financial Report 1999/2000 acceptance
motions.description: The Annual Financial Report for the year ended 30 June 2000 records the financial performance of the Town for the 1999/2000 financial year. The Town performed well against budgets with a surplus of $544,300 despite depreciation expense effects. Cash position is healthy with $14.7 million in investments as at 30 June 2000.

motions.title: Special Meeting of Electors decisions received
motions.description: Receipt and consideration of decisions from the Special Meeting of Electors held on 12 October 2000. The meeting was held to consider traffic flow through streets between Herdsman Parade and Cambridge Street, impact on Wembley residents and school access, and cessation of treatments at Herdsman Parade intersections. 253 electors attended.

motions.title: Community Consultative Committee establishment
motions.description: Establishment of a Community Consultative Committee to consider various traffic management plan options for streets bounded by Selby, Herdsman, Dodd, Harborne and Salvado. An independent engineering consultant to be appointed to address the Black Spot problem at Jersey/Grantham Streets intersection.

motions.title: Special Meeting decision - censure noted
motions.description: Council response to the Special Meeting of Electors decision regarding censuring the Town of Cambridge for failing to properly consult with residents regarding traffic restriction devices recently installed at various intersections within Herdsman Parade.

motions.title: Road works removal deferred pending consultative committee
motions.description: Council response to Special Meeting of Electors decision to remove road works at Herdsman Parade intersections. Council determined any removal would be premature until the Community Consultative Committee has agreed what works are required.

motions.title: Road works retention pending consultative committee conclusion
motions.description: Further motion confirming Council will not consider removal of road works in Herdsman Parade until the Consultative Committee reaches a conclusion and Council reviews whether changes should be made.

motions.title: Enter closed session
motions.description: Meeting to be held behind closed doors to consider confidential item regarding Lot 17 Mindarie/Tamala Park land ownership media strategy, pursuant to Section 5.23 of the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Lot 17 Mindarie/Tamala Park media strategy engagement
motions.description: Confidential item concerning media strategy for Lot 17 Mindarie/Tamala Park land ownership. Council to engage Gannon Media Services at a cost of $85 per hour plus campaign costs up to $3,000 per month until 31 December 2000, with costs shared by Towns of Cambridge, Victoria Park and Vincent.

motions.title: Budget adoption for year ending 30 June 2022
motions.description: Consideration of submissions received from community consultation and adoption of the 2021/2022 annual budget, including operating budget, capital budget, reserve budget, and endowment lands account budget. Two submissions were received from the public.

motions.title: Petition - Community security patrols
motions.description: Petition signed by 371 residents of City Beach calling on the Town to fund and establish community security patrols.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 22 November 2011
motions.description: Confirmation of the Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 22 November 2011.

motions.title: Approval - Two Storey Dwelling with Undercroft Garage, 2 Adori Place
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling with undercroft garage requiring assessment under the performance criteria of the Residential Design Codes (R Codes). Lot 249 (No. 2) Adori Place, Cnr Bent Street, City Beach. Variations proposed for building wall height, buildings setback from boundary, and site works.

motions.title: Approval - Five Storey Mixed Use Development, Cambridge Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for a three storey mixed use development containing shops, offices, cafés, consulting rooms and twenty two multiple dwellings at Lots 70, 71 and 72 (No. 334-336) Cambridge Street, Wembley, seeking variations to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 Policy Manual with respect to plot ratio.

motions.title: Approval - Multi Storey Office Building, Railway Parade, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for a multi storey office building to be occupied by Western Australian Local Government Association (WALGA) for their new headquarters on Lots 50 and 500 (No. 168-170) Railway Parade, West Leederville, previously approved under Clause 45 of Town Planning Scheme No. 1 subject to further approval of details.

motions.title: WALGA Office Development - Approval of Further Details
motions.description: Application for approval of further details for a multi-level office building with basement car parking and ground floor café tenancy at Lots 50 and 500 (Nos. 168-170) Railway Parade, West Leederville, submitted by HASSELL. Concept plan previously approved under Clause 45 of Town Planning Scheme No. 1 on 24 May 2011.

motions.title: Amendment - WALGA Office Development Conditions
motions.description: Amendment to the WALGA office development motion to clarify visitor parking and add footnote regarding future access closure from Nicholson Street

motions.title: Amendment - Public Art Contribution for WALGA Development
motions.description: Amendment to add public art requirement for the WALGA office development. Public art up to 1% of development cost or equivalent cash contribution to be allocated for public art in the vicinity

motions.title: Mixed use development (offices and restaurant) at Railway Parade, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for mixed use development (offices and restaurant) submitted by Michael Little Designs at Lot 1 (No. 156) Railway Parade, West Leederville. Developer contribution towards provision of public art was raised at Committee Meeting 13 December 2011.

motions.title: Amendment to plot ratio footnote on Railway Parade application
motions.description: Amendment to add a further footnote regarding amended proposal submitted 19 December 2011 seeking plot ratio of 1.49:1.0

motions.title: Amendment to parking contribution on Railway Parade application
motions.description: Amendment to increase cash-in-lieu of parking contribution from $60,000 to $100,000 based on 8 bay shortfall at $12,500 per bay

motions.title: Two x two-storey grouped dwellings at Jukes Way, Wembley
motions.description: Application for two grouped dwellings at Lot 43 (No. 25A) Jukes Way, Wembley requiring assessment under performance criteria of Residential Design Codes regarding buildings on boundary and buildings set back from boundary. Amendment moved to add conditions regarding street tree retention, garage setback, parapet height and driveway/crossover.

motions.title: Amendment to add conditions regarding garage, street tree and driveway
motions.description: Amendment moved to add conditions (ii), (iii) and (iv) regarding street tree retention, garage setback and height, and driveway/crossover tapering at Jukes Way, Wembley

motions.title: Amendment to add driveway/crossover tapering condition
motions.description: Further amendment to add condition regarding driveway/crossover tapering to allow additional street tree

motions.title: Motion to refer Jukes Way application back to Development Committee
motions.description: Motion to refer the item relating to Lot 43 (No. 25A) Jukes Way, Wembley back to Development Committee for further consideration of alternative designs for front unit

motions.title: Two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at Dampier Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at Lot 196 (No. 43) Dampier Avenue, City Beach requiring assessment under performance criteria of Residential Design Codes regarding retaining/fill and wall height. Amendment proposed to reduce fill at rear and maintain natural ground level in south western corner.

motions.title: Amendment to reduce fill in rear yard at Dampier Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Amendment to add condition requiring natural ground level in south western corner to be maintained with no fill/retaining above 500mm

motions.title: Two storey dwelling with undercroft at Brighton Street, West Leederville - REFUSED
motions.description: Application for two-storey dwelling with undercroft at Lot 82 (No. 25) Brighton Street, West Leederville requiring assessment under performance criteria of Residential Design Codes regarding buildings on boundaries, buildings set back from boundary and building height. Application refused due to accumulation of variations and impact on amenities of adjacent properties and streetscape.

motions.title: Amended plans for two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at Ulster Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for approval of amended plans for two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at Lot 1346 (No. 33) Ulster Road, corner Donegal Road, Floreat. Applicant requested increase in finished floor level by 250mm due to sewer level issues. Both neighbours objected but amendment represents reduction from originally requested 400mm increase.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling at Salvado Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for two-storey dwelling at Lot 561 (No. 356) Salvado Road, Floreat requiring assessment under performance criteria of Residential Design Codes regarding visual privacy. Amendment added to require screening to upper floor balcony due to member concerns regarding potential overlooking.

motions.title: Amendment to add balcony screening condition at Salvado Road, Floreat
motions.description: Amendment to add condition requiring screening to upper floor balcony due to concerns regarding overlooking of adjoining property

motions.title: Request for Surfmist Colorbond roofing at Dumfries Road, Floreat - REFUSED
motions.description: Application for request to use Surfmist Colorbond roofing material for additions to single dwelling at Lot 1198 (No. 8) Dumfries Road, Floreat, subject to Local Law 43 which restricts roof reflectivity. Applicant sought dispensation citing energy efficiency benefits. Application refused as contrary to Local Law 43.

motions.title: Deferral of garage retrospective approval application
motions.description: Application for retrospective approval for a garage at Lot 41 (No. 69) Lake Monger Drive, Wembley. Councillor King suggested deferring to enable applicant to modify plans to include open grilles on garage windows facing Lake Monger Drive.

motions.title: Refusal of retrospective garage application
motions.description: Council decision to refuse the application for retrospective approval of a garage at Lot 41 (No. 69) Lake Monger Drive, Wembley submitted by Rechichi Architects, on the grounds that the proposal does not satisfy performance criteria for garage setbacks, is a dominant structure that detracts from streetscape, and would establish an undesirable precedent.

motions.title: Approval of ancillary accommodation at Lot 758, The Boulevard
motions.description: Application for ancillary accommodation at rear of residential property at Lot 758 (No. 313) The Boulevard, City Beach. Committee members expressed concern regarding the size of proposed store room and suggested it be reduced to bring the dwelling area into line with acceptable development criteria.

motions.title: Approval of pergola at Lot 231, Empire Avenue
motions.description: Application for a pergola structure located within the rear setback of dwelling at Lot 231 (No. 93) Empire Avenue, City Beach. Structure to be 2.4 metres high positioned on existing raised paving area approximately 400mm high in south-western corner of lot.

motions.title: Endorsement of Access and Parking Strategy Part 1 report
motions.description: Endorsement of the Access and Parking Strategy Part 1 - Issues, Options and Long-term Strategic Directions Report to proceed with part two of the study. Item was referred back to Council Forum at previous meeting on 22 November 2011 for further consideration following presentation by consultant Larry Schneider from Luxmoore Consulting.

motions.title: Application for four non-complying concert events at WA Athletics Stadium
motions.description: Application by Western Australian Sports Centre Trust trading as VenuesWest to conduct up to four non-complying concert events in any 12 month period at the WA Athletics Stadium, Mt Claremont. Environmental Protection (Noise) Regulations 1997 Regulation 18 approval required. One concert already held (Stevie Nicks 26 November 2011), second concert planned for 21 January 2012, and third concert (Lenny Kravitz) promoted for 28 March 2012.

motions.title: Adoption of Holyrood Street Heritage Design Concepts
motions.description: Adoption of proposed design concepts for interpretation material recognising heritage values of Holyrood Street, West Leederville. Proposals developed by Jager Studios following workshop in August 2011 with residents, artists, councillors and staff. Three main concepts proposed: entrance signage, lighting of first two fig trees with heritage photos, and provision of original era street lights.

motions.title: Temporary long-term closure of southern half of MacEwan Street
motions.description: Approval for temporary long-term closure of southern half of MacEwan Street, West Leederville for approximately 30 months to facilitate safe construction of large commercial building at 10 Oxford Close and 3-5 Loftus Street (nine storey building with 3 level basement car park approved 19 April 2011). Closure enables safe delivery and removal of materials by large trucks and semi-trailers.

motions.title: Initiation of scheme amendment for dental surgery use
motions.description: Initiation of scheme amendment application for additional use 'consulting rooms group - dental surgery' at Lot 353 (No. 24) Floreat Avenue, Floreat. Proposal for small-scale four consulting room dental surgery to operate by appointment only, located opposite Floreat Forum District Centre. Application accompanied by proposed development standards to maintain residential appearance and limit impacts on adjacent properties.

motions.title: Draft Policy 6.5 Precinct P5 West Leederville - Adoption for Advertising
motions.description: West Leederville Planning and Urban Design Study implementation through policy amendment regarding development controls, building height, setbacks, residential development, and plot ratio provisions.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications for November 2011 - Received
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority for development and sustainability during November 2011, including delegated development approvals, applications for review, and compliance matters.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority - Received
motions.description: Schedule of building and demolition licences approved under delegated authority for November 2011, with statistics and comparative data.

motions.title: Five Year Program Footpaths 2012/13 to 2016/17 - Endorsed and Funded
motions.description: Review of draft five year program for footpath upgrading and construction, covering slab to concrete replacement and new footpath requests from community consultation.

motions.title: Road Asset Management 20 Year Resurfacing Program - Endorsed
motions.description: Review of 20 year road resurfacing program (2010-2029) for maintenance of sealed roads, distributor roads, local access roads, and laneways with updated funding requirements.

motions.title: Road Improvement Capital Works Five Year Program 2012/13 to 2016/17
motions.description: Five year capital works program for road improvements including street enhancements, traffic management, intersection upgrades, accessibility improvements, and blackspot programs.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Bicycle Plan 2009 - Works Program Approved
motions.description: Approval of implementation plan for Blue Sky shared path projects with five year program of prioritized bicycle and pedestrian path construction.

motions.title: Infrastructure Parks 2012/2013 Proposed Budget Works
motions.description: Capital and non-capital projects for Infrastructure Parks service area proposed for inclusion in 2012/2013 Draft Budget, covering Parks Construction, Sportsgrounds Construction, Ocean Beaches Construction, and Road Reserves Construction.

motions.title: Lake Monger Reserve Water Quality Monitoring
motions.description: Report on current lake water quality monitoring at Lake Monger Reserve and proposed presentation to the Lake Monger Working Group of a University of Western Australia student thesis on nutrient cycling.

motions.title: Station Street Parking Restriction Amendments
motions.description: Modification of kerbside parking restrictions on the west side of Station Street between Barrett Street and Creech Lane to accommodate additional parking for nearby businesses.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council Meeting 8 December 2011
motions.description: Report on items considered at the Mindarie Regional Council meeting held on 8 December 2011, including Resource Recovery Facility Update, Process Review Committee, City of Stirling withdrawal, tipping exemption, Tamala Park lease review, and 2012 meeting dates.

motions.title: Financial Assistance Floreat Surf Life Saving Club
motions.description: Seeking financial support for Floreat Surf Lifesaving Club purchase of a new side-by-side surf rescue vehicle to replace their current quad bike which no longer meets safety standards.

motions.title: Proposed Sids and Kids Sunshine Beach Run at City Beach
motions.description: Seeking Council support for the inaugural 'Sids and Kids Sunshine Beach Run' event at City Beach on Sunday 12 February 2012 to raise funds for WA SIDS and KIDS Association.

motions.title: Fee Review 2011 Wembley Golf Course
motions.description: Annual review of fees and charges at Wembley Golf Course, implementation of marginal increases effective from 1 January 2012, and introduction of new value-added packages and early bird driving range pricing.

motions.title: Surf Club Building and Wembley Golf Course Hospitality Development Tender
motions.description: Selection of preferred Hospitality Leasing Specialist for Surf Club Building and Commercial Facilities Development at City Beach and Hospitality Development at Wembley Golf Course under Tender T37-11.

motions.title: Herdsman Main Drain stormwater reuse study
motions.description: Report on feasibility of reclaiming stormwater from Herdsman Main Drain for infiltration at Wembley Golf Course. Capital costs approximately $960,000 with annual operating costs of $125,000. Further investigations needed at cost of $150,000.

motions.title: Wembley Sports Park access, traffic and parking study
motions.description: Report on progress of Integrated Access, Traffic and Parking Study for Wembley Sports Park. Study undertaken by Aecom for State Government and Town. Two public consultation forums held in July and August 2011. Further community consultation proposed.

motions.title: Delegated authority for Christmas/New Year recess 2011/2012
motions.description: Delegation of powers and duties to Chief Executive Officer to deal with urgent items during Christmas/New Year recess from 22 December 2011 to 20 February 2012.

motions.title: Naming of YMCC Hockey clubrooms - Des and Pam Kelly Pavilion
motions.description: Request from YMCA Coastal City Hockey Club to name hockey clubrooms at Perry Lakes Reserve after [private individual — name withheld] and [private individual — name withheld] in recognition of their significant contributions to the club and community over many years.

motions.title: Payment of accounts - November 2011
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts for November 2011 in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996. Total cheque payments $759,776.65 and electronic fund transfers $10,663,009.62, totalling $11,422,786.27.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - November 2011
motions.description: Report on investment portfolio performance for November 2011. Total investments of $27.8 million comprising Municipal Funds $16.2 million, Reserve Funds $2 million, and Endowment Lands Funds $9.6 million. Weighted average interest rate of 5.80% on weighted average investment period of 143 days.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements - November 2011
motions.description: Review of financial position for period ended 30 November 2011. Operating profit $13.156 million. Capital expenditure $2.786 million against year to date budget of $5.635 million. Overall cash surplus $16.048 million.

motions.title: Annual General Meeting of Electors 2010/11 - Decisions
motions.description: Report on Annual General Meeting of Electors held 14 December 2011 with 5 ratepayers present. Annual Report for 2010/2011 approved. Garden Competition Award Ceremony held. No decisions requiring Council consideration made.

motions.title: Surf Club Building - Tender T20-11 Architectural Services
motions.description: Award of Tender T20-11 for architectural services for Surf Club and Commercial Facilities Development at City Beach. Christou Design Group selected at indicative cost of $536,000. Tender assessment confidential. Conditions include report on new lease agreement and approval before commencement of work.

motions.title: Metropolitan Local Government Review - Submission
motions.description: Approval of Town's submission to Metropolitan Local Government Review Panel in response to Issues Paper. Themes include transitional approach to local government structure, no major shift in responsibilities between state and local government, and community of interest and localism as key to successful local government.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council - City of Stirling withdrawal
motions.description: Consideration of City of Stirling's withdrawal from Mindarie Regional Council. PriceWaterhouseCoopers valuation rejected due to flawed assumptions. Town position detailed regarding payment terms, Resource Recovery Facility guarantee, and post-closure liabilities. City of Stirling seeking approximately $9.285 million payout.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council withdrawal - Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to the original motion regarding the Town of Cambridge's position on the City of Stirling's withdrawal from Mindarie Regional Council and the implications for Cambridge.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council withdrawal - Council Decision
motions.description: Council decision on the Town of Cambridge's position regarding the City of Stirling's withdrawal from Mindarie Regional Council, including conditions for potential withdrawal by Cambridge.

motions.title: Confidential Reports - Closed Session Motion
motions.description: Motion to move into closed session to discuss confidential matters in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(a) of the Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Chief Executive Officer - Annual Review
motions.description: Consideration of the confidential Final Performance Appraisal report prepared by the CEO Performance Review Committee.

motions.title: Annual Report 2012/2013 adoption
motions.description: The 2012/2013 Annual Report outlining the activities of the Town over the past financial year had been circulated and is posted on the Council's website.

motions.title: Leave of Absence – Cr MacRae
motions.description: Approval for leave of absence for Cr MacRae for 6-10 June 2005 inclusive, in accordance with Clause 2.9 of the Standing Orders.

motions.title: Petition – Northwood Street Traffic Calming
motions.description: A petition signed by 62 residents of Northwood Street, West Leederville requesting upgraded traffic calming measures and requesting that plans to construct a 'Shared Path' be dropped.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Special Meeting 10 May 2005 and Ordinary Meeting 26 April 2005 and Special Meeting 18 May 2005, with amendment to Item CCS05.31 replacing 'Business Plan' with 'Tender No.TAC03-04'.

motions.title: Leederville Croquet Courts – Future Use Proposal
motions.description: Review of future use of Leederville Croquet Courts following relocation of croquet clubs to Floreat Oval. Proposal to amalgamate courts with Holyrood Park and include improvements such as playground relocation, picnic area, and landscaping.

motions.title: West Leederville – Parking Review – Information Received
motions.description: Receipt of information contained in West Leederville Parking Review report relating to kerbside parking strategy and future investigation of parking guidelines.

motions.title: West Leederville Kerbside Parking Report - Receipt
motions.description: To receive the information contained in the West Leederville Kerbside Parking report (Item TS05.03) following deferral and workshop consideration.

motions.title: Kerbside Parking Review - West Leederville
motions.description: Further reports to be prepared on kerbside parking restrictions, including increased no-stopping distances at intersections, timed parking restrictions, town planning scheme review, residential parking permits, yellow line markings, and paid parking meters. Yellow line markings to be installed in Salvado Road.

motions.title: Cromarty Road - Road Works and Traffic Calming
motions.description: Western Power to reinstate Cromarty Road when high voltage power is placed underground, to provide road pavement traffic calming devices for 30 kph design speed including blister islands, roundabout, traffic island, removal of median island, parking embayment, and shared path.

motions.title: Rationalisation of The Boulevard Road Reserve
motions.description: Request to Minister for Planning and Infrastructure to close a portion of The Boulevard road reserve between Salvado Road and Cambridge Street, Wembley, reducing the road easement width from 40 metres to 30 metres.

motions.title: West Coast Highway Realignment - Bold Park
motions.description: Request to Minister for Planning and Infrastructure to close a portion of West Coast Highway road easement (Loc 13372) and dedicate a section of Class A Reserve 45409 - Bold Park (Loc 13373) as a road, including management of service authority easements.

motions.title: Black Spot Road Safety Program 2006/2007
motions.description: Approval of two road safety projects for submission to State Government Black Spot Road Grants program: Jersey Street/Ruislip Street intersection and Pangbourne Street/Ruislip Street intersection, both involving installation of medians and stop signs.

motions.title: WESROC Total Water Cycle Monitoring Program 2004
motions.description: Receipt of WESROC Total Water Monitoring Program report; continued infiltration of stormwater; development of education program on domestic fertilizer application; trial of street sweeping to reduce heavy metals from road stormwater.

motions.title: Horticulture Management Programs Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of three horticulture management programs (Garden Beds, Park Trees, and Turf) developed following an asset audit, with proposed budget funding for 2005-2006 totalling $84,095 for implementation on an ongoing basis.

motions.title: Confirmation of Corporate and Customer Services Committee Minutes
motions.description: Confirmation of the minutes of the Ordinary meeting of the Corporate and Customer Services Committee held on 18 April 2005.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of payment of accounts to fund the Town's operation, comprising cheque payments from Municipal and Trust accounts totalling $1,889,259.20 and Electronic Fund Transfers totalling $1,030,670.98, for a total of $2,919,931.18.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - April 2005
motions.description: Receipt of the Investment Schedule as at 30 April 2005, detailing invested surplus funds with distribution across three sources (general, reserves, and Endowment Lands) with weighted average interest of 6.93% against Bank Bill Index benchmark of 6.21%.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements - April 2005
motions.description: Receipt of the Financial Statements for the period ended 30 April 2005, showing operating profit of $4,866,306 and working capital of $15,198,318.

motions.title: Financial Statements Quarterly Review - March 2005
motions.description: Review of financial performance and budget variations for quarter ended 31 March 2005, with working capital of $17.3 million and net operating profit of $6,367,748 against budgeted profit of $6,149,900. Approval of budget reallocations totalling $6,300 across five capital/non-capital projects including tavern roof repair, bore/pump replacement, landscape enhancement, sports club repairs, and electrical equipment upgrade.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Notification that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to one document: Withdrawal of Caveat on 362 (Lot 18) Cambridge Street Wembley relating to a Heritage Agreement dated 13 April 2005.

motions.title: Seniors Needs Advisory Committee Abolishment
motions.description: Decision to discontinue the Seniors Needs Advisory Committee (SNAC) effective 31 May 2005, as the Administration has adequate resources to meet seniors policy and plan requirements. Three community members had applied for reappointment: Kim Coleman, Audrey Milburn Morsley, and John Walsh. Policy 2.1.34 relating to SNAC Terms of Reference to be deleted.

motions.title: Cambridge Library Fees and Charges Review 2005/2006
motions.description: Adoption of revised fees and charges for Cambridge Library effective 1 July 2005. No increases proposed for most services except Group Studies Room (increased from $5 to $10 per hour) and Reading Room (increased from $10 to $15 per hour). Library bag fee reduced due to consortium purchasing arrangement. CEO authorised to waive fees under Local Government Act 1995 s.6.12(1)(b) for special circumstances.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges – Community Development, Youth Services and Beach Volleyball
motions.description: Annual review of fee structures for entry programs and services within Community Development and Youth Services, including beach volleyball courts at City Beach and Floreat Beach.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Cambridge Seniors Services
motions.description: Annual review of fee structure for Cambridge Seniors Services, including centre-based programs, home-based programs, and outings for seniors.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Wembley Community Centre and the Leederville Town Hall
motions.description: Annual review of fee structures for Wembley Community Centre and Leederville Town Hall, including room hire, programs, equipment hire, bonds, storage, cancellation fees, and penalties.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges – Sports Grounds and Reserves
motions.description: Annual review of fee structures for sports grounds and reserves including enclosed grounds, sundry reserves, turf wickets, wedding licences, and commercial rates with 3.4% increase aligned to Perth region CPI.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges – Bold Park Aquatic Centre
motions.description: Annual review of entry fees, programs and services at Bold Park Aquatic Centre with proposed increases of 7-10% to offset operational cost increases and maintain competitive positioning.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - Quarry Amphitheatre
motions.description: Annual review of fees and charges for Quarry Amphitheatre including ticketing charges, main auditorium hire, cavern hire, and technical charges with proposed 3% increase.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges – The Boulevard Centre
motions.description: Annual review of fee structures for The Boulevard Centre including room hire with tiered pricing, equipment hire, and introduction of new Community (Fee Charging) rate category for not-for-profit organisations charging participation fees.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges - General Fees and Charges
motions.description: Annual review of miscellaneous council service fees including cat sterilisation, infringement agency costs, administration charges, law enforcement charges, and freedom of information staff time charges.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Lease Outdoor Deck
motions.description: Approval of a Lease of Additional Premises for an outdoor deck area at Wembley Golf Complex to Nedgo Pty Ltd (lessee of Fairway Tavern). The deck area would seat 80 people, be sheltered from coastal wind, and shaded using shade sails. All costs estimated at $20,000 would be met by the lessee.

motions.title: Rights of Way Acquisition Minn Lane

motions.description: Application for change of use from residential to community purpose for operation of Family Support Centre by Herdsman Neighbourhood Centre Association Inc.

motions.title: Part Lot 364 Salvado Road Wembley - Two storey grouped dwelling approval
motions.description: Application for two storey grouped dwelling at rear of property with variation to carport side setback boundary requirements and conditions for existing dwelling compliance.

motions.title: Two storey dwelling, Barrington Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling at Lot 19 (No. 8) Barrington Street, West Leederville by Steven Radalj, with variations to front setback, fencing in front setback area, ground and upper floor side setbacks, and wall height. motions.title: Two storey dwelling, The Boulevard, Floreat
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling at Lot 1294 (No. 169) The Boulevard, Floreat, submitted by Zorzi Builders. motions.title: Single storey dwelling, The Boulevard, Wembley
motions.description: Application for a single storey dwelling at Lot 80 (No. 2B) The Boulevard, Wembley, submitted by J Corp T/As Impressions. Variations to front setback, side setbacks, open space, private open space dimension, and landscaping. No objections from adjoining property owners.

motions.description: Application for a single storey dwelling at Lot 257 (No. 681) Hay Street, Jolimont, submitted by Tangent Nominees. Variation to front setback garage. Existing dwelling to be demolished. No objections from adjoining property owners.

motions.description: Application for fibro cement and lattice screen wall in front setback area on side boundary. Council not prepared to approve in present form; applicant advised to modify fence to 1:1 ratio lattice infill. CEO authorised to approve if amended plans submitted.

Total of 47 building licences, 7 provisional building licences, and 9 demolition licences issued with construction value of $10,726,234.

motions.title: Approval for Attendance at AICD/WALGA Governance Course

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium redevelopment alternative strategy
motions.description: Council considered an alternative development strategy for Perry Lakes Stadium following a meeting with the Minister for Planning and Infrastructure and Minister for Sport and Recreation on 19 May 2005. The Government outlined it would not contribute to refurbishment of the existing stadium or lift 'urban deferred' zoning. Council had previously approved an in-principle alternative strategy on 18 May 2005.

motions.title: Amendment to Perry Lakes Stadium motion - clause (ii)
motions.description: An amendment was moved by Cr Gow to modify clause (ii) of the main motion regarding the alternative development strategy, proposing to hold the matter over pending resolution of other clauses rather than rejecting the strategy outright.

motions.title: Amendment to Perry Lakes Stadium motion - clauses (iii) and (iv)(a)
motions.description: An amendment was moved by Mayor Anderton to add a capital contribution cap of $20 million (indexed) and to remove reference to 'as originally proposed in the Business Plan (dated March 2005)'.

motions.title: Amendment to Perry Lakes Stadium motion - clause (iv)(a)
motions.description: An amendment was moved by Cr Langer to add reference to clearance of 'conditions precedent' and inclusion of relocation of the Riding for the Disabled.

motions.title: Tender TAC 03-04 Perry Lakes Stadium redevelopment deferral
motions.description: Council considered the tender award for redevelopment of Perry Lakes Stadium. In view of the Council decision at Item CCS05.55 (the alternative development strategy motion), Members agreed to defer the tender item for further consideration.

motions.description: Discussion and receipt of discussion paper by CEO on future of Perry Lakes Stadium including refurbishment options and alternative uses.

motions.description: Adoption of Annual Financial Statements for year ended 30 June 1995 and approval of transfer of unallocated current position surplus to reserves.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium Future Use Discussion
motions.description: Discussion of options for the future use of Perry Lakes Stadium including refurbishment, demolition, downgrading, conversion to parkland, or residential development. The motion seeks to receive the CEO's discussion paper and notify the State Government of the Council's intention to ascertain their position on athletics track replacement.

motions.title: Adoption of Annual Financial Statements and Reserve Transfers
motions.description: Adoption of the Annual Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 1995 (the Council's first full year of operation), setting the date for the Annual General Meeting of Electors, bringing forward carried works funds, and transferring unallocated surplus to reserves for area improvements and plant replacement.

motions.description: Request for approval of leave of absence for Cr Hilary Pinerua from 13 April to 24 May 2009 inclusive, in accordance with Clause 3.7 of the Standing Orders.

motions.description: Request for a deputation to be heard in relation to Item DV09.19 (Lot 1355 No. 13 Kilkenny Road, Floreat - Two Storey Dwelling). The request was made at the meeting in relation to amended plans submitted this evening.

motions.title: Display Home - Dunblane Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for a display home (use not listed) at Lot 903 (No. 1) Dunblane Road, corner Pearson Street, Floreat, submitted by Stannard Investment Pty Ltd. The dwelling is currently under construction and is intended to be used for display purposes for two to three years with limited opening hours.

motions.title: Two Storey Dwelling - Hesperia Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Application for a two storey dwelling requiring assessment under performance criteria of the Residential Design Codes and Town of Cambridge Residential Design Guidelines in respect of front setback, rear setback and fencing in the front setback area. Amended plans dated 9 March 2009 submitted addressing neighbour objections regarding rear setback, visual privacy, and fencing.

motions.title: Two Storey Dwelling - Kilkenny Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for new two storey dwelling with variations to building height (towers), buildings on boundary (eastern parapet wall), and excavation/fill. Committee voted against the administration recommendation. During council debate, applicant submitted amended plans dated 23 March 2009 reducing western tower height from 7.9 metres to maximum 7.5 metres and adding windows to southern elevation. A motion to refuse (Committee Recommendation) was put and lost. Final motion to approve with amended plans was carried.

motions.title: Garage/Workshop, Fence and Pergola - Alexander Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for additions to single dwelling comprising garage/workshop with boundary wall along southern boundary, timber pergola positioned 300mm from northern boundary, and brick fence along right of way boundary. Applicant proposes use for caravan maintenance with reduced wall height of 2.743 metres compared to original plans showing 2.9 metres.

motions.title: Conversion of Carport to Garage - Reserve Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application to reduce side setback of a constructed garage from previously approved 1.0 metre to 500mm from southern lot boundary. The garage was originally approved with 1.0 metre setback on 5 September 2008, but was constructed at 300mm. Applicant now seeks to modify to 500mm setback. Neighbour objected to the reduced setback citing overshadowing, impact on future renovation plans, and fire regulation restrictions.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Redevelopment - Subdivision and Design Guidelines
motions.description: Motion to advise WAPC of Council's support for Perry Lakes Redevelopment subdivision application stages 1 and 2, Design Guidelines and Detailed Area Plans, and to clarify the legal basis for implementation.

motions.title: WAPC Draft Perth Coastal Planning Strategy Submission
motions.description: Motion to submit Council comments on the draft Perth Coastal Planning Strategy to the Department of Planning and Infrastructure, opposing extension of MRS reserves and requesting greater autonomy for coastal management and infrastructure funding.

motions.title: Residential Design Guidelines Review - Streetscape Policy Adoption
motions.description: Motion to adopt amended Streetscape Policy 3.2 for advertising, revoke Clause 2.2 on Buildings on the Boundary, and establish three replacement policies for the Residential Design Guidelines.

motions.title: Town Planning Delegation of Authority Policy Review
motions.description: Motion to adopt amended Delegation of Authority Policy 2.6 for advertising to improve efficiency of planning decision-making process.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications for February 2009 - Received
motions.description: Motion to receive the report on delegated decisions and notifications for February 2009.

motions.title: Building Licences February 2009 - Received
motions.description: Motion to receive the schedule of building and demolition licences approved under delegated authority for February 2009.

motions.title: 36 Windarra Drive verge development deferral
motions.description: Revised application for non-complying verge development at 36 Windarra Drive, City Beach. A landscaping plan was previously refused for non-compliance with Policy No. 5.2.19. The owner has now submitted a revised plan that incorporates paving for pedestrian access. The Committee deferred the item to allow a revised application to be submitted for full review by Administration.

motions.title: Woolwich Street kerbside parking proposals
motions.description: Review proposals for kerbside parking provisions in Woolwich Street adjacent to the West Leederville Primary School. The Council had previously decided on removing Kiss and Drive restrictions from certain locations. A detailed plan showing parking embayments and on-street parking bays was prepared and presented to the school principal. Proposal 2 was preferred, creating maximum parking bays adjacent to the school with specific time restrictions.

motions.title: Salvado Road traffic management amendment
motions.description: Proposal for vehicle speed reducing measures for the section of Salvado Road between Jersey Street and Selby Street. Community survey of 130 residents showed support for traffic speed reduction measures, with preference for speed humps over blister islands. An amendment was moved during the committee meeting to consider the measures in conjunction with the Pat Goodridge Precinct Master Plan.

motions.title: Western Metropolitan Regional Council waste facility usage
motions.description: Proposal to dispose of some or all of the Town's municipal waste at the new alternative waste treatment facility established by the Western Metropolitan Regional Council (WMRC). The Town is currently a member of the Mindarie Regional Council (MRC) and required to deliver waste to MRC facilities. A request for exemption from MRC is needed to use the WMRC facility. The WMRC facility uses the DiCOM System technology located at the Brockway Transfer Station.

motions.title: Mindarie Regional Council meeting report received
motions.description: Report on strategic items considered at the Mindarie Regional Council meeting held on 5 March 2009, including Business Report on the Establishment Agreement, Resource Recovery Facility Progress Report, Mid Year Financial Review, and Strategic Waste Minimisation Plan with details of seven funded projects.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex tender discussion motion
motions.description: Motion to discuss the Wembley Golf Complex Development tenders for new driving range, pro-shop refurbishment, entry road and car parking behind closed doors. Three tender packages were released: T22-08 Driving Range, T23-08 Pro-Shop Refurbishment, and T24-08 Car Parking and Entry Road. Multiple tenders were received for each package. Tender evaluation was undertaken in accordance with WALGA Purchasing and Tender Guide 2005.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex tender award and budget approval
motions.description: Award of tenders for Stage 1 of Wembley Golf Complex Master Plan to Esslemont Building and Civil for three packages: Driving Range (T22-08), Pro-Shop Refurbishment (T23-08), and Car Parking and Entry Road (T24-08). Project construction budget approved at $12,000,000 (ex GST). Loan of up to $12 million approved through West Australian Treasury Corporation.

motions.title: 2008 Compliance Audit Return adoption
motions.description: Adoption of the 2008 Compliance Audit Return for the period 1 January to 31 December 2008. The return identifies some minor anomalies related to delegation of power/duty and finance provisions. Full compliance was not achieved in formalisation of sub delegations and facility hire deposits/bonds handling. A register of Sub-delegations is being prepared to achieve full compliance.

motions.title: Disaster Appeal Donations policy adoption
motions.description: Adoption of a new policy prescribing the provision of financial assistance in response to appeals launched by bona fide Australian disaster relief agencies. The policy provides guidance on eligible appeals, financial support (range $1,000 to $5,000 maximum), non-financial support options, and treatment of international disasters. The policy was developed following the Council's $10,000 donation to the Victorian Bushfires Appeal in February 2009.

motions.title: Payment of accounts February 2009 confirmation
motions.description: Confirmation of the payment of accounts for the period 1 February 2009 to 28 February 2009 in accordance with the Local Government Act (Financial Management) Regulations. Total payments comprised cheque payments of $1,500,331.13 and EFT payments of $10,108,523.33, with total payments of $11,608,854.46.

motions.title: Investment Schedule February 2009
motions.description: Review of Council's investment performance for the period ended 28 February 2009.

motions.title: Financial Statements Monthly Review February 2009
motions.description: Review of financial performance for the eight month period ended 28 February 2009 with commentary on permanent and timing variances. Includes approval for replacement Senior Services Bus capital budget amendment of $136K funded from reserve funds and trade-in proceeds.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements February 2009
motions.description: Receipt of Financial Statements for the period ended 28 February 2009, provided on a monthly basis to monitor actual performance against budgets and aid in decision making.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Loan Renewal
motions.description: Approval to refinance existing $2.4 million loan facility for Wembley Golf Complex irrigation system. Original loan was for $2.8 million taken in 2005 at 6.15% fixed rate for five years expiring 28 May 2009. Amendment was made at committee level to maintain current loan repayment amounts (principal and interest).

motions.title: Local Government Reform WESROC Actions
motions.description: Consideration of local government structural reform agenda including voluntary amalgamation, reducing elected members to 6-9, and forming regional groupings. Town's participation in WESROC and its own reform options discussed. WESROC commissioned Dollery Report with 17 reform recommendations. Cambridge already complies with elected members requirement (8 Councillors + Mayor). Assessment of amalgamation options being undertaken by WESROC with costs/benefits analysis due April 2009.

motions.title: Internal Audit Plan Three Year
motions.description: Consideration of three-year internal audit plan submitted by Santo Caselli and Associates covering all areas of Town's financial management systems. Year 1 covers fees/charges, bonds/deposits, debtors invoices, governance systems, and financial reporting. Year 2 covers accounts payable, purchasing, payroll, stores. Year 3 covers risk management, asset management module, and investment policy. Initial focus on governance systems compliance.

motions.title: Audit Plan 2009
motions.description: Adoption of Audit Plan for 2009 setting out key areas for Audit Committee to review. Plan includes Annual Financial Statements review, Internal Audit, Annual Financial Audit and Budget Reviews, Local Government Compliance Return, and Risk Management Plan.

motions.title: Risk Management Policy Amendment
motions.description: Progress report on Town's Risk Management systems development and implementation. Amendment to Provisional Risk Management Policy 3.2.9 to incorporate risk matrix and change $50,000 threshold for Minor/Moderate consequences to $100,000. Includes development of risk management strategy, audit tools, training program, risk register and profiling system based on Australian Standard AS4360:2004.

Ranger surveillance of parking in vicinity of small bar at No. 294 Cambridge Street showed decline in vehicles. Amendment to introduce residential parking scheme for Nanson Street with restrictions 'No Parking, 5pm to midnight, Thursday to Saturday, Residential Permit exempted' was carried 4/0 at committee meeting. Mayor then moved an amendment to revert to verge parking restrictions only, which lost 4/5. Final council decision approved the residential parking scheme.

The revised Parking Policy introduces parking provisions for bicycles, formalises criteria for considering concessions to car parking ratios based on proximity to public transport, walkability of centre, end of trip facilities, reciprocal parking and cash-in-lieu. Also introduces requirement for parking management plans for non-residential applications of 10 or more spaces or where concessions are sought.

motions.title: 44 McCourt Street, Leederville - Continuation of Consulting Room

The applicant, [private individual — name withheld], seeks to take over an existing specialist obstetrics and gynaecology practice with one consulting room. The proposal complies with Town Planning Scheme requirements and previous limited approvals were granted in 1988 and 1990. No formal complaints have been received over the last five years.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval (Lights) - WAPC Decision

The decision includes approval for Stages 2, 3a and 3b of the overall development plan. The Commission has imposed numerous conditions including requirement for an Impact Management Strategy, establishment of a Management Committee, and developer contribution of $40,000 per annum indexed to CPI.

motions.title: Lot 300 Ruislip Street, West Leederville - Two Storey Residence

Site area 300 square metres with proposed floorspace of 146.2 square metres and 63 percent open space.

motions.title: 27 Daglish Street, Wembley - Proposed New Residence

motions.title: 29 Kinkuna Way, City Beach - Three Storey Residence

Applicant agreed to delete terrace on third floor western boundary.

Council decided not to proceed with the rezoning following community consultation which received 16 submissions (11 with no objection, 5 objecting). Main concerns from objectors related to proposed development concept plan including overshadowing, overlooking, visual impact, and traffic/parking issues.

Three objections were received from neighbouring property owners at 16 McCourt Street, Unit 2/16 McCourt Street and 6 McCourt Street, expressing concerns about plot ratio, parking, overshadowing, and the impact of residential apartments on neighbouring medical practices.

During committee discussion, Members expressed concern about the extent of parking in the front setback area in light of traffic congestion in McCourt Street.

motions.title: Lot 272 Camborne Avenue City Beach single storey dwelling
motions.description: Application for building approval seeking variations to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 for a single storey dwelling with side and rear setback variations.

motions.title: Strata Lot 1 Northwood Street West Leederville upper storey addition and carport
motions.description: Application for alterations and additions seeking variations to Residential Design Codes and Town Residential Design Guidelines for upper storey addition and carport.

motions.title: Second storey additions Lot 478 McKenzie Street Wembley
motions.description: Application for second storey additions and alterations to existing dwelling with variation to wall height. Two community submissions received objecting on grounds of overshadowing, privacy, and visual impact. Assessment against performance criteria for wall height and visual privacy variations concluded proposal meets criteria subject to screening condition.

motions.title: Additions to dwelling Lot 3 Brookdale Street Floreat
motions.description: Application for additions to front and rear of existing single storey dwelling requiring variation to primary street setback. Site is corner location on curve of intersection sloping up from street with unusual lot shape. Assessment concluded proposal meets performance criteria as site location and shape support setback variation. Absolute majority decision required.

motions.title: Alterations and additions Strata Lot 1 Alderbury Street Floreat
motions.description: Application for alterations and additions to existing residence including replacement and extension of rear section (remaining single storey), new porch, fence and carport at front. Variations sought for fencing distance between piers, side and rear setbacks. Side and rear setbacks handled under delegated authority as neighbours provided no objection. Council consideration required for front fence piers variation.

motions.title: Proposed landing Lot 65 The Boulevard Floreat
motions.description: Application for building approval seeking variations to visual privacy requirements for a proposed landing. Landing constructed of limestone blocks, 6m x 4.1m with maximum height 0.7m, attached to rear of dwelling. Neighbouring property to west objected on privacy grounds citing overlooking to courtyard, dining room and bedrooms. Proposal assessed against R Codes performance criteria for visual privacy with consideration of screening provided by existing vegetation, shed and fence.

motions.title: Fencing in street setback Lot 802 Salvado Road Floreat
motions.description: Application for fencing within primary and secondary street setback areas. Proposed treated pine picket fence 1.2m high along Lissadell Street (primary); along Salvado Road (secondary) same fence sits on limestone retaining wall ranging 100-500mm, increasing total height to 1.7m. Fence exceeds permeability provisions of RDGs. Solid gate proposed on eastern boundary.

motions.title: Proposed front fence Lot 418 Adina Road City Beach
motions.description: Application for front fence with variations to RDGs requirements. Site on southern side of Adina Road at intersection of Marapana Road. Two storey dwelling under construction. Proposed combination of permeable fencing with infill panels and solid fencing to maximum 2.10m height. Designed to retain two large native eucalypt trees. Fence encloses front setback area providing privacy and screening from vehicle headlight glare and traffic noise.

motions.title: Proposed fencing Lot 4 Boronia Crescent City Beach
motions.description: Application for open style fencing along front boundary and solid fencing along side boundaries within front setback area. Two storey dwelling under construction. Front fencing proposed as 0.6m solid brick wall with open infill panels and piers above. Side boundaries proposed as 1.8m high solid walls. Southern boundary includes 0.5m retaining wall with 1.8m wall above. Three piers exceed maximum width. Neighbours consulted.

motions.title: Retrospective approval illegally constructed loft Lot 174 Tilton Terrace City Beach
motions.description: Application for retrospective approval of illegally constructed loft area. Original building licence approved June 2005 for 'plant room' with pull down staircase. Builder constructed loft as habitable room with internal staircase, different location, greater area and windows instead of louvres. Stop work order issued. Loft wall height 8.3m exceeds prescribed 6.5m. Visual privacy issues with overlooking to adjoining properties. Neighbours objected on grounds of illegal construction, height, privacy, and questioning Council's authority to grant retrospective approval.

motions.title: Alterations and additions to dwelling at Lot 124 Tilton Terrace
motions.description: Application for retrospective approval for alterations and additions to an existing dwelling including a loft structure and screen wall, which were constructed without prior approval contrary to R-Codes requirements for building height and visual privacy.

motions.title: Review of Council Policies – Development and Environmental Services
motions.description: Biennial review of Council's Development and Environmental Services policies with minor amendments to update and improve administration management practices.

motions.title: New Lions Ear and Hearing Institute Building plus Presbytery Additions referral from City of Subiaco
motions.description: Comments provided to City of Subiaco on a development application for a new medical research building with basement carpark and presbytery additions at No. 1 Salvado Road, Subiaco, with concerns regarding vehicle access proximity to intersection with Haydn Bunton Drive and parking provisions for church congregation.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Environmental Management System Update
motions.description: Progress report on environmental management system development since November 2004, addressing chemical storage, fertiliser use, fuel storage, irrigation, waste management, flora and fauna regeneration, bush and tree management, and emergency planning.

motions.title: Sustainable Gardening Practices – Great Gardens Workshop
motions.description: Report on the success of the Great Gardens workshop hosted by Town of Cambridge in October 2005, attended by 110 participants, covering sustainable gardening practices, water conservation, and environmental management.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme No. 1 Amendment No. 16 – Tavern Office and Storage at Lot 4 Kerr Street
motions.description: Adoption of amendment to allow additional use of tavern office and storage at residential property adjacent to tavern on Cambridge Street, West Leederville, with development standards and conditions to maintain residential character and limit amenity impacts.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications
motions.description: Report on matters dealt with under delegated authority in October 2005 including subdivisions, grouped dwellings, home occupations, alterations and additions. Also reports on applications for review determined by State Administrative Tribunal.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data of building licences approved under delegated authority in October 2005, reporting 50 building licences issued with total construction value of $10,900,130.

motions.title: Provision of Infill Sewerage to City Beach
motions.description: Motion seeking CEO to make representations to Minister for Water Supply and Sewerage and Minister for Health to arrange deputation comprising Mayor and Coast Ward Councillors to discuss infill sewerage provision for remaining unsewered areas of City Beach.

motions.title: Bold Park Deed of Agreement
motions.description: Motion seeking to instruct solicitors to issue writs or summons for transfer and surrender of Areas A, G and H per Deed of Agreement sealed in May 1995, with incorporation of comment in December 2005 report on Areas F and G, and obtaining preliminary legal advice on avenues to reclaim land.

motions.title: Representation on Statutory Authorities and Public Bodies – Waste Management Board
motions.description: Request for nomination of Council representative to Waste Management Board vacancy, with decision to receive the request.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Redevelopment Bill 2005 – Referral to Special Meeting
motions.description: Report on actions taken to oppose Perry Lakes Redevelopment Bill 2005, including Task Force activities, lobbying efforts, petition with 1,648 signatures, and public meeting with 600 attendees. Matter referred to Special Meeting of Council on 24 November 2005.

motions.title: CEO Recruitment Process and Acting CEO Appointment
motions.description: Appointment of external Recruitment Consultant to co-ordinate recruitment process following resignation of Graham Partridge as CEO. Formation of CEO Recruitment Sub-Committee and appointment of Acting CEO.

motions.title: Defer Committee and Council Meeting Schedule
motions.description: Consideration of the monthly Committee and Council meetings schedule for the period from December 2007 to October 2009, together with the appointment of Standing Committee members was deferred to allow induction of newly elected members.
